31559.s: The bill repeals the Invoeringswet Wet werk en bijstand and amends the Wet werk en bijstand, mainly by restructuring recovery (verhaal) of benefit costs from a municipal duty into a discretionary power and adding transitional provisions. It also updates cross-references in several other statutes to the recovery rules in paragraph 6.5 of the WWB.
31559.j: The memorandum justifies the change to a recovery power by noting that municipalities can now decide for themselves whether and when to recover, following the WWB and the Vierde tranche Awb.
q: For this reason the current second paragraph of article 92 of the Abw can also lapse.
Om deze reden kan ook het huidige tweede lid van artikel 92 van de Abw vervallen.
d: rules on benefits for starting self-employed persons (Bbz)
commencement and repeal of provisions for self-employed by royal decree
p: Recovery of benefit costs changes from a mandatory duty to a power the municipality may exercise at its discretion, with court-based procedures and a right of objection for debtors.
Minister may continue benefits to Dutch nationals abroad on terms adjusted to circumstances, with sunset after 26 weeks.

parties: Asks whether removing the AMvB on artists' benefits leaves applicants able to prove artistic work and who sets the conditions, and whether the seizure-free allowance is still guaranteed or only 'taken into account'.
However, the SP members still have some questions.
Wel hebben de leden van de SP-fractie nog enkele vragen.
Asks how benefit termination for artists inactive for more than a year will be regulated, given that conditions can no longer be set by AMvB, and on what statutory basis.
Since the conditions for ending the benefit cannot be regulated by AMvB, the VVD members ask how this is now arranged?
Aangezien het niet mogelijk is de voorwaarden voor beëindiging van de uitkering bij AMvB te regelen, vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie hoe dit nu wordt geregeld?

31577.s: The bill creates a new power for the UWV and related social insurance bodies to grant wage-cost subsidies to employers who hire benefit recipients, subject to an individual indication decision and conditions. It also adds participation-place rules for municipalities, including a ceiling on subsidies and allowed deviations from the statutory minimum wage, and sets sunset arrangements for the temporary schemes.
31577.j: The memorandum justifies discretion by saying the UWV decides objectively on whether subsidised work is the most suitable instrument, and that refusals are open to objection and appeal.
q: Subsidy provision, as with municipalities, is a power for the UWV, not a right for an employee or employer.
Het gaat bij de subsidieverstrekking, net als bij gemeenten, om een bevoegdheid voor het UWV, niet om een recht voor een werknemer of werkgever.
d: further subsidy conditions and subsidy ceiling for wage-cost subsidies
further subsidy conditions and ceiling for self-employed wage subsidies
further subsidy conditions and ceiling for disabled youth wage subsidies
further subsidy conditions and ceiling for WAO wage subsidies
further subsidy conditions and ceiling for WIA wage subsidies
municipal discretion on training, premiums and extension of additional work placements
municipal council rules on activation, training and premiums for older benefit recipients
municipal council rules on activation, training and premiums for former self-employed
p: Artikel I A, 78a lid 4 en 8 WW e.a.
UWV is given discretionary authority to decide whether subsidised employment is the appropriate instrument for an individual, subject to objective criteria and appeal.
Artikel VIII C, 10a lid 8-10 WWB and IX/X C, 38 lid 7-9 IOAW/IOAZ
Municipalities gain discretion to end or extend additional work placements after set periods based on assessments of the person's employment prospects.
Participation-place rules and the earlier horizon provision are kept in force or lapse by royal decree rather than by statute, limiting parliamentary control over timing.

parties: Asks how effectiveness of wage-cost subsidies is measured, whether the instrument is needed, and how selection and cost-benefit are justified, implying the government should demonstrate results.
An important question is how it will be determined what the actual contribution of wage-cost subsidies is to outflow into regular work.
Een belangrijke vraag is hoe wordt vastgesteld wat de feitelijke bijdrage is van loonkostensubsidies aan de uitstroom naar regulier werk.
Questions restrictions on temporary agencies, the basis for cost estimates and displacement, and asks for clarity on subsidy ceilings and rules, pressing for transparency.
The PvdA members ask whether this arrangement is not too restrictive.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of deze regeling niet te beperkend is.

Worries that subsidised workers could be used as cheap labour without rights, fair treatment or guaranteed transition, and asks how guidance, supervision and enforcement are secured and who is responsible.
This must not lead to people being deployed as cheap labour without any rights, tailored support and prospects.
Dit mag er niet toe leiden dat mensen als goedkope arbeidkrachten ingezet worden zonder enig rechten, maatwerk en perspectief.
Disappointed that more money is proposed despite past failure of subsidised jobs, and asks for evidence and for the CPB and OECD findings to be taken into account.
The VVD members ask how, despite billions spent on reintegration of these groups with little success, the government still thinks more money is the solution.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe het kan dat ondanks de miljarden budgetten die in de re-integratie van deze groepen gepompt is, met helaas weinig succes, de regering nog steeds denkt dat meer geld de oplossing is.
Asks detailed questions on UWV discretion, the absence of employer and worker involvement and appeal options, and on safeguards such as job coaches and support for workers who drop out.
They note that granting the subsidy is a power of the UWV and not a right of the worker and employer.
Zij constateren dat de subsidieverstrekking een bevoegdheid is van UWV en geen recht van werknemer en werkgever.

v.summary: The Raad van State supported the bill creating loonkostensubsidie and participatieplaatsen but objected to provisions allowing a royal decree (AMvB) to repeal the subsidy provisions, as this would let a lower regulation narrow a statute. The government's nader rapport accepted the objection and amended the bill so the repeal date is fixed in the statute itself, and also widened one exception.
concerns: Royal decree powers to repeal the statutory loonkostensubsidie provisions were held inappropriate because the policy decision on termination should be in the Act itself.

31586.s: The bill amends several Dutch social security laws to allow the UWV and Sociale verzekeringsbank to waive, in whole or part, recovery of unduly paid benefits when a debtor takes part in a voluntary debt settlement, subject to conditions such as a reliable settlement via a licensed debt assistant. It also gives the ministry power to set further rules by ministerial regulation and gives these claims a statutory preference ranking.
31586.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation power by the need to set rules on the debtor's financial capacity, alternatives, and avoiding unwanted precedent.
q: This may for example involve concealing one's own financial resources, or financial resources that are present but can only be disposed of at a later time.
Het kan hierbij bijvoorbeeld gaan om het verzwijgen van eigen financiële middelen, of van financiële middelen die weliswaar aanwezig zijn, maar waarover pas op een later tijdstip kan worden beschikt.
d: further rules on power to take part in debt settlements
further rules on power to take part in debt settlements
further rules on power to take part in debt settlements
further rules on power to take part in debt settlements
further rules on power to take part in debt settlements
further rules on power to take part in debt settlements
further rules on power to take part in debt settlements
further rules on power to take part in debt settlements
further rules on power to take part in debt settlements
further rules on power to take part in debt settlements
further rules on power to take part in debt settlements
further rules on power to take part in debt settlements
further rules on power to take part in debt settlements
p: Gives UWV and SVB discretion to waive recovery of unduly paid benefits, which benefits debtors, subject to a list of conditions including a reliable settlement and exclusion of fraud-related claims.

parties: Asks how the government can steer and prudently apply the policy rules that UWV and SVB may develop.
With the bill, UWV and SVB gain the power to develop policy rules. The CDA members ask what options the government has to steer how these rules are formulated and prudently applied.

Met het wetsvoorstel krijgen UWV en SVB de mogelijkheid beleidsregels te ontwikkelen. De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen welke mogelijkheden de regering heeft om sturing te geven aan de formulering van deze beleidsregels en de prudente hantering daarvan.
Questions the privileged creditor position of UWV and SVB, which the Raad van State criticised, and whether non-privileged creditors will cooperate.
The Council of State is critical of the proposed privileging of UWV and SVB, since it breaks the equality of creditors.
De Raad van State is kritisch wat betreft deze voorgestelde bevoorrechting van het UWV en SVB aangezien hiermee de gelijkheid van crediteuren wordt doorbroken.
Asks whether alleged fraud must first be proven before people are excluded from a voluntary settlement, to prevent unjust treatment.
The SP members ask whether misuse or other fraudulent conduct must not first be proven before people are excluded from a voluntary settlement track.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of het misbruik of ander bedrieglijk handelen niet eerst moet worden bewezen voordat mensen worden uitgesloten van een minnelijk traject?
Objects in principle to waiving repayment of unlawfully paid benefits and to the state strengthening its own position against other creditors.
The VVD members ask whether the government agrees that, in principle, all benefits unlawfully paid by the state to a citizen must always be reclaimed.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de regering het eens is met het uitgangspunt dat in principe alle onverschuldigd uitgekeerde betalingen van de staat aan een burger steeds moeten worden teruggevorderd?
Asks about sanctions for benefit fraud, the use of BKR checks, and how many people are affected, without taking a clear position.
The PVV members ask which sanctions are imposed instead of reclaiming benefits from people who commit fraud.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen welke sancties er in plaats van terugvordering worden opgelegd aan mensen die frauderen?

v.summary: The Raad van State supports allowing UWV and SVB to cooperate in voluntary debt settlements but objects to the broad statutory preference given to their claims, which it considers insufficiently justified and in tension with equal treatment of creditors, advising narrowing it and excluding fines. The government's reply largely rejects the narrowing, accepts excluding fines from the preference, and adopts the redactional comments.
concerns: The Raad finds the motivation for the general preference of UWV and SVB claims insufficient and advises a more compelling justification, given that paritas creditorum is weakened.
The Raad advises excluding social security fines from the preference because it is socially unacceptable that fines are paid while victims' claims such as damages go unpaid.
The Raad advises limiting the preference to voluntary debt settlements for natural persons, which the government declines because it would undermine the public interest and equal treatment.
The Raad's redactional comments on the terminology and cross-references in the articles are adopted in the bill.

31700-IV.s: This bill sets the 2009 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for Koninkrijksrelaties (chapter IV), fixing expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros. It enters into force on 1 January 2009 or, if published later, the day after publication with retroactive effect to 1 January.
q: The budget statement of Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) for the year 2009 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) voor het jaar 2009 wordt vastgesteld.

31700-VI.s: This bill fixes the 2009 budget statements of the Ministry of Justice (departmental budget and the budgets of the baten-lastendiensten) and clarifies that the Minister is not responsible for the operational efficiency of the judiciary but keeps a supervisory responsibility over the Raad voor de rechtspraak. The explanatory memorandum sets out policy aims and budget figures across justice areas.
31700-VI.j: The memorandum explains that the judiciary has become responsible for its own management, so the Minister's role is clarified as supervisory rather than operational.
q: Referring to Article 21 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 in conjunction with Articles 23 and 91 of the Judiciary Organisation Act, the Minister of Justice is not responsible for the efficiency of the judiciary's operations.

Onder verwijzing naar het bepaalde in artikel 21 van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 jo. de artikelen 23 en 91 van de Wet op de Rechterlijke Organisatie is Onze Minister van Justitie niet verantwoordelijk voor de doelmatigheid van de bedrijfsvoering van de rechterlijke organisatie.

31766.s: The bill amends the 2003 Act supervising collective management organisations for authors' and neighbouring rights to strengthen and widen supervision, including preventive approval of tariff increases, new transparency and cost obligations, fines and penalty orders for the supervisory College, and extension to listed voluntary organisations. It also creates an independent dispute committee for tariff disputes, with the Minister of Justice empowered to designate it and set further rules.
31766.j: The memorandum justifies the broader delegations as creating a framework for detailed supervision rules and joint collection, while stressing transparency and the need for strengthened, independent oversight.
q: In addition, the Minister of Justice is given the power to issue further rules on supervision by general administrative order.
Daarnaast wordt voorzien in de bevoegdheid van de minister van Justitie om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur nadere regels over het toezicht uit te vaardigen.
d: further requirements and code of conduct for collective management organisations
amending the annex listing organisations under supervision and threshold for listing
requiring joint exercise of collection or distribution activities
rules on composition, procedures and supervision of dispute committee
p: Requires prior written approval of the College for statute changes, tariff increases and reglement changes, while the College may only withhold approval after a non-followed advice and must refuse excessive tariff increases.
Gives the College power to impose administrative fines up to fixed amounts or percentages of collected sums, with fault and seriousness considerations as limits.
Allows the College to impose penalty orders with a time limit of at most two years.
Creates a dispute committee whose advice the civil court must generally obtain before deciding on reasonableness of tariffs, while allowing parties to go directly to court.

parties: Asks whether prior approval by the College van Toezicht of tariff increases conflicts with after-the-fact dispute committee review, and whether transparency is sufficiently increased.
They wonder, however, whether the present proposals sufficiently increase the transparency of the CBO system.
Zij vragen zich echter af of voorliggende voorstellen de transparantie van het systeem van CBO's voldoende vergroot.
Worries that the College's approval of tariff increases is only a limited general test and that user representation is absent from the dispute committee.
The approval is only a limited, general test and can (still) lead to an unfair fee.
De goedkeuring is slechts een beperkte, algemene toets en kan (toch) leiden tot een onbillijke vergoeding.
Asks why supervision is not extended to all CBOs, whether foreign organisations can be supervised, and how the dispute committee will be composed.
Is it possible to regulate in this act that every organisation active in Netherlands in collective management falls under the new supervision?
Is het mogelijk in deze wet te regelen dat iedere organisatie die in Nederland actief is op het gebied van het collectief beheer, onder het nieuwe toezicht staat?
Asks how the list of supervised organisations, the cost-control drop-in and the AMvB criteria will be applied and reviewed, and how the College's approval policy relates to its marginal test.
Can the government indicate on what grounds this threshold has been proposed?
Kan de regering aangeven op grond van welke afwegingen deze drempel is voorgesteld?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill strengthening supervision of collective rights management organisations, including preventive tariff approval by the College and the power to group CBO activities by decree. The government's nader rapport accepted several points, amending the text on tariff increases, the NMa relationship, and inclusion criteria, while defending preventive tariff supervision and retaining the delegation to group activities with competition-law limits noted.
concerns: The Raad questioned whether preventive tariff supervision is necessary and proposed less intrusive alternatives; the government defended it as not more far-reaching than OPTA's powers and kept the instrument.
The relationship between the College and the NMa on tariff supervision was unclear; the government clarified the explanatory memorandum and agreed working arrangements.
The explanatory memorandum on the tariff-increase test did not match the statutory text; the government added a new fourth paragraph to align them.
The criterion of 'necessary social relevance' for listing organisations was arbitrary; the government replaced it with market size based on aggregate collection over two years.

The delegation to require joint exercise of activities may conflict with EC Treaty articles 10 and 81; the government kept the provision, noting EU competition limits will be respected and self-regulation will be awaited first.

31775.s: The bill creates a statutory right for young people aged 16 to 26 in the Netherlands to a work-learning offer (werkleeraanbod) and an income support benefit administered by municipalities, replacing their reliance on the Work and Assistance Act for this group. It sets out municipal duties, eligibility, youth obligations, information-sharing powers, recovery of overpayments and the norms for benefit amounts.
31775.j: The memorandum justifies municipal discretion and delegated rule-making by the need to tailor work-learning support to young people and by the aim of aligning with the Work and Assistance Act.
q: The college may have the implementation of this act carried out by third parties, except for establishing the youth's rights and duties and the assessment of their circumstances needed for that.

Het college kan de uitvoering van deze wet, behoudens de vaststelling van de rechten en plichten van de jongere en de daarvoor noodzakelijke beoordeling van zijn omstandigheden, door derden laten verrichten.
d: municipal council ordinances on work-learning offer content, sanctions and norm adjustments
rules on delegating municipal tasks to third parties
extending equal treatment to other non-Dutch residents
municipality responsible for persons without fixed address
categories of persons excluded or not excluded for deprivation of liberty
adjustment of benefit norms and amounts to minimum wage changes
authentic data sources and administrations for verifying facts
information obligations of institutions, data storage by Inlichtingenbureau
rules on data provision by municipalities and additional recipient agencies
assignment of citizen service numbers to beneficiaries
designation of further administrations and data rules
p: Artikel 12 lid 1 onderdeel b en e
Municipal councils may lower benefit amounts and raise or lower norms by ordinance, giving local executives discretion over young people's income support.
Municipalities may withhold or reduce the work-learning offer and income support for non-compliance, with reduction amounts set by local ordinance.
Broad information-gathering and data-sharing powers extend municipal and agency access to personal data, with only a general proportionality safeguard.
Personal data may be disclosed to third parties for scientific research or statistics where privacy is not disproportionately harmed.

parties: Questions whether the bill fits international human rights treaties and whether it leaves non-applicants outside its scope, and asks how compulsion relates to the ECHR.
Is the government now certain that this bill no longer conflicts with the European Convention on Human Rights?
Is de regering er nu zeker van dat er met dit wetsvoorstel geen strijdigheid meer is met het Europees Verdrag tot Bescherming van de Rechten voor de Mens en Fundamentele Vrijheden (EVRM)?
Asks how legal protection, appeal rights under the Awb and medical counter-expertise are safeguarded for young people.
The PvdA asks the government to explain how legal protection is expressed where non-attributable circumstances are not recognised by the college.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering aan te geven op welke wijze de rechtsbescherming tot uiting komt indien sprake is van niet-verwijtbare omstandigheden die niet door het college worden erkend.
Doubts the bill delivers a sound approach, questions loss of income during appeals and whether vulnerable youth will fall through the cracks.
Does this proposal risk that precisely hard-to-place young people will fall between the cracks and lose any right to income?
Bestaat met het dit voorstel de kans dat juist moeilijk bemiddelbare jongeren hierdoor tussen het wal en het schip zullen vallen om er geen recht op inkomen meer bestaat?
Calls the scheme unworkable and fears a large wave of court cases, asking whether all work offered counts as suitable work.
What is the government's view on the expected large number of appeals to the courts? Will this not lead to pseudo-legislation?
Wat is de visie van de regering op het te verwachten grote beroep op de rechter? Zal dit niet leiden tot pseudowetgeving?
Argues the absence of a reporting obligation weakens the bill and urges adding a duty to report, while noting ILO and ECHR conflicts; also wants prosecution for serious misconduct.
The PVV therefore urges that the reporting obligation be added to the bill after all, despite the stated conflict of such an obligation with international law provisions.

De leden van de PVV-fractie dringen er derhalve op aan op de meldplicht alsnog in het voorstel op te nemen, dit ondanks de gestelde strijdigheid van een dergelijke plicht met internationaalrechtelijk bepalingen.
Asks what the government means by the subsistence minimum and why the bill departs from it for under-27s.
Can the government state its reasons for departing, in this bill, from the right to a subsistence minimum for young people up to 27?
Kan de regering aangeven wat haar beweegredenen zijn geweest om in dit wetsvoorstel af te wijken van het recht op bestaansminimum als het gaat om jongeren tot 27 jaar?
Asks how recovery of advance payments fits the constitutional right to assistance and why benefits are not backdated.
How does the recovery or offsetting of a granted advance relate to the basic right to assistance, ask the ChristenUnie members.
Hoe verhoudt zich de terugvordering of verrekening van een verleend voorschot, tot het basisrecht op bijstand, zo vragen de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie.
Raises concern about unequal municipal practice in judging capacity, asks for guidelines, and about youth without benefits being discouraged from registering.
Has the government considered drawing up guidelines for municipalities so that no inequality arises for young people between municipalities?
Heeft de regering overwogen om richtlijnen op te stellen voor gemeenten, zodat er geen ongelijkheid kan ontstaan voor jongeren tussen gemeenten?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Wet Investeren in Jongeren, which creates a right to a work-learning offer for young people aged 16 to 27 and removes WWB benefit entitlement for 18-27 year olds, supporting its aim but raising concerns about necessity relative to the WWB, municipal centralisation, the 27-year age limit, the link between work-learning offers and benefits, and sanctions. The government's nader rapport responds to nearly every point, accepting several adjustments (clarified article 17/24/41 links, a new article 25(2), tightened article 22, added justification for the age limit and for not paying benefits pending appeal) while defending the core paradigm shift and the decision not to adopt several of the Raad's suggestions.
concerns: The Raad questioned why a separate statute beside the WWB is needed and asked for a stronger justification; the government defended the paradigm shift and the need for a national scheme, adding further explanation.
The Raad noted the proposal centralises rules that previously gave municipalities discretion, questioning the move away from decentralised practice.
The Raad flagged unequal treatment between people under and over 27 requiring adequate justification; the government added a fuller motivation for the age limit.
The Raad doubted whether every municipality can deliver a work-learning offer given tight labour market conditions at the lower end; the government expanded the explanation in the memorie.

The Raad noted that non-reporting young people may fall outside view and that non-reporting could rise; the government explained its approach and added a section on this in the explanatory memorandum.

The Raad found the link between the work-learning offer and income support, and the sanctions in articles 17, 22, 24, 25 and 40-41, unclear and inconsistent; the government clarified these and added a new paragraph 2 to article 25.

The Raad stressed that sanctions may affect the minimum subsistence guaranteed by article 20(3) of the Constitution and that suspension during appeal must not leave applicants without support; the government added justification and a note on the article 16 WWB safety valve, but kept the no-benefit-pending-appeal rule.
The Raad made several editorial remarks on articles 6, 14, 48 and the WWB cross-references; the government adopted these except the point on article 7(1)(a) WWB.

The Raad asked why WWB provisions on in-kind assistance and on deviating from general rules were omitted; the government addressed the deviation point by reference to article 16 WWB and added in-kind assistance provisions.

31792-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2008 departmental budget of the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden and the governors' offices of the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba, mainly through second supplementary budget adjustments. It does not delegate rule-making power or shift authority between the executive and checking bodies.

31829.s: The bill simplifies how schools and institutions report student absenteeism and withdrawals to municipalities by routing reports through the Informatie Beheer Groep, which keeps a new central register of relative absenteeism. It also widens data flows from the education base register to municipalities and removes an obsolete notification duty, aiming to curb early school leaving.
31829.j: The explanatory memorandum says detailed technical rules on the data set are delegated to lower regulation because parliamentary involvement is not directly necessary, while an AMvB is chosen to safeguard personal data protection.
q: So the reporting procedure is regulated in outline in the formal statute, while which data exactly are transferred is set by general administrative order (AMvB).
Wordt dus de meldprocedure op hoofdlijnen geregeld in de formele wet, welke gegevens precies overgaan, wordt vastgesteld bij algemene maatregel van bestuur.
d: manner of data transfer and specification of data for absenteeism reports
manner of data transfer and specification of data for absenteeism reports in adult education
manner of data transfer and specification of data for absenteeism reports in expertise centres
manner of data transfer and specification of data for absenteeism reports in secondary education
rules implementing data supply from the base register (timing and frequency)
technical and organisational security measures for the absenteeism register
rules for supplying non-identifiable data to the Minister for policy purposes

parties: Welcomes the bill as improving registration and reducing bureaucracy, with a few questions; no check concern beyond general remarks.
These members consider it right that a legislative change takes place improving the way registration is done.
Deze leden achten het juist dat er een wetswijziging plaatsvindt waardoor de wijze van registratie verbeterd wordt.
Questions whether individual-level data must reach the minister and why the Raad van State's privacy objections were brushed aside.
Can the government further argue its position?
Kan de regering haar vasthouden nader beargumenteren?
Doubts the bill will deliver effective anti-dropout policy and worries about sensitive personal data reaching schools and municipalities.
These members very much doubt that, however.
Deze leden betwijfelen dat echter zeer.
Supports simplification but asks why the Privacy College was consulted only on a preliminary draft and questions the scope of sensitive data and access rights.
Why does the IB-Groep register allow sensitive personal data such as background of absence and religious conviction, while according to the Council of State the necessity has not been demonstrated?

Waarom bestaat de mogelijkheid in het meldingsregister van de IB-Groep ook «bijzondere persoonsgegevens» zoals achtergrond van verzuim, maar bijvoorbeeld ook geloofsovertuiging op te nemen, terwijl volgens de Raad van State de noodzaak hiervan niet is aangetoond?
Asks the government to justify necessity of the changes for primary and special education, echoing the Council of State's necessity test.
This group asks the government to further explain why the proposed changes for primary and special education are necessary for combating truancy and early school leaving.

De leden van deze fractie verzoeken de regering nader toe te lichten waarom de voorgestelde wijzigingen met betrekking tot het primair onderwijs en het (voortgezet) speciaal onderwijs noodzakelijk zijn met het oog op de bestrijding van verzuim en voortijdig schoolverlaten.
Notes the implementation lacks a legal basis and asks about access and the risk of database failures.
Not to their satisfaction, these members note that the implementation of the proposed amendment lacks a legal basis.
Niet tot hun genoegen constateren deze leden dat de implementatie van de voorgestelde wijziging een wettelijke basis ontbeert.

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill creating a uniform digital reporting procedure for relative truancy via the IB Groep, but raises objections on effectiveness, the absence of a statutory basis for processing special personal data before entry into force, insufficient justification for processing special personal data, and broad delegation clauses. The government replies that the procedure simplifies reporting, that the necessity has been shown, that the delegation has been narrowed and the article amended, and that it does not follow the advice to delay rollout until the law takes effect.
concerns: The Raad doubts the bill will effectively reduce early school leaving since it only unifies reporting; the government adds a passage to the explanatory memorandum acknowledging the link but maintains the approach.

Without a statutory basis, processing special personal data via the digital counter before the law takes effect is problematic under the Wbp; the government rejects delaying rollout until the law is in force.
The necessity of processing special personal data for a weighty public interest is insufficiently demonstrated; the government considers necessity shown and rejects amending the bill.
Broad delegation to general administrative orders lacks sufficient concreteness; the government narrows the delegation and specifies the data to be provided.
The Raad's redactional remarks are adopted, except for two points on paragraphs that the government considers necessary.
The legal basis for the school to report the presumed reason for absence is unclear; the government adds 'zo mogelijk' and 'naar het oordeel van' wording but maintains the basis is sufficient.

31856.s: The bill amends the Dutch Aviation Act to implement EU Regulation 1794/2006 on a common charging scheme for air navigation services, setting fee rules for the Amsterdam flight information region and for airports under 50,000 commercial movements. It also allows suspension of air navigation services for non-payment and gives the Minister of Transport power to set tariffs and related rules by ministerial regulation.
31856.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the technical and dynamic nature of the field and the need to adapt exemptions and incentive schemes flexibly, within a European level playing field.
q: However, the policy field is so dynamic that it is necessary to include in this bill a basis for setting incentive schemes by ministerial regulation.

Echter, het beleidsveld is dusdanig dynamisch dat het noodzakelijk is in het onderhavige wetsvoorstel een grondslag op te nemen voor het bij ministeriële regeling vaststellen van stimuleringsregelingen.
d: setting unit rate for local air navigation charges
charging zones and rules on notification and collection of charges
incentive measures for air navigation services
consultation of airspace users on charging policy
designating airports exempt from the regulation
height, calculation, collection and notification of charges for exempt services
further rules for suspending air navigation services
p: Air navigation service providers may suspend services to users in arrears, with notice of 30 days and a registered decision, though the suspension is imposed by a non-state provider and the minister may set further rules.
Gives the Minister a general power to apply administrative enforcement (bestuursdwang) for breaches of the charging regulation.

parties: Asks whether the bill increases costs for the aviation sector and how enforcement, including suspension of services for non-payment, will be carried out by the Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat.
These members would also like to know how the Inspectorate of Transport and Water Management (IVW) currently shapes enforcement and how the government envisions this once the law takes effect.
Deze leden vernemen tevens graag op welke wijze de Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat (IVW) de handhaving momenteel vormgeeft en hoe de regering dat voor zich ziet nadat deze wet van kracht is geworden.

Asks whether LVNL remains a administrative body, what the increase in inter-administrative burdens is, and who sets tariffs for local services, and asks about the scope of ministerial discretion over fees.
These members further ask whether it is true that for local air navigation services a different tariff is set in each country by the minister responsible for aviation.
Deze leden vragen verder of het waar is dat voor de plaatselijke luchtvaartnavigatiediensten in ieder land een ander tarief wordt vastgesteld door de minister die verantwoordelijk is voor luchtvaart.
Welcomes the bill's goals, asks how often the enforcement measures would be used, and asks to what extent government will use expanded exemptions as a steering instrument.
These members do ask how often these measures should be deployed.
Deze leden vragen wel hoe vaak deze maatregelen ingezet zouden moeten worden.
Asks whether the information obligations in the explanatory memorandum lead to more burden and financial consequences for service providers and the aviation sector.

These members would like to know whether the information obligations mentioned in the explanatory memorandum do not lead to more regulatory burden and financial consequences for providers of air navigation services.

Deze leden willen graag weten of de in de memorie van toelichting genoemde informatieverplichtingen niet leiden tot meer lastendruk en financiële consequenties voor de verleners van luchtvaartnavigatiediensten.

31874.s: The bill splits childminding into two new small-scale forms, gastouderopvang (in a minicrèche, supervised directly by the GGD) and thuisopvang (in the caregiver's home, supervised via the agency), and tightens quality rules, registration in a national register, and caps on billable hours to curb abuse and control costs. It also lets the Minister set quality rules by AMvB and sets maximum billable hours by AMvB.
31874.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB and ministerial delegations by the need to safeguard financial manageability, quality and to curb misuse, and notes that the maximum-hours rule can lapse once the market is in balance.
q: The state can set quality requirements by general administrative order (AMvB).
Het Rijk bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB) eisen aan de kwaliteit kan stellen.
d: Artikel I, C (art. 7, lid 3 Wet kinderopvang)
maximum billable childcare hours for the childcare allowance
quality rules for childminding agencies and thuisopvang
contract content, cost caps and payment administration of agencies
data provided at notification and use of citizen service number
form and content of the national childcare register
recognition of foreign childcare providers by category
p: The toezichthouder may issue a written order to a childcare provider where quality falls short and action cannot wait, valid for seven days.
Registration is made conditional on a prior GGD inspection, shifting entry control from notification to supervisory discretion.
Artikel I, Y / AB / AA (GGD supervision)
Supervision of the minicrèche is centralised with the GGD director and the gemeentelijke ambtenaar role is transferred, reducing municipal oversight role.

parties: Questions the enforceability of the new quality and oversight rules, including whether the GGD has the capacity to inspect childminders, and asks for the basis of key assumptions.
Can the government also quantify this group, ask these members.
Kan de regering deze groep ook kwantificeren, zo vragen deze leden.
Stresses that preventing abuse requires adequate registration, control and enforcement by the GGD and inspectorate, and questions whether those bodies have sufficient capacity.
Can the government indicate whether the inspectorate and the GGDs have sufficient capacity to carry out their task?
Kan de regering aangeven of de inspectie en de GGD’s voldoende capaciteit hebben om hun taak waar te maken?
Objects to imposing bureaucratic quality requirements and control systems on family-based care and argues parental freedom of choice should prevail.
Care must be taken not to build childcare into a bureaucratic system with different allowance categories, quality requirements and control systems.
Gewaakt moet worden voor het optuigen van de kinderopvang tot een bureaucratisch systeem met verschillende toeslagcategorieën, kwaliteitseisen en controlesystemen.
Calls for an independent financial supervisor over childcare tariffs and questions the weak position of parents' committees with only advisory rights.
The members ask the government to establish an independent financial supervisor overseeing childcare tariffs.
De leden vragen de regering om een onafhankelijk financieel toezichthouder in te stellen die toeziet op de tarieven in de kinderopvang.
Argues the bill should be postponed until the Van Rijn committee reports and that the government's plans are inconsistent with its coalition commitments to broader access.
In the view of the GroenLinks members, the handling of this bill should be postponed.
In de ogen van de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie dient de behandeling van het voorliggend wetsvoorstel te worden uitgesteld.
Asks how the bill ensures quality of professional childminding given growing enforcement duties of the GGD and municipalities, which the report found often under-enforced.
Supports cost reduction in principle but regrets that the bill says little about children's welfare and asks about the minister for Youth and Family's role.
They find it reprehensible that the childcare bill hardly concerns children.
Zij vinden het laakbaar dat het wetsvoorstel over kinderopvang nauwelijks over kinderen gaat.
Asks how controls over all childminder bureaus and individual childminders will be guaranteed and what sanctions apply, and asks for the full cabinet response to the Van Rijn commission.
How can the government guarantee that this will happen, now that besides the childminder agencies the childminders themselves must also be checked, the members ask.
Hoe kan de regering garanderen dat dit wel zal gebeuren, nu er naast de gastouderbureaus ook nog de gastouders zelf gecontroleerd dienen te worden, zo vragen de leden.
Supports the bill but asks whether GGD inspection capacity suffices, whether there is an inspection backlog, and how municipalities performing poorly will be held to account.
How will the government hold the GGDs to account if it turns out they are not doing well?
Hoe gaat de regering de GGD's erop aanspreken als blijkt dat ze het niet goed doen?
Welcomes removing informal care but questions GGD capacity for mandatory home visits, asks why the maximum fee and hours are not set in law, and why money for supervision is not earmarked.
Why is the money intended for supervision and enforcement not earmarked, they ask.
Waarom wordt het geld dat bedoeld is voor toezicht en handhaving niet geoormerkt, zo vragen zij.
Asks for the cost-overrun analyses to be sent to the Chamber, questions how the bill fits the coalition promise on informal care, and asks what happens if registration exceeds ten weeks.
The members request the government to send those analyses to the Chamber.
De leden verzoeken de regering de Kamer die analyses te doen toekomen.
Sees the revision as a clear improvement but asks how parents who use a childminder at another parent's home remain eligible for childcare allowance, and how the EVC qualification route will work.
The members request the government to explain how the bill secures that parents whose child is cared for by a childminder at another parent's home are also eligible for the childcare allowance.

De leden verzoeken de regering nader toe te lichten op welke wijze in wetsvoorstel geborgd is dat ook ouders die hun kind bij een andere vraagouder thuis door een gastouder laten opvangen in aanmerking komen voor de kinderopvangtoeslag.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the bill reforming childcare subsidies for host-parent care (gastouderopvang) be reconsidered, citing unanalysed effects on parental choice, labour participation, costs and misuse risks, and questioning the new thuisopvang category and delegation scope. The government's reply largely rejects the behavioural concerns but adds explanations, accepts the delegation and maximum-hours recommendations, and adjusts several provisions.
concerns: The Council questions whether the reform will achieve its cost-control aims given likely changes in parental and host-parent behaviour, and asks the government to justify further refinement rather than simply lowering subsidies.

The Council warns that lowering labour-participation support, especially for lower-income parents, creates a tension with the bill's goal of supporting work and care, which the explanatory memorandum ignores.
The Council advises limiting ministerial delegation to administrative rules and detail, and aligning the inconsistent delegation forms across quality provisions.
The Council recommends writing the maximum number of childcare allowance hours directly into the Act rather than leaving it to a general administrative order.
The Council warns that the more complex system and the split supervision chain through host-parent agencies create new misuse risks and enforcement difficulties.
The Council asks the explanatory memorandum to clarify the possibility of cumulative use of different childcare forms and the number of children cared for.
The Council made numerous drafting remarks, most of which were adopted, though the government kept the alphabetical definitions order and retained article 56(6) without separate explanation.

31892.s: The bill implements EU Payment Services Directive 2007/64/EC in Dutch law by amending the Wet op het financieel toezicht (licensing and supervision of payment institutions, new NMa oversight of payment system access) and the Burgerlijk Wetboek (new Title 7B on payment transactions, consumer rights, liability). It introduces licensing requirements for payment service providers and rules on access to payment systems, with detailed rules to be set by general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial regulations.
31892.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for flexibility to respond to developments and to implement detailed EU directive requirements, and says rules will be put to consultation.
q: It was chosen to include the exemption scheme in the ministerial regulation rather than the statute in order to retain sufficient flexibility to respond to current developments.
Er is voor gekozen om de vrijstellingsregeling op te nemen in de ministeriële regeling en niet in de wet om zo voldoende flexibiliteit te houden om te kunnen inspelen op actuele ontwikkelingen.
d: exemptions from payment institution licensing requirement
manner of safeguarding client funds of payment institutions
rules on credit extension by payment institutions
rules on information provision by payment service providers
information and conditions for payment services under the Civil Code
p: Assigns supervision of Article 5:88 payment system access to the competition authority NMa, with DNB and AFM given a right to state their views.
Allows DNB to require a payment institution to conduct non-payment activities through a separate legal entity where financial soundness or supervision is threatened.
Sets objective, non-discriminatory and proportionate conditions for access to payment systems, with exemptions for certain systems.

parties: Asks how fair market access is enforced, whether existing licences are evaluated, whether transitional arrangements exist, and whether DNB's new powers could conflict with its ESCB tasks.
How exactly is fair market access enforced?
Hoe wordt eerlijke markttoegang precies afgedwongen?
Worries about a licensing gap for foreign payment providers and a possible supervisory vacuum between DNB, AFM and NMa, and asks for timelines and guarantees for SMEs.
Is there not a risk of a supervisory vacuum ('everyone's responsibility, so no one's')?
Wordt hier niet het risico gelopen van een toezichtsvacuüm («het is van iedereen, dus van niemand»)?

Questions whether small enterprises should get extra protection given providers' market power, whether the wording 'neem in acht' is too loose, and whether consumers are adequately protected on blocking, refunds and reversals.
The market power of payment service providers relative to small enterprises will in practice be considerable.
De machtspositie van betaaldienstverleners ten opzichte van kleine ondernemingen zal in de praktijk behoorlijk zijn.
Asks the government to close the identified gap on foreign providers via a note of amendment, questions protection of merchants against payment providers, and asks about indirect cost pass-through.
The VVD members believe the identified gap should be resolved on the occasion of this bill.
De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn van mening dat het gesignaleerde hiaat ter gelegenheid van dit wetsvoorstel moet worden opgelost.

Welcomes harmonisation and the exemption of micro-enterprises, worries about pass-through of compliance costs to consumers, and asks when the review of the Wft gap will be completed and sent to parliament.
When will this review be completed? Will this review also be sent to the House?
Wanneer is dit onderzoek afgerond? Wordt dit onderzoek ook naar de Kamer gezonden?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill implementing EU Payment Services Directive 2007/64/EC in the Wft and Civil Code, raising technical points on scope, licensing prohibition, exemption delegation, head office requirement, licensing deadlines and micro-enterprise rules. The minister's reply accepted most points with amendments, and declined to add a prohibition on unlicensed EU-based providers because the directive does not require it, while promising further study.
concerns: Scope of Article 1:5a Wft should be clarified so that only payment-service-relevant provisions of the Wft apply; the wording was adjusted.

No prohibition on unlicensed operation by providers seated in another member state; the minister declined to add it now because the directive does not require it, but promised to study whether the Wft should be amended.
The delegation in Article 2:3d should allow attaching conditions to ministerial exemptions; this was added.
Head office requirement of Article 10(3) of the directive was not implemented; the wording was amended accordingly.
The three-month decision deadline of Article 11 may be exceeded through general administrative law extensions; provisions were added to Article 2:3d to prevent this.
Divergent national choices on micro-enterprises could make applicable law unclear; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented to address this.
Several minor editorial comments on capitalisation and wording in the bill's articles.

31928.s: The bill creates a statutory basis for the broad grant (brede doeluitkering) sociaal, integratie en veiligheid for large cities in the 2005-2009 period, covering urban development programmes, civic integration of newcomers and reintegration services. It lets the government set detailed rules on the grant by general administrative order and on subsidies by ministerial regulation, replacing a temporary decree that would otherwise lapse in June 2009.
31928.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by noting that the existing decree (Besluit bdu siv) would lapse on 1 June 2009 under the Financiële-verhoudingswet unless a bill is introduced, and that the statutory basis is needed to avoid an undesirable gap.
q: Lapse of the Besluit bdu siv on that date would create an undesirable situation.
Door het vervallen van het Besluit bdu siv op die datum zou een ongewenste situatie ontstaan.
d: rules on the broad grant (amount, allocation, programme, reporting)
rules on subsidies to legal persons for Grotestedenbeleid activities

parties: The VVD asks why the bill was submitted late, given that the underlying decree expires at the end of 2009, and how the planned VROM subsidies framework act relates to a government-wide subsidy framework.
Why was the bill not submitted shortly after the decree entered into force?
Waarom is het wetsvoorstel niet kort na de inwerkingtreding van het besluit ingediend?

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill providing a statutory basis for the BDU SIV but advises revising the articles 6 and 7 basis for the Subsidieregeling Kenniscentrum Grote Steden, since that subsidy runs indefinitely while the BDU SIV ends in 2009, suggesting a framework act for VROM subsidies instead. In its reply the minister explains that the subsidy will run longer than the bill, that a statutory basis is needed now, and that a solution will be found when the BDU SIV basis is withdrawn.
concerns: The statutory basis for the Kenniscentrum subsidy is tied to a bill that will be withdrawn after the BDU SIV ends, creating a mismatch in duration; the Afdeling suggests a framework act for VROM subsidies instead.

31955.s: The bill extends the statutory basis for providing facilities to self-employed persons with a structural functional limitation from illness or disability, moving it from the WIA, WAO, WAZ, ZW and Wajong into a single general provision in the Wet werk en inkomen naar arbeidsvermogen (new article 34a) that allows rules by general administrative order. It repeals the separate provisions in the other statutes and sets a transitional rule and an income ceiling for eligibility.
31955.j: The memorandum justifies the general administrative order route by extending facilities to all persons with structural limitations and by consolidating the regime in one provision, with an income ceiling to limit eligibility.
q: The new article 34a creates the possibility, by general administrative order, to provide facilities to all persons whom the UWV judges to have a structural functional limitation and who work or will work as self-employed.

In het nieuwe artikel 34a wordt de mogelijkheid gecreëerd om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur te bepalen dat aan alle personen met een naar het oordeel van het UWV structurele functionele beperking die arbeid als zelfstandige verrichten of gaan verrichten, voorzieningen kunnen worden verstrekt
d: rules for facilities supporting self-employed work
rules for facilities supporting self-employed work for young disabled persons
income ceiling for young disabled self-employed
p: Extends the discretionary facilities scheme to all persons with a structural functional limitation, with the scope and rules set by general administrative order and UWV judgment of the limitation.

parties: Asks whether UWV should carefully check beforehand that the entrepreneur has sufficient quality to start, to limit debt and failure risk.
It is therefore important that the Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) carefully checks in advance whether the entrepreneur has sufficient quality to start as self-employed.
Het is daarom belangrijk dat Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) vooraf zorgvuldig toetst of de ondernemer voldoende kwaliteit heeft om als zelfstandige te starten.

Asks about the criteria for self-employment, the conditions for eligibility, and whether a combination of schemes could leave recipients financially worse off; also asks whether the law will be evaluated.
Can the government provide insight into the applicable provisions that will apply to meet the conditions set for eligibility for benefits?
Kan de regering inzicht geven in de van toepassing zijnde bepalingen die zullen gelden om te voldoen aan voorwaarden die gesteld worden voor het in aanmerking komen van voorzieningen?
Asks why the income ceiling is set by general administrative order rather than in the statute, and why it cannot equal the minimum wage.
The SP members ask why the income limit cannot be equal to, for example, the minimum wage, and why the government wishes to set this income limit by general administrative order.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen waarom de inkomensgrens niet gelijk kan zijn aan bijvoorbeeld het minimumloon en waarom de regering bij algemene maatregel van bestuur deze inkomensgrens wenst vast te stellen.
Asks how the income ceiling will be set and on what basis, and whether the IDM-funded financing is structurally sound.
Does this manner satisfy the structural financing of the benefits?
Voldoet deze wijze voor structurele financiering van de voorzieningen?

31991.s: The bill amends Book 5 of the Civil Code so that municipalities can, with a court authorisation, convene owners' association meetings, propose maintenance decisions and, in some cases, replace a refusing owner's consent to a rules change. It also adds article 12d to the Housing Act letting mayors and aldermen order owners' associations in weakening neighbourhoods to draw up a maintenance plan, and extends the Housing Act's article 13 powers to order improvements.
31991.j: The memorandum justifies the new municipal powers as a last step after incentives fail, to support liveability in neighbourhoods under pressure and to stop housing deterioration.
q: The starting point is that this power may only be applied as a follow-up step after article 5:127a BW has been applied and has not produced the desired result.
Uitgangspunt is dat deze bevoegdheid uitsluitend kan worden toegepast als vervolgstap nadat toepassing is gegeven aan artikel 5:127a BW en dit niet tot het gewenste resultaat heeft geleid.
d: order owners' associations to produce and maintain a maintenance plan
order owners to carry out improvements to buildings
p: Allows a municipality, with a court authorisation, to convene owners' meetings and speak and propose decisions on building maintenance in place of the association board.
Lets a municipality ask a court to replace a dissenting owner's consent to a reglement change where owners holding at least half the votes support it.
Allows a municipality to seek a substitute court authorisation for building management acts where an owner unreasonably withholds consent.
Lets mayors and aldermen compel maintenance planning in neighbourhoods where liveability is under pressure, but only after a prior owners' meeting and three months without a plan.
Extends mayor and alderman power to order building improvements where needed in their judgement, subject to general administrative law balancing.

parties: Supports owners remaining primarily responsible with the Housing Act as ultimum remedium, but asks for a sunset clause and asks why the notice remains valid even if the court authorisation was wrongly granted.
The CDA members note with disappointment that the bill contains no sunset clause.
De leden van de CDA-fractie stellen met teleurstelling vast dat in het wetsvoorstel geen horizonbepaling is opgenomen.

Welcomes giving municipalities preventive powers to act against neglect, but worries about the lack of an organised reserve-fund obligation and asks whether a norm rather than an indicative guideline is needed.
The municipality must be given the power to intervene in owners' associations to prevent neglected maintenance and deterioration.
De gemeente moet de bevoegdheid krijgen in te grijpen bij verenigingen van eigenaren om achterstallig onderhoud en verloedering te voorkomen.
Doubts the effectiveness of the court-mandated municipal route given its cost and time burden, and asks why no statutory minimum maintenance contribution is set.
However, they doubt the effectiveness of Article 5:127a.
Zij betwijfelen echter de effectiviteit van artikel 5 127a.
Sees the powers as an intrusion into private-law relations of the association and asks what happens if the court refuses authorisation and whether appeal is excluded.
On the other hand, they experience the proposed powers as an intrusion into relationships regulated under private law.
Anderzijds ervaren zij de voorgestelde bevoegdheden als een inbreuk op privaatrechtelijk geregelde verhoudingen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a draft bill amending Book 5 of the Civil Code and the Housing Act to give municipalities new tools to stimulate maintenance by owners' associations (VvE), including convening meetings, petitioning courts for authorisation, and ordering maintenance plans. The Council questioned the bill's necessity, its impact on freedom of association, and its effectiveness, and the government's nader rapport accepted several points while rejecting others.
concerns: The Council questioned the added value and effectiveness of the new powers relative to existing instruments and asked for better justification, which the government addressed only partly by clarifying the preventive role.

The Council considered the powers an infringement of freedom of association (Art. 8 Constitution, Art. 11 ECHR) requiring justification, which the government rejected by arguing no infringement occurs given judicial authorisation and reserved decision-making.
The Council noted that the bill shifts private-law competences to municipalities, raising the question of why public interests are pursued through private law.
The Council doubted the proportionality of the court-authorisation power given that it presupposes majority support among owners, which the government rejected as a reason to withhold the instrument.

The Council noted that a maintenance-plan obligation without enforceable implementation is ineffective, and the government extended the obligation to keep the plan in force and update it every five years.
The Council proposed redactional changes to Art. I B and Art. II A; the government did not adopt the proposed wording for Art. I B and Art. II A, citing differences in meaning.

32123-VI.s: This bill sets the 2010 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Justice and its baten-lastendiensten, expressed in thousands of euros. It also clarifies that the Minister of Justice is not responsible for the operational efficiency of the judiciary but holds a supervisory responsibility over the Raad voor de rechtspraak.
32123-VI.j: The memorandum explains that, under the division of competences, the Minister is not responsible for judicial efficiency but retains supervisory responsibility, and that the article clarifies this position.
q: With the adoption of this statutory article, the position of the Minister of Justice relative to the judicial organisation is clarified.
Met de vaststelling van dit wetsartikel wordt de positie van de minister van Justitie ten opzichte van de rechterlijke organisatie verduidelijkt.

32189.s: The bill enacts the Belastingwet BES, a tax law for the Caribbean public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, creating a separate tax system (property, income-from-shares, general consumption and transfer taxes) as these islands join the Netherlands as public bodies. It sets out the taxes, taxpayer rules, rates, exemptions, collection and appeal procedures, with the explanatory memorandum justifying a distinct regime by geography and economic conditions.
32189.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and the distinct regime by the islands' distance from the Netherlands, their insular character, small population, economic dependence and the need to avoid disrupting regional trade.
q: Given, among other things, the population size of the three islands, the great distance from the Netherlands and their insular character, deviating provisions from Dutch legislation will however be needed.

Gezien onder meer de bevolkingsomvang van de drie eilanden, de grote afstand met Nederland en het insulaire karakter zullen echter van de Nederlandse wetgeving afwijkende voorzieningen worden getroffen.
d: reduced general consumption tax rate on Sint Eustatius and Saba
treating public bodies as entrepreneurs for certain services
conditions for exemptions and additional exemptions
cases requiring a fiscal representative for property tax
designation of foreign institutions exempt from dividend-type distributions
refund of import tax in specified cases
p: Tax inspector decides by binding decision whether a company is established on the islands, based on objective tests that can be appealed.
Minister can designate alternative places of supply or exemptions by regulation to avoid double taxation or distortion.

parties: Asks government to clarify the tax system's endpoint, individual effects, and the basis for the Raad van State's objections on legal consistency.
Can the government answer the question to what extent this task will be assigned at national level, and which tax powers will fall under local government responsibility?
Kan de regering de vraag beantwoorden in hoeverre deze taak op rijksniveau wordt belegd, en welke belastingbevoegdheden tot de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokale bestuur zullen behoren?
Asks about individual distributional effects of the new system and possible tax avoidance from the absence of a profit tax.
Can the absence of a profit and inheritance tax lead to tax avoidance from the European part of the Netherlands and from Curaçao and Aruba, ask the PvdA members.

Kan het ontbreken van een winst- en successiebelasting leiden tot belastingontwijking vanuit het in Europa gelegen deel van Nederland en vanuit Curaçao en Aruba, zo vragen de leden van de PvdA-fractie.
Finds the bill not mature and the justification for a separate tax system insufficient; questions abolition of profit tax and inheritance tax and the anti-abuse rules.
These members share the Council of State's view that this bill is not mature and that the government should not have sent this law to the House in this form.
Deze leden delen de opvatting van de Raad van State dat dit wetsvoorstel niet voldragen is en de regering deze wet niet in deze vorm naar de Kamer had moeten sturen.

Has mixed feelings; notes that the Raad van State's fundamental criticism has not been fully addressed and asks for explanation of the changes and constitutional concerns under Article 1 of the Constitution.
Why was it not foreseen earlier that the initial proposal would conflict with Article 1 of the Constitution?
Waarom is niet eerder voorzien dat het aanvankelijke voorstel strijd oplevert met artikel 1 van de Grondwet?
Agrees with the Raad van State that justifications for a different tax system are insufficient and opposes two separate fiscal regimes in the Kingdom.

These members share the Council of State's view that the justifications for proposed legislation for the BES islands deviating from the corresponding legislation for the European part of the Netherlands are inadequate.

De leden van de PVV-fractie delen de mening van de Raad van State dat de rechtvaardigingsgronden voor voorgestelde wetgeving voor de BES-eilanden afwijkend van de overeenkomstige wetgeving voor het Europese deel van Nederland ontoereikend zijn.
Asks for clarity on local tax revenues, ceilings and investor certainty, and whether a single valuation by the Belastingdienst inspector would avoid divergent property valuations.
The CDA members ask the government to provide more clarity on this, as it is an important part of their assessment of the proposed system.
De leden van de CDA-fractie verzoeken de regering hierover meer duidelijkheid te verschaffen, omdat dit een belangrijk onderdeel van hun afweging over het voorgestelde stelsel is.
Asks how citizens will be informed, whether enforcement capacity is sufficient for the new law, and whether shell companies will be monitored.
For public support for the new tax law it is important that citizens know the law will be properly enforced.
Voor het draagvlak voor de nieuwe belastingwet is het belangrijk dat burgers weten dat de wet goed gehandhaafd wordt.
Questions the justification for the flat tax and abolishing the profit tax, doubts enforcement capacity and the reliability of revenue data, and asks for the SEOR report in searchable form.
The SP finds it puzzling that no information is available on how much profit tax comes from the economic zones.
Het bevreemdt de leden van de fractie van de SP dat er geen informatie beschikbaar is over hoeveel winstbelasting afkomstig is uit de economische zones.

Demands fuller justification for the tariff structure, a clearer revenue picture before plenary debate, and questions the claimed 2% effective tax burden and the basis for a macro-neutral revenue assumption.
These members consider further justification necessary.
Deze leden achten een nadere onderbouwing nodig.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the draft Belastingwet BES, establishing a separate tax regime for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, is not yet mature and cannot be advised positively in its current form, with serious objections on the absence of inheritance tax, corporate tax and motor vehicle tax and the justification of differences from Dutch law. The government's nader rapport largely rejects the objections on corporate tax and inheritance tax and accepts some points (e.g. Caribbean tax regime rationale, BRK revision), but the text is cut off before the full reply.
concerns: The Afdeling holds that differentiation between Dutch Caribbean and European Netherlands must be objectively justified, which the explanatory memorandum did not adequately do, and the government largely rejects this as already justified by the islands' special characteristics.

The Afdeling advises including a successierecht (inheritance and gift tax) and a corporate profit tax and motor vehicle tax, which the government declines to adopt, instead substituting specific measures and forfait-based taxes.

The absence of a profit tax and a 5% dividend withholding creates an unjustified tax advantage for legal entities and an attraction effect for companies from Curaçao, Sint Maarten and Aruba, which the government rejects as not a reason for a regular profit tax.
The Afdeling sees tension with the EU Code of Conduct on business taxation because of partial exemptions in the Opb, which the government disputes.

The Afdeling requires the Belastingregeling voor het Koninkrijk to be revised before the bill enters into force to avoid double taxation and gaps, and the government largely accepts the need for BRK revision while planning it separately.

The Afdeling finds the explanatory memorandum and the systematic structure of the income tax chapters insufficiently developed, and the government accepts this by removing the income and wage tax chapters for now.

32222-IV.s: This bill amends the 2009 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Kingdom Relations by a supplementary budget adjustment accompanying the autumn memorandum. It sets the effective date of the amendment and states that the figures are expressed in thousands of euros.
q: The departmental budget statement of Kingdom Relations for the year 2009 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32222-VI.s: This bill amends the 2009 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice (supplementary budget tied to the Najaarsnota), changing the budgeted amounts in thousands of euros and setting an effective date of 1 December 2009. The explanatory memorandum reports budget changes for the courts, legal aid and related programmes, but does not delegate rule-making power.
q: It is so that We, with the joint consultation of the States General, have approved and decided, as We approve and decide by this: Article 1 The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice (VI) for 2009 is amended.

Zo is het, dat Wij met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze: Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie (VI) voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd.

32288.s: The bill amends the Zeebrievenwet to let the minister refuse new ship registration certificates for vessels whose certificate was previously revoked, and extends the grounds for revocation to cover handling that endangers other ships or people and serious breaches of the legal order harming the Kingdom's foreign relations. The revocation grounds are added to the existing list in article 8, fourth paragraph.
32288.j: The memorandum justifies the new revocation grounds by IMO recommendations on port state control and says the power is used with respect for the ECHR and general principles of proper administration, while noting a preventive deterrent effect.
q: Naturally, when applying this power, higher regulations, such as the European Convention on Human Rights and the general principles of proper administration, will be observed.

Vanzelfsprekend zal bij de toepassing van deze bevoegdheid hogere regelgeving, zoals het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens en de algemene beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur in acht worden genomen.
p: The minister may refuse issuance of certificates to vessels whose certificate was previously revoked, with no stated procedure or review.
Artikel I B (art. 8, fourth paragraph, new subparts d and e)
Adds broad, open-ended grounds for revoking a sea certificate, including vague threats to the legal order and foreign relations, widening executive discretion.

parties: Asks whether the e-ground is sufficiently clear, what 'seriously harmed relations' means, and whether the existing d-ground already offered enough powers; also asks about clear procedural deadlines for shipowners.
The VVD members are not yet convinced that the amended e-ground is sufficiently clear and concise.
De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn nog niet overtuigd dat de gewijzigde e-grond voldoende helder is en beknopt is.
Doubts necessity and scope, says the e-ground is subjective and offers insufficient legal certainty, risks a chilling effect on protest, and prefers criminal law and court involvement.
The PvdA members so far find the proposed e-ground insufficiently concrete and objectively formulated.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vinden tot dusver de voorgestelde e-grond onvoldoende concreet en objectief geformuleerd.

Not convinced of the e-ground's necessity and fears it creates legal uncertainty; asks why administrative rather than criminal law is used and notes the absence of a Council of State review of the explanatory memorandum.
With current knowledge, the CDA members are insufficiently convinced of the necessity and usefulness of the above article.
Met de kennis van nu zijn de leden van de CDA-fractie onvoldoende overtuigd van nut en noodzaak van bovengenoemd artikel.

Says the government brushes aside the Council of State's harsh criticism of the e-ground, which undermines legal certainty and invites arbitrariness; asks about appeal options and the absence of a judicial review.
The SP members believe the government insufficiently justifies why it largely disregards the Council of State's damning criticism of the e-ground.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn van mening dat de regering onvoldoende onderbouwt waarom zij de vernietigende kritiek van de Raad van State op de e-grond, grotendeels naast zich neerlegt.

Argue withdrawal of a sea letter is extremely far-reaching, questions compatibility with free expression and fair trial, and calls for a judge's intervention before any withdrawal for legal certainty.
The GroenLinks and D66 members conclude that for legal certainty, judicial intervention is desirable in all circumstances before a sea letter may be withdrawn.

De leden van de fracties van GroenLinks en D66 concluderen dat omwille van de rechtszekerheid in alle omstandigheden tussenkomst van een rechter gewenst is, alvorens tot de intrekking van de zeebrief kan worden overgegaan.
Asks why criminal enforcement is insufficient, what norms apply to the e-ground, and whether the grounds conflict with ECHR articles 10 and 11 and risk a chilling effect.
These members ask for further justification on the extent to which the e-ground is compatible with ECHR articles 10 and 11.
Deze leden vragen om een nadere onderbouwing ten aanzien van de vraag in hoeverre de e-grond zich verhoudt tot de artikelen 10 en 11 EVRM.

Rejects the bill as politically motivated retaliation against Sea Shepherd at Japan's request; argues offences should be handled through criminal law with an independent court, and that the grounds are too broad and subjective and may breach ECHR articles 10 and 11.
In the view of the Partij voor de Dieren members, violations of laws and regulations can be addressed much better through criminal law.
Naar mening van de leden van de fractie van de Partij voor de Dieren kunnen overtredingen van wet- en regelgeving veel beter via het strafrecht worden aangekaart.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises on a bill amending the Zeebrievenwet to add two grounds for withdrawing a sea letter, mainly a ground for harm to other vessels and a ground for serious harm to foreign relations. The Raad supports the bill's aim but finds the foreign-relations ground too subjective and insufficiently defined, and the government's reply narrows the ground and adds a refusal power.
concerns: The foreign-relations ground (e-grond) is too subjective and vaguely formulated, undermining legal certainty for sea letter holders, so its scope must be defined more precisely.
The Raad questions why the foreign-relations ground is needed beyond the existing harm ground and asks for a substantiated justification of its necessity.
The foreign-relations ground could affect the right to demonstrate on the high seas, so its reach should be narrowly limited.
Withdrawal of a sea letter must be proportionate to its effects on the vessel's use and the flag-state protection it provides.

32297.s: The bill amends the Wet basisregistraties adressen en gebouwen to align it with the EU Services Directive and INSPIRE directive. It replaces ministerial designation of firms performing periodic municipal register audits with an accreditation requirement set by ministerial regulation, and restricts the legal grounds for access to registers.
32297.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by EU Services Directive requirements and argues that accreditation by the Raad voor Accreditatie is a proportionate, non-discriminatory safeguard of quality and public order.
q: To ensure that this audit is carried out by firms that are sufficiently qualified, the proposed article 42, fourth paragraph, under c, provides for quality requirements to be set by ministerial regulation.

Om te waarborgen dat deze controle wordt uitgevoerd door bedrijven die daarvoor voldoende gekwalificeerd zijn, wordt in het thans voorgestelde artikel 42, vierde lid, onderdeel c, voorzien in het stellen van kwaliteitseisen bij ministeriële regeling.
d: audit procedures, cost reimbursement, and quality requirements for audit firms
elements of the periodic audit of municipal registers
procedure for the repeated audit after deficiencies are found
p: Access to registers for public bodies and other users via search and query services is limited to specified statutory grounds of the Wet openbaarheid van bestuur.
Ministerial designation of audit firms is replaced by accreditation, and the explicit mention of checking accuracy, completeness and currency of register data is removed from the audit scope.

parties: Asks why central oversight is not placed with the Kadaster instead of municipal audits, and notes the accreditation approach closely resembles designation by the minister.
However, they ask why a national check by the Kadaster was not chosen instead of audits per municipality.
Wel vragen zij waarom niet wordt gekozen voor een landelijke controle bij het Kadaster in plaats van voor audits per gemeente?
Asks for justification of replacing ministerial designation with accreditation, whether this adds bureaucracy, the duration of accreditation, and the legal status of the Raad voor Accreditatie.
Does the establishment of the Raad voor Accreditatie not mean the creation of an extra bureaucratic layer?
Betekent de instelling van de Raad voor Accreditatie niet de vorming van een extra bureaucratische laag?
