v.summary: The Raad van State advises on a bill amending the Wet basisregistraties adressen en gebouwen to align it with the EU Services Directive, mainly removing ministerial designation of audit firms and planning accreditation. The Council doubts that public order justifies an accreditation requirement and that it is compatible with Article 16 of the Services Directive, and asks the government to reconsider; the government's reply explains why accreditation is necessary and proportionate and keeps the plan.
concerns: The Council doubts that the accreditation requirement can be justified on public order grounds under Article 16 of the Services Directive and is not convinced it is compatible with that article.
The Council notes that the stated risk to public order is not demonstrated, since existing safeguards and less far-reaching quality requirements could achieve the same aim.
The Council questions whether the accreditation requirement is proportionate compared with substantive quality criteria.

The Council asks whether the Services Directive warrants reconsidering the choice of audit forms across basic registers; the government says the explanatory memorandum was supplemented but the bill text was not changed.

32395-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statement for the Overige Hoge Colleges van Staat en Kabinetten (IIB), adjusting spending and receipts for the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman and governor cabinets, with effect from 1 June 2010. It is a budgetary adjustment tied to the Voorjaarsnota and contains no new executive powers.
32395-IIB.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as budgetary adjustments in line with the spring memorandum, not as delegation of power.
q: Amendment of the 2010 budget statement for the Other High Colleges of State and Cabinets (IIB) (amendment linked to the Spring Memorandum)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Overige Hoge Colleges van Staat en Kabinetten (IIB) voor het jaar 2010 (wijziging samenhangend met de Voorjaarsnota)

32396.s: The bill strengthens the position of teachers in primary, secondary, adult/vocational and higher education by giving them a statutory right of control (zeggenschap) over the design and execution of educational policy within their school or institution. It requires the competent authority to set rules for working consultation after consulting teachers, and gives the staff part of the participation council an instemmingsrecht over those rules.
32396.j: The memorandum justifies the statutory teacher control by the LeerKracht convenants, advice from the Commissie Leraren, the Onderwijsraad and the WRR, and the goal of a more attractive profession and better education quality.
q: The teacher has control within the school, which includes at least the teacher's control over the design and execution of educational policy and policy on the quality of education.

De leraar beschikt over zeggenschap binnen de school, waaronder ten minste wordt verstaan de zeggenschap van de leraar over het ontwerp en de uitvoering van het onderwijskundig beleiden het beleid met betrekking totde kwaliteit van het onderwijs.
d: Artikel 29a lid 3 (WPO, WEC), 32b2 lid 3 (WVO), 4.1.1b lid 3 (WEB), 10.2a lid 3 (WHW)
rules for working consultation on how teacher control is organised
p: Teachers and staff gain statutory control over educational design and quality within the limits set by the competent authority, shifting internal school authority from management toward teaching staff.
The participation council's staff part receives an instemmingsrecht over adopting or amending the working-consultation rules, adding a participatory check on the competent authority."}],

parties: Asks whether co-decision agreements risk being captured by umbrella organisations and whether accountability (rekenschap) for teachers' performance should also be legislated; also asks about inspectorate workload.
The bill must not be "hijacked" by umbrella organisations that, through professional statutes, more or less "lock down" the co-decision conditions.
Het wetsvoorstel mag niet «gekaapt» worden door koepelorganisaties die vervolgens via professionele statuten de zeggenschapsvoorwaarden min of meer «dichtregelen».
Asks how the government views broader professional latitude for teachers beyond the school and whether differentiation per school location is possible.
Must uniform agreements always apply to the entire institution, or can some differentiation take place per location of an institution?
Moeten er telkens uniforme afspraken gelden voor de gehele instelling of kan er ook per vestiging van een instelling een zekere differentiatie plaatsvinden?

Asks why co-decision is not fixed at team level, how a minimum is avoided so the law does not become a paper tiger, and how the bill relates to the Wet medezeggenschap scholen and inspectorate supervision.
After all, no minimum standards are laid down in the law regarding what the teachers' co-decision covers.
Er worden immers geen minimumnormen vastgelegd in de wet waarover de zeggenschap van de docenten gaat.
Doubts the bill strengthens the teacher's position; asks what teachers can actually decide on and why the legal frameworks are not broadened.
The members doubt whether this bill strengthens the position of the teacher.
De leden betwijfelen of onderhavig wetsvoorstel de positie van de leraar versterkt.

Supports internal co-decision if freedom of direction and organisation (art. 23 Grondwet) is preserved, and asks how the constitutional freedom of education interacts with co-decision at the lowest level.
The members agree with adding the obligation to shape internal co-decision of teachers in schools, provided this preserves freedom of direction and organisation.
De leden sluiten zich aan bij het toevoegen van de verplichting om vorm te geven aan interne zeggenschap van leraren op scholen, mits dit de vrijheid van richting en inrichting in stand houdt.
Questions whether co-decision can coexist with the competent authority's responsibility under article 23 of the Constitution, questions the need for legislation, and warns of administrative burden.
These members note, however, that co-decision cannot lie in two places at once.
Deze leden constateren echter dat zeggenschap niet op twee plaatsen tegelijk kan liggen.
Asks whether the bill's effect on teacher professionalism and administrative burden is clear, and whether it adds to existing rules.
The VVD members think it is a good thing that schools are obliged to make agreements with teachers on say over educational and quality policy.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vinden het een goede zaak dat scholen verplicht worden afspraken te maken met leraren over zeggenschap inzake het onderwijskundig en kwaliteitsbeleid.
Asks what the added value of the bill is over existing primary, secondary and vocational arrangements and professional statutes.
This bill is in effect a procedural agreement, the members state.
Dit wetsvoorstel is feitelijk een procedureafspraak, zo stellen de leden.
Worries the bill will be a paper tiger because no minimum norms for teacher say are set in law, and asks for a lower limit.
Why, these members ask, can no lower limit be specified?
Waarom kan, zo vragen deze leden, geen ondergrens worden aangegeven?
Doubts the bill guarantees more teacher say, warns of a consultation circus and of new limits without a remedy for the team.
Does the government share the fear that a consultation circus will be created without teachers gaining a stronger position and more say?
Deelt de regering de vrees dat er een overlegcircus wordt opgesteld, zonder dat de leraar een sterkere positie en meer zeggenschap krijgt?
Notes the bill's voluntary character and vague scope may leave teachers without concrete say, and asks whether it can be tightened.
Can the government consider limiting the voluntary nature?
Kan de regering in overweging nemen om de vrijblijvendheid in te perken?
Asks what the bill adds to the existing works council consent right over the school plan and how it separates participation from say.
The members request a response on where the added value of the bill lies above the existing consent right of the works council regarding adoption of the school plan.

De leden vragen alsnog een reactie op de vraag waarin de meerwaarde van het wetsvoorstel ligt boven de bestaande instemmingsbevoegdheid van de medezeggenschapsraad ten aanzien van de vaststelling van het schoolplan.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill strengthening teachers' professional autonomy (professionele ruimte) across education sector laws, supporting its aim but raising objections on unclear wording, the relation between teacher control and works council participation, and academic freedom in higher education. The government's nader rapport accepts most remarks, revising the text and explanatory memorandum, but declines to drop the second paragraph of the articles on collective team-level control.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for much simpler, clearer wording of the articles and a shorter explanatory memorandum, which the government largely adopted.
The unclear procedure for establishing the professional statute and the handling of disputes was resolved by giving the personnel part of the works council a consent right and a dispute route.

The Afdeling advised clarifying the relation between teacher control and works council participation and the sectoral professional statute; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented, though the second-paragraph deletion was not accepted.
The Afdeling asked that the explanation of academic freedom at universities versus universities of applied sciences be clarified, and the memorandum was adjusted accordingly.
The Afdeling asked that the Dijsselbloem commission findings on the dangers to teacher autonomy be discussed more fully in the explanatory memorandum.

32459.s: The bill amends the Gemeentewet so that municipal councils must adopt an integrated safety plan at least once every four years, based on local analysis and input from police and prosecutors. It also adds an article obliging the mayor to oversee local safety policy, strengthening the municipality's coordinating role without altering existing competences.
32459.j: The memorandum justifies the mayoral duty by pointing to partners' view that municipalities must take a firmer coordinating role and by stating that existing allocations of tasks and powers are left intact.
q: This bill does not infringe on the existing legal division of tasks, powers and responsibilities.
Dit wetsvoorstel maakt geen inbreuk op de bestaande wettelijke verdeling van taken, bevoegdheden en verantwoordelijkheden.
p: The mayor receives a statutory duty to oversee local safety policy, an inspanningsverplichting that formalises a coordinating role without new coercive powers.

parties: Supports strengthening the municipal role but notes the mandatory plan touches municipal autonomy and asks how council prerogatives are protected against the college's preparation.

Although the obligation on the municipal council to adopt an integrated safety plan at least once every four years touches on municipal autonomy, these members consider it a good thing in the interest of local safety for citizens.

Hoewel de verplichting aan de gemeenteraad om ten minste eenmaal in de vier jaar een integraal veiligheidsplan vast te stellen raakt aan de gemeentelijke autonomie, zijn deze leden van mening dat het in het belang van de lokale veiligheid van burgers een goede zaak is.

Supports the municipal coordinating role but criticises the absence of binding power over partners and of the mayor's authority to break deadlocks, and asks why the originally planned enforcement powers were dropped.
However, the bill lacks binding of partners to the safety plan and the mayor's power to break a deadlock in case of disagreement.
Het ontbreekt in het wetsvoorstel echter aan binding van de partners aan het veiligheidsplan en de bevoegdheid van de burgemeester om hier bij onenigheid een patstelling te doorbreken.
Asks how citizens get involved and whether the bill fits with youth-care reform, and questions the absence of enforcement options when partners such as youth care fail to cooperate.
What options does the municipality have in such a situation to force a solution?
Welke mogelijkheden heeft de gemeente in een dergelijke situatie om een oplossing af te dwingen?
Fears the bill adds bureaucracy without solving the problem and asks why the college of mayor and aldermen was not given power to impose obligations on safety partners.
Why was it not chosen to give the college of mayor and aldermen the power to impose obligations on the various safety partners where necessary?
Waarom is er niet voor gekozen het college van B en W de bevoegdheid te geven om – zo nodig – verplichtingen op te leggen aan de verschillende veiligheidspartners?
Questions whether the safety plan is an effective instrument, asks who is politically accountable when policy fails, and questions the scope of the mayor's responsibility given the role of aldermen.

Is there not a large risk that the mayor will be held responsible for everything, while safety policy is implemented in important parts by aldermen and/or other parties over which the mayor has insufficient influence?

Is het risico niet groot dat de burgemeester overal voor verantwoordelijk wordt gehouden, terwijl het veiligheidsbeleid op belangrijke delen wordt uitgevoerd door wethouders en/of andere betrokkenen, waarop de burgemeester onvoldoende invloed heeft?

v.summary: The Council of State advised against the planning obligation for municipal integrated safety plans, arguing it adds administrative burden without clear new powers and that the 'regie' concept is unclear. The government's reply largely maintained the bill, kept the plan obligation, dropped the provision on agreements, and partly followed the advice on drafting.
concerns: The Council held a mandatory integrated safety plan an unnecessary administrative burden, since cooperation either exists or cannot be forced by a plan, and advised omitting the obligation; the government disagreed and kept the obligation.

The Council found the bill gives municipalities no additional powers, so unclear which problems it solves; the government added an explicit mayoral role but dropped the proposed power to impose agreements.

The Council objected to the use of the term 'regierol' and 'horizontale regie' as contradictory and misleading, and to the vague notion of 'integrale' safety; the government kept the terms but clarified them in the explanatory memorandum.
The Council advised that the bill was premature because the coordinated youth and family policy proposal had not yet been finalised, so the bill should not yet be submitted to parliament.

The Council advised against a provision on mandatory agreements with partners that would wrongly imply organisations cannot limit their statutory tasks, and suggested dropping redundant priority-setting language; the government removed the agreements provision and kept the priorities implicit.

32468.s: The bill amends the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure to restructure how the public prosecutor compiles the case file (processtukken) and how investigating officers record their work in written reports. It lets the prosecutor and the investigating judge withhold certain documents from the suspect and lets the suspect request that specific documents be added to the file, with judicial oversight through the rechter-commissaris.
32468.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the new withholding powers by the need to protect investigations and privacy, and it adds rechter-commissaris review of these decisions as a safeguard.
q: The proposed regulation aims to further emphasise the supervisory role of the investigating judge in compiling the case file.
De voorgestelde regeling beoogt een nadere accentuering van de toezichthoudende rol van het rechter-commissariaat bij de dossiervorming.
d: rules on providing copies and inspection of case-file documents
rules on how case files are compiled and organised
p: Allows the public prosecutor to omit documents from the case file on privacy, investigation or public-interest grounds, subject to investigating-judge authorisation and a written record.
Lets the prosecutor temporarily withhold file inspection and copies from the suspect, with the suspect able to challenge this before the rechter-commissaris.
Allows officers to forgo sending reports to the prosecutor when the prosecutor agrees, and makes transmission depend on prosecutorial directives.</parameter>

parties: Asks about the relationship between the victim's and suspect's file-access rights, digitalisation, and whether the rechter-commissaris's role in withholding documents is adequately justified; questions whether the raadkamer procedure should move to the rechter-commissaris.

Doubts the bill strengthens the suspect's position, asks for an overview of changing rechter-commissaris tasks, and presses that withholding documents must not limit legal protection and that all parties must have equal access to the file.
The PvdA members note that this bill and the bill strengthening the rechter-commissaris's position change the rechter-commissaris's tasks.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie merken op dat onderhavig voorstel en het wetsvoorstel versterking positie rechter-commissaris zorgen voor een verandering van de taken van de rechter-commissaris.
Sees a risk to the suspect's defence in allowing a proces-verbaal not to be drawn up, and asks how many wrong decisions resulted from not recording.
These members currently see this as a risk to the suspect's defence.
Deze leden zien dit vooralsnog als een risico voor de verdediging van de verdachte.

Supports the shift of withholding decisions to the rechter-commissaris as a critical check, but worries the NOvA's lack of support signals weakened suspect protection; asks about refusals to add defence-submitted documents.

These members welcome the shift of authority from the raadkamer to the rechter-commissaris, because this is a vulnerable restriction of the suspect's legal position that must be reviewed critically and fully.

Deze leden zijn ingenomen met de verschuiving van de bevoegdheid van de raadkamer naar de rechter-commissaris, omdat het hier om een kwetsbare inperking van de rechtspositie van verdachte gaat die kritisch en volledig dient te worden getoetst.

Accepts the rechter-commissaris ruling on access based on the full file, but warns the rechter-commissaris must keep distance from substance, and wants independent review of documents the defence wants added.
These members endorse the role of the rechter-commissaris.
Deze leden onderschrijven de rol van de rechter-commissaris.
Asks how the grounds for refusing copies relate to the grounds for refusing inspection, and whether privacy and prosecution interests can be invoked, plus limits on copies of illegal material.
They would like to know which exceptions have so far been accepted in case law for inspection of paper documents and data on other data carriers.
Graag vernemen zij welke uitzonderingen tot nu toe aanvaard worden in de jurisprudentie voor zowel de inzage in papieren stukken als gegevens op andere gegevensdragers.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill revising the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure on case documents, police reporting and the procedural file, and called for clearer links with the bill strengthening the investigating judge's position. It also advised adding a rule that the suspect's right to inspect case documents arises at the latest from the first interrogation, which the government's reply adopted along with clarifications to the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling advised adding to article 30 Sv that the suspect's right to inspect case documents exists at least from the first interrogation, to provide certainty about when the right can be invoked.
The Afdeling asked that the explanatory memorandum explain how the new position and tasks of the investigating judge affect the bill, including timely access to the full procedural file.

The Afdeling's remarks on the coherence between this bill and the bill strengthening the investigating judge led to clarifications in the explanatory memorandum and to articles II and III clarifying article 153 Sv.

32477.s: The bill amends the pension laws (Wet Bpf 2000 and Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling) to restrict pension funds and their administrators from letting third parties use the fund's name or brand in ways that could create association, and to limit data disclosure and information provided to participants. It also allows advertising by financial product providers under equal conditions and aligns the rules with the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens.
32477.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by removing uncertainty for pension funds about the restrictions, after consultation and a supervisory review by De Nederlandsche Bank, without granting new powers to the executive.
q: The bill was submitted by the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment to De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) for a supervisory review.
Het wetsvoorstel is door het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid voor een toezichttoets voorgelegd aan De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).

parties: Asks how DNB will supervise the amended provisions and when parliament will be informed whether the changes are effective, and how the Raad van State's criticism is answered.
In what manner, with what frequency and on the basis of which criteria will De Nederlandse Bank (DNB) supervise the changes included in this bill?
Op welke wijze, met welke periodiciteit en aan de hand van welke criteria zal De Nederlandse Bank (DNB) toezicht houden op de in het kader van dit wetsvoorstel opgenomen wijzigingen?
Agrees with the Raad van State that the provision serves commercial rather than informational purposes and asks for an alternative to raise pension awareness; also asks whether the AFM was consulted.
The PvdA members share the Raad van State's view that the proposed Article 5(3)(a) Wet Bpf 2000 serves more commercial purposes than the stated information provision.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie delen de mening van de Raad van State dat de strekking van het voorgestelde artikel 5, derde lid, onder a, Wet Bpf 2000 meer commerciële doeleinden dient, dan zoals voorgesteld slechts voorlichting geeft.

Worries that consumers will associate the pension fund's name and logo with the financial products of the implementing body, and asks what measures limit this risk and whether the claimed gain in pension awareness is justified.
Displaying the name and logo of the occupational pension fund towards consumers carries the risk that consumers will associate the mandatory pension with the financial product.

Het weergeven van naam en beeldmerk van het bedrijfspensioenfonds in de richting van consumenten brengt het risico met zich mee dat consumenten het verplichte pensioen en het financiële product met elkaar gaan associëren.
Presents three scenarios in which the restrictions leave employees and employers without answers and asks whether the restrictions are proportionate to the risk of market distortion.
Is the government of the opinion that the law in this situation stands in the way of adequate and efficient provision of information?
Is de regering van mening dat de wet in deze situatie een adequate en efficiënte informatievoorziening in de weg staat?
Asks whether alternatives such as a mandatory warning were considered and whether the AFM, with its consumer-protection expertise, was consulted on the bill.
The D66 members are of the view that not only the pensions sector but also the AFM should be consulted.
De leden van de D66-fractie zijn van mening dat niet alleen het pensioenveld geconsulteerd moeten worden, maar ook de AFM.
Questions what social problem the bill solves and warns that naming the fund could create an unequal playing field and steer participants toward the implementing body's products.
Indeed, they ask whether this may create an unequal playing field.
Sterker nog: zij vragen zich af of hierdoor geen ongelijk speelveld gaat ontstaan.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised, on 30 June 2010, that the proposed new article 5(3)(a) of the Wet Bpf 2000, allowing pension fund names in communication about financial products, does not clearly serve its purpose and risks undermining the ban and unfair competition, and asked the government to reconsider it. The minister's reply of 3 September 2010 rejects the concern about unfair competition, argues the rule creates a level playing field, and adds that the advice has been incorporated in the drafting and that the proposal is otherwise maintained.
concerns: The Raad doubts that the expanded exception actually serves the aim of better individual pension information, since individual advice requires data the provider does not have.
The Raad considers that the exception risks hollowing out the general ban in the first paragraph and could lead to unfair competition among financial product providers.
The Raad suggests aligning the transitional provisions in Article III with the entry-into-force provision in Article IV and bringing the explanatory memorandum in line with the drafting guidelines.

32486.s: The bill amends the Dutch Minimum Wage and Minimum Holiday Allowance Act to give labour inspectors the power to seize seizable objects, such as administrative records, when employers refuse to cooperate with an inspection. It also makes two technical changes: removing a reference to the repealed Wet inschakeling werkzoekenden and deleting the transitional provision in article 23a.
32486.j: The memorandum justifies the seizure power by employers' refusal to cooperate and the risk that records are altered before inspection, noting it will be used only when reasonably necessary.
q: The power may only be used if this is reasonably necessary for the proper performance of the task.
De bevoegdheid mag alleen worden gebruikt als dit redelijkerwijs voor de goede vervulling van de taak nodig is.
p: Designated officials may seize objects at any time without prior judicial authorisation, limited by a necessity test and a duty to return items once the investigation allows.

parties: Supports the seizure power as a tool against exploitation but asks how it is limited, how long items may be held, how employer privacy is protected, whether the employer can appeal, and whether compensation is due.
Can the government elaborate on the options for the employer to appeal against the seizure?
Kan de regering nader ingaan op de mogelijkheden voor de werkgever om in beroep te gaan tegen de in beslagneming?
Welcomes the bill and considers the seizure power essential for enforcing the minimum wage act.
The PvdA members consider this power essential for compliance with the Minimum Wage and Minimum Holiday Allowance Act.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vinden deze bevoegdheid essentieel voor de naleving van de Wet minimumloon en minimumvakantiebijslag.
Approves the bill and has no substantive questions.
The SP members have noted the bill with approval and have no substantive questions.
De leden van de SP fractie hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben geen inhoudelijke vragen.
Asks how strong the suspicion must be before seizure, whether employers can claim damages for wrongful action, and whether the employer can amend records within the period before seizure.
How strong must the suspicion of an offence be before the labour inspectorate proceeds to seizure?
Hoe sterk moet de verdenking op een overtreding zijn voordat de arbeidsinspectie overgaat tot inbeslagneming?

32549.s: The bill amends the Telecommunicatiewet, the OPTA act and related laws to implement new EU directives and a regulation on electronic communications networks and services, covering market regulation, spectrum, numbering, consumer protection and security. It introduces numerous delegations to ministerial and general administrative measures, and tasks the regulator with new powers including possible functional separation of operators.
32549.j: The memorandum justifies delegations as the appropriate place for technical detail that may change often, and says general administrative measures are used for administrative rules and ministerial regulations for frequently changing or urgent rules.
q: A ministerial regulation is chosen where rules often need amendment and where urgent adoption may be needed.

Voor een ministeriële regeling wordt gekozen als het om voorschriften gaat die vaak wijziging behoeven en voorschriften waarvan te voorzien is dat zij mogelijk met grote spoed moeten worden vastgesteld.
d: frequency plan restrictions on technology and service types
licence conditions on technologies and frequency use
forced transfer of licence to new holder and procedure
numbering plans and tariff caps for numbers
rules ensuring EU end-user access to numbers
functional separation of access operators by college decision
transparency of tariffs and service restrictions
blocking access to numbers and suspending payment
extra facilities such as tariff advice and cost control
designation of universal service providers and bids
conditions for storing or accessing data on user devices
continuity and emergency measures for networks
p: Minister may compel a licence holder to transfer its licence to a buyer chosen through a state-run procedure, with appeal available against the decision.
The regulator may order functional separation of an operator, constrained by European Commission approval and detailed justification requirements.
Rules may allow providers to block access to numbers or services and suspend payments without specified procedural safeguards.

parties: Asks where Dutch implementation goes beyond the EU directives and when the subordinate regulation will be presented, questioning the unclear scope of the bill without it.
Without the further elaboration of the law through regulation in general administrative measures and ministerial regulations, much is still unclear and these members can only speak in general terms.

Zonder de nadere invulling van de wet door middel van regelgeving in algemene maatregelen van bestuur en ministeriële regelingen is nog veel onduidelijk en kunnen deze leden alleen in algemene termen spreken.
Questions whether OPTA's heightened burden of proof hampers its supervisory task before courts and asks the government to remove it.

Is the impression of these members correct that the heightened burden of proof, or rather the heightened duty of justification, sometimes hampers OPTA in its supervisory task because certain decisions are harder to uphold before the court?

Klopt de indruk van deze leden dat de verzwaarde bewijslast, of eigenlijk de verzwaarde onderbouwingsplicht, OPTA soms belemmert in zijn toezichthoudende taak doordat bepaalde besluiten moeilijker overeind blijven of zouden kunnen blijven voor de rechter door deze toegevoegde bepaling?
Focuses on consumer choice, number portability and advertising blocks rather than on checks against the executive.
The PVV members consider legal certainty and consumer choice options very important.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vinden de rechtszekerheid en keuzemogelijkheden van de consument van groot belang.
Asks why supervision of personal data provisions is not placed with the data protection authority CBP and seeks clarity on delegated rules.
The CDA members ask the government to explain why supervision of compliance with the personal data provisions of chapters 11 and 11a is not placed with the CBP.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering aan te geven waarom het toezicht op de naleving van de bepalingen uit hoofdstuk 11 en 11a, inzake persoonsgegevens, niet wordt neergelegd bij het CBP?
Raises concern about the many delegation provisions and vague implementation context, asking for more information on when and why rules will be set.
Furthermore, the bill contains a considerable number of delegation provisions.
Verder staan er een behoorlijk aantal delegatiebepalingen in het wets voorstel.
Worries that the many delegated articles make the bill a framework law, reducing political control over actual policy, and asks why delegation was chosen.
In addition, in this way there is also insufficient political control over the actual policy.
Daarnaast is er op deze manier ook onvoldoende politieke controle op het daadwerkelijke beleid.
Sees no reason to ask questions at this stage.
These members currently see no reason to ask questions.
Deze leden zien op dit moment geen aanleiding voor het stellen van vragen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion of 3 September 2010 on the bill amending the Telecommunicatiewet to implement the revised EU telecom directives supports the bill's aims but raises several points on functional separation, consultation of amended draft decisions, cookie consent rules and drafting. The minister's reply of 29 October 2010 adopts most of the remarks, partly followed the cookie-consent advice by deferring to the Commission's efforts and moving rules to an AMB, and adds new provisions such as forced sale and universal service compensation.
concerns: Article 6a.4a(1) should be aligned with article 13bis of the access directive, limiting functional separation to wholesale access activities; the minister confirms the scope is already limited via the definition of access.
Article 6a.4a(4) should expressly list all aspects of article 13bis(2) that the draft decision must address; the minister added them.

Article 6b.2(5) does not ensure that an amended draft decision is re-consulted publicly and re-notified to the Commission; the minister points to existing obligations in articles 6b.1 and 6b.2(1) and supplements the explanatory memorandum.

The cookie-consent rule in article 11.7a should be supplemented with rules on how consent is obtained, given Article 29 Working Party criticism of browser-settings consent; the minister agrees in principle but defers until the Commission's EU-wide initiatives are known, while amending the explanatory memorandum and moving the rule to an AMB.
Editorial remarks on articles 6a.1(3) and (6) and 6a.4(2) regarding BEREC assistance were not adopted, the minister arguing the Framework Directive only obliges assistance on request.

32576.s: The bill tightens the Dutch Supreme Court cassation system by requiring Supreme Court advocates to meet specific competence rules set by the college van afgevaardigden, with discipline-court appeal, and by letting the Supreme Court declare a cassation appeal inadmissible early when claims clearly cannot succeed or the appellant clearly lacks sufficient interest. Consequential amendments to the Code of Civil Procedure and transitional rules accompany these changes.
32576.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the Supreme Court's growing workload from hopeless cassation appeals, arguing that early selection protects the court's core tasks and legal unity while leaving the right to appeal intact.
q: The bill aims to enable the Supreme Court to concentrate as cassation judge on its core tasks.
Het wetsvoorstel is erop gericht de Hoge Raad in staat te stellen zich als cassatierechter te concentreren op zijn kerntaken.
d: competence requirements for Supreme Court advocates
distinct rules for civil, criminal and tax cases
setting a later entry-into-force date for criminal and tax rules
entry-into-force date set by royal decree, varying by article
p: Gives the Supreme Court discretion to declare cassation appeals inadmissible at the outset, with the procureur-general heard and the case file consulted before deciding.

parties: Worries that letting the Supreme Court itself judge admissibility of cassation could leave citizens feeling abandoned by the judiciary, and asks for justification of the instrument and its alternatives.

These members are not convinced the proposed instrument is right, because it may lead citizens to feel abandoned by the entire judiciary if the judiciary itself decides on the admissibility of cassation.

Deze leden zijn evenwel niet overtuigd van de juistheid van het voorgestelde instrument omdat het ertoe kan leiden dat de rechtzoekende burger zich door de gehele rechterlijke macht in de steek gelaten voelt als het de rechterlijke macht zelf is die het oordeel over de toelaatbaarheid van de cassatie velt.
Supports the focus on quality over quantity and the quality requirements, while voicing concerns about the consequences of the law.
It seems a good thing to these members that the focus shifts to quality rather than quantity.
Het lijkt deze leden een goede zaak dat de focus komt te liggen op kwaliteit en niet op kwantiteit.
Asks what the admissibility criteria 'clearly cannot lead to cassation' and 'clearly insufficient interest' mean and questions whether the existing article 81 retains any function.
With these members, the criteria 'clearly cannot lead to cassation' and 'clearly insufficient interest' in article 80a of the Wet RO raise some questions.
Bij deze leden roepen de criteria «klaarblijkelijk niet tot cassatie kunnen leiden» en «klaarblijkelijk onvoldoende belang» van artikel 80a Wet RO enige vragen op.
Supports quality requirements and self-regulation by the bar, but asks what 'clearly insufficient interest' means and whether it is objective, and how Parliament will be informed on the regulation.
The CDA members ask the government to specify exactly what is meant by 'clearly insufficient interest'.  Is there an objective criterion or must it be judged case by case?
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering nader aan te geven wat precies onder «klaarblijkelijk onvoldoende belang» moet worden verstaan.

Strongly objects to the open-ended discretionary power of the Hoge Raad to select cases by its own standards, fearing non-legal considerations such as financial steering of capacity, and asks for verifiable criteria and oversight.
The Hoge Raad's own discretionary power now assigned opens the door to a practice where considerations other than the citizen's legal protection gain the upper hand.

De eigen discretionaire bevoegdheid die de Hoge Raad nu krijgt toebedeeld zet de deur open voor een praktijk waarbij andere afwegingen de overhand krijgen dan louter de rechtsbescherming van de burger.
Supports the aims but asks for clarification on how adequate representation of citizens' interests in all legal fields fits with the planned focus of the regulation on civil cases.

These members ask the government to explain how the stated interest in adequate representation in the highest instance across all legal fields relates to the remark that the regulation may primarily target civil cases.

Deze leden verzoeken de regering nader toe te lichten, hoe het genoemde belang van een adequate belangenbehartiging in hoogste aanleg in alle rechtsgebieden zich verhoudt tot de opmerking dat het denkbaar is dat de op basis van artikel 9j Advocatenwet vorm te geven verordening zich primair zal richten op eisen aan advocaten bij de Hoge Raad in civielrechtelijke zaken.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill strengthening cassation jurisprudence by tightening requirements for advocates before the Hoge Raad and allowing it to declare appeals inadmissible. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted most points, including appeal against refusal of registration, extending the transitional period to two years, deleting the transitional exemption rule, excluding sitting Supreme Court members from the examination committee, and clarifying the 'gering belang' criterion.
concerns: Appeal against refusal of registration as advocate before the Hoge Raad should be possible before the hof van discipline; the government added this to article 9j.
The one-year transitional period is too short; the government extended it to two years.
The transitional exemption rule in article V(2) is superfluous given article 9j(3)(c) and should be deleted.
Sitting Hoge Raad members should not sit on the examination committee, to protect their independence and that of the cassation bar.
The government should explain how the recommendations of the Commissie kernwaarden appelrechtspraak will compensate for reduced Supreme Court quality control.
The subjective criterion 'te gering financieel belang' needs objectification; the wording was changed to 'klaarblijkelijk onvoldoende belang'.
Redactional remarks on cross-references and the term 'klaarblijkelijk' were largely adopted.

32609-V.s: This bill amends the 2011 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by an incidental supplementary budget linked to the departmental reorganisation. It takes effect from 2 January 2011, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: We have considered that a change to the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for 2011 has proven necessary
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2011

32666.s: The bill amends the Spoorwegwet and Wet personenvervoer 2000 to implement the government's 'Spoor in beweging' rail policy, creating a formal ProRail management plan with a qualified consultation right for rail users and clarifying certification and concession rules. It also replaces criminal sanctions for several rail rules with administrative fines, set by general administrative order and ministerial policy rule, and extends the minister's power to grant special powers of attorney.
32666.j: The memorandum justifies the new fining powers as a shift from criminal to administrative enforcement in line with the government's sanctioning policy, and the advisory right as strengthening the position of rail customers.
q: The implementation agenda in the cabinet position 'Spoor in beweging' already announced replacing, where possible, the current emphasis on criminal provisions with administrative supervision.

In de uitvoeringsagenda zoals opgenomen in het kabinetsstandpunt «Spoor in beweging» is reeds aangekondigd om waar mogelijk de huidige nadruk op strafrechtbepalingen te vervangen door bestuurlijk toezicht.
d: concession penalty sums and performance obligations for infrastructure manager
time limits for advice and consultation procedure on management plan
designation of parts of management plan subject to qualified advisory right
rules on safe execution of works near main railway
adjustment of maximum administrative fine amounts for inflation
policy rule on application of administrative fines
minister may impose administrative fines for listed violations
p: ARTIKEL I, S and T (artikelen 77 and 80)

Minister may directly impose administrative fines on rail operators and individuals for many rules previously enforced criminally, with caps set by amendable general administrative order and fine decisions separated from inspection reporting.
ARTIKEL I, E (artikel 17, derde en vierde lid)

Concession authority may impose monetary penalties on the infrastructure manager and no longer needs to use enforcement orders with periodic penalties for performance failures covered by such penalties.

Qualified advisory right gives rail users consultation and reasoned-deviation rules, subject to marginal judicial review, while the minister retains final consent authority over management plan parts.
A concession decision may be taken if the manager does not object within four days, without requiring explicit acceptance.

parties: Asks what the government expects from the financial penalty on ProRail, in which concrete cases it applies, how it is calculated, and from which budget it will be recovered.
Finally, the members ask from which budget this sum will be recovered.
Tot slot vragen de leden op welk budget deze geldsom verhaald zal worden.

Supports a consultation right and extended enforcement powers over ProRail, but asks why not all of the management plan is subject to advice, whether consumer organisations and municipalities should also have advisory rights, and whether fines are financed from the state's dividend.
Is it possible to prevent the financial sanction from being financed from the dividend paid to the State?
Is het mogelijk te voorkomen dat de geldsom als sanctie wordt gefinancierd vanuit het dividend dat aan de Staat wordt uitgekeerd?

Asks how the new fining system adds to existing enforcement tools, whether fines are truly irreversible given past withdrawals for good conduct, and whether repeat offences should be treated more strictly.
In addition, the PVV members ask whether the fines are now irreversible?
Daarnaast vragen de leden van de PVV-fractie of de boetes nu wel onomkeerbaar zijn?

Questions why consumer organisations' advisory right is not made binding and why the bill itself was not submitted to consumer organisations; also doubts that administrative fines are always the most suitable sanction and proposes tariff restrictions for poor performance.
Why has the government not chosen to give the qualified advisory right a binding character?
Waarom heeft de regering er niet voor gekozen het gekwalificeerde adviesrecht een verplichtend karakter te geven?
Asks whether the qualified advisory right should be adjusted in view of strengthening reizigersorganisaties and decentral governments, and whether the management plan should be drawn up annually.
The said members ask whether the proposed Article 17b requires amendment in connection with the cabinet's recent intentions.
Genoemde leden vragen of het voorgestelde artikel 17b aanpassing behoeft in verband met de recente voornemens van het kabinet.
Supports the bill as a logical follow-up to 'Spoor in beweging' and asks whether further simplification of rail legislation will follow in a later tranche.
They therefore agree with the bill before us.
Zij stemmen dan ook in met het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the railway bill but objects that the required beheer- and vervoerplan lack statutory rules on their purpose and content and that no advisory right is given for the transport plan, asking for adaptation. The minister's reply largely rejects these objections, arguing the concession framework and existing practice suffice, while adding some explanation to the memorandum and changing the wording on the ministry definition.
concerns: The Afdeling argues the bill should set out the purpose and main content of beheer- and vervoerplannen in law, since without it the planning obligation is nearly empty and legal certainty suffers; the minister replies the concession and zorgplicht provide a sufficient framework.

The Afdeling finds no justification for a qualified advisory right on the beheerplan but none for the vervoerplan, and asks why no statutory advice requirement applies to the transport plan; the minister maintains the existing practice works and explains the omission in the memorandum.
The Afdeling makes redactional remarks on articles 80 of the Spoorwegwet and 35a of the Wet personenvervoer 2000, which the government has followed.

32693.s: The bill allows a childminder to offer care at more than one location by temporarily relaxing the one-location requirement, and extends childcare allowance eligibility for 2010 to care in unregistered locations. It also gives the GGD and municipalities supervisory powers over these equated locations and sets a sunset date by royal decree.
32693.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary arrangement by the need to allow multi-location childminding quickly while keeping supervision and enforcement workable within existing budgets.
q: Relaxing the one-location requirement means supervision and enforcement are expected to apply to more childminding facilities.
Het loslaten van de één-locatie-eis brengt met zich dat toezicht en handhaving naar verwachting op meer voorzieningen van gastouderopvang van toepassing zullen zijn.
d: termination date of equated childminding locations
termination date of supervision of equated locations
p: Extends inspection and enforcement powers to unregistered childminding locations while limiting the GGD's obligation to inspect each location against all standards.

parties: Asks whether the GGD can carry out inspections of about 40,000 home locations and whether this comes at the expense of regular inspections at day-care centres.
To what extent does the government expect the GGD to be sufficiently able to carry out these inspections?
In hoeverre verwacht de regering dat de GGD voldoende in staat is om deze inspecties uit te voeren?
Supports removing the repayment burden on parents but asks whether municipalities have enough capacity to carry out the inspections and whether the interim registration affects quality of care.
These members ask whether all municipalities have sufficient resources to carry out inspections under the assessment framework.
Deze leden vragen of alle gemeenten voldoende middelen hebben om de inspecties volgens het toetsingskader te verrichten.
Asks what the GGD must concretely do under the new framework, whether it can do so by 1 January 2012, and whether further legislative changes are needed for registration.
Can the government once again set out precisely what the GGD must do in this context?
Kan de regering nog eens precies uiteenzetten wat de GGD in dit verband precies moet doen?

Asks how parents are informed that their childminder must be registered, how they can check this, and whether municipalities may charge fees, and questions the privacy of childminders' home addresses in the public register.
How will the government ensure that the (private) address of the childminders is not visible to everyone in the National Register?
Hoe gaat de regering er voor zorgen dat het (privé)adres van de gast ouders niet voor iedereen te zien is in het Landelijk Register?
Asks where parents can file complaints about a childminder, what happens to those complaints, and whether they can lead to inspection.
The D66 members ask the government to elaborate on the options parents have to file a complaint about a childminder.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering om nader in te gaan op de mogelijkheden die vraagouders hebben om een klacht in te dienen over een gastouder.
Welcomes the end of home inspections by the GGD and argues that inspections should be sample-based and signal-driven rather than mandatory, while questioning the logic of full registration.
Assessment framework B should not be mandatory.
Toetsingskader B zou niet verplicht moeten zijn.

Asks what risk there is that the transition period lasts beyond 2012, how inspections will be prioritised for the increased number of locations, and what measures follow if oversight proves inadequate.
What measures will the government take if it turns out that the prioritisation to be set does not provide sufficient guarantee for supervision of the increased number of locations, ask these members.
Welke maatregelen gaat de regering treffen indien blijkt dat de te stellen prioritering onvoldoende waarborg biedt voor het toezicht op het toegenomen aantal locaties, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks why supervision was not shifted from individual childminders to childminder agencies, as the agencies could be made subject to inspection like childcare centres.
In the view of these members, it is logical to make the childminder agencies subject to supervision just like the childcare centres.
Naar de mening van deze leden ligt het in de rede om net als de kindercentra ook de gastouderbureaus voorwerp van toezicht te maken.

32780-V.s: The bill amends the 2011 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) through a supplementary budget tied to the Spring Memorandum, shifting appropriations across policy articles and adding a net amount to the total. It is a budgetary adjustment that sets out revised spending and commitment figures in thousands of euros with retroactive effect from 1 June 2011.
32780-V.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to higher local staff wages, annual wage and price adjustments, evaluation and audit costs, and the office relocation project, with no new delegated powers.
q: In accordance with the State Budget regulations and the Accounting Act of 2001, notable differences between the original and current estimates must be explained.
Conform de Rijksbegrotingsvoorschriften en de Compabiliteitswet van 2001 dienen de opmerkelijke verschillen tussen de oorspronkelijke en huidige raming te worden toegelicht.

32783.s: The bill amends the Wet op het financieel toezicht to extend the notification duty for substantial shareholdings to holders of cash-settled instruments and similar contracts that give economic exposure to shares. It also requires persons already holding at least three percent of capital to notify the AFM within four weeks of entry into force.
32783.j: The memorandum justifies the extension by pointing to covert accumulation of economic positions during takeover battles and the need to align with the UK and French regulators.
q: In response to these comments, and so as not to lag behind internationally, it is proposed to extend the notification duty further.
Naar aanleiding van deze opmerkingen en teneinde in internationaal verband niet uit de pas te lopen, is voorgesteld de meldingsplicht verder uit te breiden
d: form of notification under Besluit melding zeggenschap en kapitaal belang

parties: Asks how the 3% threshold was reached, how it compares with rules in the UK and France, and what effects the rules have on the investment climate.
The members of the VVD group ask the government how the 3% threshold was arrived at.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering hoe tot de grenswaarde van 3% is gekomen.

Asks whether a real problem exists with economic ownership exceeding legal ownership, whether banks actually follow counterparties' voting preferences, and whether the AFM's public register should specify instrument types.
The members of the PvdA group ask to what extent positions are built up in which economic ownership exceeds legal ownership.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen in hoeverre het voorkomt dat posities worden opgebouwd waarbij het economische eigendom groter is dan het juridisch eigendom.
Asks for a precise explanation of how holdings can be verified, for an exhaustive list of instruments, whether the AFM's enforcement tools are sufficient, and the consequences of non-reporting.
The members of the CDA group ask the government to again state precisely how the holding of the instruments can be checked.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering nog eens precies aan te geven op welke wijze het bezit van de instrumenten precies kan worden gecontroleerd?

Welcomes the bill as implementing the Irrgang motion, but questions who determines the threshold for instruments, leaving baskets and indices to the AFM, and whether instrument holdings should count toward the mandatory bid.
Should the interest built up through financial instruments not also count toward determining controlling influence?
Zou het belang dat met financiële instrumenten wordt opgebouwd niet ook mee moeten tellen voor de bepaling van overwegende zeggenschap?

32792.s: The bill amends the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 (Dutch public accounting act) to adjust budget categories after the departmental reorganisation, including renaming the royal household budget, adding a mechanism to fold other budgets into the state budget, and allowing the government to skip annual bills for the Fonds economische structuurversterking and the Waddenfonds for 2012. It also updates references to European Community treaties and removes an obsolete article 19a and parts of article 57.
32792.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary option to skip the Fes budget bill on practical grounds, noting that the choice has a temporary character and that a bill must be submitted again once a bill under the first paragraph is filed.
q: The third paragraph of this article ensures that the choice whether or not to submit a bill under the first paragraph has a temporary character.
Het derde lid van dit artikel zorgt er voor dat de keuze om al dan niet een voorstel van wet als bedoeld in het eerste lid in te dienen een tijdelijk karakter kent.
d: designating which minister manages a budget added to the state budget by statute
p: Artikel I, C (article 9a) and Artikel II

The government may refrain from submitting an annual budget bill for the Fonds economische structuurversterking and, for 2012, the Waddenfonds, with the fund's receipts and expenditures set to zero when no bill is submitted, removing a routine parliamentary approval step for those years.
Repeals article 19a on ministerial responsibility for budgets, a largely technical change.

parties: The VVD asks which alternative wording the minister considers possible to address the Algemene Rekenkamer's objection that the definition in Article 1 of the Comptabiliteitswet is too broad.
Which alternative text does the minister consider possible for this part to address the comments of the Algemene Rekenkamer?
Welke alternatieve tekst acht de minister op dit punt wel mogelijk voor dit onderdeel om tegemoet te komen aan het commentaar van de Algemene Rekenkamer?
The CDA has no additional questions on the bill.
These members have no additional questions.
Deze leden hebben geen additionele vragen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the Comptabiliteitswet amendment but objects that freezing the Fes budget belongs in the Wet Fes rather than the Cw 2001, and asks for adaptation. The Minister of Finance replies that the Cw 2001 is the most suitable place, that the freeze does not affect already committed funds, and adopts one drafting remark while rejecting another.
concerns: The Afdeling holds that the temporary deviation from the Wet Fes on revenues and expenditure should be placed in that act, not in the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.
The Afdeling asks how the freeze relates to multi-year commitments already made from the Fes for various projects.
The Afdeling suggests lowercase 'nationale schuld' in article I-A and suggests deleting paragraph 3 of the proposed article 9a; the minister follows the first and rejects deleting paragraph 3.

32828.s: The bill makes technical amendments to the environmental impact assessment (MER) rules in the Environmental Management Act (Wet milieubeheer), including adjusting when preparation procedures apply, Natura 2000 appropriate assessment references, and procedural steps for plans and decisions. It also adds transitional rules so that notifications made before entry into force remain governed by the old law.
32828.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the changes as needed to carry over the content of the old article 7.26a into article 7.24 and to avoid a substantive change to earlier project decisions and temporary exemptions, rather than to expand executive powers.
q: However, no substantive change is intended for the old project decision and the old temporary exemption.
Er is echter geen inhoudelijke wijziging beoogd voor het oude projectbesluit en de oude tijdelijke ontheffing.

parties: The VVD has no questions or remarks on the bill.
They currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
Zij hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.
The PvdA has no questions or remarks on the bill.
They currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
Zij hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.
The PVV has no questions or remarks on the bill.
They currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
Zij hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.
The CDA has no questions or remarks on the bill.
They currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
Zij hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.

The SP asks whether projects exempted via general rules, framework decisions or the old project decision are wrongly excluded from environmental assessment, which it sees as a possible oversight gap that the government should correct.
According to the SP members, the above cannot be the intention.
Bovenstaande kan naar mening van de leden van de SP-fractie niet de bedoeling zijn.
D66 has no questions or remarks on the bill.
They currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
Zij hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.
GroenLinks has no questions or remarks on the bill.
They currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
Zij hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.
The ChristenUnie has no questions or remarks on the bill.
They currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
Zij hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.

32846.s: The bill changes the start date of statutory old-age pension and related benefits from the first day of the month in which a person turns 65 to the exact day of reaching that age, amending the AOW, Anw, and about twenty other social security and pension statutes. It also removes special transitional rules and the related subsection provisions in several laws.
32846.j: The memorandum justifies the change by reducing administrative burden for employers and the UWV, since payroll and premium rules would no longer need a special regime for the birthday month.
q: With the intended amendment the arrangement becomes superfluous, since as a result the benefit continues until the day of death and the person is entitled to the survivor's benefit thereafter.
Met de beoogde wetswijziging wordt de regeling overbodig, aangezien deze als gevolg heeft dat de uitkering doorloopt tot de dag van overlijden en men daarna recht krijgt op de overlijdensuitkering.

parties: Asks how far social partners have progressed in adjusting CAOs, the cost of implementation for employers, and how quickly supplementary pensions will align with the new date.
These members endorse the principle that the right to AOW old-age pension starts when the pensionable age is reached.
Deze leden onderschrijven het uitgangspunt dat het recht op AOW-ouderdomspensioen ingaat bij het bereiken van de pensioengerechtigde leeftijd.

Questions whether the deadline for CAO adjustment is realistic, whether the government should postpone implementation, and whether the threat to declare CAOs no longer generally binding is too heavy-handed.
They consider this threat too severe, also in light of the willingness of social partners to adjust the CAOs.
Zij zijn van mening dat dit dreigement te zwaar is, mede in het licht van de bereidwilligheid van sociale partners om de CAO's aan te passen.
Asks whether the bill could instead start benefits on the first day of the following month to keep the system simple and limit costs for business and implementing bodies.
In these members' view this keeps the system simple and limits extra costs for business and implementers of other social security laws.
Zodoende blijft in de visie van deze leden de eenvoud in het stelsel behouden en worden de extra kosten voor bedrijfsleven en de uitvoerders van andere sociale zekerheidswetten beperkt.
Asks whether leaving the adjustment entirely to CAO parties will avoid problematic gaps from early 2012 and what the consequences are for people on early retirement.
Adjusting this employment-conditions arrangement is now left entirely to the CAO parties. Is that really sufficient?
Het wordt nu volledig aan de CAO-partijen overgelaten om deze arbeidsvoorwaardelijke regeling aan te passen. Volstaat dit werkelijk?
Asks for the administrative reasons behind the original start date, the status of CAO adjustments, and the status of supplementary pension changes.
Why are these administrative advantages no longer relevant now?
Waarom zijn deze administratieve voordelen nu niet meer relevant?

Argues the bill is administratively and financially disadvantageous for employees and early retirees and asks for withdrawal of the bill, questioning the continued validity of the 1954 administrative rationale.
These members believe the bill is disadvantageous in implementation and administration compared with the current situation.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat het onderhavige wetsvoorstel uitvoeringstechnisch en administratief nadelig is ten opzichte van de huidige situatie.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division supports the bill moving the AOW old-age pension start from the first day of the month of reaching the AOW age to the date of reaching 65, but asks the government to clarify whether collective agreements that tie dismissal to the first day of the month at 65 have been or will be adapted in time. The minister's reply explains that social partners were informed early, that adapting cao provisions lies with the cao parties, and that non-conforming cao provisions cannot be declared generally binding, so any gap will be temporary.
concerns: The Afdeling asks whether the adaptation of age-related dismissal rules in collective agreements has started and will be ready in time, and that the entry into force take this into account.

32855.s: The bill amends the Wet arbeid en zorg and the Wet aanpassing arbeidsduur to extend parental and pregnancy leave (including extension when a child is hospitalised), relax leave spreading and timing rules, and adds transitional law, with technical changes to the Arbeidstijdenwet. It also repeals the Invoeringswet arbeid en zorg and the 2005 amending act.
32855.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as widening the usability of the leave schemes, not as new executive discretion; no delegation is justified.
q: Whereas We have considered that it is desirable to amend the leave arrangements of the Wet arbeid en zorg so that the usability of these laws is increased.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat het wenselijk is de verlofregelingen van de Wet arbeid en zorg en de bepalingen inzake aanpassing van de arbeidsduur in de Wet aanpassing arbeidsduur te wijzigen opdat daardoor de gebruiksmogelijkheden van deze wetten worden vergroot

parties: Asks who decides what counts as unforeseen circumstances or serious business interests when employer and employee disagree, and how such disputes are resolved.
The VVD members ask who determines what unforeseen circumstances are and what happens if employee and employer disagree about the claimed (definition of) unforeseen circumstances.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen zich af wie bepaalt wat onvoorziene omstandigheden zijn en wat er gebeurt als werknemer en werkgever het oneens zijn over de aangevoerde (definitie van) onvoorziene omstandigheden.
Says the bill gives too little effect to the policy options explored, questions why only limited adjustments were chosen, and presses on enforcement and employer refusal powers.
The PvdA members note that the Council of State concludes the bill gives very limited effect to the many options set out in the policy exploration.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie constateren dat de Raad van State concludeert dat het wetsvoorstel in zeer beperkte mate gevolg geeft aan de vele opties die in de beleidsverkenning zijn uiteengezet.
Asks about budgetary consequences, funding and possible misuse of care leave, including whether sanctions exist.
Supports flexibility and employer-employee agreement on leave while questioning the creation of new leave types and the role of carers.
The CDA members' starting point is that leave is primarily regulated between employers and employees in collective bargaining and/or collective agreements.
Het uitgangspunt van de leden van de CDA-fractie is dat verlof primair wordt geregeld tussen werkgevers en werknemers in het arbeidsvoorwaardelijke overleg en/of CAO.
Asks whether employees can appeal a refusal of parental leave and how carers outside the household are protected, and criticises the lack of paid leave for lower earners.
The SP members ask whether an employee can object when the employer refuses a request to take parental leave.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of een werknemer bezwaar kan maken wanneer de werkgever een verzoek tot opname van het ouderschapsverlof weigert.
Considers the steps too small and criticises the narrow circle of eligible carers, arguing the scheme does not match modern care needs.
The GroenLinks members consider the limited expansion of the circle of eligible persons a missed opportunity.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vinden de beperkte uitbreiding van de kring van rechthebbenden een gemiste kans.
Asks what remedies employees have if an employer refuses leave, and about the effect on single-person households and carers outside shared households.
The ChristenUnie members ask what options an employee has to object if the employer refuses a leave request.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen welke mogelijkheden een werknemer heeft om bezwaar te maken als de werkgever een verzoek tot verlof weigert.
Asks what the added value of a proposed sub-clause is and whether removing provisions adequately weighs employers' freedom.
The SGP members ask whether removing a number of provisions adequately respects employers' freedom and need not to employ staff who are absent more than half the week.

De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen of met het schrappen van een aantal bepalingen voldoende recht wordt gedaan aan de vrijheid en behoefte van werkgevers om geen werknemers in dienst te hebben die meer dan de helft van de week afwezig zijn.
Asks how workers prove a social relationship and necessity of care, what happens when employer and employee disagree, and how the three-day partner leave is to be taken.
How does the employee demonstrate a social relationship, a personal bond?
Hoe toont de werknemer een sociale relatie, een persoonlijke band aan?
Welcomes the changes but asks what 'unforeseen circumstances' means, whether the employer always has the last word, and how an employee can object to an employer decision.
In what way can the employee object if they disagree with the employer's decision?
Op welke wijze kan de werknemer bezwaar maken als hij het niet eens is met de beslissing van de werkgever?
Asks how employees must document the social relationship and necessity of care, and what 'reasonably' means, given employer refusal on grounds of serious business interest.
Can the government further describe under which circumstances it may be said that the care must be provided by the employee?
Kan de regering nader omschrijven onder welke omstandigheden gesteld mag worden dat de zorg door de werknemer verricht moet worden?
Welcomes neutrality toward household forms, asks for criteria defining a social relationship and the extra cost burden on small firms.
Can the government explain which criteria must be met to qualify as a social relationship?
Kan de regering toelichten aan welke criteria voldaan moet zijn om als sociale relatie te kwalificeren?
Supports extension of care leave but asks for clarity on 'noodzakelijke zorg' and the basis of cost estimates for employers.
What must be understood by necessary care and how is it prevented that unclarity and/or discussion arises between employee and employer?
Wat moet onder noodzakelijke zorg worden verstaan en hoe wordt voorkomen dat hier straks onduidelijkheid en/of discussie tussen werknemer en werkgever over ontstaat?
Worries that removing the serious business interest safeguard places excessive responsibility on employers and risks uncontrollable misuse.
Is the employer not being assigned too much responsibility when no restrictions at all are placed on time and duration in situations where serious interests are not directly at stake?

Wordt de werkgever niet te veel verantwoordelijkheid toegemeten wanneer op generlei wijze beperkingen worden aangebracht aan tijd en duur in situaties waarin niet direct sprake is van zwaarwegende belangen.
Supports the wider circle of care leave but asks who has the final word on establishing a social relationship.
They would like more clarity on how it is established that there is a social relationship. Who has the final word in this?
Zij krijgen graag meer duidelijkheid over hoe wordt vastgesteld dat er een sociale relatie is. Wie heeft daarin het laatste woord?
Asks on which criteria employers must judge whether care is reasonably assumed by the employee and whether a social relationship exists.
Can the government further specify on which criteria employers should assess whether circumstances are such that it is reasonable for the employee to take on the care?

Kan de regering verder concretiseren aan de hand van welke criteria werkgevers dienen te beoordelen wanneer er al dan niet sprake is van zodanige omstandigheden dat het redelijk is dat de werknemer de zorg op zich neemt, zo willen deze leden weten.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill modernising leave and working-time rules but advises on its relation to broader modernisation, privacy protection for hospital-stay data, the meaning of 'huisgenoten' (boarders excluded), and transitional law. The government's reply rejects broader reform, clarifies the boarder exclusion and transitional regime, adds privacy references and specifies cost estimates.
concerns: The Afdeling asks to consider broader measures, including merging leave schemes, to meet future labour-market and care pressures, which the government declines to pursue.

Processing of hospital-stay data about mother and baby requires adequate safeguards on retention and purpose limitation under data protection law; the government points to the usual benefit-data rules.
Transitional law for long-term care leave and reduced working hours is unclear; the government adds a transitional regime only for parental leave and explains the other choices.
The Afdeling proposes a redrafted transitional provision in article 6:10 of the Wazo, which the government adopts.
The explanatory memorandum should define the boundary between a boarder under a pension agreement and a sick friend or relative taken into the home, which the government clarifies.
Financial estimates for the hospital-stay extension and the parental leave reduction need stated underpinning; the government specifies the first and only estimates the second.

32873.s: The bill clarifies that the limit on the number of supervisory and management positions held by persons at large foundations applies to foundations subject to annual accounts law, and adjusts the related rules for large public limited companies and private limited companies. It replaces references to net turnover with operating income or total income for foundations reporting under special legislation.
32873.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the change as clarifying the scope of an existing rule and aligning terminology with special legislation for foundations, without new executive powers.
q: The bill does not change the situation in which the rule limiting the number of supervisory positions applies to these special foundations.
Het wetsvoorstel brengt geen verandering in de situatie dat de regeling tot beperking van het aantal commissariaten op deze bijzondere stichtingen van toepassing is

parties: The VVD fears legal uncertainty and wants a detailed government response, and questions whether nullity of appointments is proportionate versus a simpler court procedure to remove an offending board member.
These members therefore ask the government to respond in detail to the submitted reactions.
Deze leden vragen de regering daarom om op de ingediende reacties gedetailleerd te reageren.
The PvdA asks technical questions about which foundations fall in scope, the reference date for size criteria, and the lack of an in- and uitgroeiregeling.
Is the government willing to provide the necessary clarity by still inserting the in- and uitgroeiregeling into all provisions introduced by the amendment?
Is de regering bereid de nodige duidelijkheid te verschaffen, door de in- en uitgroeiregeling alsnog in te voegen in alle bij het amendement ingevoerde bepalingen?
The CDA raises drafting ambiguities in the limits, the nullity sanction creating legal uncertainty, and the timing of revenue measurement, asking for clarification and alternatives.

Does the government agree with these members that, for the sake of legal certainty, this is an undesirable situation, especially since the nullity of an appointment can be invoked even many years after the void appointment decision?

Is de regering het met voornoemde leden eens dat dit met het oog op de rechtszekerheid een onwenselijke situatie is, vooral doordat de nietigheid van de benoeming zelfs vele jaren na het nietige benoemingsbesluit kan worden ingeroepen?
The SP asks which types of foundations face special accountability rules, whether exceptions exist, and why the term bedrijfsinkomsten is used rather than bedrijfsopbrengsten.
These members therefore ask why the law uses the term bedrijfsinkomsten rather than bedrijfsopbrengsten.
Voornoemde leden vragen daarom waarom in de wet de term bedrijfsinkomsten is opgenomen en niet de term bedrijfsopbrengsten.
The ChristenUnie has no questions at this stage.
have no questions on this at this moment.
hebben hierover op dit moment geen vragen.

32891.s: The bill reduces the number of judicial districts (arrondissementen) and appeal districts (ressorten) in the Netherlands, cutting the courts to ten district courts and four courts of appeal. It also makes related changes to court governance, board composition, prosecution office organisation, and the assignment of cases and hearing locations, with the Minister given powers to designate hearing locations and redirect cases temporarily.
32891.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to adapt the judicial map to capacity shortages and to keep the Minister politically accountable for the stability of the justice system.
q: This means that most district courts will get a larger area of work.
Dit betekent dat de meeste rechtbanken een groter werkgebied krijgen.
d: designation of hearing locations for courts
additional hearing locations and relocation of criminal hearings
temporary designation of another court for case referral
temporary designation of another appeal court for case referral
College rules on which offences the national and functional prosecutors may bring before four courts
Raad voor de rechtspraak approval of court regulations
p: The Crown, on the Minister's proposal, may annul a Raad voor de rechtspraak decision approving court case-allocation rules on grounds of legality or public interest.
The Minister may designate hearing locations and temporarily redirect cases to other courts or appeal courts, after consulting the Raad voor de rechtspraak and the College of procurators-general.

parties: Asks whether the Raad voor de rechtspraak is taking on more powers than intended and why ministerial/parliamentary control over additional court locations is limited.

These members ask whether their assumption is correct that the Raad voor de rechtspraak's power to abolish locations under the new article 20 only concerns the other sitting locations designated by the Raad and not those designated by general administrative order.
