Deze leden vragen of hun veronderstelling juist is dat de opheffingsbevoegdheid van de Raad voor de rechtspraak ex artikel 20 Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie (nieuw) slechts de door de Raad aangewezen overige zittingsplaatsen betreft.
Questions the justification for the scale enlargement, the productivity evidence, and the impact on individual judges and staff transfers.
These members ask why productivity was not of significance in the decision whether the judicial map should be redrawn.
Deze leden vragen waarom de productiviteit niet van betekenis is (geweest) bij de afweging of de gerechtelijke kaart opnieuw ingericht moet worden.
Supports scale enlargement in general but raises concerns about the size of Oost-Nederland, employment in Zwolle/Almelo and Middelburg, and access for citizens.
Can the government guarantee that the judiciary will not move further away from society?
Kan de regering garanderen dat de rechtspraak niet verder van de samenleving komt af te staan?
Objects to the rushed reorganisation before the bill is enacted, the risk of irreversible steps, and the lack of evidence that scale enlargement improves quality or access.
These members believe democracy is seriously undermined when there is a risk there is no way back.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat de democratie ernstig wordt aangetast wanneer straks het risico wordt gelopen dat er geen weg meer terug is.
Accepts administrative scale-up if rechtspraak stays close to people, objects to budget cuts, and asks for justification of figures such as 20 judges per sector and a critical threshold of 100.
These members support the idea that administrative scale-up can help develop less vulnerable organisations.
Deze leden steunen de gedachte dat een bestuurlijke opschaling kan bijdragen aan het ontwikkelen van minder kwetsbare organisaties.
Asks how the enlarged arrondissements avoid placing the OM too far from local government and wants the government's vision on the administrative structure.
How is it prevented that the OM ends up too far from local government?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat het OM op te grote afstand komt te staan van het lokale bestuur?
Asks whether scale enlargement really improves quality and how a close-to-citizen judiciary is ensured in large regions such as Oost-Nederland and Arnhem-Leeuwarden.
They have the impression that scale enlargement does not automatically lead to this improvement.
Zij hebben namelijk de indruk dat schaalvergroting niet automatisch tot deze verbetering leidt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Wet herziening gerechtelijke kaart, reducing arrondissements from 19 to 10 and appeal courts from 5 to 4, and raised concerns about the chosen scale, retaining sector chairs on the court board, and the setting of court sitting locations and case allocation. The government's reply accepts many points, including a new board-level quality role and criteria for sitting locations, but rejects statutory listing of locations, minimum categories of cases, and the call to keep the College van afgevaardigden in full.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a substantive motivation of the chosen court scale and regional division in terms of efficiency and access to justice; the government added criteria and motivation but maintained the division.

The Afdeling asked that the quality and legal unity safeguards after abolition of mandatory sector chairs on the board be strengthened; the government added a quality portfolio holder and adjusted the consultation role of the gerechtsvergadering, but did not reinstate sector chairs.

The Afdeling held that sitting locations and case allocation are matters for the legislator and should be fixed in statute, with ministerial designation of other locations rather than the Rvdr; the government rejected statutory listing but moved the designation power to the minister.
The Afdeling asked for criteria for designating sitting locations and minimum categories of cases per location; the government added criteria but rejected fixed case-category rules in statute.
The Afdeling asked that the counter opening hours of at least six hours per day be retained for access to justice; the government accepted this.

The Afdeling asked that the emergency reassignment power be placed with the minister and that the Rvdr's initiative be removed; the government adopted this, and it also postponed abolition of the College van afgevaardigden by three years.
The Afdeling asked to motivate the financial effects of the reform in more detail; the government expanded the memorandum on financial consequences.

33090-III.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget statutes of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the Queen, and the Supervisory Committee on the intelligence and security services by adjusting appropriations, mainly through a second supplementary budget. The explanatory memorandum says the changes reflect the autumn budget memorandum and a wage and price adjustment for 2011.
q: The change concerns the wage and price adjustment for 2011.
De mutatie betreft de loon- en prijsbijstelling over 2011.

33197.s: The bill implements parts of EU Directive 2010/75/EU on industrial emissions by renaming the IPPC installation concept and updating references in the Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht, Wet ammoniak en veehouderij, Wet milieubeheer, Waterwet and Wet op de economische delicten. It adds mandatory incident response duties, a new title on non-compliance measures, and public electronic availability of permits, while the explanatory memorandum mainly describes implementation via amvb (Bor and Activiteitenbesluit) rather than statute.
33197.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary to implement the directive's obligations, with most detailed implementation placed in the amvb and ministerial regulation rather than the statute.
q: Implementing chapters I and II of the industrial emissions directive mainly requires amending the Bor and has few consequences for the text of the Wabo and Wm.
Implementatie van de hoofdstukken I en II van de richtlijn industriële emissies vergt vooral een wijziging van het Bor en heeft weinig consequenties voor de tekst van de Wabo en de Wm.
d: adopting new or revised best available techniques conclusions
competent authority orders additional measures and amends permits to prevent recurrence
further rules on information duties of administrative bodies to the minister
p: Operator must halt the installation in whole or part when a incident threatens human health or serious environmental harm and compliance cannot be guaranteed, a mandatory stop duty tied to a threshold test.
Competent authority must require all reasonably necessary additional measures after an incident and may amend permits, with the amendment subject to the existing permit-change procedure.
Extends the incident measures regime to non-compliance with permit conditions, applying the same measure-and-notification system to cases that are not incidents.

parties: No questions or remarks raised; the fraction has no need to ask questions at this stage.
have taken note of the bill and currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.

hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.

Asks whether all BRZO companies are IPPC installations and whether the bill improves safety, and raises enforcement concerns about the complexity of the regime and the readiness of the new regional enforcement services (RUDs).
Does the government share this concern? Are the RUDs prepared for a possible catch-up once these organisations are operational?
Deelt de regering dit zorgpunt? Zijn de RUD’s voorbereid op een eventuele inhaalslag op het moment dat deze organisaties operationeel zijn?

Objects that prosecution of a whistleblower who reports a violation is not possible, which could create a perverse incentive for offenders who confess afterwards, and asks the government to revise this provision.
The SP members would like to see that provision revised so that offenders can be prosecuted even if they honestly report the offence afterwards.
De leden van de SP-fractie zouden graag zien dat die bepaling wordt herzien en dat plegers van een overtreding of misdrijf vervolgd kunnen worden ook als zij dit achteraf eerlijk melden.

Argues parliament must be able to decide on key matters such as the link between non-routine inspections and permit applications and tightening the update obligation, and asks the government to anchor these in the statute rather than AmvB and ministerial regulation; also questions the government's rejection of the Council of State advice on the IPPC installation term and the exclusion of certain waste incinerators.

The D66 members are of the view that the House must be able to pronounce itself on matters such as the link between non-routine inspections and permit applications and tightening the update obligation.

De leden van de D66-fractie zijn van mening dat de Kamer zich moet kunnen uitspreken over bijvoorbeeld kwesties aangaande de koppeling tussen niet-routinematige inspecties en vergunningsaanvragen en het aanscherpen van de actualiseringplicht.
have taken note of the bill and currently have no need to ask questions.
hebben kennisgenomen van het genoemde wetsvoorstel en hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen.
have taken note of the bill and currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill implementing the Industrial Emissions Directive but objects to the implementation technique, the handling of general binding rules, the reporting of non-compliance and the review of permit conditions, and advises revision. The government's nader rapport accepts most points, amending the bill to integrate non-compliance rules into title 17.1 Wm, add a Wabo basis for BAT updating, and supplement the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Council objects to the mixed use of the terms 'IPPC-installatie' and 'gpbv-installatie' and advises using the directive's terminology of 'installatie'; the government keeps 'IPPC-installatie' but clarifies the regimes in the explanatory memorandum.
The Council advises that general binding rules under Article 6 of the directive be explained in the explanatory memorandum; the government supplements the explanation.
The Council finds the implementation of Article 8 on non-compliance incomplete and advises a statutory regime; the government adds a new title 17.1B and integrates the rules into title 17.1 Wm.

The Council finds that BAT-conclusion-based review under Article 21(3) is incompletely implemented and advises a formal statutory basis; the government adds a Wabo provision and removes the 'excessive costs' limitation.

The Council advises clarifying the reporting obligation after inspections and its relation to enforcement; the government supplements the explanatory memorandum and an implementation table, while leaving the Wabo enforcement chapter largely unchanged.
The Council advises linking inspection results to permit assessment in Article 2.14 Wabo; the government declines to introduce this explicit link to avoid a national addition.

33287.s: The bill implements fiscal measures of the 2013 budget agreement, changing income tax, wage tax, corporate tax, VAT, excise and environmental taxes, including a new interest deduction limit on participation debt and a narrower medical VAT exemption. It mostly sets tax rates and thresholds directly in statute and delegates little rule-making power to the executive.
33287.j: The memorandum justifies the medical VAT exemption change by linking the exemption to the BIG register as the only usable quality benchmark, and the interest limitation rules by avoiding double denial of deductions in reorganisations.
q: Therefore it is proposed to align the medical VAT exemption with this and to limit it to those medical services of BIG-trained professionals that actually belong to the exercise of that BIG profession.
Derhalve wordt voorgesteld voor de medische btw-vrijstelling hierbij aan te sluiten en deze terug te brengen tot díe medische diensten van BIG-opgeleiden
d: rules on interest limitation in reorganisations and fiscal unity
X (Art. 1a, lid 3 Wet op de accijns)
addition of marker substances to mineral oils
X (Art. 1a, lid 3 Wet op de accijns, ministerial regulation part)
prescribed marker substances and conditions for mineral oils
X (Art. 91 lid 3 and 4 Wet op de accijns)
exemptions and conditions for storage and possession of marked oils

parties: Questions whether the new participation-interest limit could lead to overkill and asks about EU state-aid and treaty compatibility of the coal-tax change.
Can the government confirm that application of the proposed Article 13l indeed leads to this and, if so, is this considered desirable in the current economic climate?
Kan de regering bevestigen dat toepassing van het voorgestelde artikel 13l hiertoe inderdaad leidt en, zo ja, wordt dit wenselijk geacht in het huidige economische klimaat?
Objects that fiscal measures are split across two moments, denying parliament an integrated view of the full package, and asks for postponement of the bill.
The PvdA members find it very objectionable and careless that the House does not decide on the total package of fiscal measures for 2013 at one moment.
De leden van de fractie van de PvdA vinden het zeer bezwaarlijk en onzorgvuldig dat de Kamer niet op één moment over het totaalpakket van fiscale maatregelen per 2013 besluit.
Criticises the VAT increase and energy tax rises as economically harmful in a recession and attacks the coalition's green policies.
These members, together with leading economists, consider this so-called VAT shift very unwise in a time of recession.
Deze leden achten samen met vooraanstaande economen, deze zogenaamde btw-schuif in een tijd van recessie zeer onverstandig.
Asks for clarification on missing legislation for the commuting-allowance abolition and on transitional rules for VAT on pre-sold new-build homes; also asks about anti-abuse rules' multiplicity.
Can the government explain why the return of revenue for 2014 and 2015 via lower income tax rates will be arranged in the Tax Plan 2014 rather than in the present bill?

Kan de regering nader toelichten waarom de terugsluis voor de jaren 2014 en 2015 via een verlaging van de inkomstenbelastingtarieven geregeld zullen worden in het Belastingplan 2014 en niet in het voorliggende wetsvoorstel?
Questions the VAT increase's regressive effects on lower incomes, its effect on consumption and cross-border shopping, and why it cannot wait until after the elections.
Why can the VAT increase not wait until after the Second Chamber elections in September?
Waarom kan de btw-verhoging niet wachten tot na de Tweede Kamerverkiezingen in september?
Welcomes the shift toward indirect taxes and greening, asking about transition rules, environmental effects and the design of the return of revenue.
The D66 members are positive about the shift from direct to indirect taxation.
De leden van de fractie van D66 zijn positief over de verschuiving van directe naar indirecte belasting.
Accepts the urgency and commits to the coalition accord, but asks for careful procedure, transition issues and effects on work and entrepreneurship.
At the same time, the ChristenUnie members believe the legislative amendment should be carried out carefully.
Tegelijkertijd zijn de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie van mening dat de wetswijziging zorgvuldig dient plaats te vinden.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division endorsed the three draft tax bills (VAT rate rise, overdrachtsbelasting and transport costs, Stabiliteitsprogramma III) but raised numerous remarks on package coherence, delegation, retroactivity, environmental justification, and drafting. The government's nader rapport accepted most remarks, merged the bills into one, and adjusted the text, rejecting some points such as adding a general tegenbewijsregeling.
concerns: Ministerial regulations were proposed for matters that should be in statute or amvb, and the text was adjusted accordingly.
Unclear transition rules for prepaid performing-arts and art VAT rates were flagged; a beleidsbesluit and text adjustments were added.
The advice to add a general counter-evidence regime to the deelnemingsrente restriction was not followed, the government citing reduced effectiveness.
Concern about the proportionality of the interest-deduction restriction and the planned repeal of article 10d Wet Vpb was noted and partly addressed in the memorie.
The Council argued the bills should not be combined into one omnibus law due to lack of substantive coherence; the government disagreed and merged them anyway.
Redactionele kanttekeningen were adopted in the bill and memorie van toelichting.

33368.s: The bill amends the Police Act 2012 to make the national police chief formally accountable to the Minister, shift budget and management tasks away from the chief to the Minister, and require prior parliamentary laying of general administrative orders on police management and financial management. It also sets a four-year appointment and recommendation procedure for regional mayors and removes an exception on the appointment of territorial unit heads.
33368.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as clarifying the chief's subordinate position to the Minister and removing fears that the chief has too autonomous a role, with parliamentary laying of rules added to increase parliamentary influence.
q: To remove the fear that the chief would obtain too independent a position in the police system, it is proposed to explicitly provide in the law that the police chief accounts for the exercise of his tasks and powers to the Minister.

Teneinde de vrees weg te nemen dat deze een té zelfstandige positie zou krijgen in het politiebestel wordt voorgesteld expliciet in de wet te bepalen dat de korpschef over de uitoefening van zijn taken en bevoegdheden verantwoording aflegt aan de minister.
d: rules on distribution of personnel and resources across police units
p: The national police chief must explicitly account to the Minister for the exercise of his tasks and powers, strengthening ministerial control over the chief.

The Minister consults regional mayors on police management at least four times a year, and mayors' representatives are appointed by the Minister on recommendation of a designated body, centralising appointment choices.
The Minister, rather than the police chief, distributes personnel and resources across police units, with the distribution rules subject to parliamentary laying.
The Minister now adopts the annual management plan and annual report for the police, rather than the chief.
An exception allowing the police chief to appoint territorial unit heads on personnel-policy grounds is removed, while mayors and prosecutor retain consent rights.

parties: Asks the government for examples of how the general and specific directive power of article 30 will be used as a normal, low-threshold steering instrument, and what measures will follow if the evaluation of article 27 shows the separate legal personality does not work.
These members ask the government to elaborate on the general and special directive powers of article 30.
Deze leden vragen de regering nader in te gaan op de algemene en bijzondere aanwijzingsbevoegdheid van artikel 30.

Questions whether the shift of statutory tasks from the police chief to the minister leaves any meaningful legal personality for the police, and how this fits the government's claim that the police is not an instrument of the minister.

How does the substantial shift of statutory tasks from the police chief to the minister fit with the government's position that the police primarily serves mayors and public prosecutors and is not the minister's instrument?

Hoe verhoudt de forse verschuiving van wettelijke taken van korpschef naar minister zich tot standpunt van de regering dat de politie er primair is voor burgemeesters en de officieren van justitie en dat de politie niet het instrument is van de minister?
Notes the Algemene Rekenkamer's warning that the minister steers the police as if it were a department unit, and asks the government to respond to this budget-right concern.
These members ask the government to respond to this observation by the Algemene Rekenkamer.
Deze leden vragen de regering te reageren op deze signalering van de Algemene Rekenkamer.

Worries that the minister's greater control over budget and priorities will override local priorities and that the budget-right issue is being dismissed without explanation; also questions the accountability chain and oversight arrangements.
How will the minister prevent himself from considering his own priorities more important than local priorities, now that local authorities have less say over the deployment of police resources?

Hoe gaat de minister voorkomen dat hij zijn eigen prioriteiten daarbij belangrijker zal vinden dan de lokale prioriteiten, nu de lokale autoriteiten minder zeggenschap hebben over de inzet van politiemiddelen?

Asks whether the Algemene Rekenkamer's objections on budget authorisation, discharge and exclusion from the Rijksrekening have been resolved, and whether a supervisory vision clarifying responsibilities for information, judgement and intervention has been drawn up.
Has the consultation with the Algemene Rekenkamer already taken place?
Heeft het overleg met de Algemene Rekenkamer inmiddels plaatsgevonden?

Finds it contradictory to make the police chief's subordination explicit while stressing separate legal personality, and questions the shift of initiative on management documents from the chief to the minister; also questions the role of mayors in the regional mayor arrangement.

Indeed, on the one hand the proposal aims to make the subordinate position of the police chief explicit, while on the other hand it stresses that a separate legal personality was chosen precisely because the police is not an instrument of and for the minister.

Immers, enerzijds wordt met het voorstel beoogd de ondergeschikte positie van de korpschef te expliciteren, terwijl anderzijds in het voorstel wordt benadrukt dat juist voor een eigen rechtspersoonlijkheid van de politie is gekozen omdat de politie niet een instrument is van en voor de minister.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Politiewet 2012 (positions of the korpschef and regioburgemeester), arguing the korpschef has too much independence and that legal personality for the police should be reconsidered or removed. The minister's reply rejects the call to drop legal personality, accepts several changes (fixed meeting frequency, removal of the advisory body recommendation, clarification of replacement of burgemeesters) and explains why the audit commission is not set up by statute.
concerns: The korpschef enjoys excessive independence from the minister, and the minister's responsibility for the police may not be effectively exercised under the chosen structure.
Legal personality of the police organisation has little remaining meaning given the minister's essential powers; the Afdeling advises removing it and placing the police within the ministry.
The periodic consultation under article 19 should have a fixed frequency to strengthen local accountability.

The Nederlands Genootschap van Burgemeesters is an interest group and not an appropriate body to recommend the two small-municipality mayors; the recommendation should be removed from the appointment procedure.
The explanatory memorandum should explain when interim replacement of the two mayors may occur.
Members and staff of the Commission of supervision on management should be selected outside police circles to avoid any appearance of influence.
Several drafting corrections to cross-references and punctuation in articles 19, 30 and 38c are recommended.

33467.s: The bill approves on behalf of the Netherlands the 2012 Association Agreement between the European Union and its member states on one side and Central America on the other, covering political dialogue, trade and cooperation. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
33467.j: The memorandum justifies the agreement as a framework for political dialogue, democratisation support and easier trade and investment, and notes the regulatory adjustment to be made before 1 January 2013 to align with the agreed ninety-day period.
q: The purpose of these agreements is to provide a framework for political dialogue, to support efforts in the field of democratisation and development, and to facilitate trade and investment between the EU and the country concerned.

Het doel van deze overeenkomsten is het bieden van een raamwerk voor een politieke dialoog, het ondersteunen van inspanningen op het gebied van democratisering en ontwikkeling en het versoepelen van handel en investeringen tussen de EU en het betreffende land.
d: Artikel 8 Uitvoeringsregels Delegatie- en uitvoeringsbesluit Wet arbeid vreemdelingen
adjusting rules on temporary stay of staff for businesses under the agreement

33476.s: The bill amends the Dutch Aviation Act (Wet luchtvaart) to align it with EU Regulation 216/2008 (EASA), removing duplicated national rules and adding a basis for implementing rules, fees, supervision and criminal enforcement of EASA requirements. It lets the minister designate EASA provisions as offences by ministerial regulation for a year before they must be placed in statute.
33476.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for effective enforcement of EASA regulations and the expected stream of implementing rules, and limits the ministerial criminal-offence power to a one-year window pending a statute.
q: The new proposed subsection c of Article 11.10(1), together with the new third subsection, provides a solution for this situation.
Het nieuw voorgestelde onderdeel c van artikel 11.10, eerste lid, in combinatie met het nieuwe derde lid, voorziet in een oplossing voor deze situatie.
d: designating EASA provisions whose breach is prohibited
amounts of fees for EASA certificates and documents
fees for costs of international treaty obligations
designating EASA provisions as criminal offences for one year
p: The minister may by ministerial regulation make breaches of EASA provisions criminal offences, which lapses after a year unless the legislature enacts it by statute.
The minister may designate EASA provisions whose breach is prohibited, creating criminal liability through ministerial designation.

parties: Asks how implementing rules still under development fit into the bill and warns about administrative burden from lower-level rules, requesting that parliament be informed of any increases.
The VVD members are critical of any possible increases in burdens.
De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn kritisch als het gaat om eventuele lastenverhogingen.
Asks for a timetable of entry into force and whether and how parliament will be informed about new ministerial regulations and general administrative measures based on the delegation provisions.
The PvdA members ask whether, and in what way, the House will be informed about new ministerial regulations and general administrative measures based on the delegation provisions in this bill.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of, en op welke manier, de Kamer wordt geïnformeerd over nieuwe ministeriële regelingen en algemene maatregelen van bestuur, op basis van de delegatiebepalingen in dit voorliggende wetsvoorstel.
Has taken note of the bill and has no questions.
currently have no need to ask questions.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the aviation act amendment implementing EU Regulation 216/2008 but objects that the penalty provision's criterion of 'equivalent provisions' and the ministerial power to designate misdemeanours are too vague, advising a stricter wording and clarification. The government's reply accepts the drafting remarks on the notes and most wording changes, but keeps the broad 'gelijksoortige voorschriften' criterion and the vangnet provision, arguing the legislature will review them within a year.
concerns: The criterion 'gelijksoortige voorschriften' in article 11.10(1)(b) is too indeterminate for legal certainty, and the Afdeling advised a stricter description of the equivalent provisions.

Ministerial power to designate provisions as misdemeanours under article 11.10(1)(c) undermines the primacy of the formal legislature, so the criteria for designating misdemeanours should be laid down in the act.
Several redactional points on article numbering, cross-references and wording of article I, parts K, M, W and Z were raised and largely adopted.

33480-X.s: This bill amends the 2012 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence, adjusting expenditure and commitment totals across policy and non-policy articles. The explanatory memorandum describes transfers from other departments, a dropped loan, and changed personnel cost premiums.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2012 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2012 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33494.s: The bill amends the Youth Care Act to give an explicit legal basis for restrictive and control measures (restraint, clothing searches, temporary confinement) against youths under a closed-care court order while they are in the courthouse or being transported. It also requires providers to record such measures in the file and extends Inspectorate supervision to transport.
33494.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to prevent youths with severe problems from escaping court-ordered care, and by unclear existing legal bases for such measures.
q: To put beyond doubt that measures may be taken during transport and while the youth is in the courthouse, the bill provides an explicit legal basis.

Om buiten twijfel te stellen dat het nemen van maatregelen tijdens het vervoer en het verblijf van de jeugdige in het gerechtsgebouw mogelijk is, wordt in het onderhavige wetsvoorstel in een expliciete wettelijke basis voorzien.
d: requirements for approved transport providers and vehicles
p: Allows police officers to restrain, search clothing of, and temporarily confine a youth in the courthouse against their will, limited to the purpose of preventing escape from the order.

Allows transport providers to restrain, search and confine youths during transport against their will when necessary for safety or to prevent escape, with measures recorded in the care plan and reported.
Requires providers to record each use of these measures in the youth's file with the circumstances, a limited transparency safeguard.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division supports a bill giving a legal basis for restrictive and control measures against youths in closed youth care during transport and court-building stays, but asks for IVRK compliance review and clarification of complaint rights. The government reply accepts the complaint-right point (amending art. 29w to cover art. 29ta measures) and clarifies the IVRK and staffing points, while rejecting the request to amend art. 5:15 Awb for one inspectorate task.
concerns: The Afdeling finds that the bill lacks an assessment against the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child and asks for conditions ensuring IVRK compliance for transport and court stays; the government clarifies limitative listing, police staffing and functional requirements but does not change the bill.

The Afdeling notes that complaint rights and legal protection for measures applied outside the facility are not regulated; the government amends the bill so that art. 29w applies to measures under art. 29ta.

The Afdeling gives several redactional comments on articles 29fa, 29ta and 47 Wjz; most are adopted, with one on art. 47(3) Wjz not adopted because the inspectors already hold the powers as supervisors.

33548.s: The bill amends the 2013 departmental budget statement (IXB) of the Ministry of Finance to reflect a change linked to the DNB profit remittance, with figures in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as 1 March of the budget year, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that a change to the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for 2013 has proven necessary, linked to the DNB profit remittance.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2013, samenhangend met de DNB winstafdracht.

33575.s: The bill amends the Wet op het financieel toezicht to implement EU Directive 2011/89/EU on supplementary supervision of financial conglomerates, extending consolidated and supplementary supervision to banks and insurers within a financial conglomerate and adding definitions, coordinator rules and DNB supervisory tasks. It also introduces ministerial regulation powers for cooperation with supervisors of other member states and allows DNB to waive certain provisions after consultation with other supervisors.
33575.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as necessary to implement the EU directive consistently and to avoid gaps and overlaps in group supervision, with technical regulation left to ministerial rules.
q: An important aim of Directive fico I is to better align the different forms of group supervision of banks and insurers in order to avoid overlap and gaps.
Een belangrijk doel van de richtlijn fico I is om de verschillende vormen van groepstoezicht op banken en verzekeraars beter op elkaar af te stemmen om zo overlap en lacunes te vermijden.
d: rules on cooperation between DNB and AFM in supervising financial conglomerates
rules on group governance and risk management of financial conglomerates
DNB may decide not to apply certain provisions to a group after consultation with other supervisors
DNB may choose to apply only relevant provisions of one supervisory regime to a mixed financial holding
DNB may exercise supervision over conglomerate entities in an alternative manner
DNB may take measures against regulated entities where solvency or financial position is threatened
DNB may choose which provisions of overlapping supervisory regimes apply to a mixed financial holding
p: DNB may decide not to apply certain conglomerate supervision provisions if it considers them unnecessary, improper or misleading, subject to agreement with other supervisors.
DNB may take measures against a regulated entity even where it complies with the applicable provisions, if solvency or financial position could be threatened.

parties: Worries that double supervision for financial conglomerates has not been fully excluded and asks how the bill guarantees this, and asks why maximum harmonisation was not chosen.

These members are concerned that the risk of unintended double supervision for financial conglomerates has not yet been fully covered, even though the coordinating supervisor can determine which requirements apply when excluded.

Deze leden zijn bezorgd dat het risico op onbedoeld dubbel toezicht voor financiële conglomeraten nog niet helemaal is afgedekt ondanks dat de coördinerende toezichthouder kan bepalen welke eisen bij uitsluiting van toepassing zijn.

Supports the directive as a step towards a banking union but asks for clarification of the coordinating supervisor's powers in crisis and resolution, the double use of capital, and why a mandatory stress test was not chosen.
On this point these members would like further clarification from the government, specifically regarding the powers of this coordinating supervisor in times of crisis and resolution.
Deze leden willen op dit punt wel een nadere toelichting van de regering, specifiek met betrekking tot de bevoegdheden van deze coördinerende toezichthouder in tijden van crisis en resolutie.
Asks whether the crisis experience in the Netherlands motivated the bill and how supervisors are appointed by nationality, and calls the absence of mandatory stress tests a weak point.
In the view of the PVV members, this is a weak point in the bill.
Naar de mening van de leden van PVV-fractie is dit een zwakke plek in het wetsvoorstel.
Worries that the coordinating supervisor's discretion to exclude requirements could undermine the bill's aim, and asks whether excluding special purpose vehicles could increase their number.
These members would therefore like to see further justification for why the coordinating supervisor's discretionary power will not ultimately undermine the aim of this law and related legislation.

Deze leden zouden dan ook graag nader onderbouwd zien waarom de discretionaire bevoegdheid van de coördinerende toezichthouder uiteindelijk niet zal leiden tot een ondergraving van het doel van deze wet en aanpalende wetgeving.
Asks the government to explain the content of the joint guidelines of the European supervisors and why mandatory stress tests are made impossible, and asks whether other member states opt for them.
These members ask the government to further explain why this makes a mandatory stress test impossible.
Deze leden vragen de regering nader toe te lichten waarom dit een verplichte stresstest onmogelijk maakt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill implementing Directive 2011/89/EU on supplementary supervision of financial conglomerates, raising points on DNB's designation as coordinator, optional stress tests, scope of supervision, consolidated supervision and alignment with the Solvency II implementing act. The Minister's nader rapport accepts most remarks, amending the text and explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: DNB must be expressly treated as the licensing supervisor for investment firms and managers for the purposes of article 10 of the financial conglomerates directive, and the Afdeling's remark was followed by adding this to article 3:290.
Article 3:275 needed an express provision that DNB is deemed the licensing supervisor for investment firms under articles 125 and 126 of the banking directive, which the government added.
Mandatory stress tests for financial conglomerates were not imposed; the government left the decision to DNB but supplemented the explanatory memorandum to justify this choice.

The rule in article 3:291(5) excluding supervision of the whole conglomerate where it forms part of another conglomerate was brought in line with the existing article 3:292(8), with the explanation added.
The relationship between article 3:276(3) first and second sentences, concerning Dutch subsidiaries of foreign and Dutch holdings, was clarified.

Article 71(2) second subparagraph of the banking directive was not fully transposed for holdings with only multiple banks or only multiple investment firms; a sentence was added to article 3:276(4) to cover this.
The explanatory memorandum was supplemented to explain the need to amend the Solvency II implementing act, given the later entry-into-force date.
Redactional remarks in the annex were taken into account in the revised bill.

33638.s: This bill approves a 2012 tax treaty between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and Ethiopia to avoid double taxation and prevent tax evasion on income taxes, for the European and Caribbean parts of the Netherlands. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The Treaty concluded at Addis Ababa on 10 August 2012 ... is approved for the European and Caribbean parts of the Netherlands.
Het op 10 augustus 2012 te Addis Abeba tot stand gekomen Verdrag ... wordt goedgekeurd voor het Europese en Caribische deel van Nederland.

parties: Asks why the treaty contains no anti-abuse provisions given the government's own SEO-report response, and how information received from Ethiopia will be acted upon.
Asks technical questions about permanent establishment definitions, withholding taxes and the OECD model.
Why is the definition of the term permanent establishment only partly in line with the OECD principles?
Waarom is de definitie van het begrip vaste inrichting slechts deels in overeenstemming met de OESO-beginselen?
Asks whether a main purpose test should be included to prevent treaty abuse and whether Ethiopia has been offered anti-abuse measures.
Could including a main purpose test prevent or limit possible treaty abuse, ask the SP members?
Zou het opnemen van een main purpose test mogelijk verdragsmisbruik kunnen voorkomen dan wel kunnen beperken, vragen de leden van de SP-fractie?
Argues there is a real risk of treaty abuse from differing withholding rates and asks why no limitation-on-benefits clause was chosen despite government policy.
In the written consultation on this treaty, the GroenLinks members already indicated that there is indeed a risk of treaty abuse.
In het schriftelijk overleg dat over dit verdrag gevoerd is, hebben de leden van de fractie van GroenLinks reeds aangegeven dat er wel degelijk een risico is op verdragsmisbruik.

33656.s: The bill merges the former agriculture and economic affairs subsidy frameworks by amending the Kaderwet EZ-subsidies, adding agriculture-related policy areas and revising ministerial powers. It also transfers international trade subsidy rules to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and repeals the Kaderwet LNV-subsidies, with transitional provisions keeping existing subsidy regulations valid.
33656.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as integration of the former ministries' subsidy frameworks and as aligning supervisory powers with the Algemene wet bestuursrecht.
q: Article 8(2) of the Kaderwet EZ-subsidies limits the number of supervisory powers available to the supervisor under the General Administrative Law Act.
Artikel 8, tweede lid, van de Kaderwet EZ-subsidies beperkt het aantal op grond van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht voor de toezichthouder beschikbare toezichtsbevoegdheden.
d: subsidy policy areas for the Minister
specifying subsidised activities and criteria by AMvB or ministerial regulation
designation of persons supervising compliance by ministerial decision
existing subsidy regulations carried over to the Foreign Affairs framework
p: The Minister may refuse, reduce, withdraw or change subsidies to the recipient's detriment where treaty obligations would be breached, broadening executive discretion.
The deletion of the restriction on supervisory powers allows supervisors broader investigative powers, including inspection of goods and vehicles.

parties: Asks for the timeline of the changes and how parliament will be informed about integrating the underlying regulations, including any gaps that may arise.
and whether gaps may arise in this period and how the House will be informed about the integration of the underlying regulations.
en of er in deze periode eventuele leemtes ontstaan en hoe de Kamer geïnformeerd wordt over de integratie van de onderliggende regelgeving.
Expresses approval but questions the long delay in merging the subsidy frameworks, the timeline for underlying regulations, and the transition rules for subsidies paid out in tranches.
What changes are to be expected for subsidy recipients, ask the members of the PvdA fractie.
Welke veranderingen zijn er dan te verwachten voor de subsidieontvangers, zo vragen de leden van de PvdA-fractie.
Asks about changes to subsidy accountability, efficiency gains, staffing, completion timeline, and how the House will be kept informed of progress.
In what way will the House be informed about progress, ask the members of the CDA fractie.
Op welke wijze wordt de Kamer geïnformeerd over de voortgang, zo vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie.

33674.s: The bill requires youth care providers and foundations to use the citizen service number (burgerservicenummer) for clients and sets rules for verifying it, including a ministerial authorisation list managed by the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport. It also expands the inspection powers of ministry officials over subsidised closed youth care, allowing access to client files.
33674.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for technical detail, flexibility given fast electronic developments, and the need to verify subsidy use, and it states that the inspection power goes no further than strictly necessary.
q: This instrument has in recent times proved insufficient to check the lawfulness and efficiency of the use of subsidies granted to closed youth care providers.

Dit instrument is de afgelopen periode onvoldoende toereikend gebleken om de rechtmatigheid en doelmatigheid van de besteding van subsidies die zijn verleend aan aanbieders van gesloten jeugdzorg te kunnen controleren.
d: rules on authorisation list: entries, management, supervision
characteristics, application, procedure and use of access means
p: Ministry-designated officials may inspect client files of subsidised closed youth care, overriding the usual confidentiality limits, but only where strictly necessary for checking subsidy use.

parties: Asks how identity fraud and misuse of BSN data are prevented, who may access linked data, and how the reliability of sources and new providers' access are safeguarded.
How then are fraud and misuse generally prevented, and more specifically, how is the prevention of identity fraud secured?
Hoe wordt dan in het algemeen fraude en misbruik voorkomen, en meer specifiek, op welke wijze wordt het voorkomen van identiteitsfraude geborgd?
Supports the aim of effective care but insists on privacy and Wbp rules, and asks for a fuller subsidiarity analysis of alternative methods.
The subsidiarity requirement in the bill is, in the view of these members, sketchily elaborated.
De subsidiariteitseis in het wetsvoorstel is naar de mening van genoemde leden summier uitgewerkt.
Asks what concrete added value the BSN brings, how the transition to municipalities is controlled, and why Gedeputeerde Staten rather than the Inspectie supervise compliance.
The members of the SP faction ask why the Provincial Executives are made responsible for supervising the citizen service number
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen waarom de Gedeputeerde Staten verantwoordelijk worden voor het toezicht op het burgerservicenummer
Asks whether BSN use is already permitted, why the VIR index would not suffice under subsidiarity, and why the Raad van State advice on official access to health data was not followed.
The subsidiarity test requires an answer to the question whether the intended goal cannot be achieved in another way.
De subsidiariteitstoets verlangt antwoord op de vraag of het beoogde doel niet op een andere manier bereikt kan worden.
Argues the memorandum presents BSN use as indispensable without showing less intrusive alternatives, and that verification duties are left to parties rather than made firm.
It surprises them that there is not a firm obligation in all cases and that, as the memorandum shows, it is left to the parties involved to shape the verification duty

Het verbaast hen dan ook dat hiertoe niet in alle gevallen een harde verplichting staat en dat het, zo blijkt uit de memorie, aan de betrokken partijen wordt overgelaten om vorm te geven aan de vergewisplicht

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering supports the bill requiring youth care bureaus and providers to use the citizen service number, but asks for changes on processing personal data: anonymisation in the inspection powers of art. 48(4) Wjz and an explicit legal basis for access to health-related client files. The state secretary's nader rapport reports that the advice was followed, adding an anonymisation clause (new art. 48(5)), a reference to art. 45(2) Wjz, and a transitional provision.
concerns: Inspection access to client files under art. 48(4) Wjz should be subject to anonymisation where possible, to limit intrusion into privacy, by applying art. 45(3) Wjz mutatis mutandis.
Access to health-related personal data needs an explicit statutory basis under the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens, so art. 45(2) Wjz should apply to art. 48(4) Wjz.

33683.s: The bill amends the Zorgverzekeringswet to tighten address checks: insurers may refuse to insure someone whose stated address differs from the municipal population register unless narrow exceptions apply. It also gives the minister power by ministerial regulation to set the level of the administrative premium for defaulting policyholders and to add exit conditions, and redirects fines to the state treasury.
33683.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to the minister by the need to steer uitstroom and respond to market developments flexibly, and the address rule by preventing burgers from being untraceable to government.
q: To be able to use the level of the administrative premium better as an instrument to promote exit, and to respond to further market developments, it is therefore arranged that the level of the administrative premium is set by ministerial regulation.

Teneinde de hoogte van de bestuursrechtelijke premie beter dan thans als instrument voor bevordering van de uitstroom aan te kunnen wenden en om mogelijk te maken in te spelen op verdere marktontwikkelingen, wordt daarom geregeld dat de hoogte van de bestuursrechtelijke premie bij ministeriële regeling wordt vastgesteld.
d: amount of administrative premium for defaulting policyholders by group
groups of policyholders for differentiated administrative premium
additional conditions for exit from administrative premium regime
conditions for return to administrative premium regime
level of administrative premium for former uninsured persons
when sufficient effort and cooperation exist, period, height and manner of contribution
p: Insurers may refuse insurance when the stated address differs from the population register, shifting burdens onto citizens, with narrow exceptions for reasonable blame and proof of Dutch insurance.
Address mismatch allows insurers to report policyholders as defaulters, making them subject to the administrative premium regime.
Minister may set the administrative premium level and exit conditions by ministerial regulation without statutory bounds.
Rights and duties under health insurance are suspended by operation of law during detention abroad, on declaration by the Foreign Minister or Reclassering Nederland.
Removes the administrative fines from the list of items allocated in the Zvw budget provisions, redirecting them to the state treasury.

parties: Asks who is responsible for non-payers and how the NZa or other bodies will assess insurers' efforts before compensation is set.
Asks about tailored arrangements for individual circumstances and coordination with municipalities and insurers, and about the lack of binding cooperation.
They ask to what extent this bill leaves room for tailored solutions so that the personal circumstances of the non-payer can be taken into account.
Zij vragen in hoeverre dit wetsvoorstel ruimte laat voor maatwerk, zodat de persoonlijke omstandigheden van de wanbetaler, betrokken kan worden bij het opstellen van een wanbetalersregeling.
Views the growing complexity of the system as undesirable and questions the softening of enforcement against non-payers and uninsured persons.
Is a more and more complex system not being built to tackle non-payers?
Wordt hier niet een steeds complexer systeem opgetuigd om wanbetalers aan te pakken?

Argues that the penalty surcharge worsens debts, questions the reasons for non-payment and the practice of mandatory address registration, and asks for ministerial regulations to be subject to a preliminary hearing.
Does the government share the view that this shortfall is not solved by a fine but is made worse?
Deelt de regering de visie dat dit tekort niet wordt opgelost met een boete maar juist wordt verergerd.
Supports a good non-payment scheme but asks why the amount of the administrative premium is not set by general administrative order and whether it can exceed 130%.
Why has the government not also set the height of the administrative premium by general administrative order (amvb)?
Waarom heeft de regering ook niet het bepalen van de hoogte van de bestuursrechtelijke premie bij amvb vastgelegd?

Supports tighter measures but notes that cooperation between insurers and municipalities is non-binding and asks why binding agreements are not required; also questions improper compensation paid to insurers.
These members note that such consultation has no binding character.
Genoemde leden constateren dat een dergelijk overleg geen bindend karakter kent.
Asks the government when exit of welfare recipients from the non-payment regime is feasible and whether preconditions must be met before a ministerial regulation is issued.
Does the government have preconditions that must be met before it proceeds with the mentioned ministerial regulation?
Heeft de regering randvoorwaarden waar aan voldaan moet worden voordat zij overgaat tot de genoemde ministeriële regeling?

Supports a hard regime for those who can pay but a lenient regime for those who cannot, and asks how the three priority points, including the Zorginstituut's concerns about differentiation, are handled in this bill.
These members favour a hard regime for those who can pay their premium but do not, and a lenient regime for those who simply cannot pay.
Genoemde leden staan voor een hard regime voor degenen die hun premie wel kunnen betalen maar dat niet doen, en een coulant regime voor degenen die hun premie simpelweg niet kunnen betalen.
Doubts the effectiveness of the measures, warns that insurers must not profit from vulnerable enrollees, and argues the fine should not burden people who cannot pay.
According to these members, health insurers may under no circumstances profit at the expense of this vulnerable group of insured persons.
Volgens genoemde leden mogen zorgverzekeraars onder geen beding winst maken over de rug van deze kwetsbare groep verzekerden.
Asks for concrete, objectively verifiable criteria for insurers' collection efforts and for explanation of the Zorginstituut's finding that premium differentiation is not practically feasible.
These members ask the government to specify how it can be objectively established that a health insurer has made sufficient collection efforts.
Genoemde leden vragen de regering nader aan te geven hoe objectief kan worden vastgesteld dat een zorgverzekeraar voldoende incasso inspanningen heeft verricht.
Raises concerns about administrative burden and legal inequality from differentiated premiums, and asks whether an integrated registration of income and debts raises privacy risks.
These members ask whether the government intends to obtain this insight and whether it will also examine the privacy risks such an integrated registration entails.
Deze leden vragen of de regering voornemens is om dit inzicht wel te verkrijgen en of de regering daarbij ook wil onderzoeken welke privacyrisico's zo'n integrale registratie met zich meebrengt?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the aim of the bill improving the non-payment rules in the Zorgverzekeringswet but raises remarks on municipal-insurer cooperation, uninsured persons with unknown addresses, and the delegation of premium differentiation to a ministerial regulation, advising adaptation before submission. The minister's reply accepts the cooperation point by commissioning a product book and expert meetings, clarifies the uninsured-care point and amends the bill, and follows the advice to move the differentiation to an algemene maatregel van bestuur.
concerns: Coordination between municipalities, insurers and the CVZ does not arise automatically and the explanatory memorandum should explain how it will be promoted; the minister added expert meetings, a product book and convenant consultations.

The explanatory memorandum should address how care providers are reimbursed for care given to persons refused insurance due to an unverified address; the minister clarified this and added text to article 4a.

Differentiation of the bestuursrechtelijke premie across groups of defaulters requires regulation at the level of an algemene maatregel van bestuur rather than a ministeriële regeling; the minister followed this advice.

33692.s: The bill amends the Dutch Animal Experiments Act to implement EU Directive 2010/63/EU on protection of animals used for scientific purposes. It tightens authorisation rules, moves project approval to the central committee (CCD) with independent ethics review, and adds welfare, record-keeping and enforcement obligations.
33692.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to implement the directive's detailed technical requirements and to keep rules flexible and up to date with EU developments.
q: A licence has been granted to 41 companies and institutions, largely the same institutions that hold an establishment licence under Article 2(1) of the Animal Experiments Act.
Een dergelijke vergunning is aan 41 bedrijven en instellingen verleend, grotendeels aan dezelfde instellingen die een instellingsvergunning hebben op grond van artikel 2, eerste lid, van de Wod.
d: designation of the EU directive applicable under the Act
documents and data required for project licence application and fee rules
professional competence requirements for persons designing projects
publication of non-technical summaries and simplified project procedure
minister may grant exemption allowing non-human primate use for up to five years
euthanasia methods, adoption and release of animals, and other welfare rules
minister may exempt or grant derogation from approved killing methods
minister may grant exemption from the ban on severe unrelieved pain procedures for up to five years
staffing, competence and facility standards for breeders, suppliers and users
categories of establishments exempt from setting up an animal welfare body
record-keeping and reporting obligations for breeders, suppliers and users
individual records and identification marking of dogs, cats and primates
central committee recognises animal experiment committees
national committee for animal protection appointed by minister
p: The minister may grant exemptions from killing methods and from the rules on animal origin, based on scientific justification.
The minister may exempt non-human primate use and severe unrelieved pain procedures for up to five years, renewable once, without parliamentary approval.[?]
Project approval moves from the minister to the central committee, which is designed to be independent, reducing direct ministerial control over project licensing.

parties: Asks why the government deviates from the Directive, worries about stricter national rules undermining a level playing field, and asks about enforcement capacity of the NVWA.

The VVD members are concerned that the Dutch government will make frequent use of the various member-state options the Directive offers and interpret the Directive more strictly than other EU member states.

De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn bezorgd dat de Nederlandse regering veelvuldig gebruik gaat maken van de verschillende lidstaatopties die de richtlijn biedt en de richtlijn strikter gaat interpreteren dan andere EU-lidstaten.
Supports the change to Wod and the CCD deciding on project licences, but asks for clarification on oversight of institutions and on checking necessity of animal experiments per project.

The PvdA members believe it is sensible for the CCD to decide on project licences, because the DECs are tied to licence holders and therefore cannot take an independent decision on the licence application.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn van mening dat het verstandig is dat de CCD wordt belast met de besluitvorming over de projectvergunningen, omdat de DEC's zijn verbonden met vergunninghouders en dus niet in de positie verkeren een onafhankelijk besluit te nemen op de vergunningaanvraag.

Doubts the independence of the DECs, which are not majority external, asks that the CCD always review experiments, questions mandating a DEC, and objects to the term 'onpartijdig' instead of 'onafhankelijk'.
The DECs, however, consist for less than half of members from outside the institution and are therefore not independent.
De DEC's bestaan echter maar voor minder dan de helft uit leden van buiten de instelling en zijn daarmee niet onafhankelijk.
Wants room for societal actors' views in the ethical weighing by the CCD and fears article 18 gives insufficient guarantees; asks whether the government will sharpen it.
The SGP members fear that the proposed wording of article 18 offers insufficient guarantees for this.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vrezen dat de voorgestelde formulering van artikel 18 hier onvoldoende waarborgen voor biedt.

Objects to the CCD being placed under the Kaderwet while the minister keeps annulment power, questions conditional project licences, the powers of the Animal Welfare Body, openness of decisions, and the scope of the National Committee.
The Partij voor de Dieren members are pleased that the Wod, with this bill, better aligns with the standards for open government.
De leden van de fractie van de Partij voor de Dieren zijn blij dat de Wod met het voorliggende wetsvoorstel beter aansluit bij de normen voor openbaarheid van bestuur.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion of 25 February 2013 on the bill amending the Wet op de dierproeven to implement Directive 2010/63/EU supports the bill's aims but raises objections on implementing in the existing law, the broad definition of animal experiment, the CCD as independent body, entry into homes, and criminal sanctions. The government's nader rapport of 2 July 2013 responds point by point, largely accepting the remarks on redactions and the criminal-law delegation while defending its choices on the definition, the CCD role, home entry and penalties.
concerns: Advice to replace the existing Wod with a new law was not followed; the government kept amending the existing act to follow the drafting guideline on minimal implementation, while committing to publish an integral text.

The broader national definition of animal experiment covering killing for organs needed a reasoned justification and EU-law analysis of free movement of services and goods, which the government supplied in the reply.
Designation of the CCD as an independent administrative body needed fuller justification, which the government added along with reasons why mandating the DEC is not possible.

The power to enter a home without the occupier's consent under the Wod was questioned for necessity, and the government maintained it because the Gezondheids- en welzijnswet does not apply to Wod offences.

Listing of endangered species moved into the statute itself, with the species designated by general administrative order, to meet the requirement that criminal offences be defined by the formal legislator.
Higher fines needed better justification; the government compared them with penalties in the Gezondheids- en welzijnswet and Wet dieren and kept the increase.
Duty to report positive project changes to the CCD was questioned for proportionality; the government kept it, arguing the burden is minimal and it is needed for the three Rs and supervision.
Multiple redactional remarks on terminology, cross-references, article splitting and wording were largely incorporated into the amended bill.

33719.s: The bill integrates Dutch water board (waterschap) general board elections into the Kieswet, combining them with provincial states elections on the same ballot and with separate ballot boxes and voter passes. It also adapts the Waterschapswet and Algemene wet bestuursrecht on membership, registration of interest groups, and appeal procedures.
33719.j: The memorandum justifies integrating procedures into the Kieswet for uniformity and rule-of-law clarity, and keeps most detailed rules at statutory level rather than delegating them.
q: This means that many elements currently regulated at the level of a general administrative order (AMvB) will be regulated at statutory level.
Dat brengt met zich mee dat veel elementen die nu nog op het niveau van een algemene maatregel van bestuur zijn geregeld, op wetsniveau worden geregeld.
d: rules for combining water board and provincial elections
Artikel I, AG (art. J 5 lid 2 Kieswet)
municipal executive may restrict voting to designated polling stations
commissaris van de Koning appoints interim chair
p: Allows the chair to act in place of the dagelijks bestuur when its membership falls below half, with the general board retaining removal powers.

parties: Supports direct elections for democratic control of water boards but asks about the discretion of municipalities in allowing voting at any polling station and about the restriction of blank lists.
First, the VVD members note that they are in favour of direct elections for the category of residents.
Allereerst merken de leden van de VVD-fractie op dat zij voorstander zijn van directe verkiezingen voor de categorie ingezetenen.
Welcomes the reform for democratic legitimacy but questions the nationality requirement difference, the registration test for groupings and the complexity of the polling arrangements.
The PvdA members support the principle that a voter can vote at any polling station within their place of residence.
Het principe dat een kiezer binnen zijn woonplaats in ieder willekeurig stem-bureau kan stemmen steunen de leden van de PvdA-fractie.

Accepts the combination only as a temporary solution, asks for a timeline for placing water boards under provinces, and criticises the retention of reserved seats which conflicts with one-man-one-vote.
Now that water board elections are being placed in the Kieswet, these members consider it obvious to apply the same principle of one man, one vote to water board elections.

Nu de waterschapsverkiezingen ondergebracht worden in de Kieswet, ligt het naar de mening van deze leden voor de hand om hetzelfde uitgangspunt te hanteren bij verkiezingen van de waterschapsbesturen.
Supports direct elections and the need for timely clarity, and asks for research on combining elections and on the Kiesraad's advice about the registration procedure.
These members endorse the premise of the bill, that direct elections provide the best guarantee that interests in water management are safeguarded.
Deze leden onderschrijven het uitgangspunt van het wetsvoorstel, dat directe verkiezingen de beste garantie geven dat de belangen in het waterbeheer zijn gewaarborgd.

Objects to reserved seats as a form of census suffrage, asks the government to follow the Kiesraad's advice on blank lists and a non-material registration test, and wants the counting software to be used.
These members agree with the Kiesraad that a substantive test conflicts with the starting point of the Kieswet.
Deze leden sluiten zich aan bij de Kiesraad, wanneer die stelt dat een materiële toets strijdig is met de het uitgangspunt van de Kieswet.

Asks how it is prevented that a grouping losing its required special interest remains on the board and what title exists to terminate its registration, and asks about the timing of the landsdelen integration.
The ChristenUnie members ask how it is prevented that the demonstrable interest is called into question because a grouping that no longer has a demonstrable interest can remain part of the board.

De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie vragen hoe wordt voorkomen dat het aanwijsbaar belang ter discussie komt te staan doordat een groepering die geen aanwijsbaar belang meer heeft, deel uit kan blijven maken van het bestuur.

Asks why the water board elections are combined with provincial rather than municipal elections, whether the arrangement creates confusion for voters and polling staff, and about the restzetel allocation method.
The SGP members wonder whether voters who wish to do so and, for example, forgot to bring their voting pass for one of the two elections can still cast that vote.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen zich af of kiezers die dit willen en bijvoorbeeld hun stempas voor één van beide verkiezingen vergeten zijn mee te nemen, alsnog die stem uit kunnen brengen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill integrating direct water board elections into the Kieswet, raising concerns about integration, the registration requirement of a demonstrable interest, and differing voting eligibility; it advised a separate chapter and several supplements. The government largely declined the structural changes (keeping integration and the existing registration rules) but added explanatory text and adopted the drafting remark.
concerns: The Afdeling advised placing the water board election rules in a separate chapter of the Kieswet, which the government rejected in favour of integration into the general chapters.
The Afdeling asked for the explanatory memorandum to be supplemented on the requirement of a demonstrable interest for registered groupings, which the government did by adding text.
The Afdeling advised that registration be struck off when a grouping no longer has a demonstrable interest, which the government rejected as unnecessary.

The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to address the difference in voting eligibility between water board elections (residents) and provincial elections (Dutch nationals), which the government addressed.
A redactional remark on the chapter heading of the bill was adopted.

33750-X.s: This bill sets the 2014 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence and the budget statements of its three baten-lastenagentschappen (DTO, DVD, Paresto), in thousands of euros, with entry into force on 1 January 2014. The accompanying explanatory memorandum describes operational deployment, business operations, research funding and oversight relations but contains no new delegation of rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2014 accompanying this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2014 wordt vastgesteld.

33755.s: The bill sets a minimum of 4% for the tax interest on income tax, inheritance tax, wage tax, VAT, transfer tax, car and motorcycle tax, excise duties and environmental taxes, and a minimum of 8% for corporate income tax, tying both to statutory interest rates. It also introduces a 4% floor for collection interest and takes effect on 1 January 2014.
33755.j: The memorandum explains that the statutory interest rate is set by general administrative order under Article 6:120 BW, which can leave tax interest above that rate, without giving a further justification for the delegation.
q: The interest rate of the aforementioned statutory interest is determined by general administrative order pursuant to Article 6:120, first paragraph, of the Civil Code.
Het rentepercentage van de hiervoor genoemde wettelijke rente wordt ingevolge artikel 6:120, eerste lid, van het Burgerlijk Wetboek (BW) bepaald bij algemene maatregel van bestuur.
d: statutory interest rate used for tax interest

parties: Asks the government to explain the growing positive effect on the EMU balance and the larger structural effect on the expenditure ceiling.

The PvdA members ask the government to explain why the positive effect on the EMU balance rises so sharply up to 2017 and why the structural effect on the expenditure ceiling is even considerably larger.

De leden van de fractie van de PvdA vragen de regering of zij kan toelichten waarom het positieve effect op het EMU saldo zo sterk oploopt tot 2017 en waarom het structurele effect op het uitgavenkader zelfs nog aanzienlijk groter is?
Views the higher interest as disguised taxation lacking justification and violating equality, since sole traders and companies are treated differently.

There is also still no convincing justification, even after the supplementary report, why for corporate tax the tax interest rate follows the statutory rate for commercial transactions, but the collection interest rate does not.; the PVV considers this in breach of the equality principle.

Ook ontbreekt een draagkrachtige motivering, ook na het nader rapport, waarom voor de vennootschapsbelasting bij de vaststelling van het percentage belastingrente wel wordt aangesloten bij de wettelijke rente voor handelstransacties, maar bij de vaststelling van het percentage voor de invorderingsrente niet.
Asks why interest rates are lower now, how the rate is set, and whether the higher rate amounts to a punitive penalty, requesting data on interest paid and received.
Can the government explain whether in recent years the interest charged to taxpayers is proportionate to the interest amounts refunded by the Tax Authority?

Kan de regering toelichten of in de afgelopen jaren de rente die in rekening is gebracht bij belastingplichtigen in verhouding staat tot hoeveelheid rentegelden die zijn vergoed door de Belastingdienst?

Objects strongly that the tax authority may charge a higher interest rate than private persons, companies or government; flags that interest keeps running during objection and appeal, possibly impeding access to the courts.
Furthermore, the CDA members ask the government whether the increase in tax and collection interest does not form an indirect obstacle to access to the courts.
Bovendien vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie de regering weten of de verhoging van de belasting- en invorderingsrente geen indirecte belemmering vormt voor de toegang tot de rechter.
Notes the Council of State warned the proposed minimum rates are considerably above actual market rates and asks for a comparison.
The D66 members note that the Council of State warns that actual interest rates are considerably lower than the currently proposed minimum percentages.
De leden van de fractie van D66 constateren dat de Raad van State waarschuwt dat de werkelijke rentepercentages aanmerkelijk lager zijn dan de thans voorgestelde minimumpercentages.
Regards the change as disguised taxation and questions why different statutory rates apply depending on legal form.
The ChristenUnie members see the change in the tax and collection interest percentages as disguised taxation.
De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie zien de wijziging van de percentages van de belasting- en invorderingsrente als een verkapte belastingheffing.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion supports the bill lowering the tax and collection interest rate floors but finds the motivation thin, asking for a substantive justification and clarity on budgetary and boeterente risks. The government reply largely accepts the remarks, adds explanation on the rate choices and the budgetary effect, and makes only minor redactional changes, declining one redactional point.
concerns: The Afdeling finds no convincing substantive motivation for the 4% and 8% minimum interest percentages, as budgetary considerations alone are not sufficient, and asks for a supporting justification in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling warns that budgetary motives could undermine the interest character of the regime and turn it into a penalty interest, and asks that this aspect be addressed; the government rejects the boeterente risk but adds explanation.

The Afdeling asks the memorandum to explain why only corporate tax is linked to commercial statutory interest and why income-tax entrepreneurs are treated differently, which the government addresses with an added explanation.

The Afdeling notes that taxpayers can avoid the charged interest by requesting provisional assessments, possibly defeating the budgetary target; the government acknowledges this and notes the tension with the goal of working as current as possible.
The Afdeling makes redactional remarks on the wording of article 30hb, paragraph 2, of the AWR; the first is followed and the second is not, as it concerns only corporate tax interest.

33773.s: This technical amendment bill updates numerous Dutch statutes to reflect the renaming of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation and to repair drafting errors and gaps. It also makes a few substantive adjustments, such as extending appeal routes for tax penalty decisions, changing Dutch Animal Act delegation and approval rules, and adjusting procedures for gas and electricity infrastructure projects.
33773.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial-regulation delegations as needed for practical efficiency and to remove redundant royal-decree formalities, and the penalty appeal change as implementing the ICCPR right to two-tier review.
q: In view of Article 14(5) of the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, an appeal in two instances must be open against a decision imposing an administrative fine.

Gelet op artikel 14, vijfde lid, van het Internationaal Verdrag inzake burgerrechten en politieke rechten dient tegen een besluit tot oplegging van een bestuurlijke boete beroep in twee instanties open te staan.
d: imposing administrative penalties for non-compliance with RDA obligations
rules implementing binding EU acts, departing from chapters 2 and 3 in favour of ministerial regulation
rules on licensing decisions, advisory committees and procedures under Animal Act
further rules on notification of stock transfers
setting entry-into-force date of gas tariff regulation by ministerial decision instead of royal decree
p: The Minister is empowered to make rules for EU-based implementation outside the general delegation structure of chapters 2 and 3, expanding ministerial discretion.
Artikel XLVII (Wet dieren, art. 7.3 and 7.7 et al.)
Licensing and advisory-committee procedures may now be set by amvb or ministerial regulation, and some applications are excluded from the general administrative procedure rules.

33791.s: The bill clarifies the smoking bans in the Tabakswet and introduces a general smoking ban in hospitality establishments, removing the exception for small cafés. It assigns responsibility for enforcing bans to specified operators and employers, and allows an algemene maatregel van bestuur to set exceptions and alternative measures.
33791.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation as allowing flexible response to new developments and innovations in tobacco control, while stating the primary aim of protecting public health.
q: The delegation of regulatory powers, regulated in article 10, third paragraph, offers the legislator the possibility to respond relatively quickly and flexibly to such developments.
De delegatie van regelgevende bevoegdheden, geregeld in artikel 10, derde lid, biedt de besluitwetgever de mogelijkheid om relatief snel en flexibel in te spelen op dergelijke ontwikkelingen.
d: Artikel I B, artikel 10, tweede lid
exceptions to the smoking ban for categories of entrepreneurs, room types, and other workplaces
Artikel I B, artikel 10, derde lid
alternative measures to prevent exposure to tobacco smoke instead of or alongside a ban
Artikel I B, artikel 10, eerste lid, onder d
designation of other buildings or facilities subject to a smoking ban
Artikel I B, artikel 10, vijfde lid
