designation of persons or bodies obliged to implement measures under the amvb
p: Artikel I B, artikel 10, tweede en derde lid
The executive may, by general administrative order, carve out exceptions to the smoking ban and substitute alternative measures without returning to parliament.

parties: Asks for research on economic effects of a full horeca smoking ban and questions the government's claim that compliance has not improved substantially, and asks which additional measures could be set by general administrative order.
The VVD members have serious reservations about this.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben hier ernstige bedenkingen bij.
Supports the ban but asks the government to explain how it anticipates future changes to the ban by delegated rules and to justify the scope of the delegation for alternatives.
Can the government explain why and how it appears to anticipate future amendments to the smoking ban?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom en op welke wijze zij lijkt te anticiperen op toekomstige aanpassing van het rookverbod?
Asks about enforcement levels, violations in small cafés without staff and whether enforcement is adequate, and about preventive measures.
According to these members, enforcement is crucial in reducing the number of cafés where smoking continues despite the ban.
Volgens deze leden is handhaving cruciaal bij het terugdringen van het aantal cafés waar ondanks een verbod nog steeds gerookt wordt.
Prefers lifting the horeca smoking ban entirely, sees agreements with guests as the entrepreneur's own responsibility, and worries about survival of small cafés.
These members would prefer that the smoking ban in hospitality be lifted entirely.
Het liefst zien deze leden dat het rookverbod in de horeca volledig opgeheven wordt.

Supports strict enforcement of the ban but asks about conditions for exceptions by delegated rule, examples of alternatives, the scope of the employer definition, and whether enforcement should move to municipalities.
These members favour strict enforcement of the smoking ban in hospitality, including small cafés.
Deze leden zijn voorstander van een strikte handhaving van het rookverbod in de horeca, inclusief kleine cafés.
Largely satisfied with abolishing the small café exception but asks about enforcement capacity, timing, budget and expected fine revenue.
These members are largely satisfied with the proposed amendment but have some questions about the implementation of the revised law.
Deze leden worden grotendeels tevreden gesteld met de voorgestelde wetswijziging, maar hebben enkele vragen over de invulling van de vernieuwde wet.
Supports tightening but questions why exceptions and alternatives remain possible, whether the 100% smoke-free goal of the FCTC is met given smoking rooms, and what innovations are envisaged.
These members believe this wording leaves room for other exceptions.
Deze leden menen dat deze formulering ruimte open laat voor andere uitzonderingen.
Asks which developments could justify alternatives and why regulatory power is delegated, which they say avoids parliamentary treatment through amending legislation.
Why was a delegation of regulatory powers chosen, and does this effectively avoid parliamentary treatment through a law amendment?
Waarom is gekozen voor een delegatie van regelgevende bevoegdheden en wordt daarmee feitelijk een parlementaire behandeling door middel van wetswijziging vermeden?
Objects to removing the small-café exception, citing reduced freedom of choice for patrons and entrepreneurs, and questions the logic of extending the ban without enough enforcement capacity.
The VVD members have serious reservations about removing the current exception to the smoking ban for small cafés.
De leden van de VVD-fractie houden ernstige bedenkingen bij het schrappen van de huidige uitzondering op het rookverbod voor kleine cafés.
Welcomes the amendment making the hospitality smoking ban permanent and asks for swift passage without further delay; no further questions.
They hope this bill can be handled and completed in both chambers with urgency and without further delays.
Zij hopen dat dit wetsvoorstel zonder verdere vertragingen met gezwinde spoed in beide Kamers kan worden behandeld en afgerond.
Asks whether the open-ended exception for other measures is intended and questions whether enforcement capacity is enough for a full cultural shift and the 96% compliance target.
These members ask the government whether it is convinced that the increase in inspections as now proposed is sufficient to make the cultural shift permanent.
Genoemde leden vragen de regering of zij ervan overtuigd is dat de verhoging van het aantal inspecties zoals nu voorgesteld voldoende is om die cultuuromslag definitief te maken.

33809.s: The bill approves a 2005 revised social security treaty between the Netherlands and Chile, applying to the European part of the Netherlands. It enters into force on the first day of the third month after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The Social Security Treaty between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Republic of Chile concluded in The Hague on 15 June 2005 is approved for the European part of the Netherlands.

Het op 15 juni 2005 te ‘s-Gravenhage tot stand gekomen Verdrag inzake sociale zekerheid tussen het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden en de Republiek Chili ... wordt goedgekeurd voor het Europese deel van Nederland.

parties: Asks whether the treaty with Chile now prevents export of child benefit and child budget after the 1 January 2015 reform, and whether it anticipates a change in export of the WGA benefit following the adopted motion.
The said members ask whether the treaty has now been adjusted so that child benefit and the child-related budget are no longer exported to Chile from 1 January 2015.
De genoemde leden vragen of het verdrag nu zo is aangepast dat de kinderbijslag en het kindgebonden budget per 1 januari 2015 niet langer worden geëxporteerd naar Chili.
Asks the government to explain the material content of the revision and how many people experience its consequences.
How many people experience the consequences of this revision and what do these consequences entail, the said members ask.
Hoeveel mensen ervaren gevolgen van deze herziening en wat houden deze gevolgen in, zo informeren genoemde leden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a revision of the Dutch-Chilean social security treaty that adds the AKW and Zw and excludes Wajong and Toeslagenwet from export, raising concerns about case law on Tw exports, the lack of a transitional arrangement, retroactive effect for AKW and Zw benefits, and the need to update the explanatory note. The government's reply (nader rapport) states that the explanatory note was amended on each of these points, including the Tw transitional rules, the Wajong exceptions, and the retroactivity, and that the treaty was submitted for tacit approval.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory note to address Centrale Raad van Beroep case law on Toeslagenwet export and whether a transitional arrangement is needed; the government amended the note on this.
The Afdeling asked the note to explain that the Wajong excludes export only with exceptions (transitional law, hardship clause), and the government added these to the explanatory note.

The Afdeling questioned the justification for retroactive effect of AKW export to 2003 and the Zw benefits back to 2002, asking for clarification and numbers affected; the government revised the note on retroactivity.
The Afdeling suggested updating several parts of the explanatory note, which the government did.

33818.s: The bill reforms Dutch dismissal law by replacing the dual route (UWV for economic grounds, cantonal judge for others) with a single preventive test per ground, introduces a statutory transitievergoeding (transition payment) for employees with at least two years' service, tightens limits on fixed-term contract chains and non-compete clauses, and caps the employer-insolvency benefit. The explanatory memorandum notes that several provisions allow collective agreements or ministerial regulations to deviate from the statutory rules.
33818.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as allowing sector-specific tailoring (e.g. professional football, education, media) and as needed for technical detail, with the explanatory note stating that exemptions are limited to serious cases.
q: The bill puts an end to the possibility of arbitrariness in the current dual system.
Het wetsvoorstel maakt een eind aan de mogelijkheid tot willekeur van het huidige duale recht.
d: exemptions from wage-payment duty for sectors and extraordinary circumstances
disapplying fixed-term contract chain rule for certain functions in a sector
rules on reasonable grounds for dismissal, reinstatement and selection order
procedure for UWV permission to dismiss
indexation of transition payment cap and deductible costs
payment of transition payment in instalments for employers facing unacceptable consequences
which employees the employer must offer reemployment
I.B / I.H (art. 7:668a lid 8, 7:670 lid 9 BW, collective agreements)
collective agreements or regulations by competent public bodies may set derogations and independent commissions for dismissal review
p: Ministerial regulation may set detailed criteria for reasonable grounds for dismissal and the selection order, shifting detail-setting from statute to the executive.

Dismissal permission is moved to UWV (executive agency) or to commissions set up by collective agreement, and procedural rules are left to ministerial regulation, reducing judicial control of economic dismissals.'
Courts' reinstatement and compensation powers are restructured, with appeal of ontbinding decisions limited to the compensation amount.
Ministry adjusts the transition payment ceiling annually by ministerial order and sets deductible cost categories by general administrative order.
Collective agreements and ministerial regulations can extend limits on fixed-term contract chains and disapply the rule for certain sectors, weakening employee protection.

parties: Supports modernising the labour market and simplifying dismissal law, and asks for a full overview of measures, effective dates and lower regulation still to come.
They believe this bill contains important elements to modernise the labour market.
Zij menen dat dit wetsvoorstel belangrijke elementen bevat om de arbeidsmarkt te moderniseren.
Welcomes the bill as ending excessive flexibilisation and creating a fairer dismissal regime, with some remaining questions.
This bill puts an end to the excessive flexibilisation of the labour market.
Dit wetsvoorstel maakt een einde aan de doorgeschoten flexibilisering op de arbeidsmarkt.
Welcomes much of the initiative bill but has serious reservations about the WW and collective-agreement parts and asks whether the three parts can be submitted as separate laws.
They further ask whether the government is willing to submit the three parts of the bill to the House as separate laws.
vragen voorts of de regering bereid is de drie delen van het wetsvoorstel als aparte wetten bij de Kamer in te dienen.
Asks why such sweeping changes are needed, what alternatives were considered, and whether an evaluation of the flex rules is planned.
They wonder where the necessity for the scale of the far-reaching changes in this bill comes from.
Zij vragen zich af waar de noodzaak vandaan komt voor de omvang van de ingrijpende veranderingen die met dit wetsvoorstel worden doorgevoerd.
Supports the aims of reducing the flex-permanent divide and simplifying dismissal, but doubts the measures will achieve the intended effect and raises risks around self-employed workers.
They do wonder, however, whether the measures and system changes foreseen in the bill will actually have the intended effect.
Zij vragen zich echter af of de in het wetsvoorstel voorziene maatregelen en stelselwijzigingen wel het beoogde effect zullen hebben.

Supports reform but asks for an overview of all delegation provisions, including whether the Chamber can review lower regulation before publication, and raises concerns about the shorter chain-clause risk.
These members ask the government for an overview of all delegation provisions in the bill.
Genoemde leden vragen de regering om een overzicht van alle delegatiebepalingen in het wetsvoorstel.
Asks questions on the bill without a substantive position yet, including on effects for education and the chain clause.
They wish to put a number of questions to the government for answer.
Zij willen een aantal vragen ter beantwoording aan de regering voorleggen.
Supports simplifying the dual dismissal system and shortening WW but fears the bill creates false security and rigidity rather than tailored solutions.
They fear the intended security may result in false security that could even backfire.
Zij vrezen dat de beoogde zekerheid kan uitmonden in schijnzekerheid die zelfs averechts kan uitpakken.
Endorses the aims but doubts the timing given the labour market, especially for older workers, and asks whether the bill will improve the position of flex workers.
The members of the 50PLUS faction have the greatest concerns about the timing of this law given the current situation on the labour market.
De grootste zorgen hebben de leden van de 50PLUS-fractie over de timing van deze wet gezien de huidige situatie op de arbeidsmarkt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Wet werk en zekerheid, concluding the bill only partly achieves its aim of shifting from job security to employment security, with objections on dismissal law, flexible work and unemployment benefits. The government's nader rapport responds to each point, accepting some suggestions (e.g. deleting the second compensation ground, limiting cao derogations on on-call contracts) while rejecting others.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the bill will substantially advance the shift from job security to employment security and calls for a broader reorientation of labour market arrangements.
The Afdeling argues the flexible-work measures are insufficiently motivated to improve flexworkers' position and may be counterproductive.
The second compensation ground ('geheel of grotendeels te wijten aan') is too broad and should be deleted or narrowed to avoid eroding the exceptional nature of the additional compensation.
The 'intrinsieke aard van de functie' criterion for cao derogation from the chain rule is too vague and should be clarified.
Defining passende arbeid via ministerial regulation should instead occur at the level of an algemene maatregel van bestuur given its essential role for entitlement.
Algemeen verbindend verklaring of cao-based extensions of WW duration conflicts with the goal of making the WW more activating and should be excluded by law.
The premium differentiation power raises serious implementation burdens and timing problems, and the Afdeling advises dropping it from the bill.
The IOW extension to 2027 needs a fuller weighing of arguments and motivation in the explanatory memorandum.

33854.s: The bill approves, for European Netherlands, the intended denunciation of the 1989 Hague Convention on the law applicable to succession to estates. The explanatory memorandum notes that EU Regulation 650/2012 will apply from 17 August 2015 and conflicts with the Convention.
33854.j: The memorandum justifies the denunciation by pointing to the EU regulation that will make the Convention's rules conflicting with national law.
q: That European regulation necessitates adjustment of national regulation, which will conflict with the provisions of the Hague succession convention.
Die Europese regelgeving noopt tot aanpassing van de nationale regelgeving, die daarmee strijdig zal zijn met de bepalingen van het Haags erfrechtverdrag.

parties: Asks whether serious reasons are required to denounce a treaty applied in full, whether denunciation could signal negatively to other states and to the Hague Conference, and whether Dutch legislation could be arranged to avoid conflict with the treaty.
These members ask whether the government shares the view that denouncing a treaty that is currently applied in full in the Netherlands requires serious reasons.
Deze leden vragen of de regering de opvatting deelt dat er voor de opzegging van een verdrag dat tot op heden in Nederland in de volle omvang wordt toegepast, zwaarwegende redenen moeten zijn.
Asks why the other states did not ratify the convention and whether those reasons have been removed by the EU Succession Regulation.
What are the reasons of all these countries not to ratify the Convention, and have these reasons been removed by the Succession Regulation?
Wat zijn de redenen van al deze landen om het Verdrag niet te ratificeren en zijn deze redenen met de Erfrechtverorde ning weggenomen?

33863.s: The bill amends the Pensioenwet, the Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling and related laws to align pension supervision with the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen, which now applies to DNB and AFM. It also adds a ministerial power to issue policy rules on pension supervision by DNB and AFM and removes the Inspectie SZW's explicit second-line supervisory role.
33863.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial policy-rule power as a way to intervene in less exceptional situations, while limiting it to general supervisory aspects and requiring prior consultation with the supervisor.
q: To also be able to intervene in less exceptional situations where there is a need to do so, a new article 1:25b was included in the Wft through the Wet versterking governance van DNB en AFM.

Om ook te kunnen interveniëren in minder uitzonderlijke situaties waarin daartoe noodzaak bestaat, is bij de Wet versterking governance van DNB en AFM een artikel 1:25b in de Wet op het financieel toezicht opgenomen.
d: Artikel I, D (art. 104, tiende lid Pensioenwet)
rules on supervisory board powers over appointment and dismissal of pension fund directors
Artikel II, E (art. 110a, tiende lid Wvb)
rules on supervisory board powers over appointment and dismissal of directors of occupational pension funds
Artikel I, J (art. 166a Pensioenwet) and Artikel II, K (art. 161a Wvb)
policy rules by the minister on how DNB and AFM apply supervisory chapter
p: Artikel I, I (art. 166 Pensioenwet) and Artikel II, J (art. 161 Wvb)
The minister takes over, for serious neglect of duties, the supervisory authority's powers to take necessary measures and to perform supervisory tasks itself."Ontdoen"
Artikel I, J (art. 166a Pensioenwet) and Artikel II, K (art. 161a Wvb)
The minister may issue binding policy rules on supervision by DNB and AFM, after consulting the supervisor and publishing them in the Staatscourant."Afstemming"
Artikel I, K and Artikel II, M (art. 214 Pensioenwet; art. 208 Wvb)
Responsibility for the five-yearly evaluation of the supervisor's effectiveness is placed with the minister rather than a separate body reporting to parliament."Verslag"

parties: Asks for a clear distinction between technical changes and small policy changes in omnibus bills, arguing this strengthens parliament's clarity and control function.
They note that in their view this strengthens the clarity and the controlling task of the Chamber.
Zij merken op dat dit volgens hen de duidelijkheid en de controlerende taak van de Kamer versterken.
Asks why the partner pension rule is not fixed in law and what happens if social partners miss the deadline, plus whether the measure covers divorces after pension start.
If so, is this a deliberate choice of the government, or an omission in the bill?
Zo ja, is dit een bewuste keuze van de regering, of een omissie in het wetsvoorstel?
Asks why the Inspectie SZW no longer supervises DNB and AFM and whether the government's reasoning holds that such oversight is unnecessary.
These members ask the government to explain further why it considers this supervision no longer necessary.
Deze leden vragen de regering om nader toe te lichten waarom zij van mening is dat dit toezicht niet langer nodig is.
Raises the risk that broadened ministerial powers over DNB and AFM lead to political interference in independent supervision, and asks whether the minister can intervene in specific cases.
They ask the government to address the possible risk that this could lead to political interference in independent supervision.
Zij vragen de regering om in te gaan op het eventuele risico dat dit zou leiden tot politieke inmenging van het onafhankelijk toezicht.
Asks why the term nettolijfrente is used instead of nettopensioen and how it is classified fiscally and as a labour condition, including whether pension funds may offer it.
The VVD members ask why the government chose the term nettolijfrente.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen waarom de regering heeft gekozen voor het begrip nettolijfrente.

Insists that second-pillar arrangements must be called pension in legal and fiscal terms and threatens a own amendment if the government does not change the terminology; also asks when the AMvB will arrive.
Finds the nota van wijziging far-reaching, requests that the Raad van State be asked for advice, notes the bill is largely delegated to an AMvB not yet available, and asks detailed legal questions.
They find this a rather far-reaching nota van wijziging and request that the government nevertheless ask the Council of State for advice.
Zij vinden dit een behoorlijk ingrijpende nota van wijziging en verzoeken de regering de Raad van State alsnog om een advies te vragen.
Asks whether the net annuity remains voluntary and whether the government can clarify the scheme's relationship to other reforms, probing the clarity of the rules.
Does the proposed amendment mean that the net annuity is a voluntary scheme both under the Pensions Act and under the Act on mandatory participation in an industry pension fund?
Betekent de nu voorgestelde wijziging dat de nettolijfrente voor zowel de pensioenwet als de Wet verplichte deelneming in een bedrijfstakpensioenfonds een vrijwillige regeling is?
Objects to regulating the new scheme in an AMvB with possibly large future effects, arguing Parliament cannot see the precise rules and that the Council of State was not consulted.
These members repeat that they find it inappropriate that the proposed new scheme, which could become large if a future government lowered the EUR 100,000 threshold, is laid down in an AMvB.

Deze leden herhalen dat zij het ongepast vinden dat de voorgestelde nieuwe regeling, die een forse omvang kan krijgen indien een volgende regering de € 100.000 grens zou verlagen, in een AMvB wordt vastgelegd
Asks whether the amended text effectively makes participation compulsory for high earners, contrary to the voluntary basis announced earlier, probing consistency with prior commitments to Parliament.
Participation in these net schemes for people with a pensionable salary above EUR 100,000 was indeed intended to be on a voluntary basis.
Deelname aan deze nettoregelingen voor mensen met een pensioengevend salaris boven € 100.000 werd immers beoogd op vrijwillige basis te geschieden

33872.s: The bill amends the Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht and several related environmental, nature, heritage and housing laws to require minimum quality, expertise and cooperation standards for permitting and enforcement, and to make regional environmental services (omgevingsdiensten) the standard vehicle for those tasks. It sets up framework rules by general administrative order and ministerial regulation, data-sharing duties with criminal enforcers, annual reporting and a five-year evaluation.
33872.j: The memorandum justifies delegation and new powers as necessary to close quality gaps and fragmentation in permitting and enforcement, and to make binding the agreements reached in the consultative body rather than leaving them voluntary.
q: The agreements made are too non-binding and, moreover, incomplete as regards the organisations that enter into them.
De afspraken die worden gemaakt, zijn te vrijblijvend en daarnaast onvolledig voor wat betreft de organisaties die ze aangaan.
d: quality and expertise standards for permitting and enforcement
further rules on quality standards, in agreement with other minister
strategic and coordinated enforcement and priority setting
research topics, methods and performance comparison of municipalities and provinces
designation of tasks to be carried out by omgevingsdiensten and their establishment and organisation
designation of further bodies obliged to share data and processing of personal data
minister may extend inspectors' competence outside their region for designated activities
cooperation rules between criminal investigators and administrative enforcement bodies under the Wet op de economische delicten
p: Artikel I, E (art. 5.4, lid 3) and Artikel I, E (art. 5.6)
The minister and provinces gain coordinating and supervisory roles over municipal enforcement, and binding priority-setting shifts discretion toward central and provincial executives.

Municipalities must assign listed tasks to a regional omgevingsdienst, and provinces may step in with interbestuurlijk toezicht if they refuse, shifting enforcement authority away from municipal councils to the executive bodies of the service.

Mayors and aldermen must report annually to the municipal council on cases where they deviated from proposed decisions of the omgevingsdienst, giving the council information about executive departures.
Authorities and enforcement bodies may share data, including personal data, with criminal enforcers, with processing rules set by general administrative order and some limits.
Inspectors of omgevingsdiensten may supervise outside their own region on the minister's designation, extending executive enforcement reach.
The minister must report to parliament within five years on the effectiveness and effects of the law.

parties: Asks whether the bill should wait for the RUD evaluation, how it relates to the Dijkstra motion against new intervention powers, and who holds final authority in the Bestuurlijk Omgevingsberaad.
Would it not be wise to postpone treatment of this bill until the evaluation of the RUDs can be taken into account?
Is het niet verstandig om behandeling van dit wetsvoorstel uit te stellen tot de evaluatie van de RUD’s kan worden meegenomen?
Supports a second pair of eyes and ministerial intervention power for BRZO enforcement after the Odfjell case, while noting the RUD evaluation motion should be respected.
Questions whether direct ministerial intervention power breaks the system and conflicts with horizontal supervision, and asks how democratic legitimacy and accountability of the services are secured.
After all, is it not the case that the responsible minister can already intervene through interadministrative supervision if the competent authority fails?
Is het immers niet zo dat de verantwoordelijke bewindspersoon al via interbestuurlijk toezicht kan ingrijpen als het bevoegd gezag faalt?
Worries about unclear responsibility and democratic legitimacy of the environmental services and that the bill overrides local decision-making, urging local authorities to find solutions first.
These members ask why the government is intervening in the operation of the law at the decentralised and local level, further sidelining the decentralised competent authority.
Deze leden vragen waarom de regering ingrijpt in de werking van de wet op decentraal en lokaal niveau, waardoor het decentrale bevoegde gezag verder buiten spel wordt gezet.
Asks why mandating rather than delegating tasks is chosen, how local authorities can meet their responsibilities, and how parliament and councils keep democratic control over the services.
In what way is it ensured that parliament and municipal councils retain democratic influence over the actions of the environmental services?
Op welke manier wordt gewaarborgd dat het parlement en de gemeenteraden democratische invloed houden op het handelen van de omgevingsdiensten?
Asks whether national enforcement priorities could gradually overwhelm local discretion and how councils can steer the services, and questions whether the bill is too top-down.
Is there not a risk that national priorities will gradually come to dominate?
Is niet het risico aanwezig dat geleidelijk de landelijke prioriteiten toch de overhand krijgen?
Has serious reservations that the bill insufficiently respects the autonomy of decentralised governments and the bottom-up approach, opposing top-down quality criteria and binding rules.
They believe the proposal insufficiently respects the autonomy of decentralised governments and the desired bottom-up approach.
Zij vinden dat het voorstel onvoldoende recht doet aan de autonomie van decentrale overheden en de gewenste bottom-up benadering

Fears national and regional enforcement priorities could let authorities refuse citizen enforcement requests and undermine the RvS duty-to-enforce case law, and raises ECHR and EU Charter concerns about rights of the accused and privacy.
Does the government share the view that a request for enforcement by a third-party stakeholder may not be brushed aside by the competent authority merely by referring to its priorities?
Deelt de regering de mening dat een verzoek om handhaving door een derde-belanghebbende niet door het bevoegd gezag mag worden weggehoond door slechts te verwijzen naar haar prioritering?
Asks whether the evaluation of omgevingsdiensten can be included and how serious the risk is that municipalities withdraw if the law is not delayed.
The VVD members note that the government does not want to wait for the evaluation of the environmental services to be completed before treating this law.
De leden van de VVD-fractie constateren dat de regering niet wil wachten met de behandeling van deze wet totdat de evaluatie van de omgevingsdiensten gereed is.
Asks for an analysis of advantages and disadvantages of network RUDs and whether quality criteria set by municipalities and provinces through ordinances can achieve the same as statutory rules.
These members ask whether it is actually possible to achieve the same objective or quality through an ordinance as would previously have been laid down in the bill.
Deze leden vragen of het wel mogelijk is om middels een verordening dezelfde doelstelling of kwaliteit te behalen als voorheen via het wetsvoorstel zou worden vastgelegd.
Considers the termination of network RUDs a one-sided decision and doubts that a non-binding model ordinance will secure quality criteria; asks for experimentation room.
A model ordinance is a good starting point, but it misses the mark when it is not imposed binding by the government.
Een modelverordening is een mooi uitgangspunt, maar slaat de plank mis wanneer deze niet dwingend door de regering wordt opgelegd.
Argues local authorities should keep room to organise network omgevingsdiensten if evaluation shows they function well, and questions the pre-judged dissolution in 2018.
These members are of the view that if there are no problems with the way the network environmental services function and enforce the norms, this organisational form should remain possible.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat als er geen problemen zijn met de wijze waarop de netwerkomgevingsdiensten functioneren en de normen handhaven, deze organisatievorm mogelijk moet blijven.
Believes the best organisational form should be sought rather than a standard one and asks why the government sets aside VNG criticism of the mandatory joint regulation.
These members strongly believe that the best organisational form should be sought, not a standard one.
Deze leden zijn sterk van mening dat gezocht moet worden naar de beste organisatievorm en niet naar een standaard organisatievorm.
Asks how the pre-set ending of network RUDs relates to the planned evaluation and whether the uncertain Omgevingswet start date creates insecurity.
These members ask how the already planned termination relates to the intention to still evaluate the RUDs.
Deze leden vragen hoe de nu al voorgenomen beëindiging zich verhoudt tot het voornemen om de RUD's nog te evalueren.
Welcomes the bottom-up adjustments but asks what happens if network organisations are judged equivalent and why they are not allowed to continue under quality conditions.
The whole starting point of establishing the environmental services is after all that they are shaped bottom-up.
Het hele uitgangspunt van de oprichting van de omgevingsdiensten is immers dat deze bottom-up worden vormgegeven.
Objects to the mandatory public body requirement for RUDs, which cuts across the bottom-up approach, and asks the government to drop it pending evaluation.
These members have great difficulty with this, given the desired bottom-up approach and the support for the mentioned network RUDs.
Deze leden hebben hier, gelet op de gewenste bottom-up benadering en het draagvlak voor de genoemde netwerk-RUD's, grote moeite mee.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill improving environmental permitting, supervision and enforcement by creating regional environmental service agencies (RUDs), raising serious concerns about the hybrid mandate structure, binding enforcement priorities, vertical supervision, data sharing and extensive delegation. The government's nader rapport replies that the package-deal agreements are secured in the bill and that it adopted several adjustments, while not following the main advice to abandon the mandate-based model.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that the obligatory mandate to regional service agencies conflicts with the Awb mandate rules and blurs the responsibilities of provinces and municipalities; the government kept the structure.
The Afdeling criticised the large number of delegation provisions and open-ended subdelegation to ministerial regulations; the government justified the levels and tightened some provisions.

The Afdeling found the broad information sharing insufficiently justified under article 8 ECHR and asked for a privacy impact assessment and narrower sharing; the government added a PIA and clarifications.
The Afdeling warned that binding enforcement priorities could undermine the duty to enforce established by case law; the government clarified the relation with regional priorities.
The Afdeling advised strengthening horizontal rather than vertical supervision; the government replaced the reporting duty with reporting to the municipal council or provincial states.
The Afdeling questioned the number of consultation obligations and annual review duties as burdensome; the government clarified and dropped some overlapping consultation provisions.

33917.s: The bill makes the Experimentenwet BI-zones permanent by allowing municipalities to levy a area-based business improvement levy (BIZ-bijdrage) on property owners and/or users within a designated business investment zone, after sufficient support among levy payers is shown. It also extends the levy to owners, raises the threshold for early termination to thirty percent, allows levy-funded activities online, and repeals the experimental law while preserving existing zones.
33917.j: The memorandum justifies the permanent scheme by pointing to the positive evaluation of the experiment and broad support from business and municipal representatives.
q: Municipalities are given the power to designate an area (business investment zone, BIZ) within which a earmarked levy (the BIZ levy) may be imposed
Gemeenten krijgen met deze wet de bevoegdheid om een gebied aan te wijzen (Bedrijveninvesteringszone, BIZ) waarbinnen een bestemmingsheffing (de BIZ-bijdrage) mag worden geheven
d: municipal ordinance determining who pays the BIZ levy (owners, users, or both)
setting differentiated levy rates by category, location and sector
municipal rules on conditions and manner of subsidy to the designated association or foundation
p: Levy payers are polled on support by the municipal executive, with a support threshold determining whether the municipal ordinance takes effect.
The levy proceeds are channelled as subsidy to a private association or foundation designated by ordinance, which carries out the activities with limited public accountability to levy payers.

parties: Worries that municipalities may shift public-space tasks onto BIZ-levied businesses while they keep paying general taxes, and asks for safeguards and a list of tasks.
According to these members it must not be the case that a BIZ invests in street furniture, public greenery, etc. and that municipal attention to the public space in that area then slackens.
Volgens deze leden mag het niet zo zijn dat een BIZ investeert in straatmeubilair, openbaar groen, etc. en dat vervolgens de gemeentelijke aandacht voor de openbare ruimte in dat gebied verslapt.

Questions the confidentiality of objections to the BIZ ordinance, the unclear definition of a coherent area, and municipal power to withdraw ordinances without support, raising municipal autonomy issues.
Asks whether businesses in financial difficulty can obtain exemption or remission of the levy.
Is there a possibility of remission of the levy when an entrepreneur can demonstrate being in financial difficulty?
Bestaat er een mogelijkheid tot kwijtschelding van de heffing wanneer een ondernemer kan aantonen dat men in financiële problemen zit?
Asks how municipal tasks will be prevented from being shifted onto entrepreneurs given the broad definition of activities, and questions the draagvlak thresholds.
Do municipalities not get too much freedom through the broad definition to charge any costs to the entrepreneurs?
Krijgen gemeenten door de brede definitie niet teveel vrijheid om welke kosten dan ook in rekening te brengen bij de ondernemers?
Warns against compulsory participation and semi-public organisations with collective binding character, and opposes raising the threshold for early termination of a BIZ.
Can the government explain this raising of the threshold further and also pay attention to the possible adverse consequences of this increase?
Kan de regering deze verhoging van de drempel nader toelichten en daarbij ook aandacht willen schenken aan de mogelijke nadelige gevolgen van deze verhoging?
Asks that non-commercial owners and users of buildings such as schools, churches and hospitals be exempted from the levy, and that general city-promotion activities not be financed by the levy.
Does the government think non-commercial users and owners of such buildings should nonetheless be levied for a BIZ contribution?
Vindt de regering dat niet-commerciële gebruikers en eigenaren van dergelijke panden desondanks toch aangeslagen moeten kunnen worden voor een BIZ-bijdrage?

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised on a bill making business investment zones (BIZ) permanent, raising concerns about lowered support thresholds on renewal, the mandatory withdrawal of levy ordinances, the notion of public space including the internet, double levies on owner-users, and state aid under the Pearle case. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted or adapted most points, deleting the lowered thresholds, making withdrawal discretionary, and clarifying the state aid analysis.
concerns: Lowering the support thresholds for renewal of a BIZ was insufficiently justified and was removed from the bill.
The mandatory duty for municipal councils to withdraw the levy ordinance restricted their policy discretion and was changed to a duty to decide promptly.
Extending the notion of public space to the internet was not shown to be necessary and was to be handled differently.
Levying BIZ contributions on owner-users cumulatively was not justified and the reply explained why owners can now be included.
Whether the BIZ subsidy constitutes state aid under the Pearle criteria was insufficiently analysed; the reply expanded the analysis without changing its view.
Several redactional suggestions on terminology and cross-references were adopted.

33930-X.s: This bill amends the 2013 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence and the 2013 budget statements of three defence operating agencies (DTO, DVD, Paresto), chiefly by reallocating appropriations across defence articles. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Thus it is that We, in common consultation with the States General, have deemed fit and resolved, as We hereby deem fit and resolve
Zo is het, dat Wij, met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze

33935.s: The bill creates a temporary deelfonds sociaal domein, a special municipal fund of earmarked grants for social domain tasks (youth, social support, participation), paid from the municipal fund budget and expiring after three years. It also allows ministers to suspend payments to municipalities that do not comply with binding ministerial directions and repeals the Wet participatiebudget.
33935.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial directive and suspension powers by the complexity and large impact of the social domain decentralisations, and the amvb by the need for adequate allocation rules.
q: The government therefore chose to build in an extra safeguard in the form of a directive power for the responsible Minister to ensure proper implementation.
Daarom heeft de regering ervoor gekozen een extra waarborg in te bouwen in de vorm van een aanwijzingsbevoegdheid voor de verantwoordelijke Minister om een goede uitvoering te borgen.
d: calculation rules for the deelfonds grant
ministers fix annual grant amounts per municipality
p: Ministers may suspend up to 26 weeks of payments to a municipality for non-compliance with a ministerial directive, with a municipal request for reversal decided within two weeks.
The grant is placed in the municipal fund budget as an obligation paid outside the general grant, with allocation criteria left to a general administrative order.

parties: Supports decentralisation and free municipal spending, but asks the government to respond to the Court of Audit's view that the three-year period is too long.
The VVD members ask the government to respond to the Court of Audit's remark that the three-year period for the social sub-fund is too long.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering in te gaan op de opmerking van de Algemene Rekenkamer, die stelt dat de termijn van drie jaar voor het sociaal deelfonds te lang is.
Asks which tasks fall within the social domain and warns that monitoring should focus on outcomes and not penalise well-performing municipalities.
According to the PvdA members, the performance of municipalities, not the spending of funds, should be central.
Niet het besteden van de middelen, maar de prestaties van gemeenten moeten wat de leden van de PvdA-fractie betreft centraal staan.
Questions the three-year limit and the absence of accountability from municipalities to the national government, fearing funds will be diverted elsewhere.
The government chooses that municipalities do not account to the national government for the spending of funds.
De regering kiest ervoor dat er geen verantwoording plaats vindt van gemeenten aan het Rijk over de besteding van de middelen.
Asks how national supervision and corrective steps fit with municipal policy freedom, and raises the Court of Audit's concerns about legality checks and the Advisory Council's view on performance.
These members endorse the principle that control over spending from the social sub-fund should be carried out by the municipalities themselves.
Deze leden onderschrijven het uitgangspunt, dat de controle op de besteding van de middelen uit het deelfonds sociaal domein behoort te geschieden door gemeenten zelf.
Questions how the minister can account to parliament for correct spending when legality control is only local, and asks why a formal spending obligation is needed.
Since the government writes that legality control takes place only at local level, the D66 members ask how the government intends to meet its accountability duty to the States General.

Aangezien de regering in het nader rapport schrijft dat de controle van de rechtmatigheid uitsluitend op lokaal niveau plaatsvindt, vragen de leden van de D66-fractie op welke wijze de regering aan deze verantwoordingsplicht jegens de Staten-Generaal denkt te kunnen voldoen.
Asks for justification of the departure from the Financial Relations Act, the effectiveness of the suspension sanction, and whether the Court of Audit was consulted under the Comptability Act.
These members ask for justification of the effectiveness and usefulness of this sanction.
Deze leden vragen naar een onderbouwing van de effectiviteit en bruikbaarheid van deze sanctie.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the aim of the Temporary Social Domain Sub-fund Act but raises concerns about its effectiveness and sunset clause, the demarcation of social-domain spending, Court of Audit oversight, and suspension powers, and advises revision. The minister's reply accepts most points by clarifying the explanatory memorandum, adding a reserve provision and an assessment for the Youth Act, and rejects the advice on removing the transitional Article 7 and on the need for an intermediate fund structure.
concerns: The Council doubts that a spending obligation guarantees successful implementation; the minister agrees in principle and clarifies the rationale in the memorandum while stressing local quality.
The explanatory memorandum's wording on the three-year term should be aligned with the sunset clause in Article 9; the memorandum was adjusted.
Scope of the social domain is hard to demarcate in an integrated approach; the minister keeps existing funds outside the obligation and clarifies the demarcation in the memorandum.

Court of Audit and accountability lack explanation of how the Court can exercise control under a deviating financing regime; the minister points to local audit, IV-3 information and the amended Article 5.

The suspension power has no clear necessity given the existing specific-grant and neglect-of-duty rules; the minister justifies it as a sanction backing the ministerial instruction power and clarifies the memorandum.
Article 6 should be supplemented to cover the Youth Act instruction power and other redactional points; these were incorporated, except that Article 7 was kept rather than removed.

33944.s: The bill amends the Dutch Vreemdelingenwet 2000 to replace the three-month period for short-stay residence with 90 days, aligning it with EU Regulation 610/2013 on the Schengen visa code. It also allows residence permits for temporary stay to be used for multiple entries and changes the cap on certain residence periods to 180 days.
33944.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary to implement EU Regulation 610/2013 and to avoid discrepancies with the EU's competence over short-stay access, rather than delegating new powers.
q: In this case, to prevent possible discrepancies in the interpretation of the legal rules, it was chosen to align as closely as possible with the wording and time limits used in the Regulation, hence day-based designations.

In dit geval is er, om mogelijke discrepanties in de uitlegging van de wettelijke regels te voorkomen, voor gekozen om zoveel mogelijk aan te sluiten bij de bewoordingen en termijnen zoals die in de Verordening worden gebruikt, derhalve aanduidingen in dagen.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division supports the bill implementing EU Regulation 610/2013 (90 days in 180) and changing the mvv from single to multiple entry, but asks the explanatory memorandum to clarify that the change concerns repeated travel in and out of the Schengen area and to explain why multiple entry is granted. The government's reply reports that both points were followed and the memorandum was amended, plus a drafting correction.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should clarify that the proposed change concerns the possibility of entering and leaving the Schengen area multiple times.
The explanatory memorandum should explain clearly why the mvv is given multiple-entry character, given the single-entry standard of the Visa Code.
The preamble reference to Regulation 265/2010 should be removed because the bill does not implement that regulation.

33962.s: The bill establishes the Omgevingswet (Environment and Planning Act), consolidating dozens of Dutch laws on the physical living environment into one framework with six core instruments: environmental visions, programmes, general rules on activities, environmental values, a single environmental permit, and the project decision. It sets the division of tasks among national, provincial, water-board and municipal authorities and provides for delegated rule-making, instructions between government levels, and enforcement tools.
33962.j: The memorandum justifies broad delegation as necessary for flexibility, integrated decision-making and tailoring to local conditions, while keeping equivalent protection of health, safety and environmental quality.
q: The bill provides an integrated framework for site-specific activities of citizens, businesses and governments in the physical living environment.
Het wetsvoorstel voorziet in een integraal kader voor plaatsgebonden activiteiten van burgers, bedrijven en overheden in de fysieke leefomgeving.
d: municipal and provincial environment plans and bylaws, with delegation to executive bodies
exclusion of certain environmental rules from mandatory plan/bylaw inclusion
national instruction rules to lower government bodies
ministerial instructions to provincial, municipal and water-board authorities
general rules on building, pollution, discharge, water abstraction, mining and other activities
priority order for water scarcity allocation
p: National and provincial governments may instruct lower authorities on how to exercise their tasks and powers, shifting decision-making away from municipalities and water boards.
Competent authorities may set site-specific rules that deviate from general rules, widening administrative discretion.
The minister may restrict or prohibit access to state waterworks and roads by publication.

parties: Supports faster, simpler procedures but asks whether the four AMvB implementing decrees can go through a pre-consultation procedure with the Tweede Kamer.
Nevertheless, these members ask whether it is possible to submit the AMvB's to the Tweede Kamer under a pre-consultation (voorhang) procedure.
Desalniettemin vragen deze leden of het mogelijk is om de AMvB’s in een voorhangprocedure voor te leggen aan de Tweede Kamer.
Welcomes integration and flexibility but warns it must not undermine legal certainty, citizens' protection, and the role of parliament, since key rules sit in AMvB's.
By placing the implementing rules in AMvB's, the bill does insufficient justice to the role of parliament, these members believe.
Door de uitvoeringsregels in AMvB’s op te nemen doet het wetsvoorstel onvoldoende recht aan de rol van het parlement, zo menen deze leden.
Asks that draft AMvB's be submitted to the Kamer now, since the material law will largely be in implementing regulations.
Therefore these members believe it is necessary to submit the draft AMvB's to the Kamer now.
Daarom menen deze leden dat het noodzakelijk is de ontwerpAMvB’s nu aan de Kamer voor te leggen.
Fears that flexibility and decentralisation will weaken nature and environmental protection down to the European minimum, and questions how EU norms will be monitored under decentral decision-making.
How is meeting EU directives monitored?
Hoe wordt het halen van EU-richtlijnen gemonitord?
Says the bill is framed around administrators' needs and the position of citizens is secondary; asks for definitions and a transposition table.
In these members' view, the present proposal has mainly been based on the needs of administrators, and the position of citizens seems of secondary importance.
Naar mening van deze leden is met voorliggend voorstel vooral uitgegaan vanuit de behoefte(n) van bestuurders en lijkt de positie van burgers van ondergeschikt belang.
Asks why the preparatory decision period is extended to two years and whether anyone anywhere may file objections, raising administrative burden and legal certainty questions.
That means a certain location or area is locked for two years and someone is uncertain for two years about what will happen.
Dat betekent dat een bepaalde locatie of gebied twee jaar op slot zit en iemand twee jaar in onzekerheid zit over wat er gaat gebeuren.
Wants a broader, more ambitious purpose and tighter experimentation rules with monitoring and evaluation, and a uniform legal protection regime for responses to notifications.

To genuinely give effect to achieving and maintaining a safe and healthy physical living environment and good environmental quality, these members consider tightening the experimentation provision necessary.

Om daadwerkelijk recht te doen aan het bereiken en in stand houden van een veilige en gezonde fysieke leefomgeving en een goede omgevingskwaliteit, achten deze leden aanscherping van de experimenteerbepaling noodzakelijk.
Worries about unclear monitoring, sanctions and citizen recourse for environmental values, and about broad discretion through instruction rules and experimentation without limits.
These members lack any form of limitation, and moreover the effect of measures under the Environment Act cannot be overseen at all without the promised AMvBs.
Deze leden missen enige vorm van begrenzing daarnaast is de doorwerking van maatregelen vanuit de Omgevingswet absoluut niet te overzien zonder de beloofde AMvB’s.
Prefers norms set by statute rather than AMvB, argues for clear legal limits on deviation and experimentation with procedural safeguards, and questions the court's ability to review vague norms.
The proposed larger role for the House in setting norms through AMvBs and ministerial regulations does not yet give the House the role parliament should have as a genuine co-legislator.
De voorgestane grotere rol voor de Kamer bij de normstelling bij AMvB’s en ministeriële regelingen geeft de Kamer nog niet de rol die het parlement heeft als echte medewetgever.

Requests a heavy pre-consultation procedure for AMvBs, concern that broad purposes give weak direction, and that many deviation options weaken judicial control and legal certainty; questions two-tier appeal delays.
In these members' view the House must also be enabled to take stock of this balance in the interim.
Naar de mening van deze leden moet de Kamer ook in staat worden gesteld om tussentijds deze balans op te maken.
Notes weakened parliamentary involvement compared with the current verzwaarde voorhang procedure for environmental quality standards and asks whether it will be restored.
The members point out that the level of parliamentary involvement is in fact weakened in parts under the new legal regime.
De leden wijzen erop dat het niveau van parlementaire betrokkenheid op onderdelen juist wordt verzwakt onder het nieuwe rechtsregime.
Asks whether experimental deviations can always be reviewed and whether cumulative flexibility harms environmental protection and legal certainty.
Said members ask whether the government is willing to conduct such research in any case.
Genoemde leden vragen of de regering bereid is dergelijk onderzoek sowieso te doen.
Asks whether removing the delegation decision from the environmental plan means less separate appeal rights than under the current Wet ruimtelijke ordening.

Is the assumption correct that no separate appeal lies against the proposed delegation decision, so that the underlying decision can only be challenged once the delegation power is applied, and that there is therefore less legal protection than in the current situation?

Is de veronderstelling juist dat tegen het voorgestelde delegatiebesluit geen afzonderlijk beroep openstaat, dat pas bij toepassing van de delegatiebevoegdheid in de praktijk het achterliggende besluit aangevochten kan worden en dat derhalve sprake is van minder rechtsbescherming ten opzichte van de huidige situatie (Wet ruimtelijke ordening)?

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory opinion of 13 January 2014 on the draft Omgevingswet (Environment and Planning Act) finds the bill too broad, with few material norms in the statute, wide delegation and flexibility that threaten legal certainty and parliament's role, and unclear allocation of powers across government levels. The government's reply of 16 June 2014 accepts many points, strengthening parliamentary involvement, specifying delegation grounds, clarifying the experimentation clause, and unifying appeal rules.
concerns: Material norms and fundamental safeguards should be laid down in the statute rather than delegated to lower regulations; the reply adds specific delegation grounds and a pre-hearing procedure but keeps much detail in implementing regulations.
Parliament's co-legislative role is insufficiently respected; the reply introduces a voorhangprocedure and parliamentary control over key elements, though the bulk of norms remains in amvb's.
Broad flexibility and deviation instruments threaten predictability; the reply limits the experimentation clause and equivalence rules but retains broad deviation possibilities.
Legal protection must match the existing level, with enforcement and appeal rules in the statute; the reply unifies appeal regimes and adds suspension rules for permits.
Unclear allocation of powers among municipalities, provinces, water boards and the Rijk; the reply adds subsidiarity provisions but the final distribution depends on implementing regulations.
Lex silencio positivo was questioned; the reply removes it, but the reply does not fully address the request to justify breadth of deviation powers.

33971.s: The bill requires school boards to register in the national education number register (BRON) whether a pupil has an individual development plan and its start and end dates, and requires expertise centres and epilepsy schools to report pupils they support. It amends the Primary Education Act, the Secondary Education Act, the Expertise Centres Act and the Education Inspection Act to make this data available to the Minister and the Inspectorate for supervision after the leerlinggebonden financiering was abolished.
33971.j: The memorandum justifies the new registration duties by the need for the Inspectorate and the Minister to supervise and evaluate passend onderwijs, and argues that the sensitive data processing is necessary for a weighty public interest with safeguards.
q: From the Minister of Education's stewardship responsibility, it is important to gain insight into which pupils in the passend onderwijs system receive extra support.

Het is vanuit de stelselverantwoordelijkheid van de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap van belang om inzicht te krijgen in welke leerlingen in het stelsel passend onderwijs extra ondersteuning krijgen.

parties: Asks for a weighing of pragmatic benefits against the principled question of how much data government should register, store and use, and what it means for pupils and parents.
Supports registration as data needed to follow progress and quality of passend onderwijs and to adjust its implementation where necessary.
These members are of the view that this can only be done if data are available, and this bill provides for that.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat dit alleen kan als er gegevens beschikbaar zijn, en dit wetsvoorstel voorziet daarin.

Questions how quantitative registration lets the inspectorate judge whether schools provide needed support, whether it fits with registering only the existence of a perspective, and how anonymisation works given identifying data are transmitted.
To what extent can there still be talk of supplying fully anonymised or aggregated data, ask these members.
In hoeverre kan er dan nog sprake zijn van het aanleveren van volledige geanonimiseerde of geaggregeerde gegevens, zo vragen deze leden.

Accepts the registration as proportionate to privacy interests, but questions whether a registration obligation is justified since it yields no meaningful national picture of the support given, and asks how it fits the government's aim to reduce regulatory burden.
Can the government explain why there should be a registration obligation, even though this does not lead to a national picture?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom er sprake zou moeten zijn van een registratieverplichting, ondanks dat dit niet leidt tot een landelijk beeld?
Asks why schools must indicate which pupils receive extra support rather than only how many, raising privacy questions, and asks how the quality score is determined and used.
Can the government explain why it is necessary for schools to indicate which pupils receive extra support?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom het noodzakelijk is voor scholen om aan te geven welke leerlingen extra ondersteuning krijgen?

Questions whether the bill serves genuine educational benefit or mainly central government information needs and control, and asks for scientific justification of the quantitative inspection method given the wide variety in development perspectives.

Asks why person-specific registration of sensitive health-related data is necessary for supervision, monitoring and evaluation when anonymised and aggregated data would suffice, and whether parents can correct or refuse registration.
Can the government substantiate why person-specific registration is necessary for supervision, monitoring and evaluation?
Kan de regering onderbouwen waarom voor toezicht, monitoring en evaluatie persoonsspecifieke registratie nodig is?

33980.s: The bill amends the Wet marktordening gezondheidszorg, Zorgverzekeringswet and AWBZ to strengthen audit, control, and enforcement in the healthcare sector, notably by expanding insurers' access to patient health data for material and fraud checks. It also lets the Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit publish enforcement decisions, adds seizure and sealing powers, and extends data-sharing with investigative bodies.
33980.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the need to fight healthcare fraud and misuse, stressing that the private system's primary responsibility lies with insurers and providers, and cites safeguards such as the Cbp advice, proportionality and subsidiarity rules.
q: The present bill provides in the WMG that a healthcare provider must also, in the case of reimbursement, provide personal data and diagnostic information to the health insurer.
Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel legt in de WMG neer dat een zorgaanbieder ook in geval van restitutie persoonsgegevens en diagnose-informatie moet verstrekken aan de ziektekostenverzekeraar.
d: Artikel I, B (art. 7 WMG, new 2nd para.)
minister may direct the zorgautoriteit to report on implementation of its designations
categories of personal data the zorgautoriteit may process and share
zorgautoriteit may publish designations and sanctions, with exception from hearing rights in urgent cases
content and format of the zorgautoriteit's annual compliance report
zorgautoriteit may set rules on tariffs and limits for healthcare providers, with deviation permitted in set cases
zorgautoriteit-prescribed audits requiring disclosure of medical and criminal personal data
zorgautoriteit may set rules on insurer overviews of claims and payments to insured persons
zorgautoriteit may set further rules implementing ministerial regulation on material checks
Artikel I, W (art. 68a, 3rd and 5th para. WMG)
phases and safeguards of material checks including detailcontrole
phases and safeguards of material checks under the Zvw
zorgautoriteit may set further rules implementing the Zvw ministerial regulation
phases and safeguards of material checks under the AWBZ
zorgautoriteit may set further rules implementing the AWBZ ministerial regulation
p: The zorgautoriteit may publicly name providers and insurers subject to designations or sanctions, with a short notice period and a court-stay procedure, limiting targets' prior hearing rights in urgent cases.
Artikel I, L/M and Artikel I, W (art. 36, 68a, 68d WMG; 87 Zvw; 53 AWBZ)

Insurers and designated persons may access patients' medical and criminal personal data for material checks and fraud investigation, with the medical confidentiality duty overridden and proportionality and subsidiarity limits left to ministerial and zorgautoriteit rules.
Enforcement powers are extended to include sealing of business premises, orders backed by penalty payments, and administrative fines, including for refusing cooperation with supervision.
Personal, medical and criminal data may be shared more widely among the zorgautoriteit, tax authority, police, investigative services and the Openbaar Ministerie.

parties: Asks whether the bill narrows experimentation room for care providers, the role of the Inspectie SZW, and whether oversight and enforcement are equal in curative and long-term care.
Is the room to experiment in the various care acts, aimed at scrapping superfluous rules and preventing unnecessarily high care costs, reduced by this bill?
Wordt de ruimte om te experimenteren in de verschillende zorgwetten, met het doel overbodige regels te schrappen en onnodig hoge zorgkosten te voorkomen, met voorliggend wetsvoorstel verkleind?
Asks how the NZa is held to account for enforcement against insurers and how inefficient declarations and complaints are addressed.
How does the government keep a close watch on the actions and inaction of the healthcare authority in this area?
Op welke wijze houdt de regering rondom het doen en laten van de zorgautoriteit in dezen de vinger aan de pols.
Opposes lifting medical confidentiality for fraud detection, fearing mass access to patient data without independent authorization or legal protection for patients.
They see lifting medical confidentiality as an impermissible way to detect fraud.+
Het lichten van het medisch beroepsgeheim zien zij als een ongeoorloofde manier om fraude op te sporen.
Questions the necessity and proportionality of breaching medical confidentiality, the lack of safeguards in the law, and weak protection for the insured person.
The present bill reflects a fundamentally different view of the importance of access to healthcare and thereby breaks with the past.+
Het voorliggende wetsvoorstel geeft blijk van een wezenlijk andere kijk op het belang van toegang tot de gezondheidszorg en breekt daarmee met het verleden.
Opposes breaching medical confidentiality for financial interests and fears misuse of medical data by insurers and inspectors.
Medical confidentiality may not be breached for financial interests such as detecting fraud or in the context of the insurer's damage assessment.+
Het medisch beroepsgeheim mag niet doorbroken worden vanwege financiële belangen zoals het opsporen van fraude of in het kader van de schadebepaling van de zorgverzekeraar.
Supports stronger fraud tools for supervisors and insurers but accepts privacy restrictions only under strict conditions, and asks about notification, consent and patient information.
They note that the proposed measures may restrict patient privacy and consider this acceptable only under very strict conditions.+
Zij stellen wel vast dat de voorliggende maatregelen een inperking op de privacy van de patiënt kunnen vormen, en achten dit alleen onder zeer strikte voorwaarden acceptabel.
Asks whether incorrect declarations stem from complex financing rules rather than fraud, and how patients are made aware of reporting options and the NZa's enforcement powers.
These members ask whether the government acknowledges that incorrect billing in many cases is not deliberate fraud but due to unclear or unknown complex financing rules.+

Deze leden vragen de regering of zij erkent dat het onjuist declareren in heel veel gevallen geen bewuste fraude betreft, maar te wijten is aan de onduidelijkheid van en/of onbekendheid met de complexe financieringsregels.

Asks how patients will be informed after insurers review their files, whether the NZa keeps data on how often insurers view medical records, and how preventive agreements after recovery of claims work.
Does the government consider it desirable for the NZa to keep track of this going forward, to gain more insight?
Acht de regering het een wenselijk voornemen om dit in het vervolg wel te laten bijhouden door de NZa, om zo te komen tot meer inzicht hierover?

Insists medical confidentiality must not be breached for fraud detection, warns insurers could use medical details for risk selection, and asks for unanswered information such as case examples and meeting reports.
Medical confidentiality is the basis for the trust the patient places in their treating professional.
Het medisch beroepsgeheim is de basis voor het vertrouwen dat de patiënt stelt in zijn of haar behandelaar.
Asks why articles 78a, 84a and 90 of the Wmg are not being removed after all and which information obligations for providers remain.
Can the government indicate which information obligation for healthcare providers remains as a result?
Kan de regering aangeven welke informatieverplichting voor zorgaanbieders hiermee blijft bestaan?

Questions the broad discretion of the NZa to publish sanctions and enforcement decisions, the five-day publication term, the lack of safeguards on data use, and the need for medical-adviser control and proportionality, including past improper data sharing by the NZa.
The right to respect for private life outweighs the need for flexibility in combating fraud?
Het recht op eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer zwaarder weegt dan de behoefte aan flexibiliteit in het kader van fraude bestrijding?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending the Wet marktordening gezondheidszorg to tackle healthcare fraud by expanding medical data sharing between providers, insurers, the Nza and enforcement bodies, raising privacy concerns and asking for statutory safeguards, a GGZ exception and clearer insured-person responsibility. The government's nader rapport accepted most safeguards in the law and explanatory memorandum, but rejected the advice to limit detailed-check outputs to the medical adviser's conclusion.
concerns: Expanded sharing of health data is a serious privacy intrusion that requires statutory safeguards, including phased checks, proportionality, medical adviser oversight and retention limits, which the government largely incorporated.
The Afdeling advised limiting the medical adviser's output to the conclusion of the material check, which the government declined because insurers need the reasoning to contest tariffs.
The GGZ diagnosis-disclosure obligation must allow an exception for self-payers and patients objecting on privacy grounds, following CBb case law, which the government accepted via a new procedure.

Rules on which information authorities may receive, for what purpose, should be set in the law rather than left to ministerial or Nza regulation, which the government addressed by amending the explanatory memorandum.
The explanatory memorandum should explain how insured persons are informed about data sharing and how they are encouraged to check declarations, which the government addressed.
Redactional points on the wording of several articles and cross-references to other bills were to be addressed.

34085-V.s: This bill amends the 2014 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by adjusting appropriations and obligations across policy and non-policy articles, effective from 1 December of the budget year. The explanatory memorandum explains the significant variances against the first supplementary budget, citing local staff costs, honorary consulate expenditure and lower IT and housing investment.
34085-V.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to the Rijksbegrotingsvoorschriften and the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, which require explanation of significant variances.
q: In accordance with the Rijksbegrotingsvoorschriften and the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, the notable differences between the original and current estimates must be explained.
Conform de Rijksbegrotingsvoorschriften en de Comptabiliteitswet van 2001 dienen de opmerkelijke verschillen tussen de oorspronkelijke en huidige raming te worden toegelicht.

34088.s: The bill amends the Vreemdelingenwet 2000 to implement EU Directives 2013/32/EU (asylum procedures) and 2013/33/EU (reception conditions), adding new grounds for declaring asylum applications inadmissible, manifestly unfounded, or not processed, plus a border procedure and a border-detention option. It also reshapes judicial review (full ex nunc review, suspensive effect rules, a fixed four-week decision deadline in the algemene asielprocedure) and extends detention and procedure durations.
34088.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as required to implement the EU directives and to allow effective, efficient asylum procedures and clearer legal protection.
q: The bill contains a special arrangement to treat the appeal against refusal of entry together with the appeal against the detention measure.
Het wetsvoorstel bevat hiertoe een bijzondere regeling, waarin tevens is voorzien in het behandelen van het beroep inzake de toegangsweigering.
d: further rules on residence obligation at border location
Artikel I, I (art. 30 lid 3, art. 30a lid 3, art. 30b lid 2, art. 30c lid 4 Vw 2000)
further rules on inadmissibility, manifestly unfounded and not-processed grounds
rules on assessment of asylum applications
extension of decision deadlines in asylum procedure
extension of decision period for specific categories of applicants
rules on right to remain pending interim relief request
p: Gives the Minister power to declare asylum applications inadmissible, manifestly unfounded or not processed, with suspensive effect of appeal removed for such decisions.
Allows the Minister to detain lawfully staying asylum seekers for risk of absconding, with detention possibly extended up to nine months.
Sets fixed short decision deadlines for courts in certain asylum appeals while requiring full ex nunc review of facts and law.
Shortens the appeal period to one week for applications declared inadmissible, not processed, manifestly unfounded or not handled within time limits.
Deems an appeal against a detention measure to include an appeal against the underlying refusal of entry where within 28 days, limiting separate challenge.

parties: Asks whether the government goes beyond what the EU directives strictly require and what the consequences of inadmissibility and manifest-unfoundedness grounds are.
Are there points in implementing these two EU directives where the government goes further in adjusting laws, procedures or implementation than the directives strictly require?

Zijn er bij de implementatie van deze twee EU-richtlijnen punten waarop de regering verder gaat in de aanpassing van wet- en regelgeving, procedures of uitvoering dan waar deze EU-richtlijnen strikt genomen toe nopen?
Welcomes the full ex nunc judicial review of asylum decisions and asks for guidance so the courts can review facts intensively.
They are particularly pleased with the expansion of legal protection for asylum seekers through a full and ex nunc review by the judge of asylum decisions.
Zij zijn met name verheugd over het uitbreiden van de rechtsbescherming van asielzoekers, in de vorm van een volledige en ex nunc beoordeling door de rechter van de asielbesluiten.
Welcomes abandoning the positive-conviction test but questions subjective criteria such as 'manifestly' inconsistent statements and the vague 'bad faith' ground, and asks who decides.
Can the government indicate who decides when this is 'reasonably' the case and on the basis of which objective criteria this is determined?
Kan de regering aangeven wie nu bepaalt wanneer dit «in redelijkheid» het geval is en aan de hand van welke objectieve criteria dit wordt bepaald?
Worries that a full ex nunc review makes courts redo the IND's work, raising constitutional tensions between executive and judiciary and a 25% workload increase for courts.

This raises questions not only about the constitutional relationship between decisions taken by the IND on behalf of the Minister of Security and Justice and the judiciary, but also about practical problems.

Dit roept niet alleen vragen op ten aanzien van de staatsrechtelijke verhoudingen tussen door de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND) namens de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie genomen beslissingen enerzijds en de rechterlijke macht anderzijds
Opposes EU involvement and argues that suspensive effect and ex nunc review loosen asylum policy; also says the judge risks sitting in the executive's seat.
They note that with the introduction of a full and ex nunc review the judge will sit too much in the seat of the executive.
Zij merken op dat met de invoering van een volledig en ex nunc onderzoek de rechter teveel op de stoel van het bestuur gaat zitten.
Sees the bill as improving legal protection of asylum applicants and asks for codification of ECHR case law allowing exceptions to inadmissibility.
Further codification of this case law is desirable.
Een verder codificatie van deze jurisprudentie is wenselijk.
Welcomes full judicial review of the asylum account but is concerned that the inadmissibility and manifest-unfoundedness grounds are vague and insufficiently specified.

The ChristenUnie members are considerably concerned that the grounds on which a case can be declared inadmissible or manifestly unfounded are being substantially changed while the proposed grounds are insufficiently worked out.

Het baart de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie de nodige zorgen dat de gronden waarop een zaak niet-ontvankelijk of kennelijk ongegrond kan worden verklaard aanzienlijk worden gewijzigd terwijl de voorgenomen gronden onvoldoende zijn uitgewerkt.
Asks why certain inadmissibility grounds are not imperative and whether the wording creates unnecessary complexity and legal risk under the directive.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill implementing the revised Asylum Procedures and Reception Conditions Directives but raises objections on integrated credibility assessment, full ex nunc review, transitional law, rejection grounds, detention and public order, return postponement, detention review, information access, unaccompanied minors, language regime and transposition tables, advising revision. The government's nader rapport accepts most points, changing the bill on rejection grounds, detention review, information access, the transposition table and transitional law, while maintaining the new credibility assessment and full review.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for clarification of how the integrated credibility assessment differs from the abolished positive persuasive force doctrine and how it relates to judicial review; the government clarified the text but kept the new approach.

Transitional law applying full ex nunc review immediately to old decisions risks annulments; the Afdeling advises deleting the sentence, and the government narrowed the exception for cases already heard or closed.
Mandatory wording of inadmissibility grounds does not allow exceptions required by the Bahaddar case law of the ECtHR; the Afdeling advises facultative wording, which the government adopted.
