Detention on public order grounds needs the distinct meaning from the reception directive to be visible in the text; the government added a reference to the Reception Directive.
The bill's wording of 'louter' for postponing return needs concrete examples and clarification of how the motive is established.
The qualifier 'in redelijkheid' in the review of detention decisions is inconsistent with the Mahdi judgment's full review; the government removed it.
Access to country information is factual conduct that interferes with rights and must be regulated by law; the government will add a provision in the Vb 2000.
Safeguards for unaccompanied minors under Article 25(6) of the Procedures Directive are unclear regarding implementation; the government responded by adding a regulatory guarantee.
The language regime at hearings may change practice in ways the explanatory memorandum does not explain; the government kept the directive wording and clarified the memorandum.
Transposition tables are imprecise, not split by paragraph and sometimes inconsistent with the bill; the government revised the tables and memorandum.

Full ex nunc review and the new credibility assessment greatly increase the workload of courts and the Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak; the government is consulting the ABRvS but did not address workload through changes to the bill.

34097.s: The bill amends Book 3 and Book 10 of the Civil Code, the Code of Civil Procedure and the Cultural Heritage Protection Act to implement EU Directive 2014/60/EU on the return of cultural objects unlawfully removed from a member state's territory. Key changes update article references, extend the claim period from one year to three years, and adjust the due-diligence factors for good-faith acquirers.
34097.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary to implement the EU directive, without delegating new powers to the executive.
q: To this end, the Internal Market Information System (IMI) will be used to facilitate exchanges between central authorities of member states.
Hiertoe wordt het informatiesysteem interne markt (IMI) ingezet dat de uitwisseling tussen centrale autoriteiten van lidstaten zal vergemakkelijken.

parties: Asks about the direct consequences of the directive, which national body would carry out return actions, costs, and whether non-EU states can invoke it.
They see the added value of Directive 2014/60/EU (hereafter: the Directive) underlying this implementation act.
Zij zien de toegevoegde waarde van Richtlijn 2014/60/EU (hierna: de Richtlijn) die aan deze implementatiewet ten grondslag ligt.

Asks whether a cultural object qualifies only if designated under national law or procedures, whether the broadened definition applies retroactively, and whether a good-faith possessor can acquire ownership.

The SP members ask whether an item can only be classed as a cultural good if a member state has designated or defined it under national legislation or administrative procedures, as in Article 36 TFEU.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of een zaak alleen als cultuurgoed kan worden aangemerkt als deze uit hoofde van nationale wetgeving of van nationale administratieve procedures door een lidstaat zijn aangemerkt of omschreven zoals in artikel 36 van het VWEU.
Asks why the earlier directive was rarely applied, what the expected effect of the new directive is, and whether the main aim is internal market harmonisation or recovery of cultural goods.

The PVV members ask whether the primary aim of the bill is harmonisation of this legislation within the internal market, or the recovery of cultural goods unlawfully taken outside a member state's territory.

De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of het doel van het wetsvoorstel primair harmonisatie van deze wetgeving in het kader van de interne markt is, of het terugvorderen van cultuurgoederen die op onrechtmatige wijze buiten het grondgebied van een lidstaat zijn gebracht.

34178.s: The bill approves a 2015 treaty under which Norway may use the Dutch prison Norgerhaven at Veenhuizen to serve Norwegian custodial sentences, and it provides that Dutch law does not apply to that detention. It also authorises Dutch officials to escort the prisoners and take security measures, and makes Norwegian law govern complaints and legal claims about enforcement.
34178.j: The memorandum justifies excluding Dutch law and courts by arguing that Article 15 and 17 Constitution access to a judge is preserved through the Norwegian courts, so no deviation from the Constitution under Article 91(3) arises.
q: Dutch law does not apply to deprivation of liberty resulting from enforcement of Norwegian custodial sentences under the treaty.
De Nederlandse wet is niet van toepassing op vrijheidsbeneming ondergaan ten gevolge van de tenuitvoerlegging van bij Noorse vonnissen opgelegde vrijheidsstraffen.
d: designation of Dutch officials to escort and guard prisoners
p: Dutch law, including habeas corpus review before Dutch courts, is excluded for detention under Norwegian sentences, with Norwegian courts as the forum instead.
Designated Dutch officials may take all measures they consider appropriate to secure prisoners and prevent escape.

parties: Asks about escape risks, costs of escapes, language barriers and how Dutch versus Norwegian law applies inside the prison.
First, the VVD members ask what kind of detainees will be placed in Norgerhaven.
Allereerst vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie wat voor soort gedetineerden in Norgerhaven zullen worden geplaatst.
Asks how criminal proceedings and sentences for offences committed in Dutch custody will be handled under Dutch law.
How does the criminal process of the Norwegian detainee following an offence committed in the Netherlands relate to the remaining sentence he was serving in the Netherlands?
Hoe verhoudt het strafproces van de Noorse gedetineerde naar aanleiding van het gepleegde misdrijf in Nederland zich tot de nog uit te zitten straf waarvoor de Noorse gedetineerde in Nederland was?
Worries about human rights compliance, the absence of a Dutch inspection and supervisory commission, and where the limit on renting out prison capacity lies.
In response, they want to know whether there is no conflict with the Optional Protocol to the UN Convention against Torture.
Zij willen naar aanleiding hiervan weten of er geen strijd optreedt met het Facultatief Protocol bij het VN-verdrag tegen foltering.
Raises the College voor de Rechten van de Mens concerns on monitoring detention conditions, family life rights, and liability for incidents and medical care.
Asks who decides on restraints during transport, whether nationality overrides territoriality in arrests after escape, and about costs and legal status.
Who decides whether to impose restraining measures on Norwegian detainees during transport?
Wie neemt de beslissing om aan Noorse gedetineerden al dan niet vrijheidsbeperkende middelen op te leggen gedurende het vervoer van gedetineerden.
Asks about evaluation of the Belgian treaty, which law applies in cases of violations, and whether the payment truly covers all costs.
In such cases, does only Dutch law apply?
Geldt in dat soort gevallen alleen het Nederlandse recht?

34196.s: The bill makes electronic communication with the Belastingdienst and tax collection mandatory for taxpayers, with exceptions set by ministerial regulation, and adds a delegation for technical rules and processing of personal data by the Minister of Interior. It also aligns cross-references in the Gemeentewet and Waterschapswet and sets an entry-into-force mechanism tied to a future generic digital infrastructure law.
34196.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial delegation as a practical instrument for a phased transition, for unforeseen urgent exceptions, and for technical and administrative detail that changes with technology.
q: To give shape to the phase-in schedule, a list of exceptions will be formulated by ministerial regulation, which in the first years will still cover many messages.
Om het ingroeischema vorm te geven wordt bij ministeriële regeling een lijst uitzonderingen geformuleerd, die de eerste jaren nog veel berichten zal omvatten.
d: manner in which electronic messaging takes place
message types and taxpayer groups exempt from mandatory electronic messaging, and circumstances for exemption
manner of electronic messaging for collection
message types and groups of taxpayers exempt from electronic messaging
manner of electronic messaging with Belastingdienst/Toeslagen
message types and groups of beneficiaries exempt from electronic messaging
technical rules on operation, security and reliability of electronic messaging facilities
which personal data are processed, to whom supplied, and retention period
p: Artikel I A (art. 3a AWR, lid 3); Artikel II A (art. 7c, lid 3); Artikel III (art. 13, lid 3)

Ministerial regulation can designate which messages and taxpayer groups are exempt from mandatory electronic contact and under which circumstances, expanding executive discretion over the channel for citizens' communication with tax authorities.

The Minister of Interior is given a general task over digital messaging and authentication infrastructure and power to process personal data including the citizen service number, with the categories set by a general administrative order.

parties: Asks how the transition will work for people unable to use computers and whether phased introduction will cause confusion.
So what happens to people who cannot work with a computer, such as the elderly or digitally unskilled?
Hoe gaat het dan met mensen die niet met de computer kunnen werken zoals ouderen of digibeten?
Asks how the Berichtenbox will reach and notify all citizens, including isolated elderly people, and whether a physical letter can be used as a fallback.
In an extreme case, would a physical letter be among the options to alert people that messages are waiting, these members ask.
Behoort in een uiterst geval een fysieke brief tot de mogelijkheden om mensen te attenderen dat er berichten klaar staan, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks for parliamentary input on the exemption lists set by ministerial regulation and questions whether the digital shift reduces oversight capacity and self-reliance.
The SP members want a say over the messages and taxpayers to be excluded and ask the government to submit these ministerial regulations for prior review.
De leden van de SP-fractie willen graag inspraak op de uit te zonderen berichten en belastingplichtigen en vragen de regering deze ministeriële regelingen voor te hangen.

Objects that exemptions are left to ministerial regulation rather than the statute or an AMvB with prior parliamentary review, and warns of weakened legal protection when notices are missed and deadlines pass.
The CDA members consider it improper for the question of whether groups of taxpayers must use electronic correspondence to be settled by ministerial regulation.}
De leden van de CDA-fractie achten het niet juist om het al dan niet verplichten van groepen belastingplichtigen tot elektronisch berichtenverkeer per ministeriële regeling te laten plaatsvinden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory board advises sending the Dutch bill on mandatory electronic correspondence with the Tax Authority to parliament but asks for clarification of the scope of the statutory basis for MijnOverheid/Berichtenbox, the notification method and the timing of mandatory digital communication, and for notification rules to be set at a higher regulatory level. The government's reply (nader rapport) largely explains that the broader scope is needed for a uniform MijnOverheid, that notification will be set by ministerial regulation, and that exemptions will be limited, and it adds clarifications and some textual changes.
concerns: Advice that the statutory basis for electronic correspondence facilities is broader than necessary and should be limited to mandatory tax correspondence; the government explains that a narrower basis would create unworkable splits in MijnOverheid and adds explanation to the memorandum.

Advice that the formal legal provisions (receipt time, storage, notification, storage failures) may be inadequate for electronic correspondence; the government says current Awb provisions work in practice and will be reviewed with the digital government law.

Advice that the notification method and the designation of groups subject to mandatory digital correspondence should be set at a higher regulatory level than a ministerial regulation; the government keeps ministerial regulation for exemptions and adds criteria and explanation.

Advice that the timing and mandatory nature of digital communication for groups unable to comply digitally needs further justification; the government points to support via helplines and digital help and adds an explanation of the exemption groups.
Redactional corrections on references to Awb articles 2:14 and 2:15 and the numbering of article 13a of the Awir were made.

34200-IX.s: This bill amends the 2014 budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB), the National Debt (IXA) and the Domeinen Roerende Zaken agency through a final budget adjustment law (slotwet). It sets out the revised appropriations and realised figures, which the explanatory memorandum comments on mainly in budgetary terms.

34268.s: The bill abolishes the Wet op de Raad voor de financiële verhoudingen and folds the advisory task on the financial relations between central and subnational government into the advisory mandate of the Raad voor het openbaar bestuur. It also redefines that council's remit to cover the policy aspects of financial relations, particularly between the central state, municipalities and provinces.
34268.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the change by stating that advisory work on financial relations will become part of the advisory on the functioning of government, with no new executive powers claimed.
q: Advice on the policy aspects of financial relations will become part of the advice on the organisation and functioning of government.
De advisering over de beleidsmatige aspecten van de financiële verhoudingen zal hierbij onderdeel gaan uitmaken van de advisering over de inrichting en het functioneren van de overheid

parties: Asks how financial-relations expertise and continuity will be safeguarded after the Rfv is abolished, and how the new Rob's membership and staffing will be arranged.

Now that the Raad voor de financiële verhoudingen is being abolished as an independent advisory body, the VVD asks the government to explain how knowledge of financial relations will be guaranteed within the Raad voor het openbaar bestuur.

Nu de Raad voor de financiële verhoudingen als onafhankelijk adviesorgaan wordt opgeheven, vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie de regering nader in te gaan op de vraag hoe de kennis inzake de financiële verhoudingen binnen de Raad voor het openbaar bestuur is dan wel wordt gewaarborgd.
Asks when the government's review of whether an independent body should keep checking article 12 requests will be ready, and whether water boards should be named in the bill.
When can the Chamber expect the results of that review and the government's resulting proposals, the CDA asks.
Wanneer kan de Kamer de resultaten van die verkenning en de daarop gebaseerde voorstellen van de regering tegemoet zien, zo vragen deze leden.
Notes both councils advise parliament as well as government, questions why parliament was not involved earlier, and asks whether integration is necessary to strengthen the ministry's steering role.
In that light they ask whether it would not have made sense to involve parliament earlier in this bill.
Zij vragen zich in dat licht af of het niet in de rede gelegen had het parlement eerder bij dit wetsvoorstel te betrekken.
Worries that the external review of article 12 Fvw requests will not be secured after the merger, and asks whether that review should be anchored in law.
They have concerns about securing this review after the act takes effect and raise several questions about it.
Zij hebben zorgen over de borging van deze toetsing na het in werking treden van de onderhavige wet en stellen daarover enkele vragen.
Supports merging the tasks but asks that the autonomy of municipalities and provinces be safeguarded, that independence of advice be guaranteed, and that the article 12 external review be kept.
Precisely if there were substantive steering from the ministry, it is important to the SGP that the autonomy of the other governments is guaranteed.
Juist als er sprake zou zijn van inhoudelijke sturing vanuit het ministerie, is het voor de leden van de SGP-fractie van belang dat de zelfstandigheid van de andere overheden gewaarborgd wordt.

34286.s: This bill amends the 2015 departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) to allow the purchase of the marriage portraits of Maerten Soolmans and Oopjen Coppit. It changes budget expenditure and commitment lines, with the amendment taking effect from 1 October of the budget year.
q: is amended, as appears from the corresponding budget statement attached to this law
wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat

34295.s: The bill amends the Meststoffenwet to add rules limiting how much additional phosphate from dairy cattle may be processed in manure processing, scaled by the surplus per hectare, to preserve land-based dairy farming. It exempts farms that had committed financially to manure processing before 30 March 2015 and removes two earlier paragraphs.
34295.j: The memorandum justifies the earlier choice of an amvb by the lack of clarity on how land-based growth could be secured and the need for the law to take effect by 1 January 2015, and notes that the Raad van State was heard.
q: An amvb was chosen because, when the bill was being debated, there was still insufficient clarity on how land-based character could be effectively secured

Er werd voor een amvb gekozen, omdat ten tijde van de behandeling van het wetsvoorstel verantwoorde groei melkveehouderij nog onvoldoende duidelijkheid bestond over de wijze waarop de grondgebondenheid op een effectieve manier kon worden geborgd
d: calculation of surplus per hectare and conditions for exemption

parties: Asks why the bill was turned from an AMvB into a statute and whether it differs substantively and technically from the AMvB.
They attach great value to the present bill not deviating substantively or technically from the AMvB.
Zij hechten er grote waarde aan dat onderhavig wetsvoorstel zowel inhoudelijk als technisch niet afwijkt van de AMvB.
Asks what measures apply if all farms together exceed the manure ceiling and wants clarity for farmers soon.
These members want to stress that it is important to them that farmers receive clarity soon.
Deze leden willen benadrukken dat het wat hun betreft belangrijk is dat boeren spoedig duidelijkheid krijgen.
Argues the bill opens the way to intensification and a new bio-industry, contradicting sustainability goals, and wants a simpler rule.
They believe it must at all times be prevented that dairy farming transforms into a new bio-industry.
Zij vinden dat te allen tijden voorkomen moet worden dat de melkveehouderij transformeert in een nieuwe bio-industrie.
Questions whether the reference date under the phosphate rights plan is legally tenable given the Raad van State advice on property rights and precision of rules.
In your view, does your letter of 2 July meet this requirement?
Voldoet in uw ogen uw brief van 2 juli jl. aan dit vereiste?
Raises concern about legislative fragmentation and the stacking of rules, and how this fits principles of proper administration.
The D66 members ask how that relates to principles of proper administration.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen hoe zich dat verhoudt tot beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur.
Argues a core of the rules should be anchored in statute rather than an AMvB and questions the lack of full land-based requirement.
The GroenLinks members are of the view that a core of the law should not be regulated in an AMvB.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie zijn van mening dat een kern van de wet niet in een AMvB moet worden geregeld.
Strongly opposes the bill as enabling industrial growth, criticizes exemptions and the phosphate rights system, and requests a standstill and mandatory grazing.
These members note that the government places no obstacle in the way of dairy farming growing further.
Deze leden constateren dat de regering de melkveehouderij geen strobreed in de weg legt om nog verder te groeien.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Wet grondgebonden groei melkveehouderij, flagging foreseeability concerns about applying the rules to 2015, the use of the Wet raadgevend referendum exception (art. 12 Wrr) for early entry into force, and a redactional point on the transitional provision. The government's nader rapport defends the 2015 cut-off, argues urgency under art. 12 Wrr, and adjusts the fosfaatoverschot calculation to the prior year, while the Afdeling's core advice to send the bill onward after adjustment is largely accommodated.
concerns: The Afdeling flagged that the 2015 reach of the rules raises foreseeability concerns for businesses that expanded in 2015, which the government answered by pointing to the 1 January 2016 start date and the shifted knelgevallen date.

The Afdeling concluded that the extra phosphate production rules amount to regulation of property under art. 1 First Protocol ECHR and art. 17 EU Charter, requiring sufficient precision and prior publication.
The Afdeling held that the art. 12 Wrr exception for urgency cannot succeed because the same rules are already in force via the draft decree, while the government argued the bill's urgency remains.
The Afdeling asked that the entry-into-force provision be adjusted in light of its urgency analysis, and the explanatory notes on the voorhang procedure were amended.
The Afdeling noted that the calculation of the applicable percentage was hard for farmers to predict, and the government changed it to use the prior year's fosfaatoverschot.

34349.s: The bill prohibits wearing face-covering clothing in public transport and in buildings and grounds of educational, government and care institutions, with exceptions for health, safety, occupational, sporting, festive or cultural reasons and for residential care. Violation is punishable by a first-category fine as a minor offence, and enforcement is folded into regular police identification checks.
34349.j: The memorandum justifies the prohibition by public safety, the need to identify persons, and a societal norm of recognizable communication, and argues a uniform statutory rule is needed because institutions do not apply house rules uniformly.
q: The prohibition will apply to every form of face-covering clothing, except where wearing it is necessary to protect the body for health or safety reasons.
Het verbod zal voor iedere vorm van gezichtsbedekkende kleding gaan gelden, behalve als het dragen daarvan noodzakelijk is ter bescherming van het lichaam in verband met de gezondheid of veiligheid.
d: care institution authority may permit face covering in non-residential parts
p: Gives the competent authority of care institutions discretion to allow face-covering clothing in non-residential areas, with no criteria specified in the bill.
Makes wearing face-covering clothing in covered places a criminal offence enforced by police under existing identification powers, extending state coercive reach over individuals.

parties: Supports a ban as a first step but asks the government to justify why a general ban on all public places is insufficiently grounded, which touches on proportionality review.
The VVD members read that there is insufficient ground for a general ban applying in all public places and ask the government to substantiate this position.
De leden van de VVD-fractie lezen dat er onvoldoende grond is voor een algemeen verbod dat op alle openbare plaatsen zou gelden.
Questions whether a statutory ban is necessary at all, noting the Council of State's view that the bill should not have been sent to parliament and that no large-scale problem has been shown.
The PvdA members note that the Council of State's Advisory Division is of the opinion that the bill should not have been sent to the House.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie merken op dat de Afdeling Advisering van de Raad van State van mening is dat het voorliggend wetsvoorstel niet naar de Kamer gestuurd had moeten worden.
Asks for fuller justification of the necessity of the bill in response to the Council of State's criticism that institutions already have powers to set house rules.
These members nevertheless ask for a more extensive justification from the government regarding the Council of State's criticism.
Genoemde leden vragen echter wel naar een uitgebreidere motivering van de regering op de kritiek van de Raad van State.

Supports the aim of open communication and the ban's purpose but asks how it relates to existing sectoral powers and the freedom of religion under Article 6 of the Constitution, which may be restricted only by formal law.
These members endorse the government's line that the bill satisfies this requirement of restricting religious freedom only by formal law.
Deze leden onderschrijven de lijn van de regering, dat met het voorliggende wetsvoorstel aan dit vereiste wordt voldaan.
Strongly critical; endorses the Council of State's criticism that the urgent necessity is not motivated, that the bill unjustly limits freedom of religion, and questions enforceability.
The D66 members endorse the very strong criticism the Council of State has already voiced on the bill.
De leden van de D66-fractie onderschrijven de zeer stevige kritiek die de Raad van State al op het wetsvoorstel uitte.
Sees a ban as potentially justified for public order but asks why the government now departs from its 2008 view favouring alternatives and whether the bill risks conflict with Article 9 ECHR.
Where public order, safety or normal social interaction in public space is obstructed, a ban on face-covering clothing may in these members' eyes be justified.

Waar de openbare orde, de veiligheid of de normale sociale interactie in de publieke ruimte wordt belemmerd, kan een verbod op het dragen van gelaatsbedekkende kleding in de ogen van deze leden gerechtvaardigd zijn.
Accepts that a ban may be warranted for public order and safety but raises many questions on the precise scope and the government's motivation.
These members are of the view that in the context of public order and safety a ban on face-covering clothing may be appropriate.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat in het kader van de openbare orde en veiligheid een verbod op gezichtsbedekkende kleding aangewezen kan zijn.
Critical of the bill; asks for evidence of actual problems, warns the ban could deter women from care and public services, and questions the legal basis and enforcement burden on institutions.
The members of Groep Kuzu/Öztürk have studied the bill with disappointment and have several questions.
De leden van de Groep Kuzu/Öztürk hebben het wetsvoorstel met teleurstelling bestudeerd en hebben enkele vragen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised against sending the partial ban on face-covering clothing (education, public transport, government buildings, care) to parliament unless the government gives substantive justification; it found the problem small, existing sector rules and sanctions sufficient, and the ban not demonstrably necessary under Article 9 ECHR. The government's nader rapport defends the bill as needed for uniformity and legal certainty, rejects the alternatives, and states the ban is proportionate, but does not withdraw the bill.
concerns: The Council argues the ban is not shown to be necessary under Article 9 ECHR freedom of religion; the government responds that the national need is justified and the ban proportionate, while narrowing scope to specific sectors.
The Council finds the problem small and sector-level alternatives adequate, so a statutory ban is unnecessary; the government maintains that uniformity and legal certainty require a statute.
The Council says the feared legal uncertainty from non-uniform house rules has not materialised since 2003; the government counters that differing rules between institutions still cause uncertainty.
The Council doubts the added value of a separate criminal sanction since police can already act for trespass or transport rules; the government argues a uniform sanction is needed for clarity.

34448.s: The bill amends the Dutch Explosives for Civil Use Act to implement EU Directive 2014/28/EU, adding manufacturer, importer and distributor obligations, conformity assessment rules and rules for notified conformity bodies. It also updates delegation and registration provisions and sets transitional rules for explosives already on the market.
34448.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and designation powers as necessary to implement the directive's requirements for supervising and designating conformity bodies.
q: The Minister may, in agreement with other ministers concerned, set further rules by ministerial regulation on the design of the registration and the data to be registered.

Onze Minister kan, in overeenstemming met Onze Minister wie het mede aangaat, bij ministeriële regeling nadere regels stellen met betrekking tot de opzet van de registratie en de te registreren gegevens.
d: designation of harmonised standards and Commission publication references
minister designates conformity assessment bodies and may attach conditions
Artikel I, V (artikel 21a, lid 4 and related delegation)
minister may set rules on registration of special explosives and data to be recorded
p: The minister may restrict, suspend or withdraw a conformity body designation on the basis of the body's non-compliance, with notification to the Commission and other member states.

parties: Asks how safety is assured when no Dutch body is designated to assess explosives, and whether the Inspectorate's warning about fraud risk is adequately addressed.

The VVD members note that the Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport (ILT) points to a possible increase in fraud with explosives as a result of limiting the recognition requirement to the manager.

De leden van de VVD-fractie constateren dat de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) wijst op een mogelijke toename van fraude met explosieven als gevolg van de beperking van de verplichting van een erkenning tot de leidinggevende.
Asks whether a certificate of conduct offers the same level of safety as recognition, and stresses that safety and security are paramount.
These members wish to emphasise that they regard certainty and safety as of the utmost importance in handling and using explosives.
Deze leden willen benadrukken dat zij zekerheid en veiligheid van het grootste belang achten bij het omgaan met en gebruik van explosieven.
Asks for clarification of wording on recreational hunting and what industry requested during consultation, without raising a check concern.
These members request that the wording in the explanatory memorandum be aligned with the Nature Conservation Act, for example.
Deze leden verzoeken de woordkeuze in de memorie van toelichting bijvoorbeeld aan te laten sluiten bij de Wet Natuurbescherming.

34457.s: The bill introduces a national application deadline of 1 April for vocational education (mbo) and a right of admission for qualified students, amending the WEB, WVO, WEC and WEB BES. It also requires schools to share student transfer data with municipalities and lets ministerial regulations designate programmes with additional entry requirements.
34457.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as technical implementation of data exchange and programme designation, and limits student-refusal grounds to statutory exceptions.
q: The right of admission is delimited so that it does not amount to an unconditional right to remain in vocational education.
Het toelatingsrecht wordt zodanig afgebakend dat dit geen ongeclausuleerd verblijfsrecht in het beroepsonderwijs inhoudt.
d: maximum number of programmes a student may apply for
rules for transferring data on adult-education students to municipalities
specification of data, timing and method for registration of school leavers
institutions set rules on intake activities and study-choice advice
designation of programmes with additional entry requirements
institutions set selection criteria and procedure for designated programmes
rules for transferring data on pupils moving to mbo
rules for transferring data on special-education pupils moving to mbo
institutions in the Caribbean set intake and study-choice rules
p: Institutions may cap intake by capacity or labour-market prospects and refuse students who have repeatedly failed, though a statutory right of admission is created for qualified students.
Institutions may terminate or refuse enrolment for unsuitability for the profession after consulting the examination committee, a discretionary ground with appeal rights to the examinations board.
Binding study advice with possible termination of enrolment is extended from entry-level to all mbo programmes, with a right of appeal.
Personal identification numbers and school-leaver data are shared among schools and municipalities, limited to preventing early school leaving."}],

parties: Asks whether the 1 April deadline is justified, requests binding guidance and ministerial regulation on study prospectuses and intake, and asks for tighter conditions on the admission right.
The VVD members support the aim of reducing dropout in MBO.
De leden van de VVD-fractie steunen de inzet om uitval in het mbo te verlagen.
Asks how instellingen that violate the admission right are sanctioned, who supervises compliance, and how privacy of student data is safeguarded.
All young people must have equal chances to develop, choose an education themselves, and be admitted when they meet the required entry requirements.
Alle jongeren moeten gelijke kansen krijgen om zich te ontwikkelen, zelf een opleiding te kiezen en te worden toegelaten bij een opleiding wanneer zij aan de vereiste vooropleidingseisen voldoen.
Questions the proportionality and necessity of statutory rules when agreements with institutions might suffice, and asks why a binding study advice is introduced before effects are evaluated.
However, the members, together with the Council of State, question what the necessity is of laying this down in a bill.
Wel vragen de leden zich met de Raad van State af wat de noodzaak is van het vastleggen hiervan in een wetsvoorstel.

Worries that a binding study advice after four months is a heavy decision that undermines student protection against institutional discretion, and asks about the consequences of covert selection at the gate.
They also find this contrary to the idea behind the rest of the bill, under which students are protected against arbitrariness in institutions' admission policies.
Zij vinden dit ook indruisen tegen de gedachte achter de rest van het wetsvoorstel, waarbij de student wordt beschermd tegen de willekeur in toelatingsbeleid van instellingen.

Asks who is responsible for storing personal data and safeguarding privacy, whether students can check and request changes to their data, and how the admission exceptions are defined by ministerial regulation.
Who is responsible for ensuring the currency and privacy of personal data when it is stored?
Wie is verantwoordelijk voor het waarborgen van actualiteit en privacy bij het opslaan van persoonsgegevens?

Asks whether the admission right and the ministerial regulation grounds fit with existing choices, whether institutions may refuse unsuitable students, and whether the advice creates institutional liability.
These members ask why the government does not consider it obvious to also amend the provision on enrolment now that a right of admission is being introduced.
Deze leden vragen waarom de regering het niet voor de hand vindt liggen om ook de bepaling inzake inschrijving te wijzigen nu besloten wordt tot een recht op toelating.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised sending the bill introducing an early application date and admission right for vocational education (mbo) to parliament, but asked for better justification of the admission right, since the claimed unclear admission practices were not substantiated. The government's reply provides additional data and context, adds explanation to the general memorandum, and makes several drafting corrections including restoring a criterion for certain institutions.
concerns: The motivation for the admission right was insufficiently explained, so the explanatory memorandum should provide insight into the nature and number of wrongful rejections, which the government did by citing wider evidence and expanding the general part.

The MBO-raad questioned proportionality given only 100 to 200 formal complaints; the government responded that this figure undercounts informal cases but did not dispute that the scale needed fuller explanation.
Redactional remarks on renumbering newly inserted paragraphs were incorporated, and other editorial improvements and updated dropout figures were made.

34475-IIA.s: The bill amends the 2015 departmental budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (IIA), adjusting appropriations and realisations across the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer and related items, effective from the day after publication and retroactive to 31 December 2015. It is a technical budget closing act (Slotwet) that alters only the budgetary figures and does not delegate rule-making powers.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (IIA) for the year 2015
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2015

34493.s: The bill modernises the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure rules on international legal assistance in criminal matters, simplifying procedures and adding safeguards. It creates a new Book 5 structure covering incoming and outgoing requests, joint investigation teams, transfer and takeover of prosecution, and European freezing orders, and it shortens review deadlines and replaces the leave procedure with a complaint regime.
34493.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers and simplified procedures as needed to improve legal assistance, reach states without treaties and avoid duplication in court review.
q: Dropping the treaty requirement for requests to apply special investigative powers and coercive measures could lead to an increase in requests from foreign states.
Het loslaten van het verdragsvereiste voor verzoeken om toepassing van bijzondere opsporingsbevoegdheden en dwangmiddelen zou kunnen leiden tot een toename van het verzoeken van vreemde staten.
d: further rules on granting and executing legal assistance requests
list of offences exempt from double criminality check
model certificate for outgoing freezing orders
p: Allows investigative powers, including coercive measures, to be used for foreign requests without the Dutch proportionality and necessity assessment, and drops the treaty requirement for special powers.
Replaces the prior leave procedure with a complaint regime in which the court does not examine the grounds of the foreign request, narrowing judicial review of the basis for seizures abroad.
Gives the Minister the decision on refusal grounds relating to discrimination or political persecution, a safeguard for individuals.

parties: Asks what the added value of the bill is and how the risk of flagrant human rights violations as a ground for refusal should be interpreted.
What contribution does the proposal make to being able to pursue and prosecute criminals more actively and effectively?
Welke bijdrage levert het voorstel in het actiever en effectiever kunnen oppakken en berechten van misdadigers?
Argues that more safeguards are needed when assisting non-treaty countries and that the pre-approval judicial check should be retained for requests from outside the EU.

Especially regarding the easing of rules for cooperation with countries with which there is no treaty basis, more safeguards in providing legal assistance are called for than the bill currently provides.

Vooral met betrekking tot de versoepeling van de regels ten aanzien van samenwerking met landen waar geen verdragsgrond mee bestaat, zijn meer waarborgen bij het verlenen van rechtshulp op zijn plaats dan waar het wetsvoorstel nu in voorziet, aldus deze leden.
Asks how refusal of treaty-less requests is tested and what role judicial review plays, and how privacy of non-suspects is protected in data collection.
How and by whom is this tested? To what extent is there a role for the judge through judicial review?
Hoe en door wie wordt hierop getoetst? In hoeverre is hier een rol weggelegd voor de rechter via een rechterlijke toetsing?
Broadly supports the measures except the complaint regime, and questions the risks to effective investigation and the need for notification of seized goods and data.
have noted with some surprise the government's choice to largely abolish the pre-approval procedure
hebben met enige verbazing kennisgenomen van de keuze van de regering om de verlofprocedure grotendeels af te schaffen
Asks why the treaty requirement for coercive measures and special investigative powers is dropped and why the video-hearing exception covers trial but not investigation.
ask why the treaty requirement is dropped for using video conferencing to hear witnesses and experts
vragen waarom bij de inzet van videoconferentie voor het horen van getuigen en deskundigen het verdragsvereiste wordt losgelaten

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion on the bill modernising international legal assistance in criminal matters (non-EU small legal assistance) raises rule-of-law and fundamental-rights concerns, notably that intrusive powers should only follow requests from judicial authorities, the verlof procedure scope, notification duties, and the fiscal refusal ground. The government's nader rapport largely accepts the advice, adopting most changes and explaining the few it declines, such as the fiscal-matters terminology.
concerns: Advised that intrusive powers be used only on requests from foreign judicial authorities; government first dropped the requirement, then reinstated it as default with treaty exceptions for Scandinavian states.
Advised clarifying in the statute that legal assistance requests cannot be tested against additional national criteria, which the government accepted.

Advised extending the verlof procedure to all covert powers requiring rechter-commissaris authorisation; government clarified infiltration is not covered and expanded notification to searches for recording data.
Advised a statutory refusal ground where there is well-founded risk of flagrant human rights violations abroad; government replied this duty follows from ECHR and declined a separate provision.
Advised simplifying the fiscal and customs refusal ground; government decided to abandon the terminology simplification.
Advised clarifying the meaning of direct belanghebbenden relative to belanghebbenden in the complaint procedure, which was addressed in the explanatory memorandum.

34529.s: The bill repeals the Sunday Act (Zondagswet), returning regulation of Sunday rest and related holidays to municipalities within constitutional and statutory limits. It inserts a new Municipal Act article 146 that bars municipalities from restricting sports and non-public-entertainment leisure on Sundays and equates Ascension Day and the first Christmas Day with Sunday.
34529.j: The memorandum justifies the transfer by the principle of decentralisation and differing local views on Sunday regulation, and notes that constitutional and fundamental-rights limits remain for courts to review.
q: With this, the government aims to leave it to municipalities to regulate and govern autonomously on public peace on Sundays and related holidays, observing statutory and fundamental-rights limits.

Daarmee beoogt de regering het aan gemeenten over te laten om ten aanzien van de openbare rust op zondag en aanverwante feestdagen zelf regelend en besturend op te treden, met inachtneming van de wettelijke en grondrechtelijke grenzen.
d: municipal regulation of Sunday rest and public order
p: Repeal of the Sunday Act transfers regulatory discretion over Sunday rest from national law to municipal councils and mayors.

Municipalities are barred from restricting sports and non-entertainment leisure on Sundays, a limited protection for citizens while other municipal restrictions remain possible subject to constitutional limits and court review.

parties: Asks how the government's Sunday-rest rules work in practice, which activities municipalities may decide on, and what exemptions exist.
What may municipalities determine and what may they not?
Wat mogen gemeenten bepalen en wat niet?
Agrees Sunday-rest regulation should be left to municipalities within conditions, but asks why two overlapping bills exist.
As far as these members are concerned, the Sunday Act may therefore be repealed.
Ook wat betreft deze leden mag derhalve de Zondagswet worden ingetrokken.
Asks whether the guarantee for sports is sufficient to stop municipalities adopting broader Sunday restrictions and what problems repeal solves.
Has mixed feelings; questions whether repeal is aimed at obstructing Sunday observance and asks for evidence that the Sunday Act leaves too little room for local tailoring.
With the Council of State, these members ask what shows that the Sunday Act leaves insufficient room for local tailoring by municipal authorities.
Met de Raad van State vragen deze leden waaruit blijkt dat de Zondagswet onvoldoende ruimte laat voor lokaal maatwerk door gemeentebesturen.

Criticises the purely administrative approach, asks for clearer criteria than an undefined 'need for regulation' and for clarity on limits to municipal power that could infringe citizens' freedoms and fundamental rights.
Does the government agree with the D66 group that clearer criteria are needed for restricting citizens' freedoms than an unspecified 'need for regulation' of Sunday rest?

Is de regering het met de fractie van D66 eens, dat voor het inperken van vrijheden van burgers duidelijkere criteria nodig zijn dan een niet nader bepaalde «behoefte aan regulering» van de zondagsrust?

Sees a collective rest day as valuable and questions the need for repeal and decentralisation, asking how the Sunday Act's protection of worship and rest would be replaced and whether religious freedom balance changes.

They therefore do not understand where the necessity lies in repealing the Sunday Act and decentralising policy, and note together with the Council of State that a sound justification for this is lacking.

Zij begrijpen daarom niet waarin de noodzaak is gelegen de Zondagswet in te trekken en het beleid te decentraliseren en constateren samen met de Raad van State dat een dragende motivering daarvoor ontbreekt.

Opposes repeal, arguing public Sunday rest and worship are important values; questions whether criminal provisions guarantee undisturbed church attendance and whether municipal freedom is needlessly restricted.
In the view of the SGP members, the criminal provisions (arts. 145 and 146 Criminal Code) on disturbing church services offer insufficient guarantees for undisturbed church attendance.

Naar de overtuiging van de leden van de SGP-fractie geven in dit verband de strafrechtelijke bepalingen (artt. 145 en 146 WvSr.) rond de verstoring van kerkdiensten onvoldoende garanties voor ongehinderde kerkgang.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises sending the bill repealing the Sunday Act (Zondagswet) to parliament, but asks that the necessity of repeal be substantively justified, including why municipalities would better safeguard the balance and a collective Sunday rest moment. The government's reply states it adopted the advice, explaining that the decentralisation principle favours local regulation, and it also kept the Sunday-related restriction on public amusements in the bill rather than the implementing decree.
concerns: The Afdeling asks the government to justify the necessity of repealing the Sunday Act, since the text does not show the Act fails its purpose and local variation alone does not prove the margins for local tailoring are too narrow.
The Afdeling advises stating explicitly in the explanatory memorandum that a collective moment of rest on Sunday deserves protection, which the government added.

The Afdeling advises that the scope of the term public amusements, currently defined in an implementing decree, be fixed in the bill itself, which the government adopted by moving the restriction into the proposed Gemeentewet article.
The Afdeling proposes a wording change in the bill's article 146 on the purpose of celebrating Sunday, which the government did not follow, citing the wording taken from the Act's title.

34556.s: The bill abolishes the income tax deductions for heritage (monument) property expenses from 2017 and for training expenses from 2018, shifting the associated funds into non-fiscal spending schemes on the education and culture budget. It also adds transitional provisions and makes consequential amendments to the housing market act.
34556.j: The memorandum justifies the abolition by citing doubtful effectiveness and efficiency of the training deduction and the difficulty of administering it, and by the need for budget savings.
q: Because of the reasonable doubt about the effectiveness and efficiency of the training expense deduction, the complexity of its implementation by the Tax Administration
Vanwege de gerede twijfel over de effectiviteit en doelmatigheid van de aftrek scholingsuitgaven, de complexiteit van de uitvoering door de Belastingdienst

parties: Asks the government for detailed explanation of the consequences for owners, transition arrangements for commitments already made, and the basis for abolishing a popular, low-cost scheme.
Why does the government want to abolish a scheme that is low-threshold, easy to implement and popular with users, ask the VVD members.
Waarom wil de regering een regeling die laagdrempelig, goed uitvoerbaar en populair is bij gebruikers schrappen, vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie.
Critical that the abolition takes effect in 2017 before the replacement subsidy scheme is defined, and questions the small maximum subsidy amount.
The PvdA members note that it is not yet clear what these subsidy schemes will look like.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie stellen vast dat nog niet duidelijk is hoe deze subsidieregelingen eruit zullen zien.
Asks why the tax measures are abolished before the replacement scheme is worked out and why there is no transitional law.
Why are tax schemes abolished before a new intended scheme has been worked out?
Waarom worden fiscale regelingen afgeschaft voordat er een nieuwe beoogde regeling is uitgewerkt?

Strongly objects that Parliament is asked to approve abolition before the replacement is known, arguing this prevents effective parliamentary control over state spending; also disputes the government's effectiveness arguments.

The worst part of this bill, the CDA members find, is that the government first asks parliament to agree to abolishing existing schemes and announces a huge cut, and only later wants to say what replaces them.

Het ergste van dit wetsvoorstel vinden de leden van de CDA-fractie dat de regering het parlement eerst vraagt in te stemmen met het afschaffen van bestaande regelingen, een enorme bezuiniging aankondigt en pas later wil vertellen wat er dan precies voor in de plaats komt.
Argues the personal deduction individualises tax liability and that abolition would be more acceptable if combined with a rate reduction.
If the abolition were accompanied by a rate reduction, the proposal would be easier to swallow than a subsidy scheme.
Zou de afschaffing gepaard gaan met tariefsverlaging dan zou het voorstel beter te verteren zijn dan een subsidieregeling.
Asks why the abolition is decided now while the replacement remains unclear, questions the claimed ineffectiveness based on a 2009 evaluation, and asks for justification of the cuts.
Why does the government ask the House to approve abolishing a scheme without knowing the alternative?
Waarom vraagt de regering de Kamer om in te stemmen met het afschaffen van een regeling zonder het alternatief te kennen?
Asks why the government does not wait until the replacement scheme is fully clear and asks for insight into the societal impact of the cuts.
These members ask the government to provide at least full clarity on the transitional arrangement before the treatment of this bill continues.
Deze leden vragen de regering ten minste volledige duidelijkheid te bieden over de overgangsregeling, voordat de behandeling van dit wetsvoorstel wordt voortgezet.
Not yet convinced of necessity; asks whether a flat-rate deduction variant was considered and worries about the limit on large renovations.
The SGP members are very worried about the design of the listed monuments measure.
De leden van de SGP-fractie maken zich grote zorgen over de vormgeving van de maatregel rijksmonumenten.
Asks whether the scheme's abolition throws out the baby with the bathwater, whether a longer transition period is warranted, and why the replacement scheme's budget is cut.
This member considers it advisable to take a longer period for abolishing the monuments deduction.
Het lijkt dit lid raadzaam een langere periode te nemen voor het schrappen van de monumentenaftrek.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the bill abolishing the tax deduction for training costs and monument property expenses may proceed, but asked for a reasoned justification or adjustment of the transitional rules, since keeping a tax benefit for the fiscus while dropping an existing transitional benefit for taxpayers is unbalanced. The government's reply explains that a separate deduction for the limited group of students who did not graduate within the term would undo the intended simplification and burden tax administration, and that any compensation will be considered within the planned non-fiscal scheme with a smaller budget.
concerns: The transitional rule favouring the fiscus is kept while the existing transitional rule favouring taxpayers is dropped, which the Council considers unbalanced and in need of reasoning or adjustment.
The government rejects keeping a separate tax deduction for the small group affected, arguing it would undermine simplification and burden enforcement.

34574.s: The bill amends the Dutch Road Traffic Act 1994 to bring driving licence recognition for EU licences held by residents of the Netherlands in line with Directive 2006/126/EC, including a new rule that licences may be exchanged for replacement licences in cases set by general administrative order. Most other changes are editorial wording adjustments.
34574.j: The memorandum justifies moving the list of replacement-licence cases from the statute to a general administrative order because the Commission required replacement licences to be available and the existing practice is already set out in that order.
q: it was chosen no longer to list in the statute the exhaustive cases in which a driving licence may be replaced, but to include in the statute a basis to elaborate them by general administrative order

is ervoor gekozen de limitatieve opsomming van gevallen waarin het rijbewijs kan worden vervangen niet langer in de wet te vermelden, maar in de wet een basis op te nemen om deze bij algemene maatregel van bestuur uit te werken
d: I, E, onder 1, sub j (art. 120, eerste lid, WVW 1994)
cases and rules for issuing replacement driving licences

parties: Asks the government to explain how the bill affects the rights and obligations of B+ and BE licences issued before and after 2013 and what this means in practice.
To what extent do the rights and obligations for B+ and BE licences issued before and after 2013 remain in force under this bill?
In hoeverre blijven de rechten en plichten voor B+ en BE rijbewijzen van vóór en na 2013 door dit wetsvoorstel gehandhaafd?
Asks what comments the CBR and police made on the bill and how the government dealt with them, since the report does not show they were incorporated.
Can the government explain what comments they made and how these were dealt with?
Kan de regering toelichten welke opmerkingen zij hebben gemaakt en hoe daarmee is omgesprongen?

34583.s: The bill amends the Wet op het financieel toezicht to implement MiFID II and the MiFIR, extending regulation to over-the-counter and direct electronic access trading, introducing licensing for data reporting services and high-frequency algorithmic trading, and adding Dutch supervisory powers such as trading suspensions and bans on holding certain functions. It also sets rules for third-country investment firms and creates several new supervisory and enforcement instruments for the AFM and DNB.
34583.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as required by the EU directive and regulation, and as needed to address risks to investors and orderly trading.
q: To address potential risks to investors' interests, further rules are set on suspending, interrupting or excluding trading of financial instruments on trading platforms.

Om potentiële risico's voor de belangen van de beleggers te adresseren, worden nadere regels vastgesteld met betrekking tot het opschorten, onderbreken of uitsluiten van de handel van financiële instrumenten op handelsplatformen.
d: AFM order to suspend or halt trading in a financial instrument
partial exemption from branch licensing requirements for third-country firms
Artikel 1:1 (definitions via algemene maatregel van bestuur)
detailed rules on licence applications and supervision for data reporting services and related matters
p: Supervisors gain power to impose bans on holding certain management or policymaking functions on persons responsible for infringements.
The AFM may ask the Rotterdam court to exclude a financial instrument from trading on a platform after a suspension order.
The AFM may temporarily bar an investment firm from being a participant or member of a trading platform, for up to one year, renewable once.
The AFM may refuse information requests where disclosure would conflict with Dutch sovereignty, national security or public order.

parties: Asks whether the rules are proportionate for SMEs, whether the AFM and market parties have enough time, and how open norms and national choices will be applied consistently across the EU.
To what extent are the proposed measures proportionate and effective?
In hoeverre zijn de voorgestelde maatregelen proportioneel en effectief?
Asks how board functions and OTF trading will be supervised, whether clear criteria will be developed, and what the AFM's oversight of OTFs will involve.
These members ask how an OTF will prevent own-account trading from harming the client's interest and how the AFM will supervise this.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen hoe op een OTF voorkomen wordt dat handel voor eigen rekening ten koste gaat van het belang van de klant en hoe de AFM hier toezicht op zal houden.
Asks why rules on conflicts of interest and staff remuneration are set by general administrative order rather than by statute, which reduces parliamentary control.
what advantage there is in setting the rules on conflicts of interest for insurance products with an investment component by general administrative order rather than by statute?
welk voordeel het heeft om de regels over belangenconflicten rond verzekeringen met een beleggingscomponent bij algemene maatregel van bestuur, in plaats van bij wet vast te stellen?
Asks about the rules on remuneration incentives and the enforceability of any bonus caps, and about the relation of conflict-of-interest rules to the advice-commission ban.
Is she thinking of bonus caps, as is customary in the banking sector? How does the government intend to enforce such provisions?
Denkt zij hierbij aan bonusplafonds, net zoals dit in de banksector gebruikelijk is? Hoe denkt de regering dergelijke bepalingen te kunnen handhaven?
Asks how the AFM's unconditioned power to permit extra board functions will be bounded so the numerical limits are not circumvented.
The PVV members also want to know how it will be prevented that the numerical limits of the revised directive are circumvented if the AFM's unconditional power is used generically.

Tevens willen de leden van de PVV-fractie weten hoe voorkomen zal worden dat de getalsmatige grenzen uit de herzieningsrichtlijn omzeild worden wanneer generiek gebruik zal worden gemaakt van ongeclausuleerde bevoegdheid die de AFM krijgt
Supports strengthened and harmonised supervisory powers and asks about the choices member states have made, including maximum and minimum fines and how branch offices will be supervised.
They note that the directive prescribes maximum fines for authorities; can the government indicate whether a minimum fine is also prescribed?
Zij constateren dat er in de richtlijn maximumboetes worden voorgeschreven aan autoriteiten, maar kan de regering aangeven of er ook een minimumboete voorgeschreven?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised sending the MiFID II implementation bill to parliament, while asking for a reasoned justification or adjustment on the toezichthouder's information-request power, the rule-making power for the SME growth market, and the control of procedures for direct electronic access. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, adding a grondslag for SME growth market rules, incorporating the client trading and credit thresholds sentence, and fixing several technical omissions.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a reasoned justification why article 20(7) of the directive is not implemented given that article 1:70 Wft covers a narrower power; the government corrected the transposition table and pointed to articles 4:2 Awb and 1:74 Wft.
The Afdeling noted that article 4:91ea(6) gave no basis for rules on the suitable admission criteria for SME growth markets, and the government added a delegation in 4:91ea(6)(a) for AMvB rules.
The Afdeling advised incorporating the client trading and credit threshold obligation of article 17(5) into article 4:91o, which the government did by amending the first paragraph.
Redactional comments on the bill title, cross-references to the directive and matched principal trading definitions were accepted and incorporated.

34592.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Franekeradeel, Het Bildt, Menameradiel and part of Littenseradiel into the new municipality of Waadhoeke, adds Leeuwarderadeel and part of Littenseradiel to Leeuwarden, and adds part of Littenseradiel to Súdwest-Fryslân. It also sets transitional rules and updates the safety region annex, with entry into force by royal decree.
34592.j: The memorandum justifies the merger by the administrative capacity problem of the municipalities and notes that the non-abolished municipalities stay out of preventive financial supervision under the Wet arhi.
q: In this royal decree, retroactive effect may be granted to article 8, first paragraph, of this law up to and including 1 January 2009.
In dit koninklijk besluit kan aan artikel 8, eerste lid, van deze wet terugwerkende kracht worden verleend tot en met 1 januari 2009
d: fixing the date of entry into force by royal decree, possibly with retroactive effect

parties: Asks for further explanation of the future development and positioning of the municipality of Harlingen; otherwise no remarks.
The VVD members would like further explanation of the future development and positioning of the municipality of Harlingen.
De leden van de VVD-fractie willen graag een nadere toelichting op de toekomstige ontwikkeling en positionering van de gemeente Harlingen.

Asks why four municipalities chose the light merger variant when the government said all must agree, and what motive applied to Leeuwarden and Súdwest-Fryslân; raises an unintended tax effect of the WKR on merged administrations.
How does this fit with the statement "It is important that all municipalities support the choice of the light merger variant"?
Hoe rijmt dit met de uitspraak «Het is van belang dat alle gemeenten achter de keuze voor toepassing van de herindelingsvariant «lichte samenvoeging» staan»?

Asks about the consequences of Harlingen staying independent, the continuity of cooperation with Het Bildt, citizen closeness and local democracy in the enlarged Súdwest-Fryslân, and the basis for confidence in the merger given the 2014 evaluation.
These members ask the government to elaborate on the consequences of Harlingen remaining independent for the surrounding municipalities and for Harlingen itself.
Deze leden vragen de regering nader in te gaan op de vraag, welke consequenties het zelfstandig blijven van de gemeente Harlingen heeft voor de omliggende gemeenten en voor Harlingen zelf.

Stresses that the merger must be voluntary and produce a future-proof municipality; questions the logic of re-including the recently formed Súdwest-Fryslân and the representativeness of local government for added villages.
They consider it important that reorganisation is not forced but takes place from the bottom up.
Zij vinden het belangrijk dat herindeling niet gedwongen, maar van onderop plaatsvindt.

34620-III.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs (second supplementary budget), changing appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros with effect from 1 December 2016. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no explanatory memorandum excerpts were found.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA) for the year 2016 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken (IIIA) voor het jaar 2016 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34628.s: The bill simplifies the calculation of the protected minimum income (beslagvrije voet) in Dutch debt collection by introducing fixed amounts and formula-based rules, requiring bailiffs to notify debtors of the calculation and to recalculate it periodically. It also extends the protected amount to benefit-type payments, adds a hardship clause allowing courts to raise the amount, and grants bailiffs expanded access to income data from the UWV policy administration and the use of the citizen service number.
34628.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and expanded data access as necessary to make the protected amount transparent, simple to check, and consistent across debt collection procedures.
q: With the proposals the cabinet aims for the protected minimum income to become a transparent and easily verifiable norm for both debtors and creditors.
Met de voorstellen beoogt het kabinet dat de beslagvrije voet een transparante en eenvoudig te controleren norm wordt voor zowel schuldenaren als schuldeisers.
d: Artikel I, E (artikel 475c lid 1 Rv) and G (artikel 475da lid 6 Rv)
amounts of protected minimum income adjusted and published in Staatscourant
shorter recalculation period for certain periodic payments
factor for debtors with residence abroad
specification of data obtainable from UWV policy administration
model form for notifying debtor of protected amount
p: Bailiffs gain expanded access to income and personal data from the UWV policy administration and the authority to use the citizen service number, with the specific data categories left to ministerial regulation.
Artikel I, G (artikel 475da lid 5) and Artikel I, J (artikel 475fa)
A hardship clause allows the kantonrechter to raise the protected amount on the debtor's request, providing a judicial safeguard against rigid application of the formulas.
Artikel I, D and N (artikel 475b and 478 Rv)
The coordinating bailiff takes over collection and allocation among multiple creditors and may override the usual priority order, with the debtor notified of the protected amount calculation.

parties: Asks whether bailiffs' data access suffices to establish household situations and whether the hardship clause and coordinating bailiff role are workable, raising oversight of debtors' protection.
The VVD asks whether data available via the BRP are sufficient for a bailiff to conclusively establish a shared household where debtors are not married or registered partners.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering of de gegevens beschikbaar via de BRP voldoende zijn voor een deurwaarder om een situatie van een gezamenlijke huishouding waarbij schuldenaren niet zijn gehuwd, of een geregistreerd partnerschap hebben, onomstotelijk vast te stellen.
Welcomes the bill but presses on protection of debtors: reasonable minimum income, accuracy of the calculation, timely recalculation and access to the hardship clause.
Can the government further explain what is meant by 'a realistic minimum'?
Kan de regering nader toelichten wat er verstaan wordt onder «een reëel minimum»?
Worries that the coarse model and four household situations may push people below subsistence, and that preferential state claims and bank garnishment still endanger debtors.
The SP asks how great the chance is that people fall through the cracks due to the coarse-grained nature and four household situations of the new calculation model.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering hoe groot de kans is dat mensen alsnog tussen wal en schip vallen als gevolg van het grofmazige karakter en de vier leefsituaties van het nieuwe rekenmodel.
Welcomes simplification and coordination but questions the remaining complexity of the formula, the Belastingdienst's data link, and bank garnishment without a protective rule.
The CDA still has questions about the formula currently used for the exempt garnishment amount.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben nog wel vragen over de formule die nu gehanteerd wordt bij de beslagvrije voet.
Stresses that the exempt amount must be respected by all creditors, including the tax authority, and asks how the government guarantees this and what the error rate under the current system will be.
They consider it very important that people with debts facing garnishment can continue to provide for the basic costs of living.
Zij vinden het heel erg belangrijk dat mensen met schulden, die te maken krijgen met beslagleggingen, in de basiskosten van hun levensonderhoud kunnen blijven voorzien.
Asks about the order of recourse, the sanction of nullity for misapplication, incomplete information for creditors, and the cap on reduction based on partner income.
These members ask why nullity was chosen as the sanction, while creditors may not always have all relevant data to apply the order of recourse correctly.

Deze leden vragen waarom hiervoor gekozen is terwijl bekend is dat beslagleggers nog niet per definitie over alle relevante gegevens kunnen beschikken om de verhaalsvolgorde juist te kunnen toepassen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised proceeding with the bill simplifying the beslagvrije voet but raised concerns that the protection can be undermined by bank seizures outside its scope and that different bailiffs may calculate different amounts, and asked for a fix to the UWV information provision article. The government's reply largely accepts the drafting points and the UWV article fix, but declines to extend the protection to bank seizures now, deferring that to further exploration, and disputes the claim that tax bailiffs would reach different results.
concerns: Bank seizures outside the beslagvrije voet can undermine the protection of minimum subsistence income; the government acknowledges the problem but does not add measures now, promising further exploration.
Differences in the calculated beslagvrije voet may arise depending on which bailiff has which information about the debtor's situation and income.
Article 475ga(2) Rv lacks a legal basis for UWV to provide information based on a deviating household situation; the article is amended accordingly.
Several drafting and clarification points in the bill and explanatory memorandum are accepted and adjusted.

34664.s: The bill amends the Dutch European Works Councils Act so that seafarers on ships can take part in works council meetings remotely, removing the existing exception for them. It also amends Book 7 of the Civil Code to extend transfer-of-undertaking rules to ships transferred as part of a business, excluding transfers of ships alone.
q: It is recognised that information and consultation of seafarers can now also take place remotely through forms of electronic communication.
Daarbij wordt erkend dat informatie en raadpleging van zeevarenden tegenwoordig ook op afstand kunnen plaatsvinden via vormen van elektronische communicatie.

parties: Asks whether the implementation deadline of 10 October 2017 will be met, what the government will do if it is not, and what the consequences of overrunning it would be.
Will the implementation deadline of 10 October 2017 be met?
Wordt de implementatietermijn van 10 oktober 2017 gehaald?

34673.s: The bill allows general practitioners (huisartsen) to obtain a licence under the Termination of Pregnancy Act to perform medical (pill-based) abortions in early pregnancy, with conditions on practice organisation, cooperation with hospitals or clinics, counselling and data registration. It also brings abortions beyond six weeks and two days, which were previously treated as overtime treatment (overtijdbehandeling), under the Act, amends the Criminal Code provisions so licensed GPs can invoke the legal exemption, and makes GP registration and administrative fines enforceable.
34673.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated rules by the need to guarantee medical quality and that GP treatment stays limited to medical abortion, and makes the detailed rules flexible so they can be adjusted as circumstances change.
q: As the circumstances of the GP or the practice change, these requirements can be adjusted, supplemented or withdrawn at any time.
Naarmate de omstandigheden van de huisarts of de praktijk wijzigen, kunnen deze voorschriften te allen tijde worden aangepast, aangevuld of ingetrokken.
d: maximum duration of pregnancy for medical abortion by GP and data required with application
organisation, working method and equipment of GP practices and cooperation with hospitals or clinics
timing and manner of providing registration data to the inspectorate
procedure for proposing the general administrative measures under the revised articles
p: Extends licensed abortion provision to individual GPs, with detailed conditions set by general administrative measure rather than in the statute itself.
Imposes anonymised reporting and five-year record-keeping duties on GPs, with data use limited to statistics and supervision, protecting patient anonymity.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against allowing GPs to perform medicinal abortions now, recommending waiting for the second evaluation of the abortion law, and requested that a waiting period be explicitly provided for late-term treatments and the 9-week limit be reconsidered. The government's reply largely accepted the advice on the waiting period, the statutory level of the time limit, financing, the BES islands and the Wetboek van Strafrecht BES, but did not follow the advice to postpone the proposal, instead defending the GP role.
concerns: The Afdeling found the reasons in the explanatory memorandum insufficient to justify allowing GPs to perform abortions now, and advised awaiting the second evaluation of the abortion law.
The Afdeling found the current abortion practice in clinics and hospitals sound and saw no serious problems that would require change.
The Afdeling questioned whether the personal bond with the patient is weighty enough to justify GP abortions, noting referral to a clinic may have added value.
Excluding the waiting period for late-term treatments sends a signal that no period applies; the Afdeling advised explicitly providing for a flexible waiting period in the law.
The 9-week (or 6 weeks and 2 days) time limit for GP abortions is a fundamental element that should be set in the formal law rather than by general administrative order.
The NHG position supports safety only up to 6 weeks and 2 days, so the Afdeling advised limiting the GP time limit to that period rather than 9 weeks.
The explanatory memorandum should answer the NVOG questions on financing and clarify that women will face no cost difference between GP and clinic.
The Afdeling advised consulting the BES island governing bodies under the WolBES, which the government ultimately did not do, arguing impact was minimal.
The Wetboek van Strafrecht BES should be amended in line with the change to article 296(5) Sr for the Caribbean public bodies.

34691.s: The bill amends the Dutch vocational education act (WEB and WEB BES) to create a formal legal basis for samenwerkingscollege, a joint body through which two or more publicly funded vocational institutions jointly offer programmes, with rules on governance, examinations and a notification duty. It also lets the Minister grant a temporary exclusive right (alleenrecht) for five years to one institution to offer a unique small vocational programme at risk of disappearing, and allows loss of funding or diploma rights to be limited to one learning route.
34691.j: The memorandum justifies the exclusive right as a last-resort (ultimum remedium) measure to preserve small unique programmes when self-regulation by the sector chamber fails, and notes it expires automatically after five years.
q: The exclusive right is expressly intended as a last resort (ultimum remedium).
Het alleenrecht is nadrukkelijk bedoeld als een ultimum remedium.
d: granting a five-year exclusive right to one institution for a unique small vocational programme
deadlines and form of notification of programme start and end
content of written cooperation agreement between institutions forming a samenwerkingscollege
p: Gives the Minister discretion to grant an exclusive right to one institution for five years, excluding competitors from funding and diploma rights, with advice from the macrodoelmatigheid commission as the only check.
Extends the macrodoelmatigheid commission's remit to advise on granting exclusive rights and allows policy rules to govern the Minister's use of this power.

parties: Asks whether the bill undermines the human scale, student choice and quality competition, and how the rules for joint colleges (participation caps, works council rights, dissolution) are set.
They ask the government to reflect on whether and how this bill contributes to each of these three starting points, and if it harms one, why the government chooses that.

Zij vragen de regering te reflecteren of en hoe dit wetsvoorstel bijdraagt aan ieder van deze drie uitgangspunten en wanneer dit wetsvoorstel een van deze uitgangspunten schaadt, waarom de regering daarvoor kiest.
Asks whether the director of a joint college will be a board member of a participating institution and whether the government will cap that director's salary.
