Furthermore, the members ask whether the government will cap the salary of a director of a joint college.](NOTE)
Verder vragen de leden of de regering het salaris van een directeur van een samenwerkingscollege zal maximeren.

Supports joint colleges but asks how they avoid becoming a merger incentive, and questions why a five-year exclusive right is needed given advice from the Raad van State and MBO-Raad that other tools suffice.
Both the Raad van State and the MBO-Raad state in their respective responses that there are sufficient options besides the exclusive right to protect these courses.
Zowel de Raad van State als de MBO-Raad geven in hun respectievelijke reacties op het wetsvoorstel aan dat er voldoende mogelijkheden naast het alleenrecht zijn om deze opleidingen te beschermen.

Welcomes flexibility but finds the conditions for the exclusive right insufficiently sharp, asking how 'no help from self-regulation' is defined and how the SBB and Commissie macrodoelmatigheid divide roles.
How is it defined that the sector chamber for specialist craftsmanship of the SBB no longer offers 'no help'?
Hoe is gedefinieerd dat de sectorkamer specialistisch vakmanschap van het SBB 8 «geen soelaas» meer biedt?
Asks about student voting rights in both participating institutions' works councils and whether councils have advisory rights over the cooperation agreement.
They ask whether a student has voting rights in the participants' council elections of both institutions or only of the course from which they receive the diploma.
Zij vragen of een leerling stemrecht in de deelnemersraadsverkiezingen van beide instellingen heeft of slechts op de opleiding waarvan de leerlingen het diploma ontvangt.
Supports the exclusive right as a means to protect specialist expertise but asks why self-regulation via the SBB sector chamber falls short and what hinders the SBB.
How does the government explain that self-regulation via the sector chamber for specialist craftsmanship can fall so short?
Hoe verklaart de regering dat de zelfregulering via de sectorkamer specialistisch vakmanschap zo tekort kan schieten?

Asks what justifies the far-reaching power to grant an exclusive right when self-regulation fails, whether there is reason to think institutions cannot self-regulate, and on what indicators extensions would be based.
The aforementioned members request the government to further explain what justifies this far-reaching power.
De voornoemde leden verzoeken de regering nader toe te lichten wat deze vergaande bevoegdheid rechtvaardigt.
Notes the bill does not yet make clear what considerations will guide granting an exclusive right and asks whether an institution offering a course alone can expect to receive it.
They note that from the proposal and explanatory memorandum it is not yet clear which considerations will guide the granting of the exclusive right.
De leden van de SGP-fractie constateren dat uit het voorstel en de toelichting nog niet duidelijk wordt welke overwegingen bij het toekennen van het alleenrecht leidend zullen zijn.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill introducing a samenwerkingscollege for mbo institutions, an exclusive right (alleenrecht) for small threatened vocational programmes, and an extended task for the Commissie macrodoelmatigheid, asking for justification of state intervention, a statutory basis for the committee's extended task, clarification on data-sharing limits, and consultation of BES island authorities. The government's nader rapport accepted the statutory-basis point, added justification and explanation in the memorie van toelichting on the alleenrecht, data-sharing and BES consultation, and adopted the redactional remarks.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a substantiated justification of the alleenrecht given existing self-regulation and price-factor options; the government added explanation to the memorie van toelichting but maintained the instrument.
The Commissie macrodoelmatigheid's extended task lacked a statutory basis, and the government added one in article I, onderdeel K as advised.

The Afdeling questioned why data-sharing barriers are removed only for the samenwerkingscollege; the government clarified the reasons in the explanatory memorandum and kept the limited statutory basis.
Consultation of the BES island authorities under WolBES was advised; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented to state that Caribbean schools were given the opportunity to respond.
Redactional remarks on samenloop with other WEBBES amendments were largely adopted, though the first remark on the reference to the Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs was not followed.

34736.s: The bill makes several procedural changes in criminal justice: it allows the investigating judge to extend once, by up to seven weeks, the observation period for a defendant's mental fitness assessment, and extends the enforcement of Dutch administrative fines on working and rest time to other EU states. It also lets the RSJ appeal chamber chair decide manifestly inadmissible, manifestly unfounded or manifestly well-founded appeals alone, and shortens the review period for certain detention orders and adjusts the Wet langdurig toezicht provisions.
34736.j: The memorandum justifies the observation extension by the need to obtain conclusive expert reports from refusing defendants and the single-judge procedure by rising appeal caseloads and the RSJ's workload.
q: When the defendant refuses to cooperate with the examination, a conclusive advice often cannot be drawn up.
Wanneer de verdachte medewerking aan het onderzoek weigert, kan vaak geen concludent advies worden opgesteld.
p: Allows the investigating judge to extend the observation period of a remand defendant once by up to seven weeks, on request of the prosecutor, without requiring new expert opinion, with appeal available.
Article III A, IV C, V A (art. 69/67/74 penitentiary and related laws)
Allows a single judge of the appeal committee to dispose of manifestly inadmissible, unfounded or well-founded complaints, with the power to refer any case back to the full committee at any time.

Removes the maximum duration for conditional termination of detention and extends supervision of former offenders, with the public prosecution service given more time to file for enforcement of the GVM measure.

parties: Questions the legal basis and coverage of cross-border enforcement of administrative fines and whether enforcement is adequately secured, and asks how many appeal cases a single judge could decide.
It is still not entirely clear to these members whether this obstacle has now been fully removed by the proposed amendment.</gr_replace>
Het is deze leden nog niet helemaal duidelijk of deze belemmering nu geheel is weggenomen met de voorliggende wijziging.
Supports the proposals as consistent with its views and has no questions or remarks.
The subjects and proposals are in line with what these members advocate.</gr_replace>
De onderwerpen en de voorstellen liggen in lijn met wat deze leden voorstaan.

Supports allowing the judge-commissioner a single extension of the observation period, while asking whether extended enforcement periods also apply to the confiscation measure and whether the 10-to-30-day deadline reduction still fits its rationale.
These members ask whether this also applies to the confiscation measure.</gr_replace>
Deze leden vragen of dit ook geldt voor de ontnemingsmaatregel.

Asks how the care and quality of single-judge decisions is safeguarded, whether complainants' legal protection remains guaranteed, and how the reference to the chair versus a designated member is to be understood.
Moreover, to what extent does the legal protection of a complainant remain guaranteed?</gr_replace>
In hoeverre blijft bovendien de rechtsbescherming van een klager gewaarborgd?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the proposed amendment to the Wet internationale misdrijven (extending the criminalisation of obstructing humanitarian aid to non-international armed conflicts) be split off into a separate bill, because it is a principled change of course not suited to an omnibus procedural bill. The government followed this advice, removed the Wim amendment from the bill, and made some editorial changes; no other objections were raised.
concerns: The Wim amendment, a principled departure from the ICC-alignment policy, should be removed from the omnibus bill and handled in a separate bill.
Minor editorial changes to the Wim amendment were made, and a duplicate change to article I, part A was dropped since it was already provided for in another act.

34745.s: The bill amends the Dutch Wet informatie-uitwisseling ondergrondse netten to let network operators store location and contact information in the electronic system, requires operators and excavators to agree on precautionary measures, and assigns exclusive jurisdiction for disputes to the Rotterdam court and the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven. It also grants a transitional exemption from digitising service-line location data until 2019 or 2027 and requires a five-yearly evaluation report to parliament.
34745.j: The memorandum justifies the transitional exemption by stating that immediate digitisation duties would impose disproportionately high costs on some operators.
q: an immediate entry into force of the obligation to provide location data on such service lines is expected to lead to disproportionately high costs for some of these operators.

leidt een onmiddellijke inwerkingtreding van de verplichting liggingsgegevens over dergelijke aansluitleidingen te verstrekken naar verwachting tot onevenredig hoge kosten voor een deel van deze beheerders.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel R (artikel 45, eerste lid, WION)
exemption from duty to supply location data for service lines

parties: Asks about the phased timeline for digital location data, the three-day response deadline for network operators, and how the Agentschap Telecom will supervise compliance.
The CDA asks how the Agentschap Telecom officials designated to supervise compliance with the law will organise that supervision and how it will work in practice.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen op welke manier de ambtenaren van het Agentschap Telecom, die zijn aangewezen om toezicht te houden op de naleving van de bepalingen uit de wet, het toezicht gaan inrichten en hoe dit in de praktijk precies in zijn werk zal gaan.
Asks about the timing of a planned cost-reduction review for companies that dig only on their own premises and how shared sites such as Chemelot would be treated.
The VVD asks by when the exploration of cost relief for companies that carry out digging work only on their own premises is expected.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen op welke termijn de verkenning van een lastenverlichting voor bedrijven die uitsluitend graafwerkzaamheden verrichten op het eigen terrein wordt verwacht.

34763.s: The bill extends the mayor's power under Article 13b of the Opium Act to impose a closure order under administrative coercion on a home, room or adjoining plot where objects or substances intended for drug production or large-scale or commercial illegal cannabis cultivation are present, even when no drugs are found. The explanatory memorandum justifies this as a preventive tool to close off preparatory drug-production activity, while noting proportionality safeguards under the General Administrative Law Act.
34763.j: The memorandum justifies the expansion as needed because criminals evade current drug rules, and says the mayor's closure power is a preventive, reparatory sanction that does not require landlord culpability, with proportionality under Article 3:4 Awb.
q: Closure must be possible as soon as the property forms a link in the production or distribution of drugs, even if there are (as yet) no direct consequences for the local living environment.
Sluiting moet mogelijk zijn zodra het pand een schakel vormt in de productie of distributie van drugs, ook als er (nog) geen directe gevolgen zijn voor de lokale woon- en leefomgeving.
p: Artikel I (artikel 13b, eerste lid, onderdeel b, Opiumwet)

The mayor may close a home, room or plot on the basis of objects or substances linked to preparatory drug offences, without drugs being present, widening closure discretion against occupants and landlords.

parties: Welcomes the broader closure power as a valuable addition against organised and undermining crime and asks for a concrete example of when a mayor may assume the subjective element is met.

The possibility to close a premises as soon as it forms a link in the production or distribution of drugs, even if no drugs are found, they see as a valuable addition in tackling organised and undermining crime.

De mogelijkheid om een pand te sluiten zodra het een schakel vormt in de productie of distributie van drugs, ook als er geen drugs worden aangetroffen, zien zij als een waardevolle toevoeging in de aanpak van georganiseerde en ondermijnende criminaliteit.
Supports the extension as an effective tool and asks why vehicles or money under Article 11a are excluded from the closure power and how mayors meet the subjective element.

The closure power under Article 13b of the Opium Act is an effective means for mayors to act actively against drug trafficking and these members therefore wish to see this closure power extended as the bill intends.

De sluitingsbevoegdheid uit artikel 13b van de Opiumwet is een effectief middel voor burgemeesters om actief op te treden tegen drugshandel en deze leden zien deze sluitingsbevoegdheid dan ook graag uitgebreid zoals het wetsvoorstel beoogd.
Accepts the need for the extension if proportionate and legally certain, but asks what motivation standard applies to the mayor's decision and how the subjective element is substantiated.
However, the members believe that the elaboration of this additional power of the mayor must be clear and must provide legal certainty.
Wel zijn de leden van mening dat de uitwerking van deze aanvullende bevoegdheid van de burgemeester duidelijk moet zijn en rechtszekerheid moet bieden.

Argues the closure carries a punitive character that should be imposed by an independent criminal judge, and asks why the Wet strafbaarstelling voorbereiding illegale hennepteelt route is not used instead.

These members ask whether it would not be obvious to have such a far-reaching infringement on an interest protected in most cases by constitutional and treaty law (namely respect for private life and the sanctity of the home) imposed by an independent (criminal) judge.

Deze leden vragen of het hierbij niet voor de hand ligt om een dergelijke verstrekkende inbreuk op een in de meeste gevallen grond- en verdragsrechtelijk beschermd belang (namelijk de eerbiediging van privéleven en huisvrede) door een onafhankelijke (straf)rechter te laten opleggen.
Worries about disproportionate closures, families being left homeless, and mayors' discretion; asks for a judicial check before closure and a proportionality clause in the article itself.

It therefore seems of great importance to these members that, at the very least, in addition to the general proportionality principle of Article 3:4(2) of the General Administrative Law Act, a proportionality clause is also included in the article itself.

Het lijkt deze leden dan ook van groot belang dat er ministens naast het algemene proportionaliteitsbeginsel uit artikel 3:4, tweede lid, van de Algemene Wet Bestuursrecht ook in het artikel zelf een proportionaliteitsclausule wordt opgenomen.
Asks how the interests of professional owners and managers are considered given that culpability of the landlord is not required for closure.
The members of the ChristenUnie faction note that culpability of the landlord of the premises is not considered a requirement for the closure power.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie constateren dat verwijtbaarheid van de verhuurder van het pand geen vereiste wordt geacht voor de sluitingsbevoegdheid.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises sending the bill extending the mayor's closing power under the Opium Act to premises containing objects intended for drug production, but asks that the explanatory memorandum be revised on the burden of proof regarding the subjective element of the offences. The government reply (nader rapport) explains that the mayor's administrative assessment based on police-established facts will have real practical significance and does not dispute the advice.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum wrongly suggests the mayor need not demonstrate the subjective element of preparatory offences, which conflicts with the intended alignment with case law; the Afdeling asks for this to be revised.

The Afdeling considers the mayor's burden to show the subjective element to be of little practical significance, whereas the government argues that the administrative assessment will matter in practice.

34808.s: The bill rewrites the Dutch anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing act (Wwft) to implement EU Directive 2015/849 and Regulation 2015/847, widening scope to gambling providers and dealers in cash transactions of EUR 10,000 or more, and introducing risk-based customer due diligence, group policies, and a broader sanctions and publication regime for supervisors. It also strengthens the Financial Intelligence Unit's information powers and cross-border cooperation.
34808.j: The memorandum justifies delegations and new powers mainly as necessary to implement the EU directive and regulation and to apply risk-based rules proportionately.
q: The scope of the directive is extended to new categories of institutions, namely providers of gambling services and persons who trade in goods professionally or commercially where cash payments of EUR 10,000 or more are made or received.

Het toepassingsbereik van de richtlijn wordt uitgebreid naar nieuwe categorieën instellingen, te weten de aanbieders van kansspeldiensten en personen die beroeps- of bedrijfsmatig in goederen handelen
d: additional categories of professions covered by the act
exemption of payment service agents from obligations for proven low risk
exemptions for institutions with incidental financial activity
assigning supervisory tasks under EU regulations; further rules on supervisor conduct
exemption of banks in central credit institution groups from DNB supervision
thresholds and risk-based scope of customer due diligence
simplified customer due diligence for low-risk relationships
p: Supervisory tasks are allocated across several designated supervisors and the Minister may further regulate their conduct.
Enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons is set out in detail for institutions.
Financial Intelligence Unit gains broader information-exchange and request powers with other EU units.
Supervisors may publish sanction decisions before they become final and may impose temporary bans on management, subject to a five-day window for interim relief.

parties: Asks why many matters are delegated to lower regulation rather than the statute, how the House is involved, and why no pre-consultation (voorhang) procedure is provided.
How is the House of Representatives involved in that further regulation?
Hoe wordt de Tweede Kamer betrokken bij die nadere regelgeving?
Raises concerns about publication of fine decisions before they are final and about data sharing with EU states with weaker data protection, asking for safeguards for citizens.
What rights then remain for the company or the affected creditors?
Welke rechten zijn er dan nog voor het bedrijf of de getroffen crediteuren?
Asks the government to respond to the Council of State's criticism that publishing sanction decisions before they are irrevocable may cause harm if the decision later fails.
These members ask the government to respond to the critical remark of the Council of State regarding the possible adverse consequences of publishing sanction decisions before they are irrevocable.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering te reageren op de kritische kanttekening van de Raad van State ten aanzien van de mogelijke nadelige gevolgen van het publiceren van sanctiebesluiten voordat die onherroepelijk zijn.

Objects that many matters are set in lower regulation, limiting parliamentary input, and asks for prior parliamentary involvement; also raises concerns about the late UBO register bill and tax-fraud procedures lasting years.
Is it the government's intention to thereby limit the House's say, these members ask.
Is het de bedoeling van de regering om hiermee de inspraak van de Kamer te beperken, zo vragen deze leden.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises sending the Implementatiewet vierde anti-witwasrichtlijn to parliament but asks for better justification on early publication of unappealed fines, on delegating the exemption threshold for low-risk institutions to the minister, and on the late implementation and its consequences. The government's nader rapport accepts the points, adding explanation in the memorie van toelichting, moving the exemption rules to an algemene maatregel van bestuur, and noting limited consequences of the delay.
concerns: The Afdeling found it insufficiently clear how publishing sanctions before they become final contributes to the effectiveness of anti-money-laundering rules, and asked for explanation in the explanatory memorandum, which the government added.

The Afdeling found no justification for delegating to the minister the national policy choices on exempting low-risk institutions, and the government moved the rules to an algemene maatregel van bestuur while keeping a ministerial power to grant exemptions.
The Afdeling asked the explanation to address the consequences of the late implementation and how further delay will be prevented, which the government added in the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling made redactional comments on the transposition table and on article 13a, which the government incorporated.

34826.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Nuth, Onderbanken and Schinnen into a new municipality called Beekdaelen, effective on a date set by royal decree. It also makes consequential amendments to the Wet algemene regels herindeling, the Wet maatregelen woningmarkt 2014 II and the Wet veiligheidsregio's.
q: This law enters into force on a date to be determined by royal decree.
Deze wet treedt in werking op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip.
d: fixing the date the law takes effect by royal decree

parties: Welcomes the voluntary merger and raises no remarks or questions.
The bill gives the VVD members no reason to make remarks or ask questions.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft de leden van de VVD-fractie geen aanleiding tot het maken van opmerkingen en het stellen van vragen.
Asks the government to send the reorganisation advice and the province's view to the House, since publication on a website is not equivalent to submission to parliament.
They are of the view that publication on a website cannot be equated with submission to the House of Representatives.
Zij zijn van mening dat publicatie op een website niet gelijkgesteld kan worden met aanbieding aan de Tweede Kamer.
Asks whether residents' concerns in Hulsberg and Schimmert were addressed and whether other municipal options were explored.
Have the municipalities explored options to join these parts of Nuth to another municipality?
Hebben de gemeenten opties verkend om deze delen van Nuth bij een andere gemeente te voegen?
Asks how residents, organisations and local politics were involved in the proposal and how accessibility of services is guaranteed.

These members ask the government to explain again how the residents, social organisations and local politics of the municipalities concerned were involved in drafting the municipal reorganisation proposal.

Deze leden vragen de regering om nog eens nader uiteen te zetten hoe de inwoners, maatschappelijke organisaties en de lokale politiek van de betreffende gemeenten betrokken zij geweest bij de totstandkoming van het voorstel tot gemeentelijke herindeling.
Questions whether a majority of residents supports the merger, why no citizen consultation was held, and why reorganisation proceeds without majority support; also questions the financial basis.
According to the SP members, reorganisations should only take place from the bottom up, when the population supports them.
Herindelingen zouden volgens de leden van de SP-fractie alleen plaats moeten vinden van onderaf, als hiervoor steun is van de bevolking.
Supports the merger and has no further questions at this stage.
These members endorse the planned merger of these municipalities.
Deze leden onderschrijven de voorgenomen samenvoeging van deze gemeenten.

34871.s: The bill modernises the 1855 Ministerial Responsibility Act: it updates terminology to the current Constitution, clarifies that ministers, state secretaries and members of parliament can be prosecuted for official offences before the Supreme Court, and sets out the procedure for prosecution orders by the government (royal decree) or by the House of Representatives after a complaint and inquiry. It also drops the rule that a pending complaint lapses on dissolution of the House, and makes minor consequential amendments to the Criminal Procedure Code and Criminal Code.
34871.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as modernisation to match the current Constitution's terminology and the 2015 inquiry's finding that the act is outdated, and argues that dropping the lapse rule on dissolution follows the modern constitutional view.
q: Thus, having heard the Advisory Division of the Council of State and in joint consultation with the States General, We have resolved and enacted as follows.
Zo is het, dat Wij, de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State gehoord, en met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan.
p: The government keeps its own power to order prosecution of ministers and members of parliament by royal decree, alongside the House's power, with the prosecutor-general obliged to act on either order.
After a complaint is rejected or lapses, the government may still order prosecution by royal decree for the same facts, although rejected complaints otherwise bar renewed investigation.
Civil damages for official offences by ministers and members can only follow a Supreme Court conviction, a restriction on victims' compensation claims.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a limited technical modernisation bill of the Wet ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid, objecting that the proposed deletion of article 16(4) (lapse of a pending impeachment-type complaint on dissolution of the Tweede Kamer) lacked substantive justification and belonged in a later substantive bill. The government's reply added a fuller justification, citing the outdated discontinuity principle, and otherwise made minor drafting changes.
concerns: The Afdeling found no substantive reasoning for deleting article 16(4) Wmv and questioned why this substantive matter belongs in a technical bill.
Minor redactional points were corrected, including the ministry name, numbering of paragraphs, and references to the Aanwijzingen voor de regelgeving.

34916.s: The bill provides special procedural rules for prosecuting and trying criminal offences linked to the downing of MH17 in 2014, including assigning jurisdiction to The Hague district court, allowing Ukrainian prosecution requests against non-extraditable suspects, and permitting trial by videoconference and use of English. It implements a 2017 bilateral treaty with Ukraine and sets the bill's entry into force subject to the advisory referendum law.
34916.j: The memorandum justifies the special rules by the need to implement the 2017 Netherlands-Ukraine treaty and the impossibility of extraditing Ukrainian nationals.
q: For the specific situation of prosecuting and trying the downing of flight MH17, the bilateral treaty with Ukraine provides that suspects located on Ukrainian territory who cannot be extradited may stand trial using a videoconference link.

Voor de specifieke situatie van de vervolging en berechting van het neerhalen van vlucht MH17 is in het bilaterale verdrag met Oekraïne geregeld dat eventuele verdachten die zich op Oekraïens grondgebied bevinden en niet kunnen worden uitgeleverd, terecht kunnen staan met gebruik van een videoconferentieverbinding.
d: rules on implementing videoconference trial, including deviating from the videoconference decree
p: The minister forwards Ukrainian prosecution requests to the national prosecutor and the usual refusal ground for non-residents is set aside, reducing judicial screening of such requests.
Jurisdiction is fixed in The Hague district court rather than following the ordinary venue rules.
Trial by videoconference is allowed for suspects who consent before a rechter-commissaris, with the court deciding and only serious interests permitting refusal.

parties: Asks about the physical location of the court proceedings, whether existing facilities will be used or new ones built.
Is it already known what the physical location will be where the court cases are held?
Is al bekend wat de fysieke locatie zal zijn waar de rechtszaken worden gehouden?
Asks that the defendant's presence at trial be treated as the starting point rather than optional, and asks why the Dutch court cannot issue a bevel tot medebrenging against the Ukrainian suspect.
These members ask the government, in line with the comments on the approval bill, to remove the optionality from this article and to take as the starting point that the suspect is present.

Deze leden vragen de regering – in lijn met de opmerkingen gemaakt bij de tekst van het goedkeuringsvoorstel – de vrijblijvendheid uit dit artikel te halen en als uitgangspunt te nemen dat de verdachte aanwezig «is».
Questions whether the 9 million euro annual budget is adequate and why no suitable hearing location has yet been found, raising oversight of public spending and planning.
Does the government consider this amount sufficient to finance the trial?
Acht de regering dit bedrag afdoende om het proces te kunnen financieren?
Asks what the role of the Dutch defence lawyers will be and why a statutory arrangement, as advised by the Rvdr, is not needed, and asks how far the judge's freedom to use English extends.
Can it be further explained why a further statutory regulation, as advised by the Rvdr, is not necessary?
Kan nader worden toegelicht waarom een nadere wettelijke regeling zoals geadviseerd door de Rvdr niet nodig is?
Asks whether there are sufficient means to effectively handle civil claims of injured parties so that relatives can obtain their rights, following the Rvdr advice.

These members ask the government to further explain whether there are nevertheless sufficient means to effectively handle claims of injured parties, so that relatives can also obtain their rights on this point.

Deze leden verzoeken de regering nader toe te lichten of er desondanks voldoende wegen zijn om vorderingen van benadeelde partijen effectief te behandelen, zodat nabestaanden ook op dit punt hun recht kunnen halen.
Asks about the scope of jurisdiction transfer in cases of concurrence and the risk of ne bis in idem if Ukraine later wishes to prosecute.
What is the significance of this in light of the ne bis in idem principle if Ukraine later itself wishes to prosecute in such a case?
Wat is de betekenis hiervan in het licht van het principe «ne bis in idem» als Oekraïne later zelf in een dergelijke zaak zou willen berechten?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the MH17 implementing act and the Dutch-Ukrainian treaty on international legal cooperation, recommending the bills proceed after clarifying the explanatory memorandum on the relationship to the European Conventions (EVIG, EVOS, the Second Additional Protocol on videoconferencing) and a drafting point on delegation in article 4(8). The government's reply (nader rapport) largely adopted these points by supplementing the explanatory memoranda and making the bills' wording more precise, while noting that some Raad voor de rechtspraak remarks were not taken up.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to clarify the relationship between the treaty and the Second Additional Protocol declaration on videoconferencing, which the government did.
The Afdeling asked to state that the implementing act supplements and facilitates the EVIG and EVOS, which the explanatory memorandum now does.
The Afdeling advised narrowing the delegation basis in article 4(8) of the implementing act as concretely as possible under drafting guideline 2.23.
The Afdeling asked for more attention to the fair-trial safeguards for trials by videoconference, several of which the government did not address in detail.
A redactional remark was adopted in the revised bill.

34934.s: The bill implements Directive 2016/2341/EU on occupational pension institutions by amending the Pensioenwet and the Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling, the Wft cross-references, and related provisions. It tightens cross-border collective value transfers with stronger member and works-council approval, adds key functions (risk management, internal audit, actuarial) with reporting and whistleblower protection, and makes sanctions publication mandatory with limited exceptions.
34934.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new supervisory powers as necessary to implement the EU directive and to protect members and beneficiaries of cross-border pension transfers.
q: This bill serves to implement Directive 2016/2341/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14 December 2016 on the activities of and supervision of institutions for occupational retirement provision.

Dit wetsvoorstel dient ter implementatie van Richtlijn 2016/2341/EU van het Europees parlement en de Raad van 14 december 2016 betreffende de werkzaamheden van en het toezicht op instellingen voor bedrijfspensioenvoorziening
d: rules on contents of custodian agreement
p: Mandatory publication of sanctions by the supervisor, with a balancing test allowing delay or anonymisation and publication only after a decision becomes final.

The supervisor may share confidential information with EU supervisors, the European Parliament inquiry committee, the Algemene Rekenkamer and parliamentary inquiry committees despite the general secrecy duty.
The supervisor may require a pension fund to carry out a stress test.

parties: Asks whether the directive adds delegated powers for the Commission or EIOPA and whether DNB's powers over cross-border transfers are changed.

Can the government again confirm that there is no further harmonisation of capital requirements for pension funds, that the directive contains no delegated powers, and that there is no room for the European Commission or EIOPA to set further conditions or requirements for pension funds?

Kan de regering nogmaals bevestigen dat er geen sprake is van een (verdere) harmonisering van de kapitaaleisen voor pensioenfondsen, dat er geen gedelegeerde bevoegdheden zijn opgenomen in de richtlijn en dat er geen ruimte is voor de Europese Commissie of Europese Autoriteit voor verzekeringen en bedrijfspensioenen (EIOPA) om nadere voorwaarden of eisen aan pensioenfondsen te stellen?
Opposes EU regulation of pensions on sovereignty grounds and asks the government to withdraw the bill.
We therefore request the government to withdraw the bill and not proceed with implementation.</br>
Wij verzoeken de regering dan ook het wetsvoorstel in te trekken en niet tot implementatie over te gaan.
Strongly opposes cross-border transfers as enabling regulatory arbitrage, questions DNB's limited grounds to block transfers, and asks for implementing rules to be shared early.
DNB cannot block such a transfer because of insufficient supervision in the receiving country.</br>
DNB kan zo’n waardeoverdracht niet tegenhouden vanwege onvoldoende toezicht in het ontvangende land.
Asks on what grounds DNB can block a cross-border transfer and whether DNB has discretion or only objective criteria.
Is this an objective test based on fixed criteria, or does DNB have a degree of policy discretion in cross-border transfers?
Betreft het hier een objectieve toets op basis van vaste criteria, of heeft DNB bij grensoverschrijdende waardeoverdrachten een mate van beleidsvrijheid?
Asks about the scope of the directive, the meaning of adequate remuneration policy, and the timing and content of pension statements and benefit cuts notice.
Why is the notice period for (former) participants not also extended to at least three months as the AFM proposes?
Waarom wordt de termijn voor (gewezen) deelnemers ook niet verlengd naar tenminste drie maanden zoals het AFM voorstelt?

Worries that collective value transfers of IORPs abroad, exploiting lower discount rates in other member states, could weaken Dutch funding standards and member protection, and asks the government for precise answers and the draft delegated regulation.
The members of the CDA fractie are particularly concerned about possible collective value transfers of IORPs abroad.
De leden van de CDA-fractie maken zich in het bijzonder zorgen over mogelijke collectieve waardeoverdrachten van IORP’s naar het buitenland.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering advised that the bill implementing EU pension directives 2016/2341 and 2014/50 may proceed, but asked for clarification of how the outsourcing of key functions by pension funds is to be limited and what this means in practice. The government's reply accepts the point, adds clarification in the explanatory memorandum on the conditions for outsourcing key functions, and splits the bill into two separate bills.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to explain the implications of the directive for persons holding key functions who do not determine day-to-day policy, and what this means in practice.
The government added to the explanatory memorandum the framework within which pension funds and PPIs may outsource key functions, referring to article 12 of the Besluit uitvoering Pensioenwet en Wvb.

34960-IIB.s: The bill amends the 2018 budget (first supplementary budget) for the Hoge Colleges van Staat (Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kiesraad) and the governors' cabinets, raising expenditure by about EUR 17.4 million. It makes the amended budget statute effective from 1 June 2018, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Following the task-and-resources analysis, additional funds were added to the budget this cabinet period to secure the statutory tasks of the Hoge Colleges van Staat (Council of State, Court of Audit and National Ombudsman).

Naar aanleiding van de taken Middelen Analyse zijn voor borging van de uitvoering van de wettelijke taken van de Hoge Colleges van Staat (Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer en Nationale ombudsman) in deze kabinetsperiode extra middelen aan de begroting toegevoegd.

35087.s: The bill allows orthopedagogen-generalist, health psychologists and physicians to act as Wzd-functionaris under the coercive care act, replacing the Wzd-arts role, and registers orthopedagogen-generalist as a BIG profession subject to disciplinary law. It also reinstates a police-style investigative power (location tracking, interception, data requests) for the public prosecutor to trace persons evading compulsory mental health care, and amends the Wet toelating zorginstellingen accordingly.
35087.j: The memorandum justifies the investigative powers by the need to trace persons who abscond from compulsory care quickly, citing prosecutor examples and privacy safeguards such as investigating judge authorisation.
q: An investigating officer cannot decide independently to use these powers, but may only do so on the order of the public prosecutor.
Een opsporingsambtenaar kan niet zelfstandig beslissen tot het gebruik van deze bevoegdheden, maar mag dit alleen op bevel van de officier van justitie.
d: rules on issuing orders and requesting data for tracing persons evading compulsory care
categories of communication data that may be requested
training requirements for registration as orthopedagoog-generalist
p: Allows the public prosecutor, after authorisation by an investigating judge, to order following, interception of communications, and data requests to trace persons evading compulsory mental health care, limited to life-threatening or serious-crime situations with time limits and written orders.
Limits the mandatory involvement of an external expert in advising on care plans to cases where phasing out involuntary care fails within set deadlines.

parties: Asks whether implementation risks delaying the three laws' entry into force on 1 January 2020 and how responsibilities are allocated.
These members nonetheless ask whether implementing the proposed amendments risks delaying the entry into force of the three underlying laws on 1 January 2020.

Bij genoemde leden roept het wetsvoorstel nog wel de vraag op of de implementatie van de voorgestelde wijzigingen risico's met zich meebrengt op vertraging rond de inwerkingtreding van de onderliggende drie wetten per 1 januari 2020.
Worries that broadening definitions and the Wzd-functionaris lowers the threshold for coercive measures and that medical causes may be overlooked.
Changing the Wzd-arts into a Wzd-functionaris is a good example, because more people can then decide on a far-reaching measure such as involuntary care.
Het wijzigen van de Wzd-arts in Wzd-functionaris is daar een goed voorbeeld van, want hierdoor kunnen meer mensen beslissen over een ingrijpende maatregel zoals onvrijwillige zorg.
Questions whether legal protection of clients with intellectual disability or dementia is adequate, especially the CVP notification gap compared with the Wvggz.

In general, these members want to know whether the government considers the legal protection of people with an intellectual disability and/or psychogeriatric condition sufficient after adoption of this bill.

In zijn algemeenheid willen genoemde leden weten of de regering de rechtsbescherming van mensen met een verstandelijke beperking en/of psychogeriatrische aandoening na aanneming van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel voldoende vindt.
Asks for justification given KNMG objections and why child psychologists were excluded; questions limiting external expert involvement.
There has been considerable debate in the field about deploying behavioural experts as the Wzd-functionaris.
Over de inzet van gedragskundigen als de Wzd-functionaris is de nodige discussie ontstaan in het veld.
Asks that all locations be registered unless shown no involuntary care is given, and that clients be informed of the right to a independent client advocate.
The GroenLinks members also consider it very important that clients have access to an advocate independent of their own care.
Tevens vinden de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie het heel belangrijk dat cliënten toegang hebben tot een vertrouwenspersoon die los staat van zijn of haar eigen zorg.
Regrets that the Chamber-adopted amendment requiring a physician was not implemented and questions the government's reliance on proponents' arguments; asks for external expertise to be preserved.
The SP members therefore wish to stress that they regret that its amendment is not being implemented.
De leden van de SP-fractie willen dan ook graag benadrukken dat zij het betreuren dat haar amendement niet wordt uitgevoerd.
Asks why the Raad van State's negative advice on the discrepancy with the Wvggz was not followed and how quality and client protection are guaranteed.
The Council of State gave negative advice on this discrepancy.
De Raad van State gaf een negatief advies ten aanzien van deze discrepantie.
Notes the resulting inequality in legal protection between the Wzd and Wvggz and asks for justification of the late addition of the orthopedagoog-generalist.
Does the government consider this inequality desirable and acceptable, these members ask.
Acht de regering deze ongelijkheid wenselijk en aanvaardbaar, zo vragen genoemde leden.
Asks why some professions may act as Wzd-functionaris and others not, and whether the CCE recommendation on external expertise was followed up.
Can the government explain why certain professional groups can advise the Wzd-functionaris as external experts or care-responsible persons but cannot themselves become Wzd-functionaris?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom bepaalde beroepsgroepen wel als externe deskundige of zorgverantwoordelijke de Wzd-functionaris kunnen adviseren, maar zelf geen Wzd-functionaris kunnen worden?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the proposed amendment to the Wzd, allowing other BIG-registered professions besides doctors to serve as Wzd-functionaris, should be limited in the statute itself to a GZ-psychologist, since the broad delegation suggested all BIG professions could fill the role. The government's reply accepts the advice and adds that academically trained orthopedagogues will also be designated, with a BIG-type register created for them.
concerns: The broad ministerial-regulation delegation to designate categories of experts wrongly suggests all BIG professions could serve as Wzd-functionaris, so the statutory definition should be limited to a doctor or GZ-psychologist.
The academically trained orthopedagogue is not a BIG-registered profession and therefore cannot fall under the proposed definition, requiring the statute to be adjusted accordingly.

35095-IIB.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2018 budget for the other high state bodies, the governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, adjusting spending and commitments across articles such as the Council of State, the Court of Audit and the National Ombudsman. The memorandum explains the mutations mainly as reallocations of wage and price adjustments and project funding, with no new powers for the executive.
35095-IIB.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to wage and price adjustments and the financing of the digital litigation project, not by any delegation of power.
q: This concerns the allocation of the 2018 wage and price adjustment.
Dit betreft de verdeling van de loon- en de prijsbijstelling 2018.

35186.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the 2016 Agreement on political dialogue and cooperation between the EU and its member states and the Republic of Cuba, as required under Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It provides that the law enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: Alongside the Union, the member states must therefore also become parties to the Agreement.
Naast de Unie dienen daarom ook de lidstaten partij te worden bij het Verdrag.

parties: Asks how much confidence the government has in Cuba's commitment to combat discrimination and what concrete human rights cooperation is possible, given reports of discrimination and asylum claims.

Asks whether the conditions of the former common position have been met, what the government expects from the human rights dialogue, and whether it will raise LGBTI rights bilaterally and within the agreement.
Is the government of the opinion that these conditions have been met to reach a new agreement?
Is de regering van mening dat aan deze voorwaarden is voldaan om tot een nieuwe overeenkomst te komen?

Supports engagement over isolation but is concerned about intimidation of activists, censorship and restricted access for human rights organisations, and asks whether the agreement allows pressure or sanctions.
The human rights situation under the communist regime remains worrying.
De mensenrechtensituatie onder het communistische regime blijft zorgwekkend.
Asks what progress has been made on strengthening human rights and civil society in Cuba since signature, how the human rights dialogue is progressing, and the role of the Dutch embassy.
The GroenLinks members commend the Netherlands' efforts to strengthen and protect human rights in Cuba.
De leden van de GroenLinksfractie prijzen de inzet van Nederland ten aanzien van de versterking en bescherming van mensenrechten in Cuba.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering advised that the EU-Cuba political dialogue and cooperation agreement may affect the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom and that the explanatory memorandum should explain their involvement, and that they could become parties if desired. The government replied that the Caribbean parts fall outside the agreement's scope under the EU treaties and Rijkswet criteria, and added a clarifying passage to the memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling said the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom may be affected by the agreement and that the explanatory memorandum should address their involvement; the government disagreed on substance but added a clarifying passage on why they fall outside the agreement.
The memorandum was updated and minor editorial corrections were made in response to the advice.

35195.s: The bill requires schools to admit pupils holding a vmbo theoretical or mixed-pathway diploma to havo year 4, barring refusal based on the school's judgement of the pupil's knowledge, skills or attitude. It allows an algemene maatregel van bestuur (general administrative order) to set admission conditions on knowledge, skills or attitude, with the government free to adjust or drop them.
35195.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need for flexibility to respond to curriculum reform and transfer-programme developments, allowing quick adjustment or removal of the condition.
q: To respond flexibly to these developments, it was chosen to delegate the power to set the transfer condition to the government.
Om met de benodigde flexibiliteit in te kunnen spelen op deze ontwikkelingen, is ervoor gekozen om de bevoegdheid tot vaststelling van de doorstroomvoorwaarde aan de regering te delegeren.
d: Artikel I, B (art. 27a, lid 2 WVO); Artikel II, B (art. 64a, lid 2 WVO BES)
admission conditions for vmbo-havo transfer on knowledge, skills, attitude
p: Artikel I, B (art. 27a WVO); Artikel II, B (art. 64a WVO BES)
Removes schools' discretion to refuse vmbo graduates on competence grounds and lets the executive set admission conditions by amvb without parliamentary approval.

parties: Asks how schools may still differ on entry requirements, which criteria apply, and whether leerlingen can be obliged to take extra courses, and how the Inspectie will judge schools.
How will the government ensure that vmbo pupils can keep up with the pace of havo pupils without disadvantaging havo pupils?
Hoe gaat de regering ervoor zorgen dat de leerlingen van het vmbo meekunnen met het tempo van havoleerlingen zonder havoleerlingen te benadelen?
Questions why a statutory rule is needed instead of a revised toelatingscode with Inspectie enforcement, and why the AMvB route and timing were chosen before the new curriculum takes effect.
Would it not have made more sense to first examine the shortcomings in how the toelatingscode worked?
Had het niet meer in de rede gelegen dat de tekortkomingen met betrekking tot de werking van de toelatingscode eerst onder de loep waren genomen?
Supports equal entry conditions but asks whether additional conditions can later be set and what limits the law places on them, and why programmes were not chosen over a condition.
Will it be possible in future to set additional transfer conditions, and does the law set limits on the conditions that may be imposed?
Is het in de toekomst mogelijk aanvullende doorstroomvoorwaarden te stellen? En stelt de wet grenzen aan de voorwaarden die gesteld kunnen worden?
Wants as few restrictions as possible on vmbo-to-havo transfer and asks how the rule against refusing pupils on other grounds is monitored and enforced.
How does the government guarantee that this ground for refusal will not be used to specifically refuse vmbo-gl or -tl pupils?
Hoe garandeert de regering dat deze weigeringsgrond niet wordt gebruikt om specifiek vmbo-gl- of -tl-leerlingen te weigeren?
Welcomes generous transfer chances for late bloomers and objects to unequal treatment between schools, while asking for the government's view on the scope of school freedom of organisation.
This means an inequality of opportunity that cannot be justified by the constitutional freedom of schools to organise themselves.
Dit betekent een kansenongelijkheid die niet valt te rechtvaardigen met de grondwettelijke inrichtingsvrijheid van scholen.

Worries that schools will lose the room to judge each pupil's suitability and that rigid rules will hamper a fair assessment, and questions the exclusion of a cijfereis and of other flexible criteria.
They consider it important that schools have sufficient room to assess pupils' chances and that rigidity resulting from new regulation is avoided.
Zij vinden het belangrijk dat scholen voldoende ruimte hebben om de kansen van leerlingen te kunnen beoordelen, en dat verstarring als gevolg nieuwe regelgeving wordt vermeden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the bill for equal transition from preparatory vocational education (vmbo-tl/gl) to havo, questioning whether the planned extra-subject condition is effective and why it is delegated by AMvB rather than set in law. The government's reply accepts changes: the delegation is made non-imperative, broadened to knowledge, skills and learning attitude, and the memorandum is revised, while defending the extra-subject condition and rejecting the Council's suggestion on doubling bans.
concerns: The Council doubts that requiring an extra subject exam effectively improves the vmbo-havo transition; the government disagrees but makes the condition non-imperative and will consider a profile-linked subject.
The Council questions why the condition is left to an AMvB and why the delegation grounds are so broad; the government broadens and explains the delegation, but keeps flexibility.
The Council says the breadth of delegation could allow more conditions such as grade requirements; the government sees no reason to exclude a grade requirement from the delegation.
The Council advises removing passages treating a doubling ban as an admission condition; the government removed the link from the explanatory memorandum.

35210-IV.s: This bill amends the 2019 budget statements (first supplementary budget) for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds (H), adjusting spending and receipts for rule of law, socio-economic structure, loans to Curaçao and Sint Maarten, and reconstruction of the Caribbean islands. It sets entry into force from 1 June 2019 with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) and of the budget statement of the BES-fund (H), all for the year 2019.
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) en van de begrotingsstaat van het begrotingsfonds BES-fonds (H), alle voor het jaar 2019.

35210-VI.s: This bill amends the 2019 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security and the budget statements for its agencies (first supplementary budget), raising appropriations and receipts by specified amounts in thousands of euros. It also sets the effective date of 1 June 2019, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: We have approved and resolved ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security (VI) for the year 2019 is amended
Wij ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid (VI) voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd

35249.s: The bill adds a second section to the Faillissementswet creating a court-homologated out-of-court composition (WHOA) that lets a debtor, creditors, shareholders or works council obtain appointment of a restructuring expert, offer a binding composition, and have the court homologate it even over dissenting classes, with a cooling-off period and court-authorised financing protections. It also amends the court fee act and related provisions so that the court's involvement is limited to defined points and creditors retain appeal and objection rights.
35249.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the court's limited involvement as a way to make the procedure efficient while keeping necessary judicial safeguards for creditors and shareholders.
q: To give parties as much room as possible to reach an agreement tailored to the specific circumstances, the WHOA is designed as a framework regulation as far as possible.

Om partijen zo veel mogelijk ruimte te bieden om in goed overleg tot een akkoord te komen dat is toegesneden op de specifieke omstandigheden van het geval, is de WHOA zo veel mogelijk vormgegeven als een kaderregeling.
d: court rulings on preliminary composition issues before vote
p: Court-appointed restructuring experts and observers can act on the debtor's behalf in a composition process, with creditors given a chance to comment before court decisions.

parties: Asks whether the Directive's consent requirement for SME debtors undermines creditors' and employees' right to initiate an arrangement, potentially letting controlling shareholders block a creditor-friendly deal.
The requirement of the debtor's consent may lead to an infringement of creditors' and employees' right to initiate an arrangement.
Het vereiste van instemming van de schuldenaar kan zorgen voor een aantasting van het recht van crediteuren en werknemers om een akkoord te initiëren.
Asks how the absence of appeal or cassation against homologation is offset, and how prejudicial questions to the Supreme Court will be handled quickly given the urgency of insolvency.
Supports the bill's aims of preventing harmful creditor or shareholder conduct and disproportionate restructuring burdens on other financiers.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the Bill on court approval of an out-of-court debt restructuring agreement (WHOA) may proceed after changes, notably a clearer explanation of its practical impact on SMEs, a specialised court or chamber, protection of small debtors, and advance payment of the expert's costs. The government's reply accepts most points, adds some alignment with the final EU directive, and explains where it did not adopt the advice in full.
concerns: The Council asked for a fuller explanation of the Bill's practical significance, including the position of SMEs as creditors, which the memorandum was supplemented to provide.
The Council advised a specialised court or chamber for homologation requests; the government instead proposed a national pool of judges, organised within the existing legal framework.
The Council advised considering a debtor-consent requirement for SMEs, which was incorporated in the Bill to align with the directive.
The Council advised arranging advance payment of the restructuring expert's costs, which was adopted in the Bill.
The Council made several redactional suggestions, which were largely adopted.

35267.s: The bill amends the Environmental Management Act to implement the 2018 EU Waste Framework Directive amendment, redefining by-products and end-of-waste status and extending producer responsibility. It removes the minister's power to decide case by case whether a waste has ceased to be waste, while adding ministerial and general administrative order powers to set detailed criteria.
35267.j: The memorandum justifies the new ministerial and amvb powers as necessary for full implementation of the EU directive and for uniformity and workable criteria for waste status.
d: criteria for by-products not set at EU level
criteria for end-of-waste status for specific waste types
extended producer responsibility rules and information duties
mandatory separate collection of household waste and possible exemptions
mandatory separate collection of business waste and possible exemptions
producer responsibility rules applying to collective agreements declared generally binding
p: I.A (art. 1.1, lid 6 Wm, vervallen bevoegdheid minister per geval)
The minister's power to decide case by case that a waste has ceased to be waste is removed, shifting such decisions to local competent authorities whose decisions remain appealable.
Extends producer responsibility rules to collectively agreed arrangements through an amvb, a technical extension of existing delegation powers.

parties: Asks for fuller insight into administrative burdens and how regulatory pressure can be limited.
These members ask to what extent this additional regulatory burden can still be limited.
Deze leden vragen in hoeverre deze aanvullende regeldruk alsnog beperkt kan worden.
Questions why the Minister gets a standalone power to decide when waste ceases to be waste, leaving parliament without a say.
A standalone power of the Minister means the House has no say over this.
Een eigenstandige bevoegdheid van de Minister houdt immers in dat de Kamer hierover geen zeggenschap heeft.
Asks why the Minister's power to rule on individual cases is removed and how enforcement against individual producers can work.
These members ask the government to further justify whether it expects more or fewer requests for rulings and why this power is being removed.
Deze leden vragen de regering nader te motiveren of zij meer of minder verzoeken tot oordelen verwacht en waarom deze bevoegdheid wordt geschrapt.
Wants a prior assessment framework with conditions and goals constraining the Minister's waste-classification decisions, and reporting to the House.
These members strongly want a testing and weighing framework to be set in advance, with conditions, goals and research requirements prescribing how the Minister reaches a decision.

Deze leden willen wel sterk benadrukken dat er vooraf een toetsings- en afwegingskader moet worden vastgelegd, met randvoorwaarden, doelen en onderzoekvoorschriften, dat voorschrijft hoe de Minister tot een afweging komt.
Questions the added value of the law, unclear minimum producer-responsibility requirements to be set later by AMvB, and municipal-level end-of-waste decisions without guaranteed expertise.
How is the required knowledge at municipal level safeguarded?
Hoe wordt de vereiste kennis op gemeentelijk niveau geborgd?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Implementatiewet wijziging Kaderrichtlijn Afvalstoffen (implementing EU Directive 2018/851 amending the Waste Framework Directive) and raised no substantive objections, only redactional remarks. The government's nader rapport reports that all redactional remarks were adopted and that the entry-into-force date was adjusted to 1 July 2020.
concerns: Redactional remarks on wording in the definition of extended producer responsibility, the reference to Article 22.1, and the transposition table were adopted.

35294.s: The bill extends the Wet inkomensvoorziening oudere werklozen (IOW) by four years, moving its sunset from 1 January 2030 to 1 January 2034, and raises the entry age for the benefit from 60 to 60 years and 4 months. It also adds a transitional provision so persons already entitled under the prior rules keep the old age threshold.
35294.j: The memorandum justifies the extension and higher entry age by income security for older unemployed people and notes that re-employment prospects for those aged 60 and 4 months and older were not weighed when deciding the four-year extension.
q: A possible negative effect on the re-employment prospects of persons aged 60 years and 4 months and older was not considered when the decision to extend the IOW by four years was taken.
Een mogelijk negatieve invloed op de werkhervattingskansen van personen van 60 jaar en 4 maanden en ouder is niet meegewogen ten tijde van de beslissing om de IOW met vier jaren te verlengen.

parties: Asks the government to clarify the choice of the precise age limit, its link to the evaluation, and the budgetary effects on the Toeslagenwet and social assistance.
These members ask the government to substantively clarify the choice of this precise age limit.
Deze leden vragen de regering om de keuze voor deze precieze leeftijdsgrens inhoudelijk te verhelderen.
Welcomes attention to older unemployed but questions whether the extension may reduce work resumption incentives and asks for effectiveness data on existing measures.
They ask whether the term 'work resumption incentives' or 'work resumption efforts' would not be better suited here, given the purpose and context of the bill.

Zij vragen of hier, en elders in de memorie van toelichting, de term «werkhervattingsprikkels» of «werkhervattingsinspanningen» niet beter op zijn plek is gegeven het doel en de context van het wetsvoorstel.
Asks about the interaction with the Wet werk en zekerheid, the offsetting of IOW benefits against other income, and transitional rules.
The D66 members ask whether the government can elaborate on the Council of State advice pointing to the link between the IOW and the shortening of the WW benefit under the Work and Security Act.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen of de regering nader in kan gaan op het advies van de Afdeling van de Raad van State dat wijst op de samenhang tussen de IOW en het verkorten van de WW-uitkering met de Wet werk en zekerheid.
Supports extension and lowering the entry age to 55, and asks whether the government will suspend the job-search obligation and equalise partner and survivor income offsets.
Is the cabinet prepared to suspend the job-search obligation if it has turned out that job prospects were already nil during the preceding WW period?
Is het kabinet bereid om de sollicitatieplicht op te schorten als gebleken is dat tijdens de voorafgaande WW-periode de baankansen ook al nihil waren?
Considers extension sensible but asks why the scheme is not made structural, the evidence for the 60y4m threshold, and whether 2010s austerity measures will be reversed.
Furthermore, the PvdA members want to know why it has not been chosen to make the IOW structural.
Verder willen de leden van de PvdA-fractie weten waarom er niet wordt gekozen om de IOW structureel te maken.
Supports the bill's protection of assets but questions the 60y4m threshold versus 55, the wealth eligibility of applicants, and investment in sustainable employability.
Like the Council of State, the 50PLUS members find the bill lacks a convincing justification for applying the IOW only from age 60 years and 4 months.

De leden van de 50PLUS-fractie missen evenals de Raad van State in het wetsvoorstel een overtuigende motivering, waarom er voor wordt gekozen de IOW-regeling pas van toepassing te laten zijn vanaf de leeftijd van 60 jaar en 4 maanden.
Welcomes the age limit not rising further and a good transitional scheme, but is concerned about the broader group of older unemployed not covered and asks about negative effects.
These members are, however, concerned about the broader group of older unemployed than that covered by the bill.
Deze leden zijn wel bezorgd over de bredere groep oudere werklozen dan die door het wetsvoorstel wordt bestreken.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the explanatory memorandum to the bill extending the Wet inkomensvoorziening oudere werklozen (IOW) and raising its entry age be better motivated, because the age distinction and the continued need for the scheme under a tight labour market were not justified. The government replied by adding reasoning on the need to keep the safety net for four more years and by adjusting the memorandum, and also added transitional rules and updated the financial section.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a fuller justification of the need for extending the IOW given the improved labour market position of older workers, and the government added reasoning to the memorandum while maintaining its choice.

The Afdeling found no justification for the age distinction (60 years and four months) in the entry age, and the government justified the choice mainly by reference to the coalition agreement, adding limited reasoning.

35300-IV.s: This bill fixes the 2020 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (Kingdom Relations) and for the BES-fonds (Caribbean Netherlands fund) in a single act, setting expenditure of 83.3 million euro and receipts of 38.5 million euro for Kingdom Relations. The explanatory memorandum describes spending on strengthening the rule of law, socio-economic development, financial supervision of the islands, and reconstruction of the windward islands, without itself delegating rule-making power.
q: The budget statements that form part of the national budget are each established separately by law under article 2.3, first paragraph, of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016.
De begrotingsstaten die onderdeel zijn van de Rijksbegroting, worden op grond van artikel 2.3, eerste lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2016 elk afzonderlijk bij wet vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division reported on 9 September 2019 that it had no remarks on the 2020 budget bills (begrotingsstaten) for the listed ministries and funds, and advised submitting them to the House of Representatives. The Minister of Finance's reply of 16 September 2019 notes that some budgets need amendments, which are set out in annexes.

35300-VI.s: This is the 2020 budget bill for the Ministry of Justice and Security, fixing departmental expenditure and receipts, agency budgets (DJI, CJIB, NFI, IND, Justis) and the budget of the judiciary as a separate item under the Minister for Legal Protection. The explanatory memorandum describes budgetary policy across legal protection, judiciary funding, prosecution, sanctions and youth protection, without new delegated rule-making powers.
q: With reference to article 4.1 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016 in conjunction with articles 23 and 91 of the Judicial Organisation Act, the Minister for Legal Protection is not responsible for the efficiency of the judiciary's business operations.

Onder verwijzing naar artikel 4.1 van de Comptabiliteitswet 2016 jo. de artikelen 23 en 91 van de Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie is Onze Minister voor Rechtsbescherming niet verantwoordelijk voor de doelmatigheid van de bedrijfsvoering van de rechterlijke organisatie.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no substantive remarks on the 2020 budget bill for the Ministry of Justice and Security and advises submitting it to parliament, with only a drafting remark on article 3. The government's nader rapport (16 September 2019) states that some budgets need amendments, referring to annexes, and transmits the advice to the King.
concerns: The Afdeling suggests reconsidering article 3 of the budget bill because a statutory text is not used to give a further explanation.

35348.s: The bill amends the Dutch Code of Civil Procedure and Civil Code Books 1 and 10 to require parties to a religious marriage to cooperate in its dissolution, allowing courts to order this as an ancillary measure in divorce, and to make various procedural and technical family-law changes such as oral judgments and hearings at secure youth facilities. It also modifies rules on registered partnerships, recognition of children, guardianship notices and matrimonial property regimes.
35348.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the court-ordered duty to cooperate by the need to protect freedom to divorce and private life, balanced against religious freedom through a reasonableness test.
q: Only if there are weighty interests of the other party that make cooperation unreasonable to demand is there room to depart from this starting point.

Enkel als sprake is van zwaarwegende belangen van de andere partij, die maken dat medewerking in redelijkheid niet van hem of haar kan worden gevergd, bestaat er ruimte om van dit uitgangspunt af te wijken.
p: ARTIKEL I, E / ARTIKEL II, C (art. 68 BW)

Introduces a duty to cooperate in dissolving a religious marriage, enforceable by a court order with coercive measures, subject to a court's reasonableness test that protects individuals' religious freedom and privacy.
Allows judges to pronounce judgments orally with the written version following later, including in urgent cases where not all parties are present, reducing some procedural protections for parties.
ARTIKEL I, B and C (art. 801b, 802a Rv)
Lets courts omit oral hearings in certain youth-protection matters and hold hearings at secure youth facilities, which can reduce the physical separation between court and detained minors.

parties: Asks whether the bill is sufficient, since women in marital captivity often do not know their rights, and whether criminal law should also be amended.
A law alone is not sufficient; women must also know that they can make use of the law.
Alleen een wet is niet voldoende, vrouwen moeten ook weten dat ze gebruik kunnen maken van de wet.
Asks whether the government considered criminalising men who refuse to request a religious divorce.
Has the government also considered making men who refuse to request a religious divorce punishable?
heeft de regering ook overwogen mannen die weigeren een religieuze scheiding aan te vragen strafbaar te stellen?
Supports countering forced marriage but notes the tension of state involvement in religious matters.
Nevertheless they also understand the tension that arises when laws are extended so that they affect religious unions, whereby the state in a sense intervenes in religious affairs.

Desondanks begrijpen zij ook het spanningsveld dat ontstaat wanneer er wetten worden uitgebreid zodat zij van invloed zijn op religieuze verbintenissen, waarmee in zekere zin de overheid zich mengt in religieuze aangelegenheden.
Weighs self-determination against religious freedom and asks how the Hoge Raad's reasonableness test and 'serious interests' exception would work in practice.
Since weighing these two interests touches the core of this bill, they would like examples of when refusal may be unlawful.
Daar de afweging van deze twee belangen volgens deze leden de kern van dit wetsvoorstel raakt, horen zij graag voorbeelden wanneer weigering onrechtmatig kan zijn
Welcomes the bill but asks whether an evaluation clause should be added and whether restraint toward religion is appropriate where it underlies human rights violations.
Would it therefore be wise to include an evaluation provision?
Zou het daarom verstandig zijn om een evaluatiebepaling op te nemen?
Supports the bill but argues victims should not have to take the initiative alone and asks for an active state role and better knowledge among police and prosecutors.
With this bill victims are still expected to take the step to the court themselves.
Met dit wetsvoorstel wordt nog steeds verwacht van slachtoffers dat zij zelf de stap naar de rechter zetten.
Supports legal instruments to encourage cooperation in religious dissolution and asks about the balance between preventing captivity and religious freedom.
Can the government elaborate on the weighing made between preventing marital captivity on the one hand and freedom of religion on the other?
Kan de regering nader ingaan op de afweging die is gemaakt tussen enerzijds het voorkomen van huwelijkse gevangenschap en anderzijds de vrijheid van godsdienst?
Wary of state interference in religious marriage but finds an obligation to cooperate conceivable given women's restricted freedom; asks what cases could justify a different balance.
From this perspective the members find an obligation to cooperate conceivable.
Vanuit dit perspectief vinden de leden een verplichting tot medewerking voorstelbaar.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division gave no substantive remarks on the bill amending the Civil Code and Code of Civil Procedure, but advised on a specific question about a general duty to cooperate in dissolving a religious marriage, finding that the Maastricht alternatives conflict with ECHR Articles 8, 9 and 12 and church-state separation, while the bill's Article 827 Rv provision is acceptable. The minister's reply accepts that a blanket duty cannot be imposed without room for judicial balancing and adds a qualified duty to cooperate with an exception for serious interests.
concerns: Blanket duty to cooperate in dissolving a religious marriage would disproportionately infringe religious freedom and the right to marry, leaving no room for case-by-case balancing; the minister adopted a qualified duty with judicial exception.
Pre-marriage declaration or conditioning civil divorce on religious cooperation would mix civil and religious marriage, contrary to church-state separation.
Proposed alternative c, conditioning divorce on cooperation, could prolong civil divorce and infringe the right to remarry under Article 12 ECHR.

35357.s: The bill abolishes the mandatory national arithmetic test (rekentoets) in secondary education and adult secondary education and replaces it with a school-level arithmetic exam (schoolexamen rekenen) and, for state exams, a college-examination in arithmetic. It also adds transitional provisions and repeals the related statutory tasks of the College voor toetsen en examens and the subsidy law for national education support activities.
35357.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated rules by saying the schoolexamen rekenen needs general measures for matters such as how the grade appears on the transcript, and that the abolition is needed because the test no longer serves its purpose.
q: General administrative regulations will however also set further rules for this school arithmetic exam, for example on how the grade is recorded on the transcript.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur zullen echter ook nadere regels worden vastgesteld voor dit schoolexamen rekenen, bijvoorbeeld over de vermelding van het cijfer op de cijferlijst.
d: Artikel I, A/D (Artikel #, overgangsrecht eindexamens, lid 2)
detailed rules on the school-level arithmetic exam
Artikel I, D (Artikel #, overgangsrecht staatsexamen, lid 2)
detailed rules on the college-examination arithmetic
date on which the transitional provision expires, set by royal decree
detailed rules on the institutional arithmetic exam in adult secondary education
entry into force and possible retroactive effect set by royal decree
p: The royal decree may set the entry-into-force date and make the act retroactive, differently per article, without a fixed deadline in the bill.

parties: Asks how the government will guarantee and measure arithmetic levels of pupils in other school types and how it will monitor this, and responds to the Council of State's objections.
How does the government guarantee the arithmetic level of pupils in these other education levels? How is this monitored?
Hoe waarborgt de regering het rekenniveau van leerlingen in deze andere onderwijsniveaus? Hoe wordt daarop gecontroleerd?
Questions the status and timeline of the alternative to the rekentoets and the recommendations of the advisory report, and the lack of internet consultation with the education field and NVvW.
To what extent has the NVvW been specifically consulted on this bill?
In hoeverre is de NVvW specifiek geconsulteerd over dit wetsvoorstel?
Asks whether schools were actively directed on arithmetic teaching and how the government will prevent additional admission requirements in further education.
How will the government prevent additional admission requirements being imposed as a result of this bill
Hoe gaat de regering voorkomen dat er extra toelatingseisen worden gesteld als gevolg van dit wetsvoorstel
