Questions the intention-only commitment that the school exam will not count toward pass/fail, the legitimacy of skipping consultation, and the rush behind the bill.
These members have doubts about the legitimacy of this.
Deze leden hebben twijfels bij de legitimiteit hiervan.
Finds the hasty manner of abolition unattractive and asks the government to maximally mitigate the risks to arithmetic education.
They attach importance to maximum effort to mitigate the risks to arithmetic education arising from this bill.
Zij hechten aan een maximale inzet om de risico’s voor het rekenonderwijs die door dit wetsvoorstel ontstaan te ondervangen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises against abolishing the arithmetic test in secondary education before an alternative is in place, arguing that monitoring and attention to numeracy would otherwise lapse and that the test's separate significance was stated by the legislator. The minister's reply rejects this, arguing the test has become ineffective and lacks political support, and that an alternative school exam and curriculum integration will secure numeracy, while accepting a one-year gap.
concerns: The Council argues the arithmetic test should be kept as an interim measure until an alternative is ready, since abolition risks weakening attention to numeracy and monitoring; the minister rejects this as ineffective because the test no longer counts for pupils.

The Council warns that abolishing the test from 2019/2020 leaves numeracy of pupils without a final assessment for at least one school year, and the minister accepts a gap but argues its effects will be limited.
The Council asks that the explanatory memorandum be revised to address the importance of numeracy after abolition and the consequences of the implementation gap, which the minister did.

35366.s: The bill broadens article 2:20 of the Civil Code so that a legal person can be banned where its purpose, not only its activities, conflicts with public order, and adds judicial orders during proceedings, a civil ban on directors for at least three years, and a power to award the liquidation surplus to the State. It also doubles the penalty for continuing a banned organisation and makes breach of a judicial order a criminal offence, allowing pre-trial detention and investigative powers.
35366.j: The memorandum justifies the expanded powers as necessary to protect the democratic constitutional state against radical antidemocratic forces, with judicial review as the main safeguard.
q: The government considers these arguments, weighing everything, convincing.
De regering acht deze argumenten, alles afwegende, overtuigend.
d: Artikel I, A, sub 5 (art. 2:20 lid 5 BW)
judicial orders to banned entity and its members during proceedings
p: Artikel I, A, sub 1-2 (art. 2:20 lid 1-2 BW)
Extends the grounds for banning legal persons to purposes contrary to public order, including threats to democratic rule of law, enlarging prosecutorial reach over associations.
Artikel I, A, sub 3 and 6 (art. 2:20 lid 3, 6 BW)
Presumes violation of public order where purposes lead to violence or incitement to hatred, and makes bans enforceable immediately, so appeal does not suspend them."
Imposes a civil directorship ban of at least three years on directors of banned entities, with judicial discretion to exempt those not seriously at fault."
Allows the judge to award the liquidation surplus of a banned legal person to the State."
Doubles the maximum penalty for continuing a banned organisation and criminalises breach of judicial orders, enabling pre-trial detention and investigative powers."

parties: Asks whether a legal person promoting Sharia legislation could be banned, whether the state should automatically receive surplus assets, and why the judge rather than the state decides on surplus.
Why has the government chosen to assign this power to the judge?
Waarom heeft de regering ervoor gekozen deze bevoegdheid bij de rechter te beleggen?

Supports strengthening democracy against harmful organisations but asks about the scope of the ontwrichting concept, the basis for dossiers, and whether the Minister rather than the OM should file claims.
They still have questions about the bill.
Zij hebben nog enkele vragen over het wetsvoorstel.
Asks how the court order mechanism relates to the approach to outlaw motorcycle gangs and the overlapping initiative bill.
In light of the approach to Outlaw Motorcycle Gangs (OMGs), these members see this as a step in the right direction.
In het licht van de aanpak van Outlaw Motorcycle Gangs (OMG's) zien de voornoemde leden dit als een stap in de goede richting.

Questions the necessity of the bill, notes criticism from Amnesty and the bar/notaries, asks why procedure durations are not first shortened, and questions the pressing social need and proportionality under the ECHR.
In other words, what demonstrates the pressing social need to justify this infringement on freedom of association, which in the members' view is also not absolute?
Waaruit blijkt met andere woorden de pressing social need om deze inbreuk op de verenigingsvrijheid, die overigens ook naar het oordeel van de leden niet absoluut is, te rechtvaardigen?
Raises concern about lengthy civil procedures, the minimum three-year board ban limiting judicial discretion, and the threat to the freedom of association.
Banning associations is a serious power and in that context these members have some questions.
Het is een zware bevoegdheid om verenigingen te verbieden en in dat kader hebben deze leden nog enkele vragen.

Supports the aim of making the democratic constitutional state more resilient but asks for clarification on the need for handles for the judge and on special protections for churches and trade unions.
A goal these members fully endorse.
Een doel dat deze leden volledig onderschrijven.

Asks how far the power reaches regarding criticism of government and threats to the international legal order, and whether the OM itself must prove wrongful aims rather than merely make them plausible.
Is it not important that the OM itself proves that there is an organisation with wrong intentions or activities?
Is het niet belangrijk dat het OM zelf bewijst dat sprake is van een organisatie met verkeerde bedoelingen of werkzaamheden?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill broadening article 2:20 BW to ban radical organisations threatening the democratic rule of law, raising points on the clarity of 'public order', the evidential burden, the scope of criminal liability, the five-year board ban, political parties, and the relationship with article 8 of the Constitution and the initiative bill on administrative bans. The Minister's nader rapport accepts most points, including adding rebuttal possibilities, clarifying criminal liability, making the board ban discretionary with a three-year minimum, and deleting 'deelneming', while defending the ban's immediate enforceability and the separate handling of political parties.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned whether the rebuttable presumption for the public prosecutor's burden of proof truly lightens the burden and how rebuttal is possible; the government clarified the mechanism and added examples to the explanatory memorandum.

The five-year automatic board ban was considered disproportionate without judicial discretion on duration; the government reduced the minimum to three years while keeping the ban's signalling function.

Unclear practical effect of immediate enforceability given the irrevocability requirement in article 140(2) Sr; the government added explanation linking the rechterlijk bevel to criminal enforcement under article 184a Sr.

Scope of the criminal offence of continuing an organisation's activities under article 140(2) Sr is unclear and rarely prosecuted; the government clarified the broad reading in the memorie and removed the 'deelneming' element but declined a non-exhaustive list of conduct.

Relationship with the delegation ban in article 8 of the Constitution and the initiative bill on administrative bans required explanation; the government acknowledged the judicial-review safeguard and committed to address the initiative bill in its standpoint without fully resolving the relationship.

The definition of political parties left to the court raised concerns about criteria; the government adopted a material test based on intent to take part in democratic elections and added this to the explanatory memorandum.

35375.s: The bill amends the Judicial Organisation Act so that the courts of Amsterdam, Oost-Brabant, Overijssel and Rotterdam may mutually use each other's hearing locations for criminal cases within their concentration competence, without a ministerial designation or a temporary-shortage condition. It also changes Articles 46a and 62a so that the Minister can designate courts whose hearing places temporarily serve another court's cases in case of insufficient hearing capacity, with transitional rules for earlier designations.
35375.j: The memorandum justifies the designation power by the need to respond quickly and flexibly to temporary capacity shortages while keeping parliamentary control over the designation of hearing places.
q: With this direct designation in the Judicial Organisation Act, a ministerial regulation is no longer needed to provide mutual assistance in this type of case.
Met deze directe aanwijzing in de Wet RO is voor het kunnen verlenen van onderlinge bijstand in dit type zaken geen ministeriële regeling meer nodig.
d: Artikel I, B (art. 46a, eerste lid Wet RO)
designation of courts sharing hearing places for a category of cases
Artikel I, C (art. 62a, eerste lid Wet RO)
designation of courts of appeal sharing hearing places for a category of cases
p: Artikel I, B and C (art. 46a and 62a Wet RO)

The Minister may, after hearing the Council of State, temporarily designate courts' hearing places for use by another court in case of a temporary capacity shortage, with the designation limited in time.

Concentration courts may hear each other's criminal cases at each other's hearing places without a ministerial designation or a temporary-shortage requirement, so the rule is permanent rather than case-by-case.

parties: Asks whether the bill addresses the commission-Kummeling bottlenecks and how often the existing articles 46a and 62a have been used.
They still have some questions and comments on the bill.
Zij hebben nog enkele vragen en opmerkingen bij het wetsvoorstel.
Asks how the internal financing system affects courts assisting each other and what role the Raad voor de rechtspraak can play.
They have some questions mainly concerning the financing system used for the judiciary.
Zij hebben nog enkele vragen die vooral betrekking hebben op het gehanteerde financieringssysteem van de rechtspraak.
Supports the bill's aim but insists referral to another court be a last resort, protecting access to justice and proximity, and asks how the minister's designation power is safeguarded.
However, these members attach importance to the accessibility and proximity of the law, and therefore see referring cases due to lack of hearing capacity as an extreme last resort.
Wel hechten deze leden aan het belang van toegankelijkheid en nabijheid van het recht, en zien het verwijzen van zaken bij gebrek aan zittingscapaciteit dan ook als uiterst redmiddel.
Worries that moving hearings elsewhere undermines local accessibility of the judiciary and asks how this will be prevented, citing the NVvR concern about financial disincentives.
With this bill to organise hearings elsewhere, that principle may come under pressure.
Met dit wetsvoorstel om zittingen ergens anders te organiseren komt dat principe mogelijk onder druk te staan.
Welcomes the bill as a good way to provide mutual assistance during temporary capacity shortages and has no questions.
They see that the bill offers a good option to provide a solution in such situations.
Zij zien dat het voorstel een goede mogelijkheid biedt om in dergelijke situaties uitkomst te bieden.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie to remove obstacles for courts providing mutual assistance when there is insufficient sitting capacity. The Afdeling had no remarks and advised submitting the bill to the Tweede Kamer, with only some editorial improvements made to the explanatory memorandum.

35384.s: The bill amends the Wet op het bevolkingsonderzoek, renaming it the Wet preventief gezondheidsonderzoek, to extend licensing and quality requirements to preventive health screening offered or performed outside government screening programmes. It strengthens enforcement by the health inspectorate through orders under administrative coercion, penalty payments and administrative fines, and allows ministerial orders to prohibit certain screening types.
35384.j: The memorandum justifies the enforcement powers by the presence of short-lived, mobile providers and the need for swift, proportionate action, and justifies the temporary ban by the impossibility of awaiting statute.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel C (art. 3 lid 3-6 nieuw)
rules and exemptions for preventive screening licensing
designate screening categories subject to quality standards
prohibit ethically or legally undesirable screening
p: Allows an order in council to ban screening where legislation cannot await, lapsing after two years unless a bill is introduced.
Artikel I, onderdelen J en K (art. 12, 13)
Gives the minister power to impose administrative coercion and administrative fines for violations, including by providers outside the Wkkgz scope.

parties: Asks how the bill increases freedom of choice, whether consumers rather than doctors should decide on incidental findings, and whether the Inspectorate has the capacity and cross-border enforcement powers needed.
These members find it unclear how this bill will lead to that goal.
Het is deze leden onduidelijk hoe dit wetsvoorstel tot dit doel zal leiden.
Asks why ministerial orders (AMvB) will not be pre-published, how the professional standards will be enforced, and who assesses risks of tests without medical risk.
These members also ask why the general administrative measures (AMvB) made possible by this bill will not be submitted in advance to parliament.
Deze leden vragen tevens waarom de algemene maatregelen van bestuur (AMvB's) die mogelijk gemaakt worden met dit wetsvoorstel niet voorgehangen zullen worden.
Worry that citizens may be incompletely informed about quality and risks of category-one tests sold online, and ask how risk assessment and the framework for medical risk are determined.
These members note that the consequence may be that citizens are incompletely informed about quality requirements and possible risks.
Genoemde leden constateren dat het gevolg hiervan kan zijn dat burgers mogelijk onvolledig worden geïnformeerd over de kwaliteitseisen en mogelijke risico's.

Ask who decides whether a test carries risks, how users are guaranteed adequate information when no specific requirements apply, and how the government monitors pressure on primary and secondary care.
How does the government also guarantee that users are adequately informed if it imposes no further requirements for them?
Hoe garandeert de regering bovendien dat gebruikers adequaat geïnformeerd worden als zij hier geen nadere eisen voor oplegt?

Critical that the bill may increase commercial and substandard testing, lower safeguards for participants, and that category-one tests get no additional requirements despite possible consequences of results.
These members have the impression that this new classification means that only a small part of the examinations will require a licence.
Deze leden hebben de indruk dat deze nieuwe indeling ervoor zorgt dat nog maar voor een klein deel van de onderzoeken een vergunningplicht nodig is.
Ask how users of category-one tests are protected, whether professional standards are sufficient when untested, and how participants get clarity on licensing criteria.
To what extent do the so-called professional or occupational standards offer sufficient protection if these standards are not verified?
In hoeverre bieden de zogenoemde professionele of beroepsstandaarden hierbij voldoende bescherming als deze standaarden niet worden getoetst?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending the Wet op het bevolkingsonderzoek to broaden preventive health checks, introduce three risk categories and drop the licensing requirement for cancer screening, asking for better justification, clarification of goals, clauses on ministerial power, reliance on standards, enforcement abroad and terminology. The government's nader rapport reports that most points were followed through amendments to the bill and explanatory memorandum, while retaining some choices with explanation.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a fuller assessment of the advantages and disadvantages of preventive health checks and the evidence on their effects, which the government addressed by supplementing the financial-effects section and the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling questioned the broad clauses allowing the executive by general administrative order to bind or prohibit screenings on cost and societal grounds; the government narrowed the clause to quality and added a two-year lapse, but rejected a parliamentary pre-consultation requirement.

The Afdeling flagged uncertainty over when a screening is licensable and incidental findings; the government replaced the 'reasonable chance' test with a test based on the conditions the screening targets and added a prohibition on reporting incidental findings subject to exceptions.

The Afdeling asked how the Inspectie could enforce against providers abroad; the government added explanation of enforcement routes via Dutch branches and mutual-assistance requests, while the reliance on professional and quality standards was defended as adequate.
The Afdeling recommended replacing the term 'bevolkingsonderzoek' with 'preventief gezondheidsonderzoek' in the Wbo, which the government adopted with consequential changes to the title and citation.

The Afdeling asked for justification for dropping the licensing requirement for cancer screening and for a clearer definition; the government explained the changed circumstances and adopted the terminology change, while not taking over the Afdeling's proposed wording of the definition.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State had no remarks on the draft nota van wijziging amending the Wet op het bevolkingsonderzoek and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Staatssecretaris for Health thereby requested the Crown's consent to send the amendment to parliament.

35429.s: The bill implements the EU regulation establishing the European Public Prosecutor's Office (EPPO) in Dutch law by amending the General Tax Act, General Customs Act, Extradition Act, Code of Criminal Procedure, Special Investigation Services Act, Judicial Organisation Act and the Judicial Officers Legal Status Act. It assigns EPPO-related investigative and prosecutorial powers to European Delegated Prosecutors housed at the functional parket and sets up related designation and employment rules.
35429.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as necessary to implement the directly applicable EPPO regulation and to ensure the Delegated Prosecutors can carry out EPPO tasks in Dutch law.
q: Only limited changes to legislation are needed to enable investigation and prosecution by the EPPO in the Netherlands.
Er zijn slechts beperkte aanpassingen in wetgeving nodig om opsporing en vervolging door het EOM in Nederland mogelijk te maken.
d: appointment and support of European Delegated Prosecutors
p: Powers of the national prosecutor are transferred to European Delegated Prosecutors acting under EPPO supervision, with rule-making and investigative authority partly outside national OM hierarchy.
Jurisdiction over EPPO cases in first instance is concentrated in four district courts."}],

parties: Asks how the opportunity principle of the Dutch OM is safeguarded and whether the Dutch authorities have the final word on EPPO jurisdiction.
How is it ensured that the EPPO indeed does not undermine the opportunity principle of the OM?
Op welke wijze is gewaarborgd dat het EOM inderdaad geen afbreuk doet aan het opportuniteitsbeginsel van het OM?
Asks for clarification of the opportunity versus legality principle and of supervision over the EPPO by EU bodies.
Is there something like an instruction power towards the chief prosecutor?
Bestaat er zoiets als een aanwijzingsbevoegdheid in de richting van de hoofdaanklager?
Asks how democratic accountability to the Council and European Parliament is organised and whether the minister's special instruction power applies.
in what way democratic accountability is rendered towards the Council and the European Parliament?
op welke wijze democratische verantwoording wordt afgelegd ten opzichte van de Raad en het Europees Parlement?
Asks how the EPPO will handle non-participating states and how suspects can complain about investigative and non-prosecution decisions.
It also raises the question whether, and if so to what extent, suspects can complain about investigation and (non-)prosecution decisions.
Het roept ook de vraag op of, en zo ja, in hoeverre verdachten zich kunnen beklagen over opsporings- en (niet-)vervolgingsbeslissingen.
Opposes the EPPO in principle, warns of salami tactics and of a possible extension of its mandate to terrorism, and asks for an explanation of the risks to the OM budget.
How does the government assess that proposal?
Hoe waardeert de regering dat voorstel?
Notes that democratic control over investigation changes and asks why a non-Dutch prosecuting body may operate independently on Dutch soil; wants a modest mandate.
At the same time Dutch investigative competence will be shared with the EPPO, changing democratic control over investigation.
Tegelijkertijd zal de Nederlandse bevoegdheid tot opsporing met het EOM gaan worden gedeeld, waarbij de democratische controle op de opsporing verandert.
Doubts that the EPPO can take cases to itself and give instructions, and asks about the relation between national and European competences.
They in particular ask how the relationship is between national competences and European competences.
Zij vragen zich met name af hoe de verhouding is tussen de nationale bevoegdheden en de Europese bevoegdheden.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill implementing the European Public Prosecutor's Office (EPPO) regulation in Dutch law, mainly asking for a fuller explanation of cross-border fraud rules and of how the special investigation services and tax/customs authorities coordinate with the EPPO, and for an amendment to ensure the EPPO can direct investigations. The minister's reply states the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on these points, adds a transposition table, and amends the General State Taxes Act and General Customs Act to require timely forwarding of reports to the EPPO.
concerns: The advisory division asked that the explanatory memorandum address how cross-border fraud cases with EU funds are handled under the EPPO regulation, and the government supplemented it.

The advisory division questioned whether the EPPO can direct investigations nationally given overlapping police and special investigation service powers and special tax and customs rules, and the government added an explanation and amended the AWR and Customs Act to require forwarding of reports.
The advisory division made editorial remarks, and the government added a transposition table to the explanatory memorandum.

35438.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate through a second supplementary budget for the Corona emergency package, adding about 10.5 billion euro in expenditure commitments and 2.475 billion euro in expenditure. It takes effect from 15 April 2020 with retroactive effect if published later.
35438.j: The memorandum justifies the spending increase by stating the cabinet wants support to reach entrepreneurs entitled to it, with after-the-fact checks on misuse of the schemes.
q: Therefore, it will be checked afterwards whether there has been no misuse of the schemes.
Daarom zal er achteraf gecontroleerd worden of er geen misbruik van de regelingen is geweest.

35447.s: The bill creates a statutory framework for joint processing of personal and other data by designated cooperation partnerships (FEC, iCOV, RIEC's, Zorg- en Veiligheidshuizen) pursuing serious public interest aims, and lets further partnerships be designated by general administrative order with a nahang procedure. It obliges participants to supply data, sets safeguards such as a legality advisory committee, logging, retention limits and audit duties, and allows detailed rules to be set by AMvB.
35447.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers by the need for an integrated approach to societal problems and legal certainty for joint data processing, with safeguards to protect privacy.
q: The bill provides that a cooperation partnership may jointly process data insofar as necessary for a purpose of serious general interest laid down by or pursuant to this Act.

Het wetsvoorstel regelt dat een samenwerkingsverband gezamenlijk gegevens mag verwerken voor zover dat noodzakelijk is voor een bij of krachtens deze wet vastgesteld doel van zwaarwegend algemeen belang.
d: ending participation in a cooperation partnership
working method and responsibilities of joint controllers, data subject contact point
conditions, reliability requirements, legality committee rules, further safeguards for all data processing
human intervention in automated analysis; processing phases for pseudonymised analysis
adding data categories and sources for FEC, after four-week period before parliament
rules on indicators and data analysis methods for iCOV
territorial work areas of Regional Information and Expertise Centres
designating further public bodies or private parties as RIEC participants
categories and sources of RIEC data, additional categories
designating further participants in Zorg- en Veiligheidshuizen
designating and regulating new cooperation partnerships by AMvB
p: Overrides sectoral secrecy provisions and allows joint use and onward disclosure of data across agencies, widening executive information powers over citizens subject to the necessity test and participant objection rights.
Allows new data-sharing partnerships to be created by general administrative order, with only a nahang procedure in which one chamber by absolute majority may request statutory regulation.
Zorg- en Veiligheidshuizen may process sensitive and criminal-law data for case coordination under specified purposes, with transparency duties.
Sets retention limit of five years and deletion or anonymisation when data are no longer necessary.

parties: Asks how the bill's facultative character and the Raad van State's effectiveness concerns are addressed, and whether the ATR was consulted on administrative burden.
The VVD members share the Council of State's concern about the optional character of the bill.
De leden van de VVD-fractie delen de zorg van de Afdeling Advisering van de Raad van State (hierna: de Afdeling) over het facultatieve karakter van het wetsvoorstel.
Welcomes a strong legal basis and a role for parliament, but questions whether the closed, regulated system is too bureaucratic and suggests open powers with judicial review instead.
Data processing by cooperation bodies is naturally a far-reaching power that must have a firm legal basis, sufficient safeguards and a role for the legislature.

Het gaat bij gegevensverwerking door samenwerkingsverbanden vanzelfsprekend om een verregaande bevoegdheid die dient te worden voorzien van een stevige wettelijke basis en van voldoende waarborgen en met een rol weggelegd voor de wetgevende macht.
Asks the government to seek renewed advice from the Council of State and the AP on the amended bill and questions the extensive delegation and loosening of purpose limitation.
Since this is complex material, it seems wise to these members to ask the Council of State and the AP for advice on the amended bill.
Daar het gaat om complexe materie, lijkt het deze leden verstandig de Afdeling en de AP om advies te vragen over het gewijzigde voorstel.
Argues that essential conditions and the scope of 'serious public interest' should be set in formal law rather than in AMvB, and that privacy risks require clear limits.
The members in principle understand and endorse the need to reconsider the legal frameworks for information sharing.
De leden begrijpen en onderschrijven in beginsel de noodzaak om de wettelijke kaders voor informatiedeling ter heroverwegen.
Criticises the many AMvB delegations, the late addition of bodies after advice, and the loosening of purpose limitation, warning this bypasses the advisory bodies' role.
Does the government agree that the Council of State and the AP were sidelined on this point and could not fully perform their statutory advisory role?
Deelt de regering de mening dat de Afdeling, alsmede de AP, op dit punt door de regering buitenspel zijn gezet en daardoor niet (optimaal) hun wettelijke adviesrol hebben kunnen uitvoeren?
Accepts the need for a legal basis but stresses article 10 privacy protection and asks whether the amended bill was submitted for advice and how democratic control over AMvB expansion is ensured.
Civil society organisations are concerned about democratic control over this expansion and speak of overly broad definitions and powers for clusters.
Vanuit maatschappelijke organisaties is er zorg over de democratische controle op deze uitbreiding en wordt gesproken van te brede definities en bevoegdheden voor clusters.

Rejects the bill as disproportionate and in conflict with the Constitution and privacy principles, asks for withdrawal, and questions the lack of parliamentary control and the use of framework legislation.
The members urgently ask the government to withdraw the bill and to refrain from reformulating a similar law afterwards.
De leden vragen de regering met klem het wetsvoorstel in te trekken en daarna ook af te zien van het herformuleren van een soortgelijke wet.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised against submitting the draft Wet gegevensverwerking door samenwerkingsverbanden (WGS) unless revised, citing an overly broad, optional, and insufficiently specific framework that delegates essential elements to lower regulation in breach of article 10 of the Constitution. The government's nader rapport accepts the advice, restructures the bill around four named cooperation bodies (FEC, iCOV, RIEC's, Zorg- en Veiligheidshuizen) and adds specific safeguards, procedures, and limits on private participation and purpose limitation.
concerns: The bill's delegation of essential privacy-limiting elements to lower regulation falls short of article 10 of the Constitution, so the core elements must be set in the formal law.
Excessive delegation to amvb level for participants, purposes, data processing and safeguards removes parliament's role as co-legislator.
Broad, facultative scope and open-ended profiling powers raise doubts about necessity and proportionality for all cooperation types.
The broad and optional framework will not effectively achieve the aims of regulation and harmonisation of cooperation bodies.
Parliament should itself decide which cooperation bodies fall under the law rather than leaving that to voluntary opt-in.
Private participation is too open-ended and private parties should be limited to what is necessary for the purpose.
Unclear allocation of joint data-processing responsibility and accountability toward citizens and politically responsible ministers.
Strict purpose limitation is weakened by allowing incompatible purposes via amvb, undermining legal certainty.

35456.s: The bill amends the Dutch Wvggz (compulsory mental health care act) and the Wzd (care and coercion act for psychogeriatric and intellectually disabled clients) to simplify procedures, remove technical omissions and reduce administrative burden. Key changes allow courts to alter the forms of compulsory care in a crisis-measure extension, extend the validity of crisis measures over weekends and holidays, and loosen the independence requirement for the medical declaration supporting judicial authorisations under the Wzd.
35456.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the changes as removing procedural burdens and preventing repeated procedures, while claiming client legal position is safeguarded.
q: Overall, the proposed amendments adapt the Wvggz so that practical implementation aligns with the general principles of both laws, without affecting the legal position of the person concerned.

Alles overziend wordt met de voorgestelde wijzigingen de Wvggz zodanig aangepast dat de praktische uitvoering in overeenstemming wordt gebracht met de algemene uitgangspunten van beide wetten, zonder de rechtspositie van betrokkene aan te tasten.
p: The court may, deviating from the prosecutor's petition, order other forms of compulsory care, broadening judicial discretion within a court procedure.

The medical declaration may now come from a doctor who has not treated the client for one year rather than being entirely uninvolved, and the separate provider declaration for already-admitted clients is dropped, lowering safeguards on the evidence for coercive admission.

parties: Asks how the Wzd-functionaris is anchored and how supervision of coercive care in the home is organised, and questions the lack of a quantitative assessment of the administrative burden.
These members ask whether the government can indicate where the Wzd official is anchored.
Deze leden vragen of de regering kan aangeven waar de Wzd-functionaris wordt verankerd.
Insists that lower administrative burden must never come at the expense of clients' legal position under coercive care and asks whether rights were safeguarded during the coronavirus crisis.
that this must never come at the expense of the legal position of clients subject to coercive care.
dat nooit ten koste mag gaan van de rechtpositie van cliënten die te maken krijgen met dwangzorg.
Stresses that legal protection of people under involuntary care must remain as well guaranteed as possible and questions the change to article 26 on independent medical statements.
Therefore these members find it important that the legal protection of those subject to coercive care remains guaranteed as far as possible.
Daarom vinden genoemde leden het belangrijk dat de rechtsbescherming van de betrokkenen die gedwongen zorg ondergaan zoveel als mogelijk gewaarborgd blijft.
Seeks an optimal balance between maximum legal protection of psychiatric clients, good care and limited regulatory burden, and asks whether client rights remain well safeguarded.
that there must be an optimal balance between maximum legal protection of (psychiatric) clients, good care and not too much regulatory burden.
dat er een optimale balans is tussen maximale rechtsbescherming van (psychiatrische) cliënten, goede zorg en niet te veel regeldruk.
Stresses the constitutional right to personal liberty and that coercion may only be used in extreme circumstances, and raises delays in the Openbaar Ministerie in issuing care authorisations.
Only in extreme circumstances may, in these members' view, forms of coercion be used.
Slechts in extreme omstandigheden kunnen wat deze leden betreft vormen van dwang ingezet worden.
Asks for a clear commitment that the change does not weaken prevention of coercion and for the effect on legal protection, and raises the reported Openbaar Ministerie backlog.
They therefore ask for a clear assurance that the proposed amendment brings no change regarding preventing coercion as far as possible.
Zij vragen dan ook om een heldere toezegging dat de voorliggende wijziging geen verandering brengt met betrekking tot het zoveel mogelijk voorkomen van dwang.
Welcomes the feasibility improvements but asks how the legal position of clients is guaranteed and how patient organisations are involved, and asks about the comprehensibility of letters to clients.
An important aim of the Wzd and Wvggz was to improve the legal protection of clients.
Een belangrijk doel van de Wzd en Wvggz was om de rechtsbescherming van cliënten te verbeteren.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the draft bill amending the Wet verplichte geestelijke gezondheidszorg and the Wet zorg en dwang, and advises submitting it to the House of Representatives. The government's reply (nader rapport) merely confirms that the bill gives no reason for substantive remarks and forwards it for submission.

35474.s: The bill amends the 2020 budget of the Ministry of Kingdom Relations to add a second tranche of liquidity support for Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, amounting to about 185 million euros in the third supplementary budget. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and is backdated to 15 May 2020.
35474.j: The memorandum justifies the liquidity support by the COVID-19 crisis and by a request for solidarity under Article 36 of the Statute, based on advice from the Aruba and Curaçao/Sint Maarten financial oversight colleges.
q: The countries invoked solidarity within the Kingdom under Article 36 of the Charter for the Kingdom of the Netherlands.
De landen hebben op grond van artikel 36 van het Statuut voor het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden een beroep gedaan op de solidariteit binnen het Koninkrijk.

35483.s: The bill replaces the existing Dutch civic integration act with a new framework in which municipalities take on intake, individual integration plans and enforcement, and in which integration obligations (language exam, participation, labour-market module) are set out in statute. It delegates many details to amvb and ministerial regulations and creates new fines, data-sharing powers and a loan scheme.
35483.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for flexibility to adapt the system to changing circumstances and to set detailed operational rules.
q: By setting the maximum term by or pursuant to a general administrative order, flexibility is built into the system to respond to changing circumstances in the future.
Door de maximale termijn bij of krachtens amvb vast te leggen wordt flexibiliteit in het stelsel ingebouwd, om in de toekomst op veranderende omstandigheden in te kunnen spelen.
d: temporary purpose of stay defining who is obliged to integrate
rules on exemptions from integration obligation
rules on proving impediments for exemption
content of participation trajectory, module and text of participation declaration
content, administration and fees of civic integration exam
content and reporting of broad intake
deadline and rules for the personal integration plan
rules allowing lower-level exam for asylum holders
loans to persons other than integration-obliged
amount of administrative fines set by amvb and municipal ordinance
certification of providers and grounds for refusal or withdrawal
grounds for designating certifying body and supervision
rules on data exchange between parties
information municipalities must provide for statistics and evaluation
revision of municipal allocation of funds
p: Refusal of permit extension or change for failing an integration requirement set by amvb, with content of the requirement left to subordinate rules.
The municipality may complete the broad intake in the absence of the integration-obliged person after three summonses.
Administrative fines for non-attendance, non-cooperation and failure to complete the trajectory, imposed by municipalities and the minister, with recurring fines allowed.] ]

parties: Asks for an overview of the AMvBs to follow from the law, including whether a voorhang is planned and their timing, and asks how boetes will be applied.
Can the government provide an overview of the AMvBs arising from this law, indicating whether a voorhang is foreseen and the planned readiness?
Kan de regering een overzicht verstrekken van de uit deze wet voort te vloeien AMvB’s en daarbij steeds aangeven of hier een voorhang is voorzien en wat de planning is van gereedheid?
Asks how fraud by language schools will be prevented and enforced, and what role the Inspectie SZW should play alongside Blik op Werk.
How is enforcement precisely arranged and how, besides issuing certificates to language schools by Blik op Werk, is supervision of fraud carried out?
Hoe is de handhaving precies geregeld en hoe wordt naast het uitgeven van certificaten aan taalscholen door «Blik op Werk» toezicht gehouden op fraude?
Asks how municipal regie and supervision can bring large-scale fraud under control and whether gezinsmigranten can be prevented from enrolling with bureaus that escape municipal oversight.
Does the government agree that the municipalities' regie role, supervising and directly contracting training institutes, must bring this large-scale and problematic fraud under control?

Deelt de regering de mening dat de regierol van de gemeenten – het toezicht houden op en het direct sluiten van contracten met opleidingsinstituten – deze grootschalige en problematische fraude onder controle moet krijgen?
Raises rights concerns about the B1 requirement, the three-year slagingsplicht and sanctions, citing EU case law and EVRM article 8, and the differential treatment of asylum and family migrants.
How can that be reconciled with the case law of the Court of Justice, in particular the C&A and K judgments, both dated 7 November 2018?
Hoe is dat te rijmen met de rechtspraak van het Hof van Justitie, met name het arrest C&A en het arrest K, beiden gedateerd op 7 november 2018?

Objects that inspection of language quality is left to Blik op Werk rather than the Onderwijsinspectie and asks how municipalities will be equipped and whether fraud checks will be part of the evaluation.
The SP members find it very disappointing that the Onderwijsinspectie will not monitor the quality of civic integration, but instead the external foundation Blik op Werk.
De leden van de SP-fractie vinden het zeer teleurstellend dat de Onderwijsinspectie niet de kwaliteit van inburgering gaat bewaken, maar nog altijd de (externe) stichting Blik op Werk.

Objects to the distinction between asylum status holders and other newcomers, questions equal rights and duties and the three-year deadline for those paying themselves, and asks about rechtsongelijkheid between municipalities.
These members find this distinction undesirable.
Deze leden vinden dit onderscheid onwenselijk.
Welcomes municipal regie but worries about inequality between municipalities and asks whether the government can guarantee uniformity and what powers exist if municipalities fail.
At the same time it is important that no large differences or legal inequalities arise in how different municipalities shape the civic integration trajectory.
Tegelijk is het van belang dat er geen grote verschillen of rechtsongelijkheden ontstaan in de wijze waarop diverse gemeenten het inburgeringstraject vormgeven.
Questions the need for a new law given the similar structure, the reasons for the reform, and the criteria for exemptions, suggesting the Minister rather than municipalities decides on exemptions.
These members ask why a completely new law is needed and desirable for these changes.
Deze leden vragen waarom voor deze veranderingen een geheel nieuw wet nodig en wenselijk zou zijn.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Wet inburgering 20.. (civic integration bill), finding it improves on the 2013 law but insufficiently allows for individual tailoring, notably the strict split between asylum status holders and family/other migrants, the mandatory six-month 'ontzorgen' for asylum holders, the B1 level and the absence of an A2 route, the age limit on the education route, delegation to lower regulation, prestation-based funding, the start date and the link to the Vreemdelingenwet. The government's nader rapport accepts most points, partly or fully: it adds flexibility on the education route age limit and on extension of the term, adjusts the start of the term and the regulation grounds, but rejects the 'nee, tenzij' approach for family migrants, the 'ja, tenzij' approach for ontzorgen, the A2 route, and the postponement of the start date.
concerns: The strict distinction between asylum status holders and family/other migrants in guidance and support is insufficiently tailored; the Afdeling advises a 'nee, tenzij' approach, which the government rejects while stating existing municipal discretion suffices.

The mandatory six-month ontzorgen for asylum status holders is absolute and should be a 'ja, tenzij' rule allowing flexibility; the government keeps the uniform obligation, adding only that longer support is possible.

Absence of an A2 route and the B1 standard, with only a late downgrade option, insufficiently accommodate individual capacities; the government rejects a separate A2 route but adds clarity and an extension mechanism.
The age limit of 28 for the education route is hard to reconcile with the other routes; the government dropped the age limit.

Many grounds for lower regulation (amvb) limit municipal room for tailoring; the government removed the timeliness and minimum-support regulation grounds and clarified municipal discretion, including through municipal ordinance for fines.
The start of the integration term at BRP registration does not account for time needed for the intake and PIP; the government moved the start to the day after the PIP date.
Performance-based funding lacks clear criteria and effects; the government retains it but supplements the memorandum on design and limits it to asylum status holders.

The planned start date of 1 July 2021 leaves insufficient room to incorporate pilot results and municipal preparation; the government rejects postponement, citing ongoing pilots and a support programme.

The alignment of integration requirements with the Vreemdelingenwet 2000 and Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap needs clearer contours; the government explains the naturalisation B1 requirement and pending decisions.

35492.s: This bill amends the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) as a fifth supplementary budget for COVID-19 crisis measures, raising IMF PRGT and EIB pan-European guarantee fund resources and adjusting IMF funds. It takes effect on 1 July 2020, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (IX) for the year 2020.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IX), voor het jaar 2020.

35519.s: The bill amends article 225 of the Gemeentewet so that municipalities may set lower parking tariffs for zero-emission vehicles compared with non-zero-emission vehicles. It entered into force on a date set by royal decree and does not itself delegate new rule-making power.
35519.j: The memorandum justifies the change as a municipal autonomous competence, noting that the planned further elaboration in the Besluit gemeentelijke parkeerbelastingen was dropped after advice from the Raad van State.
q: using this differentiation option falls within the municipality's autonomous competence
het inzetten van deze differentiatiemogelijkheid tot de autonome bevoegdheid van de gemeente behoort
p: Municipalities gain discretion to differentiate parking tariffs by emission status, expanding local fiscal autonomy relative to central rules.

parties: Worries that the discount mainly benefits affluent households who can buy electric cars, and asks whether non-electric tariffs will be raised and how revenue loss is covered.
These members are concerned about the consequences of this bill for the "ordinary" Dutch citizen.
Deze leden maken zich zorgen over de gevolgen van dit wetsvoorstel voor de «gewone» Nederlander.
Objects that the bill was sent to parliament despite the Raad van State having rejected it, and asks how compensation of the discount via higher fees for other cars will be prevented.
They ask whether the government is aware that the Council of State has already rejected this proposal.
Zij vragen of de regering ervan op de hoogte is dat de Raad van State dit voorstel al heeft afgefakkeld.

Asks how the law can prevent municipalities from passing lost revenue on to owners of non-zero-emission vehicles through higher tariffs, and questions the Raad van State's point on using fiscal law for non-fiscal goals.
How will the government prevent the discount for zero-emission cars from being offset by municipalities making non-zero-emission cars pay more?
Hoe gaat de regering voorkomen dat de korting voor emissieloze auto’s door gemeenten wordt gecompenseerd door niet-emissieloze auto’s meer te laten betalen?
Asks for national guidelines so foreign drivers can also benefit from the tariffs and for the government to explain why the internet consultation responses were not substantively answered.
The D66 members stress that the adjusted parking tariffs must also apply to foreign (non-Dutch) parkers.
De leden van de D66-fractie benadrukken dat de aangepaste parkeertarieven ook voor buitenlandse (niet-Nederlandse) parkeerders moeten gelden.
Supports the goal of cleaner traffic but argues the measure will do little for air quality because the largest gains lie with older diesel cars, and calls for national environmental zones.
These members do regret that the current form will mean much less for air quality.
Deze leden betreuren wel dat de huidige vorm veel minder zal betekenen voor de luchtkwaliteit.
Views the measure as another subsidy for affluent electric-car leasers, undermining support for climate policy, and asks for quantification of CO2 savings and of past subsidies.
These members ask the government to quantify that "small contribution": how much CO2 will be saved by this measure?
Deze leden vragen de regering die «kleine bijdrage» te kwantificeren: hoeveel CO 2 gaat er door deze maatregel bespaard worden?
Believes the bill does not meet its aim, deepens a rich-poor divide, and that variable municipal parking policy makes the incentive unreliable, possibly attracting more car traffic to city centres.
Together with the Council of State, they are of the view that the bill does not contribute to the intended goal, while it fuels the divide in society between "rich" and "poor".
Zij zijn met de Raad van State van mening dat het wetsvoorstel niet bijdraagt aan het beoogde doel, terwijl het de tweedeling in de samenleving tussen «rijk» en «arm» aanjaagt.
Welcomes the bill as a good step and asks whether it could also cover shared zero-emission vehicles and whether municipalities will use the option soon.
As far as these members are concerned, it is a good step that municipalities are given the option to apply lower parking tariffs for zero-emission vehicles.
Het is wat deze leden betreft een goede stap dat gemeenten de mogelijkheid krijgen om lagere parkeertarieven te gaan hanteren voor emissieloze voertuigen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the bill allowing municipalities to differentiate parking tariffs by vehicle exhaust emissions had insufficiently justified effectiveness, instrumentalised parking tax for non-fiscal purposes, and failed to respond substantively to internet consultation comments. The government's reply accepted the advice to limit differentiation to lower tariffs for zero-emission vehicles, added substantive justification and clarified the explanatory memorandum, and the advice was largely followed.
concerns: The measure's necessity and effectiveness were not convincingly justified, as CE Delft studies suggest only a modest effect in isolation; the government added evidence from other studies and policy-package reasoning.

Using parking tax, a fiscal instrument, for air-quality (non-fiscal) purposes adds regulatory complexity and implementation costs and may conflict with the original parking-regulation purpose; the government argued such goals fit the parking tax framework.
The internet consultation responses were not substantively addressed in the explanatory memorandum; the government published its substantive response online and clarified the memorandum.
The bill allowed tariffs to vary by emissions in both directions, although only lower tariffs for zero-emission vehicles were intended; the wording was changed accordingly.

35528.s: The bill amends article 22b of the Dutch Criminal Code to add a new ground under which a community service sentence (taakstraf) may not be imposed for violent offences (articles 300-303) against police officers, fire or ambulance staff, extraordinary investigating officers, or other persons performing a public task in maintaining order or safety. It leaves the judge's sentencing discretion otherwise intact and applies only to offences committed after entry into force.
35528.j: The memorandum justifies the sentencing restriction by the unacceptability of community service for violence against people performing public tasks and says the judge retains room to consider personal circumstances.
q: In doing so, the bill in our view leaves sufficient room for the judge to take into account special circumstances, lying in the personality of the suspect or the circumstances under which the offence was committed.

Daarbij biedt het wetsvoorstel naar ons oordeel afdoende ruimte om bijzondere omstandigheden, gelegen in de persoonlijkheid van de verdachte of de omstandigheden waaronder het feit is begaan, in de rechterlijke beoordeling te betrekken.
d: date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: Asks how the expanded community-service ban will work in practice and whether judges can circumvent it by combining a community sentence with a one-day prison term.

Can the government estimate the possibility that, as a result of this amendment, judges will impose a community sentence together with a one-day prison sentence, thereby circumventing the community-service ban?

Kan de regering een inschatting geven van de mogelijkheid dat rechters als gevolg van deze wetswijziging een taakstraf samen met één dag gevangenisstraf gaan opleggen, zodat op die manier het taakstrafverbod wordt omzeild?
Asks how the existing community-service ban functions and whether prosecutors could avoid it through a one-day prison term, and questions the scope of covered public officials.
Argues the bill unnecessarily restricts judges' sentencing discretion, is counterproductive for recidivism, and undermines the separation of powers.
However, they consider the chosen means of combating such offences counterproductive and unnecessarily and undesirably hindering the work of judges and public prosecutors.

Zij zijn echter van mening dat het gekozen middel om dergelijke misdrijven te bestrijden contraproductief is en het werk van rechters en officiëren van justitie onnodig en op onwenselijke wijze belemmert.
Doubts that a blanket ban is needed and insists the criminal judge must be able to tailor sentences to the circumstances of each case.
Each criminal case has its own merits and the criminal judge must be able to arrive at a sanction aimed at the offender based on the circumstances of the case.
Elke strafzaak kent zijn eigen merites en de strafrechter moet aan de hand van de omstandigheden van het geval tot een op de persoon van de dader gerichte sanctie kunnen komen.
Sees the bill as a restriction on judicial autonomy and sentencing freedom, questions its evidentiary basis, and asks why combined sentences are not allowed.
The members point out that this bill means a restriction of the judge's autonomy.
De aan het woord zijnde leden wijzen erop dat dit wetsvoorstel een inperking van de autonomie van de rechter betekent.
Supports tougher treatment of violence against public officials, arguing a bare community sentence offends the sense of justice, and asks about scope and damage to vehicles.
When they are assaulted and violence is used against them, in these members' view it runs counter to the sense of justice if only a bare community sentence is imposed.
Wanneer zij belaagd worden en geweld toegepast wordt tegen hen druist het wat voornoemde leden betreft in tegen het rechtvaardigheidsgevoel indien enkel een kale taakstraf wordt opgelegd.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill extending the prohibition on community service sentences to all physical violence against persons with public duties in law and order or safety, raising concerns about justification, effectiveness, proportionality, alternatives and scope. The minister's reply largely accepts the points: adds crime statistics, clarifies the complementary nature of the measure, justifies not allowing conditional sanctions, and narrows and clarifies the scope.
concerns: The Afdeling found the proposed extension insufficiently justified with figures and questioned its effectiveness given existing measures and judicial room to impose lighter sentences; the government added statistics and clarified the complementary role but kept the measure.

The Afdeling argued the absolute ban leaves no room for individual circumstances, risking disproportionate outcomes for lighter offences; the government replied that existing sentencing discretion suffices but did not change the provision.

The Afdeling asked for explanation of why conditional prison sentences cannot be combined with community service; the government explained in the memorie van toelichting why these do not serve sanction aims.

The Afdeling asked to limit the scope to persons genuinely charged with public duties in law and order or safety and to clarify it, including the requirement of a traceable public principal; the government added clarifications but refused a closed list.

35546.s: The bill amends the Gemeentewet, Provinciewet, Waterschapswet and the BES islands act to replace scattered confidentiality rules with a single regime, abolish the Wob-linked confidentiality ground for individual procedures, and let councils decide on lifting secrecy. It also gives the commissaris van de Koning a new power to attend closed meetings and inspect confidential documents of municipalities in cases of integrity problems or administrative trouble, and requires a certificate of good conduct (VOG) for candidate aldermen and board members.
35546.j: The memorandum justifies the commissaris van de Koning's new powers as concrete tools to fulfil an existing duty to advise and mediate in integrity and administrative problems, and says use will be limited to such cases.
q: It is proposed to give the commissaris van de Koning (or an official designated by him) the power to inspect documents subject to confidentiality and to attend closed meetings.

Voorgesteld wordt om de commissaris van de Koning (of een door hem aangewezen functionaris) de bevoegdheid te verschaffen om documenten waarop geheimhouding rust in te zien en om besloten vergaderingen bij te wonen.
p: Artikel II, onderdeel S (artikel 182 Provinciewet, lid 2)

The commissaris van de Koning gains power to attend all municipal board and council meetings, including closed ones, and inspect any documents deemed necessary, including confidential ones, for integrity and administrative-problem duties.
Artikel I, onderdeel Q (artikel 87-89 Gemeentewet); Artikel II, onderdeel Q (artikel 84-86 Provinciewet)

Secrecy may be imposed on information by councils, colleges, mayors and committees, with confidentiality duties binding all who know the information, sanctioned by temporary exclusion from information for council members.

parties: Asks why the Commissioner of the King's powers are strengthened instead of the mayor's, and whether the Minister of BZK would take on similar powers at provincial level.
Can the government further justify why, in promoting administrative integrity in a municipality, the mayor's position is not strengthened?
Kan de regering nader motiveren waarom, in het kader van het bevorderen van de bestuurlijke integriteit in zijn gemeente, de positie van de burgemeester niet wordt versterkt?
Asks for the timeline of the second tranche of the bill to be in force before the March 2022 municipal elections.
the CDA members ask the government to indicate the timeline for the second tranche.](Note: this is a question about timing, not a check concern.)
vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie de regering het tijdpad aan te geven voor de tweede tranche.
Questions whether the Commissioner's access to secret documents should be subject to a stronger role for the council, given municipal autonomy and democratic legitimacy.
Does the government agree with these members that constitutional safeguards such as municipal autonomy and democratic legitimacy call for a larger role for the council in exercising this power?

Is de regering met deze leden van mening dat rechtsstatelijke waarborgen als de gemeentelijke autonomie en democratische legitimatie een grotere rol van de raad vragen bij de uitoefening van deze bevoegdheid?
Asks whether enforcement and oversight instruments are adequate, noting that side-job registers are insufficiently checked at decentralised level.
These members point out that, for example, the side-function register is insufficiently checked at many decentralised authorities.
Deze leden wijzen in dit verband op het feit dat bijvoorbeeld het nevenfunctieregister bij veel decentrale overheden onvoldoende wordt gecontroleerd.
Considers the mandatory VOG a small step and asks why the government did not adopt the VNG advice that absence of a VOG makes appointment impossible.
These members ask why the government did not choose to adopt the VNG advice that, when no VOG can be submitted, appointment is by definition impossible.
Deze leden vragen waarom de regering er niet voor heeft gekozen het advies van de VNG over te nemen dat, wanneer geen VOG kan worden overgelegd, een benoeming per definitie onmogelijk is.
Asks for justification of the 19-seat threshold for list exhaustion and whether a lower bound is needed to avoid large parts of a council dropping out.
At the same time the question arises whether these municipalities should not also have some lower bound to prevent a substantial part of the council from dropping out.
Tegelijk dringt zich de vraag op of ook voor deze gemeenten niet enige onder-grens dient te bestaan om situaties te voorkomen dat een substantieel deel van de gemeenteraad uitvalt.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering advised on the bill amending the Gemeentewet, Provinciewet, Waterschapswet, Wet openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba and Kieswet to promote administrative integrity and address persistent problems in decentralised government. The Afdeling made no substantive remarks and advised submitting the bill to the Tweede Kamer, and the minister's covering letter forwards it without a point-by-point reply.

35555.s: The bill lets pension scheme participants in both the second pillar (occupational and PW pensions) and third pillar (annuity products) withdraw up to 10% of their old-age pension entitlement as a lump sum at pension start, and temporarily eases the pseudo-employment tax on early-retirement schemes and widens the tax room for saving unused statutory leave. It amends the Pensioenwet, Wvb, Wft, Wet IB 2001 and Wet LB 1964 accordingly, and requires an evaluation within five years.
35555.j: The memorandum justifies the lump-sum option as expanding individual choice and sets the 10% cap to balance choice against adequate pension and reliance on public provisions, while the delegated rules are described as technical and implementation details.
q: A maximum percentage of 10% is considered appropriate to achieve these goals.
Een maximumpercentage van 10% wordt passend geacht om deze doelen te bereiken.
d: further rules on lump-sum withdrawal of pension entitlements
further rules on lump-sum withdrawal under occupational pension
Artikel V, D (artikel 32ba Wet LB 1964), lid 8
annual adjustment of the early-retirement income threshold amount
conditions for lump-sum withdrawal from frozen pension in own management
Artikel V, G (artikel 39j Wet LB 1964), lid 2
annual adjustment of transitional early-retirement threshold amount
p: Gives consumers in the third pillar the option to take up to 10% of periodic annuity payments as a lump sum, expanding individual choice rather than executive discretion.
Artikel I, C (artikel 69a PW) en Artikel II, C (artikel 80b Wvb)
Obliges pension providers to honour lump-sum withdrawal requests subject to conditions, including partner consent and supervision by the AFM.

parties: The CDA opposes the lump-sum option, fearing it undermines the protective function of pensions and that citizens will not be adequately informed about tax consequences.
These members are not in favour of the measure to pay out 10% of the pension on the pension date and are very concerned about its possible consequences.
Deze leden zijn geen voorstander van de maatregel om 10% van het pensioen op de pensioendatum uit te keren en maken zich zeer veel zorgen om de mogelijke gevolgen van deze maatregel.
D66 asks about economic effects, eligibility, the partner-consent requirement and whether the regulation will be evaluated after three years.
These members ask whether the government is willing to evaluate the scheme after three years.
Genoemde leden vragen of de regering bereid is de regeling na 3 jaar te evalueren.
GroenLinks cites AFM, Raad van State and others on informing participants, asks how low-income groups are protected and how tax avoidance and collective risk are prevented.
The Council of State considers it likely that those involved are insufficiently informed and make decisions based on incorrect assumptions that ultimately turn out to their disadvantage.
De Raad van State acht de kans groot dat betrokkenen onvoldoende zijn geïnformeerd en op basis van onjuiste aannames beslissingen nemen die uiteindelijk nadelig voor hen uitpakken.
The SP asks about administrative costs, partner consent, information provision and the consequences for workers in low-wage sectors.
These members note that under current law generic and personal information may be provided both in writing and electronically.
Genoemde leden lezen dat conform de huidige wet- en regelgeving generieke en persoonlijke informatie zowel schriftelijk als elektronisch mag worden verstrekt.
The PvdA worries that a lump sum harms low- and middle-income participants through reduced income-related benefits and possible repayments, and asks for ring-fencing and reconsideration.

Paying out an amount in one lump sum also reduces income-related allowances (such as rent and care allowances), with the result that this scheme turns out less favourably for people with lower incomes.

Het laten uitbetalen van een bedrag in een keer zorgt ervoor dat inkomensgerelateerde toeslagen (zoals de huur- en zorgtoeslag) ook lager worden met als gevolg dat deze regeling nadeliger uitpakt voor mensen met een lager inkomen.
The VVD supports the lump-sum option but wants it combinable with the high-low construction and asks whether personal advice can be facilitated given the Council of State's concerns.
They nevertheless regret that this option cannot be combined with the existing possibility of a high-low payout.
Zij betreuren het evenwel dat die optie niet kan worden gecombineerd met de bestaande mogelijkheid voor een hoog-laaguitkering.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Wet bedrag ineens, RVU en verlofsparen, doubting that the lump-sum pension option adds practical value given its conditions and tax effects, and questioning the generic RVU levy relief and doubled leave-saving as undermining sustainable employability policy. The minister's nader rapport accepts several points (information duties, delegation, RVU explanation, transition rules, evaluation clause) but largely maintains the core design, rejecting the call to allow combining lump sum with hoog-laag and not adapting the generic RVU and verlofsparen measures.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the lump-sum option adds value given restrictive conditions and tax consequences; the government adds information duties and an evaluation clause but keeps the core design.

The Afdeling warns that participants may make disadvantageous decisions due to insufficient information, especially low-income groups; the government adds information obligations for pension providers.

The Afdeling considers the generic RVU levy relief and doubled leave-saving to undermine sustainable employability policy and to need a far more targeted approach; the government rejects a generic-approach concern and keeps the measures.

The Afdeling advises that conditions for the lump sum for bevroren pensioen in eigen beheer be set by algemene maatregel van bestuur rather than beleidsregel; the government adopts a direct ministerial delegation.
The Afdeling asks that the temporary nature of the RVU relief be reflected in the statutory text and that the transition rule be placed in the act; the government adjusts the text accordingly.
The Afdeling asks for clarification of the partner consent requirement, the RVU exemption per employer, and the ODV exception; the government revises the text and explanatory memorandum.

35564.s: The bill amends the Criminal Code, Code of Criminal Procedure, Opium Act, Economic Offences Act, Weapons and Ammunition Act and the Precursors Act to add penalties for trespassing on logistics hubs, raise maximum sentences for threatening officials and lawyers, and allow courts to order offenders to repay state costs of destroying seized dangerous goods. It also extends the asset investigation powers of the prosecutor to cover fines, damages and forfeiture, and lets the minister designate precursor substances by ministerial regulation.
35564.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation route by the need for swift action against new precursors, noting that a general administrative order would slow the ban and that the industry would not be harmed since only substances without legal use can be designated.
q: That is why it is proposed that substances can be designated by ministerial regulation.
Daarom wordt voorgesteld dat de stoffen kunnen worden aangewezen bij ministeriële regeling.
d: designating precursor substances without known legal use
p: Extends the prosecutor's asset investigation powers, including covert surveillance and telecommunications interception, to cover fines, damages and forfeiture, with authorisation by the investigating judge.
Allows the minister to ban substances by ministerial regulation without parliamentary involvement, limited to substances with no known legal use.

parties: Asks why the penalty increase is limited to three years and whether intimidation is already prosecutable, and whether serious assault should be included, questioning the reach of the proposed measures.
The VVD members ask why the maximum penalty is raised to three years rather than aligning with the existing four-year maximum.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen waarom wordt gekozen om het strafmaximum te verhogen tot drie jaar in plaats van aan te sluiten bij de reeds geldende maximumstraf van vier jaar.

Supports the new aggravating ground for threats against officials and legal professionals, asks whether a community-sentence ban should apply, and raises the need for information sharing and clarity on precursor enforcement.
The CDA members support introducing a new aggravating ground for threats against a specific group of officials and legal professionals.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn voorstander van de introductie van een nieuwe strafverhogingsgrond voor onder meer de bedreiging van een specifieke groep ambts- en gezagsdragers en togaberoepen.

Accepts the need for tougher threat penalties but asks whether current sentences are actually too low, questions whether the precursor ban respects foreseeability, and asks how cost recovery will be imposed on co-perpetrators and how the courts' workload is affected.
As set out in the explanatory memorandum, this underlines the seriousness of the offence of threats.
Zoals in de memorie van toelichting is verwoord, wordt daarmee de ernst van het delict bedreiging onderstreept.

Doubts that higher penalties will deter given low reporting and conviction rates, asks whether the temporary scheduling of precursors risks over-criminalisation without foreseeability, and questions whether the cost-recovery measures are cost-effective.
Would it not be far more sensible to first direct all efforts at increasing willingness to report among local officials, lawyers and magistrates?
Is het niet veel verstandiger om alle inspanningen er allereerst op te richten om ervoor te zorgen dat de aangiftebereidheid onder lokale bestuurders, advocaten, magistraten e.d. toeneemt?
Asks about the expected effect of higher penalties, whether police and prosecution capacity is sufficient, whether a catch-all precursor provision is included, and who bears the cost of enforcement.
Will the number of threats decrease as a result?
Zal het aantal bedreigingen hierdoor afnemen?
Supports protecting officials and judges from threats but asks why the aggravating ground excludes civil servants, and asks about possible wijkrechtbanken and the Bibob follow-up.
Can the government further explain why this ground does not apply to civil servants?
Kan de regering nog nader toelichten waarom deze grond niet voor ambtenaren geldt?

Argues the increase from two to three years is too small to deter and asks for four years, and asks whether the scope should extend to emergency workers; also questions whether a set assessment framework exists for knowledge of precursor purposes.
The SGP members ask whether the government agrees that the maximum penalty should be doubled to four years to have a genuine deterrent effect.

De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen de regering of zij deze overweging deelt en of, om van een daadwerkelijk afschrikwekkende werking uit te kunnen gaan, de maximumstraf niet zou moeten worden verdubbeld naar vier jaar.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill tightening criminal law against undermining crime, including a cost-recovery measure, criminalising precursor chemicals, expanded criminal enforcement investigation, and trespass offences at ports and airports, raising effectiveness, drafting, scope and proportionality concerns and advising revision (dictum B_Revise). The government's nader rapport accepted several points (evaluation clause, hardship moderation, clarified intent and SEO formulation) but rejected others such as narrowing cost recovery scope, narrowing SEO thresholds, and lowering the precursor penalty.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts that the benefits of the cost-recovery measure outweigh its financial and social costs, asking for an evaluation clause; the government added an evaluation clause and expanded the financial analysis.
The Afdeling advised limiting cost recovery to offences where destruction is costly, since low-cost cases may not justify the measure; the government did not adopt this.
The Afdeling advised narrowing the scope of the expanded SEO by specifying 'aanzienlijk belang' in the statute; the government declined, relying on existing safeguards.

The Afdeling noted inconsistent wording and treatment of cost recovery across the Opiumwet, WED and Wwm, including post-mortem application; the government aligned the WED provisions but kept the differing approach.

The Afdeling asked for clarification of the intent required under the new precursor offence and of its relation to Article 10a Opiumwet and the six-year maximum; the memorie was supplemented but the penalty was kept.
The Afdeling asked that the amount of cost recovery be capable of moderation with regard to the offender's means; the government added such a moderation provision.
The Afdeling asked for explanation of the relationship between the new trespass offence at airports and Article 62a Luchtvaartwet; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.
The Afdeling provided redactional comments, including aligning wording with Article 62a Luchtvaartwet and relocating SEO provisions to a separate chapter; these were adopted.

35570-V.s: This bill fixes the 2021 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, setting expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros for its policy and non-policy articles. It enters into force on 1 January 2021 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2021 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2021 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State Afdeling advisering raised no remarks on the 2021 budget bill for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and advised submitting it to the House of Representatives. The government's reply notes one non-blank advice concerning the Ministry of Finance, addressed in an annex, and some budget adjustments.

35573.s: The bill amends several Dutch tax laws for 2021, including investment deduction rules for small-scale investment, the wage tax treatment of pension-related rights in the levensloop scheme, corporate tax interest limitation rules, and the Natuurschoonwet estate rules. It also adjusts enforcement rules for tax debts and transitional provisions for motor vehicle tax and other measures.
35573.j: The memorandum justifies the transitional rules and the joint decision mainly by the need for legal certainty and a workable implementation of the levensloop scheme and estate rules.
q: In the Wage Tax and Social Insurance Premiums Reduction Act, the words 'without profit motive' are removed from article 1, first paragraph, under m, under 2°.
In de Wet vermindering afdracht loonbelasting en premie voor de volksverzekeringen vervalt in artikel 1, eerste lid, onderdeel m, onder 2°, «zonder winstoogmerk».
d: joint ministerial decision that a country estate status ends
p: Allows the Ministers of Agriculture and of Finance to decide by joint decision that a property no longer counts as an estate, departing from the general rule in the Natuurschoonwet.
Disapplies a statutory enforcement safeguard for the tax collector when executing enforceable titles and distraint orders.

parties: Asks the government to explain every measure, why some proposals were not submitted separately, the feasibility of the levensloopregeling change, and the implementation capacity of the Tax Authority.
The VVD members ask the government to explain every measure of the bill in the explanatory memorandum.
De leden van de VVD-fractie verzoeken de regering om iedere maatregel van het wetsvoorstel in de memorie van toelichting (MvT) toe te lichten.
Asks for information on the number of participants in the levensloopregeling and on additional costs for institutions designated as wage-tax withholders.
The PVV members ask whether the government can inform the House about the size of the remaining population of participants in the levensloopregeling.
