De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of de regering de Kamer kan informeren omtrent de omvang van de nog bestaande populatie deelnemers in de levensloopregeling.

Welcomes practical simplifications but raises many questions on legal protection, unequal treatment in the levensloopregeling, the 50-50 limit for marital property division, and possible abuse in the investment deduction.
The CDA members consider the measures in the bill on the levensloopregeling practical simplifications for implementation.
De leden van de CDA-fractie achten de in onderhavig wetsvoorstel met betrekking tot de levensloopregeling opgenomen maatregelen praktische versoepelingen voor de uitvoering.

Asks whether taxpayers can pay the withheld wage tax, whether institutions have incentives to collect it, and how the complex ATAD2 and earnings-stripping sequencing is communicated and administered for taxpayers.
The D66 members ask whether the government has taken this into account and has insight into the payment capacity of taxpayers.
De leden van de fractie van D66 vragen tevens of de regering hier rekening mee heeft gehouden en inzicht heeft in de betaalcapaciteit van de belastingplichtigen.

Critically notes that legal certainty of many groups was violated by Tax Authority policy while a small group of estate owners receives transitional protection, and asks for estimates of taxes foregone.

These members find it strange that while the legal certainty of countless groups was violated by government policy carried out by the Tax Authority, this bill carefully ensures that a group of at most 600 people keeps its exemption.

Het bevreemdt deze leden dat, terwijl de rechtszekerheid van talloze groepen zijn geschonden door regeringsbeleid dat is uitgevoerd door de Belastingdienst, met dit wetsvoorstel op uiterst zorgvuldige wijze ervoor wordt gezorgd dat een groepje van hooguit 600 mensen
Asks how duplicate wage-tax collection by the former employer and the implementing institution is prevented and whether the privacy of the beneficiary is adequately safeguarded.
How is it prevented that both the (former) employer and the implementing institution apply wage tax?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat zowel de (ex-)werkgever als de uitvoerende instelling loonheffing toepast?

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering reviewed the draft Overige fiscale maatregelen 2021 bill and raised no substantive objections, only some drafting remarks. The State Secretary of Finance accepted the drafting suggestions, implementing one with a small textual change and declining the other, and made some further redactional adjustments.
concerns: The Afdeling proposed redactional changes to article IV, part F and article VIII; the government did not follow the first but adopted the second with a small textual change.

35582.s: The bill amends the Higher Education Act (WHW), the Student Finance Act 2000 and the Education Inspectorate Act to harmonise funding and student finance for higher professional masters, allow premaster fees, regulate pilot and air traffic controller training with partner organisations, and adjust several administrative rules. It also extends inspectorate oversight to non-institutional persons and raises the age limit for the lifelong learning credit.
35582.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by pointing to technical detail, EU requirements for pilot and air traffic controller training, and the need for flexible administrative rules applied consistently across institutions.
q: Further rules may be laid down by ministerial regulation to implement this article.
Bij ministeriële regeling kunnen nadere voorschriften worden vastgesteld ter uitvoering van dit artikel.
d: permitted student fee and contribution categories
further rules for pilot and air traffic controller programmes
documents and procedure for replacement diplomas after name change
minimum premaster fee set by general administrative order
other student contributions and maximum amounts
I.EE (art. 18.95 / Wet taal en toegankelijkheid reference)
minimum institutional tuition for non-EEA students by general administrative order
p: Institutions may select students for pilot and air traffic controller tracks based on the partner organisation's judgement of suitability, with the selection procedure set by the institution.
Examination committee and examiner rules do not apply where EU rules reserve assessment to an external partner, limiting usual internal examination oversight.
Ministerial regulation may permit institutions to charge students additional contributions, with a hardship support duty for some students.
Inspectorate oversight extends to non-institutional persons and bodies subject to administrative fines, strengthening enforcement of higher education naming rules.

parties: Asks who bears the costs of harmonised hbo master funding and whether it draws on the growing student-number funding, and asks whether the inspectorate gets a sufficiently strong instrument since it cannot impose administrative fines.
Will this be paid from the ever-expanding funding of student numbers by OCW, which is supplemented almost every year by Finance, the members ask.
Zal dit betaald worden uit de steeds uitdijende bekostiging van studentenaantallen door OCW 4 , dat vrijwel jaarlijks aangevuld wordt door Financiën, zo vragen de leden.
Welcomes the bill realising earlier commitments, including the motion on raising the lifelong-learning credit age limit, and asks technical questions on study load of dual programmes.
These members are of the view that it is good that various policy changes previously promised to the House are being realised with this amendment to the law.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat het goed is dat verschillende beleidsmatige wijzigingen die eerder toegezegd zijn aan de Kamer met deze wetswijziging gerealiseerd worden.
Welcomes harmonisation of funding for hbo and wo masters and asks for an overview of regulatory differences and how the criterion of distinctiveness is applied.
These members ask the government for an overview of the aspects in which the rules for hbo masters and wo masters differ further from each other.
Deze leden vragen de regering om een overzicht op welke aspecten de regels voor hbo-masters en wo-masters nog meer van elkaar verschillen.
Cautiously positive on harmonised funding but warns, citing institutions, that 82 hbo 90-credit masters may be excluded from funding and asks whether their position will worsen.
These members ask whether the government agrees that the position of these 82 programmes will worsen due to the proposed changes in article 7.51a.
Deze leden vragen of de regering het met de leden eens is dat de positie van deze 82 opleidingen zal verslechteren door de voorgestelde wijzigingen in artikel 7.51a.
Asks what costs institutions will face and whether the ministry will pay them, and asks whether the law actually widens access to premasters.
Can the government shed some light on the possible costs for educational institutions arising from this law and the proposed amendments?
Kan de regering een licht schijnen op de mogelijke kosten voor onderwijsinstellingen die voort vloeien uit deze wet en de voorgestelde wijzigingen?
Asks whether the government has generically reviewed the Open Universiteit's arrangements beyond incompatibility rules, including the programme committee and works council relationship.
Has the government examined the Open Universiteit arrangement generically for the presence of any other contradictions, they ask.
Heeft de regering de regeling van de Open Universiteit generiek bezien op de aanwezigheid van eventuele andere tegenstrijdigheden, zo vragen zij.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised no substantive objections to the Variawet hoger onderwijs (a bill amending higher education, research and student finance rules) and advised submitting it to parliament, with only drafting remarks. The Minister's nader rapport accepted the drafting remarks, added transitional provisions on tuition fees for ongoing students, and corrected technical errors.
concerns: The Afdeling proposed several technical drafting corrections to the bill's articles, which the government incorporated into the amended bill.

35618.s: The bill implements the 2001 Bunkers Convention in the Caribbean Netherlands (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba) by adding a liability section for bunker oil pollution damage to Book 8 of the Civil Code BES. It sets strict shipowner liability, direct action against insurers, and a mandatory insurance requirement for large ships calling at those islands.
35618.j: The memorandum justifies the insurance and port state control provisions as required to give effect to the Convention's obligations, not as a new executive power.
q: Accession to the convention ensures that the liabilities arising from it can also be invoked for bunker oil pollution damage in the BES islands.

Met de toetreding tot het verdrag wordt bewerkstelligd dat de aansprakelijkheden die voortvloeien uit het verdrag ook ingeroepen kunnen worden bij schade door verontreiniging door bunkerolie op de BES-eilanden.
d: insurance or financial security certificate requirement for ships

parties: Asks why accession and the needed legislative adjustments for the BES islands did not happen earlier, and which convention obligations aimed at flag states cannot apply there.

In addition, these members ask which obligations under the convention (aimed at flag states), beyond the obligation on the registered owner of a ship over 1000 GT to maintain insurance or other financial security for liability for pollution damage, also do not apply to the BES islands.

Daarnaast vragen deze leden welke verplichtingen op grond van het verdrag (die gericht zijn op vlaggenstaten), naast de verplichting van de geregistreerde eigenaar van een schip van meer dan 1000 GT tot het in stand houden van een verzekering of andere financiële zekerheid ter dekking van de kosten wegens aansprakelijkheid voor schade door verontreiniging, nog meer niet van toepassing zijn op de BES-eilanden.
Asks what the absence of flag-state obligations means for implementing the convention and for effects on European Netherlands.
What does this mean for the implementation of the convention?
Wat betekent dit voor de uitvoering van het verdrag?

Welcomes the extended shipowner liability but questions the consultation of the island bodies, which gave no reaction, and asks for a concrete entry-into-force date and a list of unenforceable obligations.
Why did the public bodies not respond? Does the government know whether they really support this bill?
Waarom hebben de openbare lichamen geen reactie gegeven? Weet de regering of zij wel achter dit wetsvoorstel staan?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill extending the Bunker Oil Convention 2001 to the BES islands via Book 8 of the Civil Code BES, noting that the bill itself does not accede the islands to the Convention and that implementing legislation should enter into force together with accession. The minister's reply explains that the entry-into-force date will be aligned with the date of the declaration of extension deposited with the IMO Secretary-General.
concerns: The Afdeling advises stating explicitly in the explanatory memorandum how accession of the BES islands to the Bunker Oil Convention will be achieved and how this relates to the implementing legislation.

The Afdeling recommends that the implementing legislation enter into force simultaneously with the Convention's extension to the BES islands, which the government's reply accommodates by aligning the entry-into-force date with the deposit of the declaration.

35627.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science by reallocating additional funds of EUR 40 million to culture, specifically for independent theatre producers affected by COVID-19. It takes effect on 6 November 2020 and is a seventh incidental supplementary budget.
35627.j: The memorandum justifies moving funds ahead of the Second Supplementary Budget by invoking article 2.27(2) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016.
q: For this reason OCW, as stated earlier, invokes paragraph 2 of article 2.27 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016.
Daarom doet OCW zoals eerder vermeld beroep op lid 2 van artikel 2.27 van de Comptabiliteitswet 2016.

35645.s: The bill amends the proposed aviation tax law so that the tax applies to all passengers departing from Dutch airports, dropping the separate cargo aircraft provisions and fixing the rate at €7.450 per passenger. It also provides that the tax amount is indexed by ministerial regulation to the price level in the year the law takes effect.
35645.j: The memorandum justifies the indexation delegation only by stating that indexation to the price level of the year of entry into force takes place by ministerial regulation, without further reasoning.
q: Article II provides that indexation to the price level of the year of actual entry into force of this bill takes place by ministerial regulation.
Artikel II regelt dat indexatie naar het prijspeil van het jaar van daadwerkelijke inwerkingtreding van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel bij ministeriële regeling plaatsvindt.
d: replacing the fixed passenger tax amount by indexed amount
p: The minister may change the statutory tax amount by ministerial regulation, using a fixed indexation formula tied to the income tax table correction factor.

parties: Asks for explanation of the passenger-volume assumptions behind the compensating tariff, whether the figures were independently certified, and whether the planned two-year evaluation of the freight tax still applies.
Welcomes the removal of the freight tax given expected economic effects in the Maastricht region and asks for updated passenger tariff figures.
The CDA members understand that removing the freight tax is compensated by a higher aviation tax on passengers.
De leden van de CDA-fractie begrijpen dat het wegnemen van de belasting op vracht wordt gecompenseerd met een hogere vliegbelasting op passagiers.
Asks about environmental effects (CO2, particulate matter) and how an increase in freight flights and night noise for residents will be prevented.
The GroenLinks members ask what the consequences of these legislative changes are for the environment (CO2, fine particulates, etc.).
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen wat de gevolgen zijn van deze wetswijzigingen voor het milieu (CO 2 , fijnstof, etc.).
Argues the freight tax was dropped under sector pressure without convincing justification, questions the economic studies relied on, and asks the government to reconsider.
Is the government willing to reconsider the decision to withdraw the freight tax?
Is de regering bereid om het besluit om de vrachttaks in te trekken te heroverwegen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft amendment to the Wet belastingen op milieugrondslag (aviation tax) and raised no remarks, recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Staatssecretaris of Finance replied in a nader rapport that the Afdeling gave no occasion for substantive comments and only redactional and technical improvements were made.

35654.s: This bill amends the temporary COVID-19 elections act to adapt the March 2021 Dutch House of Representatives election to pandemic conditions, covering election board composition, extended result-determination deadlines, distanced and digital sessions, and expanded postal voting for voters aged 70 and over and voters abroad. It also grants ministerial regulations power to set hygiene and distancing rules and procedures for ballot counting and custody of ballot boxes.
35654.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations and deviations by the need to protect public health during the COVID-19 pandemic while holding the March 2021 election on schedule.
d: number of election board members and deputy members
model for health check of election board members
rules on receipt, transport and storage of return envelopes and opening hours of postal ballot offices
rules on suspension of counting, custody of ballot boxes and electronic publication of files
rules on suspension and resumption of counting at postal ballot offices
conduct rules and digital attendance for candidacy sessions
royal decree may end the act earlier than 1 July 2021
p: Artikel I, onderdeel L and T (9, 17e)
Burgemeester and voorzitter gain discretion to suspend vote counting and move counting to the next day, with the burgemeester in consultation deciding on suspension.
A royal decree may terminate the temporary act earlier than its statutory end date without the advisory procedure applied to extensions.</description_en>

parties: Accepts postal voting for this election but asks how late-arriving postal votes are handled and whether early voting should be limited to avoid burdening municipalities; also asks about abroad ballots arriving up to five days after the election.
The VVD members do not prefer postal voting, but given the COVID-19 circumstances they will agree to it for these elections.
Voor de leden van de VVD-fractie gaat niet de voorkeur uit naar briefstemmen, maar gelet op de covid-19-omstandigheden zullen zij hier voor deze verkiezingen mee instemmen.

Asks why postal voting is not open to all voters, questions the workability of handing in postal votes at polling stations and the counting timetable, and suggests dropping proxy-related expansions in the longer term.
These members ask the government why it was not chosen to give all voters the option to vote by post?
Deze leden vragen de regering waarom niet is gekozen om alle kiezers de mogelijkheid te geven om per brief te stemmen?

Questions whether limiting postal voting to age 70+ is unlawful age discrimination and whether it excludes equally vulnerable under-70s; also raises fraud risks such as intercepted ballots and whether authorities can investigate suspicions.
First, the members would like a response to whether strictly delimiting a group of voters on the basis of age is not in conflict with a prohibition on unjustified distinction on the basis of age?

Allereerst ontvangen de aan het woord zijnde leden graag een reactie op de vraag of het strikt afbakenen van een groep kiezers op basis van leeftijd niet in strijd is met een verbod op ongeoorloofd onderscheid op grond van leeftijd?

Worries about voter safety, pressure and intimidation in postal voting, confusing communication, and wants postal voting open to everyone; questions the OSCE criticism of proxies and asks for safeguards against distrust.
How does the introduction of postal voting relate to criticism by, among others, the OSCE of proxy voting?
Hoe verhoudt zich de invoering van briefstemmen met de kritiek van onder andere de OVSE op machtigingen?
Asks whether postal voting can be extended to vulnerable people with documented health conditions and how the government will explain that postal voting is optional.
Does the government consider it feasible that if persons with fragile health, with substantiation of their vulnerability, indicate in advance that they wish to vote by post, this be made possible?

Acht de regering het uitvoerbaar dat als personen met een kwetsbare gezondheid, met onderbouwing van hun kwetsbaarheid, vooraf kenbaar maken dat zij per brief willen stemmen dit dan wel mogelijk te maken?

Argues the age-only selection undermines free and independent voting with secrecy for vulnerable voters, asks whether it violates equality, and asks for the government's justification and evidence on proxy voting.
A large number of (vulnerable) voters are now not enabled to participate freely and independently in the elections.
Een groot aantal (kwetsbare) kiezers wordt nu niet in staat wordt gesteld om vrij en zelfstandig deel te nemen aan de verkiezingen.

Asks whether the measures meet international obligations on accessibility of elections for persons with disabilities (CRPD Article 29) and whether proxy voting is a real alternative for those valuing vote secrecy.
The members of the ChristenUnie faction ask whether the government, with the measures taken, complies with international legal obligations on accessibility of elections for people with disabilities.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen of de regering met de getroffen maatregelen voldoet aan de internationaalrechtelijke verplichtingen voor toegankelijkheid van verkiezingen voor mensen met een beperking.
Asks why postal voting should not also be open to under-70s with limited social networks, suggesting a doctor's statement as a safeguard, and asks for the relevant considerations.
These members would like an explanation of the relevant aspects that played a role in weighing the possibility of an application.
Deze leden zouden graag een toelichting krijgen op de relevante aspecten die bij het afwegen van de mogelijkheid van een aanvraag een rol hebben gespeeld.

Asks the government to reconsider postal voting for other clearly vulnerable groups to respect freedom of choice and the UN disability convention, and raises whether volunteers could be offered COVID tests.
These members ask whether the government would again consider what options exist for the group of people who can clearly also be classed as vulnerable to also choose to vote by post.

Deze leden vragen of de regering nog eens willen bezien welke mogelijkheden er zijn om voor de groep mensen die duidelijk ook als kwetsbaar kunnen worden aangemerkt, ook ervoor zouden kunnen kiezen om per brief te stemmen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised no remarks on the bill amending the temporary COVID-19 election law for the 2021 House of Representatives election and advised submission to parliament. The minister's nader rapport reports that the bill was amended on several points, including separate dispatch of voting passes, limiting postal voting for 70+ voters to the European Netherlands, and aligning polling station opening hours.

35708.s: This omnibus tax bill (Fiscale verzamelwet 2022) amends several tax and customs laws, including the Algemene douanewet (free provision of customs space, fine for failure to notify goods), the Invorderingswet 1990 (interest on customs refunds, removal of the sunset clause on the Belastingdienst's bodemrecht), the Wet belastingen op milieugrondslag, and adds an anti-abuse rule to the Wet op de internationale bijstandsverlening. It also contains minor technical corrections and a dividend-tax adjustment.
35708.j: The memorandum justifies the free-space provision by citing more targeted supervision and shorter response times, and the detention extension by aligning with the Wetboek van Strafvordering.
q: Performing customs checks permanently at business locations leads to more targeted supervision and causes the least disruption to the logistics process for businesses.
Het permanent uitvoeren van douanecontroles op locaties van bedrijven leidt tot gerichter toezicht en brengt voor de bedrijven de geringste verstoring van het logistieke proces met zich mee.
d: designation of free office and inspection space by the customs inspector
p: Businesses and facility users must provide space free of charge to customs at the inspector's designation, to explicit requirements set in that designation.
Extends the maximum detention period for holding suspects for questioning from six to nine hours for offences where pre-trial detention is permitted, excluding midnight to 9 a.m.
ARTIKEL V, A and C (Invorderingswet 1990, artikel 27ter and 70)
Removes the sunset (horizon) clause on the Belastingdienst's bodemrecht, so this preferential collection right no longer lapses.
Allows authorities to disregard arrangements whose primary purpose is evading obligations under international tax assistance rules, applying the obligation as if the arrangement did not exist.

parties: Asks whether customs space obligations can be periodically reviewed, whether objection and appeal is possible against a designation, and how often fines will be imposed.
Objection and appeal should also be possible against the 'designation'.
Tevens dient bezwaar- en beroep mogelijk te zijn tegen de «aanwijzing».
Asks for an implementation test one year after introduction, the quality of implementation, and oversight of Belastingdienst supervision of financial institutions.
Asks the government, in line with the cabinet response to the Kinderopvangtoeslag inquiry report, to carry out an implementation review one year after the measures take effect.

vragen de regering om, in lijn met het voorstel in de kabinetsreactie op het rapport van de Parlementaire ondervragingscommissie Kinderopvangtoeslag, een jaar na de invoering van de maatregelen in deze fiscale verzamelwet een invoeringstoets uit te voeren.

Questions whether administrative-burden reduction justifies the exemption, asks for cost breakdowns and criteria for disproportionate burdens, and asks why the box 3 fictitious yield and online gambling motion were not addressed.
Can the government further justify why introducing a withholding exemption is objectively justified solely to reduce administrative burdens?
Kan de regering nader onderbouwen waarom het introduceren van een inhoudingsvrijstelling objectief gerechtvaardigd is, enkel om administratieve lasten te verminderen?
Asks how large the office space burden on businesses is, how long it lasts, and whether imposing it on firms rather than government is justified.
Does the government find it justified to place this burden on businesses rather than on the government?
vindt de regering het gerechtvaardigd deze last bij bedrijven neer te leggen in plaats van bij de overheid?
Asks whether the exemption gives unintended tax advantages to owners of natuurschoon, how many people benefit, and how customs powers are expanded.
Asks about conditions for exempt entities, foreign shareholders, and the budgetary consequences of the new interest provision.
Surely paying out interest has budgetary consequences?
Het moeten uitkeren van rente heeft toch budgettaire consequenties?
Asks about the consequences of the delayed reform of the Belastingdienst's bodem right and the status of research into alternatives.
What consequences does this delay have and are there risks attached?
Welke gevolgen heeft dit uitblijven en zijn hier risico's aan verbonden?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division issued its opinion on the Fiscale verzamelwet 2022 (a bill amending several tax laws) without any remarks, advising that it be submitted to the House of Representatives. The government's nader rapport notes only minor editorial changes and removal of a redundant clause and subsection in article 27ter of the Invorderingswet 1990.

35726.s: The bill makes corrective amendments to the General Act on Recognition of EU Professional Qualifications and the Architect Title Act to complete the implementation of Directives 2005/36/EC and 2011/98/EU. It adds information-exchange duties for diploma verification, extends the definition of migrant professional, and corrects terminology and the supervision wording for architects.
35726.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as codifying existing practice and correcting incomplete implementation after a Commission formal notice, without substantive changes.
q: Since the proposal explicitly does not intend substantive changes, this proposal was part of the bill up to the Council of State stage.
Aangezien het voorstel uitdrukkelijk geen inhoudelijke wijzigingen beoogt, maakte voorliggend voorstel tot en met de fase Raad van State onderdeel uit van het voorstel van wet

parties: The VVD asks about the practical effects of the bill, whether member-state options exist, and why implementation was delayed by nearly fifteen years, without raising checks on the executive.
What practical consequences does this bill have, or is it mainly a textual change to the law?
Welke praktische gevolgen heeft dit wetsvoorstel of betreft het hier voornamelijk een tekstuele wijziging van de wet?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Verzamelwet OCW 20## omnibus bill amending education, culture and media laws, raising three objections: the Papiaments-in-mbo provision needed a separate bill and better justification, the removal of the special primary education evaluation was insufficiently justified, and additional EU directive implementation should be split off. The government's reply states it adopted all three points by dropping the Papiaments and evaluation provisions and splitting off the EU implementation into a separate bill.
concerns: The Papiaments-in-mbo amendment is a policy change that should be a separate bill with substantive analysis, not part of an omnibus law; the government dropped it from the bill.

Removing the evaluation obligation for special primary education is insufficiently justified, since results for regular primary education cannot simply be transferred; the government dropped this removal from the bill.
Additional implementation of two EU directives in an omnibus bill conflicts with legislative policy; the government split these into a separate bill.

35735.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget (departmental budget statement) of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, adding about 24 million euros for extra support to cultural and creative makers in connection with COVID-19, as shown in the accompanying table. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 12 February 2021.
q: The budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35744.s: The bill amends the Wet luchtvaart to align national aviation charging and performance rules with EU Implementing Regulation 2019/317 by replacing references to the earlier regulations with the new one. It also lets the Minister set additional performance and monitoring indicators by ministerial regulation and adjusts scope and enforcement references.
35744.j: The memorandum justifies the new ministerial power by stating that the EU regulation already allowed such indicators but no formal basis had yet been created to give them national effect.
q: This possibility already existed under the performance regulation, but there had not yet been a need to formally give it effect.
Deze mogelijkheid bestond reeds onder de prestatieverordening maar er was nog geen behoefte geweest hier formeel invulling aan te geven.
d: additional performance and monitoring indicators for air navigation services

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wet luchtvaart to implement EU Implementing Regulation 2019/317 on performance and charging schemes in the European airspace, raising no substantive objections but offering drafting remarks on the explanatory memorandum and transposition table. The minister's nader rapport confirms that the editorial remarks were incorporated into the explanatory memorandum and asks that the bill be sent to the Tweede Kamer.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the explanatory memorandum and transposition table indicate which articles of Regulation 2019/317 apply and justify use of discretionary room for member states, and replace 'no transposition needed' remarks with concrete reasons; the government incorporated these editorial remarks.

35762.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2019/520 on interoperability of electronic road toll systems, establishing registration and accreditation of EETS providers, a EETS register, technical requirements, toll data exchange, a mediating body (NIWO) and enforcement by the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport. It also amends the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 and repeals its chapter VIA.
35762.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly by technical detail, the need for ministerial regulation to specify procedures, and the independence of NIWO, and notes that decisions can be reviewed by the administrative court.
q: For that reason it is permitted to assign this task to the RDW.
Om die reden is het toegestaan deze taak bij de RDW te beleggen.
d: data and documents for EETS provider registration
further rules on exemption for small local toll areas
designation of body receiving anonymised traffic data
exemption from statutory provisions for experimental toll systems
designation of national contact point for cross-border data exchange
restrict, ban or withdraw non-compliant on-board equipment
fee tariffs set by NIWO; Minister approval, ministerial policy rules excluded
p: The minister may grant exemptions from statutory provisions for experimental toll systems, subject to Commission approval, conditions and judicial review of decisions.
Ministerial policy rules on the NIWO's mediation task are excluded under the Kaderwet, reducing ministerial steering of that body while approval of tariffs is retained.

parties: Asks whether cross-border enforcement via vehicle registration data stays within privacy law and whether other member states have implemented the directive in time.
provided this is not in conflict with privacy legislation and regulations.
mits dit niet in strijd is privacywet- en regelgeving.
Asks for clarity on whether the directive indirectly encourages road tolls, on exemptions for local systems, and on the limited scope of public-law supervision and legal protection for EETS users.
Can the government further indicate whether this act will not indirectly lead to road tolls being encouraged?
Kan de regering verder aangeven of deze wet er ook niet indirect voor gaat zorgen dat wegentol wordt gestimuleerd?
Has no major objections in principle but asks about vague criteria ('peripheral', 'local') that could cause interpretive differences and about consultation of parties not using electronic systems.
In the eyes of these members these are very subjective descriptions that may foster differences in interpretation.
Dit zijn in de ogen van deze leden zeer subjectieve omschrijvingen, die interpretatieverschillen in de hand kunnen werken.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Dutch EETS implementation bill (electronic road toll interoperability), raising concerns about the scope of supervision over EETS providers and public toll collectors, a role conflict for the RDW, and unclear legal protection for EETS users. The Minister's nader rapport reports that most points were followed: ILT was designated as supervisor, the NIWO was chosen as mediating body, and the explanatory memorandum was expanded on user remedies.
concerns: Supervision scope was unclear: why EETS providers and public toll collectors were not subject to public-law supervision; the government replaced the RDW with the ILT as supervisor covering both toll collectors and EETS providers.

RDW risked combining conflicting roles (toll collector duties and supervision of private toll collectors); the government now assigns supervision to the ILT and narrows the RDW's role, with the Minister as sole toll collector under the bill.

Legal protection for EETS users disputing invoices or collection was not explained; the government explained that remedies depend on the toll system (bestuursrechtelijk or civielrechtelijk) and added explanation to the memorandum without new statutory remedies.
Redactional points on missing legal bases, cross-references and the transposition table were corrected in the bill and explanatory memorandum.

35771.s: The bill declares void any contract clause that restricts a party's right to publicly disclose or pass on information about incidents in youth care, care and support, under the Jeugdwet, Wkkgz and Wmo 2015, and in Veilig Thuis. It adds corresponding new articles to those three laws, with exceptions for clauses required by statute and for clauses agreed before entry into force.
35771.j: The memorandum justifies the bill by the need for transparency and quality in care, since secrecy clauses allow misconduct to persist and hinder supervisors and clients.
q: Any clause in a contract between contracting parties that restricts or removes the right to make public information about an incident or to provide it to a third party is void.
Elk beding in een door contractspartijen gesloten overeenkomst dat het recht beperkt of ontneemt om informatie over een incident openbaar te maken of aan een derde te verstrekken, is nietig.
d: entry into force by royal decree
p: Artikel I, Artikel II B, Artikel III B, Artikel III C
The bill strengthens citizens' and clients' ability to disclose incident information, reducing contractual barriers to reporting to supervisors and courts.

parties: Asks how the government weighs the Council of State's doubts about necessity and possible adverse effects, and the sector's argument that existing law and codes suffice.
But how does the government weigh the doubts of the Council of State and the criticism from the internet consultation, particularly regarding necessity and possible adverse effects?

Maar hoe weegt de regering de twijfels van de Raad van State en de kritiek die uit de internetconsultatie naar voren zijn gekomen; met name op het vlak van de noodzakelijkheid en de mogelijk nadelige effecten?
Strongly supports an open incident culture and asks questions about the expected effectiveness of the bill and its relation to the AVG.
These members are strongly in favour of an open culture in which it can be discussed how incidents arise and how one can learn from them.
Deze leden zijn groot voorstander van een open cultuur waarin bespreekbaar is hoe incidenten ontstaan en hoe hiervan geleerd kan worden.
Considers gag clauses on incidents unacceptable and asks how privacy of clients and staff will be protected and how violations can be reported.
These members find gag clauses about incidents in care unacceptable.
Deze leden vinden zwijgbedingen over incidenten in de zorg onaanvaardbaar.

Asks why a statutory regulation is needed now, given the Council of State's point that no arguments were offered, and asks about enforcement, supervision of Wmo and balance between client and provider interests.
The Council of State states in its reaction that the government offers no arguments for the necessity of a statutory regulation at this time.
De Raad van State stelt in haar reactie namelijk dat de regering geen argumenten aandraagt voor de noodzaak om thans een wettelijke regeling voor te stellen.
Asks about the scope of the ban, its application to Veilig Thuis and related parties, and risks of ambiguous definitions and aggression toward staff.
These members note, however, that Veilig Thuis is a societal point of contact where many different (societal) parties can bring their concerns.
Deze leden constateren echter dat Veilig Thuis een maatschappelijk aanspreekpunt is, waar veel verschillende (maatschappelijke) partijen met hun zorgen terecht kunnen.

Asks whether the broad definition of incident covers all care activity, how existing gag clauses will be declared void, and whether legal aid is accessible; also questions the Council of State's objection on necessity.

These members note that the definition of 'incident' is quite broad (especially through the phrase 'could have led') and ask the government whether, in this way, everything that happens in assistance or care would fall under it.

Genoemde leden merken op dat de definitie van «incident» vrij breed is (zeker door het stuk «had kunnen leiden») en vragen de regering of op deze manier niet alles dat in de hulpverlening of zorg gebeurd hieronder zal vallen?
Welcomes statutory nullity of gag clauses for client position and trust, while stressing information campaigns and monitoring of side effects.
These members are pleased that this bill legally anchors that a gag clause on providing information about incidents in youth care, care and support is void by operation of law.

Deze leden zijn verheugd dat met dit wetsvoorstel wettelijk wordt verankerd dat een zwijgbeding met betrekking tot het verstrekken van informatie over incidenten in jeugdzorg, zorg en ondersteuning van rechtswege nietig is.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State questions the necessity of a bill declaring silence clauses (zwijgbedingen) about incidents in youth care, care and support null and void, arguing that existing norms, supervision and civil-law nullity under art. 3:40 BW already cover the problem and that no new facts justify statutory regulation. The Minister's reply accepts the advice in part by better motivating necessity, clarifying the role of civil courts, and dropping the term 'bijna-incident', while maintaining the bill.
concerns: The Afdeling finds insufficient justification for the necessity of the bill given existing norms, supervisory tools and civil-law nullity; the government expanded the explanatory memorandum to argue why statutory anchoring is still needed.
The explanatory memorandum should address whether the civil court must still be invoked to establish nullity in disputed cases; the government added this clarification.
The term 'bijna-incident' creates confusion with the definition of incident; the government removed the term from the explanatory memorandum.

35780.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate by adding supplementary appropriations for start-up and scale-up support, innovative SMEs, and COVID-19 economic relief and event subsidies. It takes effect from 25 March 2021, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate for 2021.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

35807.s: The bill adds a temporary legal basis to the Public Health Act allowing ministerial regulations to require a COVID-19 test certificate for access to culture, events, youth activities, hospitality and sport, and by general administrative order for secondary vocational and higher education. It sets conditions (public interest, feasibility, safeguards), digital certificate and application rules, and time-limits the framework to the life of chapter Va.
35807.j: The memorandum justifies the new delegation as needed to give a clear legal basis for test certificates under fundamental rights review, given Health Council advice and court challenges, and to act quickly during the epidemic.
q: The bill makes explicit the basis to use test certificates by ministerial regulation for access to sports and youth activities, cultural institutions, events, restaurants and other hospitality.

Het wetsvoorstel expliciteert de grondslag om bij ministeriële regeling testbewijzen te kunnen inzetten voor toegang tot sport- en jeugdactiviteiten, culturele instellingen, evenementen, restaurants en overige horeca
d: test certificate requirement for culture, events, youth activities, hospitality and sport
test certificate requirement in vocational and higher education
rules on test certificate checks and denial of access
digital and paper certificate requirements, data processing conditions
exemptions and exceptions for mass automated checking systems
equating other documents (vaccination proof, medical statement) with a test result
retention period for test result files
p: Gives the executive a specific statutory basis to require test certificates for access to listed activities and, via general administrative order, education, restricting citizens' bodily integrity and privacy rights.
Sets conditions that regulations must meet: public interest, feasibility and safeguards against unequal access.
Minister becomes controller of certificate data and applications, with information duties toward citizens on rights and complaints.
Minister may exempt systems that read certificates from the normal application rules, with conditions on security and data protection.

parties: Asks for a full overview of ministerial regulations and AMvBs, whether parliamentary pre- or post-review procedures apply, and why delegation rather than statute is used.
They therefore want to know what the involvement of parliament is in the various regulations, and want the overview to state whether there is a pre- or post-review procedure.

Daarom willen deze leden weten wat de betrokkenheid van het parlement bij de verschillende regelingen is, en zij willen daarom in het overzicht opgenomen hebben of er een voorhang- of nahangprocedure is

Questions the logic of regulating test certificates in the statute while vaccination certificates are left to a later AMvB, the equivalence criterion, the proposed fee creating inequality, and the timeline of the bill.
Said members ask whether the government really considers these certificates mutually comparable.
Genoemde leden vragen of de regering deze bewijzen werkelijk onderling vergelijkbaar acht.
Opposes the bill as premature, objects to the EUR 7.50 fee as a barrier for low-income people, asks for a fixed end date, and raises data-protection concerns.
These members therefore ask the government to scrap the own contribution and keep the test free.
Genoemde leden vragen de regering dan ook om de eigen bijdrage te schrappen en de test gratis te houden.
Accepts test certificates as temporary but stresses that mandating them restricts fundamental rights, so proportionality, subsidiarity and temporariness must be secured.
Mandating test certificates by government is however a restriction of fundamental rights.
Het van overheidswege verplichten van testbewijzen is echter wel een beperking van de grondrechten
Warns that Parliament will lose grip on many rules left to ministerial regulation, questions the commercial testing set-up and the risk of a two-tier society.
Worries the EUR 7.50 fee widens inequality, questions excluding self-tests, and asks about costs and expert input.
Said members fear that for them an own contribution of EUR 7.50 per person per test certificate is an enormous barrier.
Genoemde leden vrezen dat voor hen een eigen bijdrage van € 7,50 per persoon per testbewijs een enorme drempel opwerpt.
Objects that the bill shifts from healthy-unless-symptomatic to sick-unless-tested, lacks a clear horizon and objective criteria, and may increase inequality.
Instead of healthy-unless-proven-otherwise, the bill proceeds from sick-unless-proven-otherwise.
In plaats van «gezond, tenzij» gaat het wetvoorstel dus uit van «ziek, tenzij».
Asks how the unpredictable route map and the interests of people with low incomes or who cannot be tested are weighed.
In what way have the interests been taken into account of people for whom a test as access to important parts of public life presents a major barrier.
Op welke manier zijn de belangen meegenomen van mensen waarvoor een test als toegang tot belangrijke onderdelen van het openbaar leven een grote drempel opwerpt.
Questions the purpose of test certificates given expected summer vaccination coverage.
The 50PLUS member asks what the use of the test certificates is in relation to the timing of everything.
Het lid van de 50PLUS-fractie vraagt wat het nut van de testbewijzen is in relatie tot de timing van een en ander
Asks the government for a detailed explanation of OMT and ECDC advice and wants the vaccination-certificate AMvB prepared in advance rather than only after risk equivalence is established.
Would it not be more logical to already prepare and have ready the AMvB for mid-May 2021, when the Health Council advice is in?
Is het niet logischer dat nu al voor te breiden en klaar te hebben liggen voor medio mei 2021 als het advies van de Gezondheidsraad er is?

Objects that the bill regulates test certificates in detail while equating vaccination certificates only through a later AMvB, questions the 'comparable transmission risk' criterion, and demands concrete individual answers.
Does the government really consider these certificates mutually comparable?
Acht de regering deze bewijzen werkelijk onderling vergelijkbaar?
Criticizes the invasiveness of nasal swabbing, the lack of a legal basis for school staff testing children, and the continued use of the BSN despite a parliamentary motion.
Penetrating the nasal cavity is an invasive act, the PVV members state.
Het binnendringen in de neusholte is een invasieve handeling, zo stellen de leden van de PVV-fractie.
Asks about the timing of the fee if step five of the reopening plan is not reached by July and about the status of the Open House tender.
Objects to the EUR 7.50 fee creating a class divide, to the commercial delivery of testing, to unclear supervision of commercial providers, and to the lack of parliamentary control over later AMvBs.
Can the government elaborate on this? The SP members also ask the government to what extent commercial interests conflict with people's societal and personal interests.
Kan de regering hier nader op ingaan? Ook vragen de leden van de SP-fractie de regering in hoeverre commerciële belangen botsen met maatschappelijke en persoonlijke belangen van mensen.
Finds the criteria for when test certificates apply too vague, calling the routekaart insufficient legal basis for restricting fundamental rights, and questions the fee as a financial barrier.
These members need more legal anchoring to be able to agree to a bill that may affect several fundamental rights of citizens.
Deze leden hebben meer wettelijke houvast nodig om in te kunnen stemmen met een wetsvoorstel dat toch meerdere grondrechten van burgers kan gaan raken.

Questions the ambiguous purpose of the test certificates, the rejection of self-tests, and whether the chosen design is sustainable in a future scenario; asks about the involvement of a commercial party.
Can the government imagine that this creates a high threshold, and how does it view the use of self-tests, supervised or not?
Kan de regering zich voorstellen dat dit een hoge drempel opwerpt en hoe kijkt zij naar de inzet van – al dan niet begeleid – zelftesten?
Asks how a legal test obligation for businesses fits with the claim that businesses remain free to participate, and whether this should be regulated at statutory level.
How does a legal obligation for a test certificate relate to the claim that businesses are always free to participate or not?
Hoe verhoudt een «juridische verplichting» voor een testbewijs zich tot de stelling dat het «ondernemers altijd vrij staat om al dan niet deel te nemen»?
Asks whether a person with a vaccination certificate must still test, and what a vaccination certificate is defined as, and whether a test-certificate access criterion creates inherent societal harm.
Refusing both persons or the person without a test certificate access is an undesirable societal effect.
Beide personen of de persoon zonder testbewijs toegang weigeren is een maatschappelijk ongewenst effect.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division accepts the purpose of the Temporary COVID-19 test certificates bill, but advises clarifying scope and sector delimitation, ensuring alternatives and equal access, dropping the employee exemption and the vaccination-certificate equivalence, and delegating less to ministerial regulation. The government's reply accepts most points, adds clarifications, keeps the employee exemption and the delegation design, and moves vaccination-certificate equivalence to an AMvB with a pre-consultation procedure.
concerns: Council questions proportionality of passing on test costs to non-essential sectors and recommends not charging education institutions; government limits passing-on and states education costs are borne by the state.

Council advises dropping the exemption for employees from the obligation to show a test certificate because it undermines effectiveness and the aim of the bill; government keeps the exemption while adding clarifications.

Council urges primacy of the legislature, recommending that equivalence of vaccination certificates be dropped from the bill and regulated separately, and that certain matters be set by AMvB rather than ministerial regulation; government moves equivalence to AMvB with pre-consultation but keeps delegation largely intact.

Council finds that broad delegation to ministerial regulation on test certificates, personal data and apps requires more statutory detail; government defends delegation given urgency and adds safeguards.
Council asks for clarity on criteria for phased introduction and boundary between designated and non-designated sectors; government adds clarifications to the explanatory memorandum.
Council asks for information on the state of app implementation and feasibility of paper certificates; government adds explanation about the state of the apps and the role of the scanner.

Council asks clarification on alternatives for people unable or unwilling to be tested, and on the position of students; government clarifies that alternatives are desirable but not required and that education must remain accessible without a certificate.
Council notes overlap between the criteria in article 58b and the new article 58rb of the Wpg; government removes the duplicated criteria.

35816.s: The bill allows municipalities to use a simplified tendering procedure for social services under the Youth Act and the Wmo 2015, and requires municipal ordinances to ensure reasonable prices and continuity of care. It adds delegation clauses allowing general administrative orders (AMvB) to set further rules on cost elements and continuity safeguards, and requires a review report within five years.
35816.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying that national rules on reasonable prices and continuity are needed for quality care and that they only give more detail to an existing statutory duty, so budgets are unaffected.
q: This bill contains the delegation provision for this 'AMvB reasonable prices Youth Act'. The AMvB will be submitted to parliament beforehand.
Dit wetsvoorstel bevat de delegatiebepaling voor deze «amvb reële prijzen Jeugdwet». De amvb zal bij het parlement worden voorgehangen.
d: further rules on reasonable prices and care-quality safeguards for youth care procurement
Artikel II, A (Wmo 2015 art. 2.6.6 as amended)
continuity safeguards for procurement of social support under the Wmo
p: Allows the municipal executive (college) to have implementation of the Wmo performed by third parties, excluding the setting of client rights and duties.
Artikel I, B and Artikel II, B (Jeugdwet art. 2.12; Wmo art. 2.6.4)
Permits simplified tendering for youth and social support services, letting municipalities award contracts on quality rather than lowest price, within specified conditions.
Requires the minister to report to the States General on the effectiveness of the law within five years.

parties: Asks how municipalities will apply the simplified procurement regime, how quality and selection criteria will be set, and when the EU procurement evaluation will be completed.
Said members would like to know in which situations, or under which circumstances, this would be the case.
Genoemde leden zouden graag willen weten in welke situaties, of onder welke omstandigheden, dit het geval zou zijn.
Asks what checks and balances remain in the simplified procedure, whether it risks favouritism, and how gemeenteraden can supervise compliance with the real-price regulation.
Is it not logical that this risk grows when the options are widened to forgo a tendering procedure specifically designed to make as fair an assessment as possible and reduce the risk of favouritism?

Is het niet logisch dat dit risico groter wordt als de mogelijkheden worden verruimd om af te zien van een gunningsprocedure die er specifiek voor is gemaakt om een zo eerlijk mogelijke afweging te maken en het risico op «vriendjespolitiek» te verminderen?
Questions why EU procurement rules are not simply abolished for youth and social care and whether the bill truly solves the problem, while asking how quality and smaller providers will be protected.
Why does the government not stop these European procurement rules?
Waarom stopt de regering niet met deze Europese aanbestedingsregels?
Supports the goal of more money for care but doubts municipalities will professionalise contract management, notes the Raad van State warning, and asks about subcontracting and cost-based pricing.
Municipalities can only do this well if they have a number of things in order at the outset, such as the policy, contracting and implementation cycle.
Dat kunnen gemeenten immers alleen op een goede manier doen als zij bij aanvang een aantal zaken op orde hebben, zoals de cyclus van beleid, contractering en uitvoering.
Has long favoured real tariffs and asks who will supervise them, whether a Jeugdautoriteit should do so, and how staff and client continuity are protected during provider takeovers.
They also ask who will supervise these real tariffs.
Daarbij vragen zij wie zal gaan toezien op deze reële tarieven.

Supports reducing procurement burdens but asks how the quality rule and selection criteria will be enforced, whether client organisations get a formal role, and whether small providers will be squeezed out.

How will the government ensure a balanced approach in which not only reducing administrative burdens but also care content, the client and the client's system are taken into account in the procurement process?

Op welke wijze gaat de regering ervoor zorgen dat er een evenwichtige benadering komt waarbij niet alleen vermindering van administratieve lasten maar ook de zorginhoud, de cliënt en het systeem rondom de cliënt meegenomen worden in het aanbestedingsproces?

Supports simpler procurement and quality over price, but asks why much of the substantive quality and continuity requirements are left to municipal ordinances and AMvB, and how municipal discretion is balanced against quality assurance.
How has the balance between municipal policy freedom and safeguarding quality and continuity been struck?
Hoe is de afweging tussen beleidsvrijheid van gemeenten en de borging van kwaliteit en continuïteit gemaakt?
Supports the aim of lower burdens but fears smaller specialist providers will be excluded and asks how breadth of supply, subcontracting risks and municipal capacity will be guaranteed.
In addition, these members fear that the proposed amendment may lead to smaller (specialist) care providers being less easily contracted by municipalities.
Daarnaast vrezen deze leden dat de voorgestelde wetswijziging ertoe kan leiden dat kleinere (specialistische) zorgaanbieders minder gemakkelijk door gemeenten zullen worden gecontracteerd.
Says the bill is too non-binding, that municipalities keep too much discretion and lack expertise, and calls for a Jeugdautoriteit with statutory powers to guarantee real prices and quality.
The BIJ1 member is of the view that the amendment should be much more binding in this area.
Het lid van de fractie van BIJ1 is van mening dat de wetswijziging veel dwingender moet zijn op dit gebied.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that the bill amending the Jeugdwet and Wmo 2015 to ease tendering burdens is acceptable but that the explanatory memorandum must address the financial consequences of the quality and price rules that can be set by AMvB for youth care. The government's nader rapport accepts the point, explains that the AMvB is expected to bring both price increases and decreases, and states that the financial effects are otherwise limited.
concerns: The Afdeling notes that the quality improvements from delegated price and quality rules may raise prices and asks the explanatory memorandum to address the financial consequences, which the government only partly does by arguing the delegation itself has no financial effects.
The Afdeling stresses that professionalisation of contract management by municipalities is essential, and the government agrees and points to its existing support programme.

35825.s: The bill replaces the court-expert requirement and the court-based procedure for changing the sex registration in Dutch birth records with a civil-registrar procedure based on a declaration and in-person confirmation after four to twelve weeks. Court involvement remains required for minors under sixteen and for third or later changes.
35825.j: The memorandum justifies removing the expert declaration and court step by citing the right to self-determination, comparative practice, and that identity fraud risks are addressed by existing checks.
q: After an administrative period of at least four and at most twelve weeks, the transgender person can confirm their notification in person before the civil registrar.
Na een administratieve periode van ten minste vier en ten hoogste twaalf weken kan de transgender persoon zijn kennisgeving in persoon bevestigen bij de ambtenaar van de burgerlijke stand.
d: documents to submit and content of the registration change and name change deed
p: Sex registration changes move from a court-based procedure to an administrative procedure before the civil registrar, reducing judicial oversight of such changes for adults.
Court review of changes for minors under sixteen is retained, with the court assessing whether the change serves the child's interest.

parties: Questions the arbitrary age limit and the reasoning for dropping the minimum age, and supports court involvement for minors to prevent hasty changes.
These members therefore agree with the government that judicial intervention is desirable and necessary to prevent a change of gender registration from happening hastily.
Voornoemde leden zijn dan ook met de regering van mening dat rechterlijke tussenkomst gewenst en noodzakelijk is, om te voorkomen dat een wijziging van de geslachtsregistratie overhaast plaatsvindt.
Supports abolishing the expert declaration on self-determination grounds but considers the judicial review for minors an unnecessary restriction on self-determination.
In their view this review is a restriction of the right to self-determination and adds little or nothing to protecting the child's interests.
Deze toets is in hun ogen een beperking van het zelfbeschikkingsrecht en voegt weinig tot niets toe aan het beschermen van het belang van het kind.
Asks whether sufficient safeguards exist for minors and whether the voorlichtende function of the expert conversation lost by the Council of State's objection should be replaced.
Can the government explain whether an alternative should still be introduced for the informational function of the conversation, as the Council of State among others suggests.
Kan de regering toelichten of alsnog een alternatief geïntroduceerd zou moeten worden voor de voorlichtingsfunctie van het gesprek zoals (onder meer) de Afdeling oppert.
Asks whether a children's judge is competent to assess durability of a minor's wish and whether the court step adds value over the old expert declaration.
Is the children's judge sufficiently expert to establish whether a child's wish to change gender registration is sufficiently durable.
Is de kinderrechter voldoende deskundig om te kunnen constateren of de wens van een kind tot wijziging van de geslachtsregistratie voldoende duurzaam is.
Asks why parents and child cannot weigh the child's interest themselves without court involvement for under-sixteens, and seeks comparison with other countries.
Why does the government consider parents and child unable to weigh the child's interest themselves in the decision to change the gender entry?
Waarom acht de regering ouders en kind niet in staat om zelf het belang van het kind te wegen bij de beslissing tot wijziging van de geslachtsvermelding?
Sees court involvement for under-16s as violating self-determination and disproportionate, and urges the bill to be amended to allow changes without judicial intervention.
In this form, in the view of these members, the right to self-determination is violated.
In deze vorm wordt naar het oordeel van deze leden het zelfbeschikkingsrecht geschonden.
Asks how a judge can test the inner conviction, durability and consequences of repeated changes, and notes the Council of State's concerns about dropping the expert review.
How should a judge deal with the fluidity of minors' gender identity, which the government itself mentions?
Hoe moet een rechter omgaan met de, ook door de regering, genoemde fluïditeit die de genderidentiteit van minderjarigen kenmerkt?

Argues that dropping the expert declaration takes grave risks contrary to the principle of due care, that the bill lacks verification of the conviction, and that independent third parties should check the child's interests.
These members believe the government, contrary to the principle of due care, takes major risks by deliberately dropping the involvement of an external expert.
Deze leden menen dat de regering in strijd met het zorgvuldigheidsbeginsel grote risico's neemt door het moedwillig laten vervallen van de betrokkenheid van een externe deskundige.
Welcomes the bill as a first step but asks whether less intensive alternatives to mandatory judicial intervention for minors were considered.
Why does judicial intervention add value compared to other alternatives, they ask the government.
Waarom heeft de rechterlijke tussenkomst een meerwaarde ten opzichte van andere alternatieven, zo vragen zij de regering.
Considers court intervention for minors too heavy a measure, and argues the bill fails to respect self-determination, including for non-binary persons.
This member, however, also considers the intervention of the judge too heavy a measure.
Dit lid is echter ook van mening dat de tussenkomst van de rechter een te zware maatregel betreft.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises against adding a non-binary gender registration option ('X') via amendment to the gender-change bill, arguing it is a substantive change with wide implications for other legislation, IT systems, statistics and international law and should be a separate bill. The minister's reply accepts the need for careful study, states an inventory of bottlenecks is underway, and forwards the advice to parliament.
concerns: The amendment amounts to a substantive change to the legal system of gender registration, not a mere procedural change, and creates unclear implications for existing law, including the existing category for children whose sex cannot be determined.

The amendment has wide consequences for other legislation, IT registration systems, statistics and administrative implementation, with potentially high costs that were not addressed in the explanatory note.
International private law implications, including the low likelihood that a non-binary gender designation would be recognised abroad, must not be underestimated.
The advice is that the question deserves a separate, thorough legislative treatment with a complete overview of effects and financial consequences rather than inclusion in this bill.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division endorsed emancipating transgender persons but objected that the bill's justification for dropping the age-16 limit and the expert statement requirement was insufficiently reasoned, given expert opinion favouring caution and the value of the expert's advisory role. The government's reply accepted the criticism in part by expanding the justification, explaining the two-step procedure, and clarifying that the 16-year threshold is kept for major personal matters while minors under 16 would use court involvement.
concerns: Removing the minimum age of sixteen for changing legal sex markers requires a self-standing, reasoned justification that weighs expert opinion, which the explanatory memorandum lacked.

Dropping the expert statement requires explanation of how the two-step procedure before the civil registrar still ensures capacity and durability of the wish, and why the advisory and information function of the expert is no longer needed.
The explanatory memorandum should justify why the expert statement is also dropped for sixteen and seventeen year olds, which the evaluation's criticism mainly did not address.

35852.s: The bill implements the surrender, mutual legal assistance, justice data exchange and passenger name record provisions of the EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement in Dutch law. It adds procedural rules for European arrest warrants involving the UK, a proportionality requirement, and a new data-processing basis for justice data.
35852.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers and processing by the need to implement the Trade and Cooperation Agreement and to fill gaps the agreement leaves to member states.
q: Article 10: Notwithstanding Article 3(2) of the Justice and Criminal Data Act, justice data are processed in implementation of the agreement and this chapter.

Artikel 10 In afwijking van artikel 3, tweede lid, van de Wet justitiële en strafvorderlijke gegevens worden justitiële gegevens verwerkt ter uitvoering van de overeenkomst en het bij dit hoofdstuk bepaalde.
d: enforcement of sentences transferred to Dutch authorities
date of entry into force by royal decree, possibly differing per article
p: The Minister of Justice may advise the court or public prosecutor on whether to take over enforcement of a sentence, giving the executive a role in surrender decisions.
Justice data may be processed and passenger data transferred to UK authorities outside the normal purpose limits of the Wjsg and PNR Act, reducing privacy protection of individuals.

parties: Asks whether the bill should also cover police data exchange and how the new specialised committee's powers and the surrender framework will work in practice.
Can the government explain what tasks and powers this committee will precisely have and when it will be operational?
Kan de regering toelichten welke taken en bevoegdheden dit comité precies krijgt en wanneer dit comité wordt geoperationaliseerd?
Asks what counts as justice data, whether police data may be shared, and what extra safeguards apply to passenger data transfers in light of the Schrems rulings.
Asks whether the bill fully resolves implementation issues, whether bilateral arrangements are needed, and whether an evaluation should be committed to.
Is the government willing to commit to such an evaluation or include it in this bill?
Is de regering bereid een dergelijke evaluatie toe te zeggen of te verwerken in dit wetsvoorstel?

Warns that surrenders based on mutual trust may bypass substantive review of arrest warrants if UK rule of law deteriorates, and asks about rights of suspects, consent procedures and the risk of surrendering residents for execution of sentences.
Will this agreement also mean that arrest warrants from the UK cannot be substantively reviewed by the International Court?
Houdt deze overeenkomst straks ook in dat de aanhoudingsbevelen vanuit het VK door de Internationale Rechtskamer niet inhoudelijk getoetst kunnen worden?
Asks why so many categories of criminal data are shared, how this fits with suspects' privacy rights, and what data protection safeguards and oversight role the data protection officer has.
What is the necessity of this, and how does it relate to suspects' right to privacy?
Wat is hiervan de noodzaak, en hoe verhoudt dit zich tot het recht van verdachten op privacy?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Uitvoeringswet for Part III of the EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement, raising concerns about the conditions for transferring PNR passenger data to the UK, including the unclear relationship with the temporary data-protection bridge and a drafting inconsistency in the PNR-wet. The government's nader rapport accepts the points, adapts article 13 and article 14 (differentiated entry into force) and clarifies the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling notes that PNR data retained beyond six months and depersonalised may be transferred to the UK under the Agreement without the safeguards of the PNR-wet, raising the question of the level of data protection.

The explanatory memorandum does not address whether article 13 PNR-wet must be disapplied for transfers to the UK if the Act enters into force within the temporary six-month period in which the UK is not treated as a third country.

Article 13 of the PNR-wet creates an inconsistency by applying the conditions of article 10(2) and (3) also to transfers to other Member States, a point the government corrected in the revised provision.
The Afdeling recommends the explicit reference in the amended article 13 that transfers take place in accordance with the Agreement, and the redactional comments were followed.

35870.s: The bill amends the Dutch donor-data act for artificial donor insemination: it introduces donor codes and mother codes to monitor the maximum number of families per donor, adds a duty to report hereditary conditions of donors, allows disclosure of identifying data of half-siblings with consent, and converts the Foundation for donor data into a public-law independent administrative body called the College, with the minister given broader oversight powers. The memorandum notes the College's composition, advisory committee and enforcement via the inspectorate, and that the minister cannot annul College decisions on individual donor data.
35870.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and expanded College powers by the need to monitor donor family limits, protect donor children's access to information and align the body with public-law governance rules.
q: The College may on its own initiative assign a donor code to a donor or link a mother code to a donor code and assign it to a treated woman.
Het College kan uit eigener beweging aan een donor een donorcode toekennen of aan een donorcode een moedercode koppelen
d: statutory maximum number of mother codes per donor code
I, I (art. 4 lid 2 sub b-c, lid 2 sub e)
other tasks assigned to the College by ministerial regulation
deadline and detailed donor data set set by College regulation and general administrative order
College regulation on registration and disclosure of donor data, approved by minister
College regulation on composition of advisory committee
p: The College may disclose a donor's identifying data after weighing interests, dropping the requirement that the institution know or suspect the donor's identity is relevant, with an advisory committee consulted unless deemed unnecessary.
Donor data may be disclosed without donor consent; the donor may object only to the College and the applicant may challenge a refusal, so disclosure is decided by the executive body.
Ministerial regulation may assign further unspecified tasks to the College, a flexible grant of new functions.
The College may on its own initiative assign donor and mother codes and request data from clinics, and may exceed the statutory maximum where codes cannot otherwise be allocated.
The College composition is restructured with a flexible seat for a member of unspecified expertise, while under the Kaderwet zbo the minister appoints, suspends and dismisses members.

parties: Asks how the College's balancing of donor interests against donor-child rights will be prepared, what guidance and jurisprudence the advisory committee uses, and how practice will be monitored.
No experience has yet been gained with this balancing of interests.
Met deze belangenafweging zijn nog geen ervaringen opgedaan.
Asks what safeguards ensure donor-children's rights, whether donor-children should be registered themselves, and how genetic-condition information reaches children over 12.
Donor children want to know whose children they are.[translation of Dutch text]
Donorkinderen willen graag weten van wie zij afstammen.
Asks about donor numbers, waiting times, foreign donors and whether an effective control mechanism exists for the number of children per donor.
These members also ask whether there is an effective control mechanism to check how many children a donor has already fathered.[translation]
Genoemde leden vragen ook of er een afdoend controlemechanisme is om te controleren hoeveel kinderen een donor reeds heeft voortgebracht.

Supports the main lines favouring the child's information right over donor privacy, but questions registration of donor sex, the 24-week reporting timing, enforcement penalties, and the 12-woman cap versus the 25-child norm.
The CDA members support the main lines of this bill, since they give the child's right to information about its descent more weight than the donor's privacy right.[translation]

De leden van de CDA-fractie steunen de hoofdlijnen van dit wetsvoorstel, aangezien zij het recht van het kind op informatie over zijn afstamming zwaarder laten wegen dan het recht op privacy van de donor.
Asks why the switch from B-donor to A-donor is now deemed undesirable and for examples of the 'weighty arguments' allowing donors to stay anonymous.
Finally, the SP members see that the possibility for switched B-donors to keep their identity secret for weighty reasons is retained.[translation]
Tenslotte zien de leden van de SP-fractie dat de mogelijkheid voor geswitchte B-donoren wordt behouden om hun identiteit geheim te houden vanwege zwaarwegende argumenten.

Argues donor-children have a right to ancestry information and presses for active state roles such as registering donor-children, notifying them of genetic conditions, and ensuring parents inform them.
They are of the opinion that not knowing whom you descend from can shape a life, and that donor children have a right to access their ancestry and kinship data.[translation]
Zij zijn van mening dat het niet weten van wie je afstamt een leven kan bepalen en dat donorkinderen recht hebben op toegang tot hun afstammings- en verwantschapsgegevens.

Welcomes the statutory basis for a maximum number of conceptions per donor and central registration, but asks about BSN-based coding, foreign donors, bans on anonymous donation, and legal equality between A- and B-donor children.
These members see the added value of the statutory basis for a maximum number of conceptions per donor.[translation]
Deze leden zien de meerwaarde van de wettelijke grondslag voor een maximumaantal verwekkingen per donor.
Asks how the 12-family maximum was justified, why it is set by AMvB rather than in statute, whether privately arranged donations escape oversight, and how the IGJ enforces the rules.
Can the government further explain how the IGJ monitors and enforces the maximum of 12 families?[translation]
Kan de regering nader toelichten hoe de IGJ het maximum van 12 gezinnen controleert en handhaaft?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a nota van wijziging to the Donor Data Artificial Insemination Act that would apply the 'yes, unless' disclosure procedure to pre-2004 non-anonymous donors, raising concerns about the scope of the proposal, the justification of the balancing, and the undefined notion of 'zwaarwegende belangen'. The minister's reply largely rejects the scope limitation, explains the choice for a uniform balancing approach, and states that the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented and clarified.
