concerns: The Council requested a substantive, self-standing justification for applying 'yes, unless' to pre-2004 donors who were not known as anonymous, given the intrusion on donors' privacy and family life; the government supplemented the explanatory memorandum but maintained its position that the regular balancing suffices.

The Council advised limiting the scope to donors who explicitly consented to disclosure at donation, arguing the broad group (including those with unclear side agreements) was not justified; the government rejected this and deliberately kept the wider scope.

The Council asked the government to explain what 'zwaarwegende belangen' may entail in this context and whether historic examples remain current; the government clarified that such interests arise only in exceptional circumstances, assessed on the facts and current social views, and adjusted the memorandum.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Council of State advised on a bill amending the Dutch donor-data act for artificial insemination, raising objections on an internal advisory committee, the retention of already registered medical data, and a planned switch from B-donor to A-donor status. The minister's reply accepts the advisory committee rationale with added explanation, retains registered hereditary data with justification, adds an explanatory note on hereditary conditions, and states an amendment on B-to-A donor switching will be resubmitted to the Afdeling before being sent to parliament.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a separate justification for introducing an internal advisory committee, which the government supplemented in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asked for an explanation of the necessity and proportionality of retaining already registered medical data of donors; the government narrowed retention to hereditary data and added explanation.

The Afdeling advised submitting a planned amendment on switched B-donors to it for advice before it is sent to parliament, given its far-reaching effects on donors; the government committed to this in its reply.

35906.s: This is an eleventh incidental supplementary budget bill amending the 2021 budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport to fund COVID-19 measures, with effect from 8 September 2021. The bill itself contains no delegations or new executive powers; the explanatory extracts describe guarantees for test analysis capacity and a national care reserve.
35906.j: The memorandum justifies the guarantees by the need to maintain pandemic test capacity as part of the government's COVID-19 control strategy, with the guarantee expiring on 31 December 2021.
q: The Minister of VWS thereby stands as guarantor for the risk that incurred (availability) costs cannot be recovered if demand falls short.
De Minister van VWS staat hiermee garant voor het risico dat gemaakte (beschikbaarheids)kosten niet kunnen worden terugverdiend als de afname tegenvalt.

35915.s: The bill amends the Bankruptcy Act (Faillissementswet) article 288 to shorten the good-faith test for admission to the debt rescheduling scheme for natural persons (Wsnp) from five to three years. It also adds a new paragraph allowing courts to admit a debtor despite the ten-year re-admission bar where refusal would cause an overriding unfairness.
35915.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the need to improve the flow from municipal debt assistance to the Wsnp and to avoid hardship in repeat cases, while noting the court retains discretion.
q: In certain cases, however, the court can apply a hardship clause.
De rechter kan in bepaalde gevallen echter een hardheidsclausule toepassen
p: A new hardship exception lets the court grant re-admission to the debt scheme within ten years where refusal would be an overriding unfairness, expanding judicial discretion in favour of debtors.

parties: Asks whether the problem is one of interpretation of the court procedure rules rather than statute, and wants creditors' options and monitoring of the shortened good-faith test clarified.
Does the government agree that the problem is also a matter of the wording and interpretation of the procedural rules for insolvency petitions at the district courts?
Deelt de regering de mening dat de problematiek ook een kwestie is van de formulering en interpretatie van het procesreglement verzoekschriftprocedures insolventiezaken rechtbanken?
Supports an exception to the ten-year bar but asks for data on rejections and early terminations and whether the ten-year term should be dropped altogether.
These members ask whether the government can provide an overview of the number of petitions for the Wsnp, how often they were rejected and on what grounds between 2012 and now.

Deze leden vragen of de regering een overzicht kan geven van het aantal verzoekschriften tot de Wsnp, hoe vaak deze afgewezen zijn en op basis van welke afwijzingsgronden dit gebeurde tussen 2012 en nu.
Welcomes judicial discretion via the hardship clause but questions whether judges have enough time to assess individual cases and supervise trustees.
They point out, however, that a hardship clause can only be effective if judges really have enough time to assess individual cases thoroughly.
Zij wijzen er wel op dat een hardheidsclausule alleen effectief kan zijn als rechters ook echt voldoende tijd hebben om individuele zaken goed en grondig te beoordelen.
Asks why the ten-year rule is not removed entirely so judges can do case-by-case assessment, and questions how judges apply article 285(1)(f) inconsistently.
Does the government recognise that judges apply this provision differently and that this is also a reason for the limited inflow into the Wsnp?
Herkent de regering dat rechters deze bepaling verschillend hanteren en dat dat ook een reden is voor de beperkte instroom in de Wsnp?
Asks how the good-faith test and hardship clause will be applied, warns against treating debtors as potential fraudsters, and questions limiting judicial discretion via the fraud example.
Does this not limit the judge's room for assessment?
Beperkt dit niet de beoordelingsruimte van de rechter?

Asks whether the aim can be met by consistent application of article 285(1)(f) and proper use of the hardship clause without legislation, and raises creditor involvement and a possible rule for deliberate bad faith.
There are signals that district courts handle differently what is understood as the 'amicable track', while uniformity and equal treatment should be paramount.
Er zijn signalen dat rechtbanken verschillend omgaan met wat onder het «minnelijke traject» wordt verstaan, terwijl eenduidigheid en rechtsgelijkheid hierin voorop zouden moeten staan.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised no substantive remarks on a bill amending the Bankruptcy Act to improve the flow of municipal debt assistance cases into the statutory debt rescheduling scheme for natural persons, and advised submitting it to parliament with only one drafting remark. The Minister for Legal Protection accepted the drafting remark and forwarded the bill to parliament.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should be supplemented with a reference to the original explanatory notes introducing the debt rescheduling scheme, specifically the passages giving examples of 'good faith'.

35933.s: The bill amends the Dutch corporate income tax act (Wet Vpb 1969) and the Mijnbouwwet to block downward transfer-pricing adjustments between related entities when the counterpart does not include a corresponding upward adjustment in taxable profit, and to restrict depreciation on assets acquired intra-group, effective 1 January 2022. The aim is to close tax mismatches arising from the arm's length principle.
35933.j: The memorandum justifies the measures as removing an unwanted double non-taxation caused by transfer-pricing differences, and discusses EU-law compatibility; it does not justify any new executive power.
q: The proposed measures are designed so that the unwanted mismatch, i.e. the double non-taxation resulting from a transfer-pricing difference, is eliminated.
De voorgestelde maatregelen zijn zodanig vormgegeven dat de ongewenste mismatch – ofwel de dubbele niet-heffing als gevolg van een verrekenprijsverschil – wordt weggenomen.

parties: Asks whether the bill causes double taxation in combination with CFC rules and whether a concurrence provision is needed.
Is it correct that A B.V. must pay Dutch corporate income tax twice on the same interest in this situation?
Klopt het dat A B.V. in deze situatie tweemaal over dezelfde rente Nederlandse vennootschapsbelasting moet betalen?
Supports the measures but asks how taxpayer evidence of foreign correction will be verified and whether EU-law compatibility is secured.
Although the CDA members consider it likely the measure meets this, they ask whether it would not be wise to submit the measure to the European Commission.

Hoewel de leden van de CDA-fractie de kans aanwezig achten dat de maatregel hieraan voldoet, vragen zij de regering of het toch niet verstandig is de maatregel voor te leggen aan de Europese Commissie.
Strongly supports anti-avoidance measures but questions design, such as why low-tax adjustments fall outside scope.
These members ask why the government did not choose to also test the taxation of the upward adjustment.
Deze leden vragen waarom de regering niet heeft gekozen om ook de onderworpenheid van de opwaartse aanpassing te toetsen.
Questions why the informal capital regime itself is kept and why transitional exemptions allow continued double non-taxation.
Does the government consider this desirable?
Doubts effectiveness against profit shifting, raises loophole scenarios and urges stricter grandfathering and anti-abuse rules.
Asks why no evaluation provision was included given possibly far-reaching consequences.
why it was chosen not to include an evaluation provision in the bill, while the consequences may be far-reaching.
waarom ervoor gekozen is om geen evaluatiebepaling in het wetsvoorstel op te nemen, terwijl de gevolgen verstrekkend kunnen zijn.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Wet tegengaan mismatches bij toepassing zakelijkheidsbeginsel, criticising the absence of a general part in the internet consultation, and asking for justification of immediate effect and transitional law (eerbiedigende werking) for existing intercompany arrangements and the depreciation limitation in article 35. The government's nader rapport accepts most remarks, adds the general part and clarifies the measures, but declines the Afdeling's advice on dropping 'in het jaar' in articles 8bc and 8bd and justifies immediate effect by pointing to foreseeability and the aim of preventing double non-taxation.
concerns: The Afdeling objects that immediate effect on existing intercompany legal relationships was not weighed against trust, reasonableness, legal certainty and surprise; the government justifies immediate effect by foreseeability and anti-avoidance but adds explanation.

The Afdeling asks for justification of the depreciation limitation in article 35 covering assets acquired from 1 July 2019 and suggests aligning with the 4 March 2021 consultation date; the government adds to the explanation of the depreciation limitation.
The Afdeling proposed deleting the words 'in het jaar' in articles 8bc and 8bd; the government declines, saying they clarify that earlier transfers are excluded.

The Afdeling criticised the absence of a general part in the internet consultation and the unclear summary of consultation responses; the government added the general part and clarified the consultation inbreng.

35942.s: The bill amends the Youth Act to strengthen the legal position of young people placed in closed youth care, by tightening conditions for placement and for conditional orders, and by regulating coercive measures, daily regime, complaints and appeals, and the role of confidential advisers. It also lays down detailed rules for closed institutions, including record-keeping, reporting to the inspectorate, and transitional provisions for existing placements.
35942.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying that detailed rules on the manner and conditions of restrictive measures and transport will be set by general administrative order or ministerial regulation, aligning with the Wvggz and Wzd.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative order, rules will be laid down on the residential room referred to in the first paragraph, subsection f, and on how contact is maintained with the young person during confinement.

Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur worden regels gesteld over de verblijfsruimte, bedoeld in het eerste lid, onderdeel f, en over de wijze waarop contact wordt gehouden met de jeugdige tijdens de insluiting.
d: rules on bedroom for separate safe room and contact during stay
rules on transport to and from closed institutions
detailed rules on conditions for applying restrictive measures
rules on insulation room and contact during insulation
content and manner of annual analysis of restrictive measures
p: Allows insulation in a separate safe room for young people aged twelve and over in an emergency, subject to a behavioural scientist's assessment and an age limit, while removing the earlier possibility of full isolation.
Authorises body searches, urine tests, searches of rooms and post on a reasonable suspicion of prohibited substances or objects, with limits on who may search and in whose presence.
Adds an exhaustive list of restrictive measures, including electronic monitoring, that may be included in a conditional order's care plan, with rules for gender of searchers.
Writes the appeal procedure against complaint decisions into the Youth Act itself, strengthening young people's ability to challenge restrictive measures before an appeal commission.
Requires a care plan within six weeks, consultation with parents and guardians, and periodic evaluation with the young person, strengthening their participation.

parties: Asks how the bill's rules on restrictive measures and the formal position of the youth and parents relate to the Wvggz and Wzd, and whether discretion for the responsible official is clear.
Questions why no judicial review or external checks apply to conditional authorisations and suspensions, and whether restrictions are adequately justified and communicated.
Who is informed in the case of such a suspension, and to what extent is it possible or desirable for a judge to review on request whether the suspension or its withdrawal is justified?

Wie worden er op de hoogte gebracht in het geval van een dergelijke schorsing en in hoeverre is het mogelijk of wenselijk dat op aanvraag een rechter alsnog toetst of (het intrekken van) een schorsing gerechtvaardigd is?
Asks for professional and internal oversight of restrictive measures, a full overview of tightened provisions, and guarantees that understaffing never justifies restrictions.
These measures, in the view of these members, therefore require professional supervision.
Deze maatregelen vragen wat genoemde leden betreft dan ook om professioneel toezicht.
Supports the bill's aim to end arbitrary institutional rules and limit restraints, but asks for further concretisation of rules to be set by general administrative order (AMvB).
The CDA members ask the government for further concretisation on this point.
De leden van de CDA-fractie verzoeken de regering om nadere concretisering op dit punt.
Argues the bill does not improve youths' legal position enough, notes it is weaker than the Wzd and Wvggz on judicial control and decision-making, and asks why differences exist.
These members conclude that the legal position of the young person under this bill appears less well regulated than under the Wzd and the Wvggz.
De leden van GroenLinks-fractie concluderen dat de rechtspositie van de jeugdige op basis van dit wetsvoorstel minder goed geregeld lijkt te zijn dan in de Wzd en in de Wvggz.
Supports the goal of improving youths' rights and reducing restrictive measures; has no further questions at this time.
They endorse its aim of improving the legal position of young people in closed youth care and curbing the use of restrictive measures.
Zij onderschrijven het doel ervan, namelijk om de rechtspositie van jongeren in gesloten jeugdhulp te verbeteren en de inzet van vrijheidsbeperkende maatregelen terug te dringen.

Supports clearer legal delimitation but questions the treatment of therapeutic goals as an independent ground for measures, the omitted religious and spiritual provisions, and the risk of stretching the emergency concept.
Does this not create the risk that measures become an improper means of pressure that is harder to objectify?
Ontstaat hiermee niet het risico dat maatregelen een oneigenlijk drukmiddel kunnen worden dat in mindere mate te objectiveren valt?
Argues closed youth care should be abolished, that the bill leans toward justice-system logic, lacks clear youth rights in law, and that consultation input from experts was ignored.
The BIJ1 member notes that it is not clearly anchored in the Youth Act what the rights of young people are and what obligations thus follow for the institutions providing care.

Het lid van de fractie van BIJ1 merkt op dat niet duidelijk in de Jeugdwet verankerd wordt wat de rechten zijn van jongeren en welke verplichtingen daar dus uit voortvloeien voor de instellingen die de zorg leveren.
Welcomes the bill but asks how the right to religious identity and contact with important persons such as siblings is guaranteed, and asks why the timeframe for the care plan is long.
The BBB member supports the proposed changes but misses freedom regarding the child's identity in terms of religion or belief.
Het lid van de BBB-fractie steunt de voorgenomen wijzigingen, maar mist daarin de vrijheid in het kader van de identiteit van het kind als het gaat om godsdienst of geloofsovertuiging.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the aims of the bill strengthening the legal position of young people in closed youth care, but raises objections on legality, proportionality and subsidiarity (insluiting duration, broad delegation, supervision forms) and on feasibility given staffing and funding. The government's nader rapport adopts most remarks by amending the bill, aligning durations with the Bjj and Wvggz, narrowing delegation and adding supervision provisions, while arguing the bill is feasible.
concerns: Insluiting of three days exceeds the Bjj limits and is insufficiently justified; the Afdeling advises aligning with the Bjj durations, which the government then revised to three days aligned with the Wvggz, with added reassessment duties.

The broad delegation for nadere regels on freedom-restricting measures should be limited and the substantive content set out in the law; the government clarified the scope and listed the measures covered.

Supervision of individual youths and camera supervision lack statutory conditions and forms; the government removed the general supervision article and added a specific individual supervision measure with nee-tenzij conditions.
Feasibility depends on sufficient staff and funding, which the Afdeling says is unclear; the government points to recent funding and argues the bill is implementable without a cost estimate.
Searching clothing and pockets is added explicitly to the regulated search measure to make its scope clear.
Redactional improvements and a clarified 'vastpakken of vastpakken en vasthouden' formulation were made.

35951.s: The bill reverses the 2021 expansion of temporary rental contracts by cutting the maximum temporary lease duration from three years to two in the Housing Act, the Civil Code and the Woningwet. It also repeals the transitional provisions and sets out how contracts agreed before the new law remain governed by the old rules.
q: Whereas We have considered that it is desirable not to expand the possibilities for temporary rental contracts
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat het wenselijk is om de mogelijkheden voor tijdelijke huurovereenkomsten niet te verruimen

parties: Asks how the minister views the Eerste Kamer's perception of too many temporary leases, estimates of rental volumes from the Companen evaluation, and the status of several withdrawn amendments and motions.
The VVD members ask how the Minister views this perception following the Companen evaluation.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe de Minister tegen dit beeld aankijkt na aanleiding van de evaluatie van Companen.
Asks whether the transitional law applies only if the amendment takes effect after 1 January 2022 and how transitional rules would work in that case.
They ask whether this assumption is correct.
Zij vragen of deze veronderstelling terecht is.

Question why the government rushed a further expansion of temporary leases before the evaluation was complete, and whether it still wishes to expand them, and argue that permanent leases should be the norm.
These members ask the government why it hastily chose a further expansion of temporary leases while the evaluation of the rental market flow act was not yet sufficiently complete.

Deze leden vragen de regering waarom zij überhaupt overhaast voor een verdere uitbreiding van tijdelijke huurovereenkomsten heeft gekozen terwijl de evaluatie van de wet doorstroming huurmarkt nog niet voldoende was afgerond.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a draft bill amending the Housing Act, Housing Act code and related laws following evaluation of the revised Housing Act and expanding possibilities for temporary leases, and raised no remarks. The minister's reply is included in the text, but the advice itself contains no objections, so the government reply section is brief.

36077.s: The bill modernises training and examination requirements for port security personnel, replacing the recognition of training institutes with a national examination and certificate, and adds powers for ministerial regulation on port ship security controls, including designating additional authorised officers. It also repeals the Erkenningsregeling opleidingen havenbeveiliger and removes the requirement to submit a port facility security assessment with the mayor's consent request.
36077.j: The memorandum justifies the regulatory delegations by the need for uniform, administratively streamlined rules and by the European Commission's call for explicitly designated authorised officers.
q: Through the proposed amendment of Article 16b, it becomes possible to secure by ministerial regulation the designation and allocation of powers of the DAOs involved in the process.
Door de voorgestelde wijziging van artikel 16b wordt het mogelijk om bij ministeriële regeling de aanwijzing en verdeling van de bevoegdheden van de bij het proces betrokken DAO's te borgen.
d: examination rules, certificate validity, recognition of foreign certificates
registration conditions and validity of existing certificates
training components for port facility security officers
how completion of training is demonstrated
implementation of ship security control procedures and powers, including designation of additional officers such as the Kustwacht
p: Allows the minister to designate additional parties with powers over ship security controls and set their division of powers by ministerial regulation, with the memorandum promising delimitation in that regulation.
Removes the requirement that a port facility security assessment accompany the request for the mayor's consent to a security plan, reducing the mayor's information base.

parties: Asks about labour market shortages of port security staff, training waiting times, consultation outcomes, and how examination costs are built up.
The VVD members want to know what the labour market for port security staff looks like.
De leden van de VVD-fractie willen weten hoe de arbeidsmarkt voor havenbeveiligers eruitziet.
Asks why training requirements rather than an examination are chosen for port security officers, and whether the regulations explicitly address undermining by organised crime and corruption.
Why is an examination not chosen instead of training requirements, as for the port security guard?
Waarom wordt niet, net als voor de havenbeveiliger, gekozen voor een examen in plaats van eisen aan de opleiding?
Asks how the quality and integrity of training is safeguarded without ILT supervision and how to screen out officers with dual loyalties amid organised crime in ports.
How does the government hope to screen out potential security officers with dual loyalties from the training, given undermining crime in Dutch ports?
Hoe hoopt zij potentiële veiligheidsbeambten met een dubbele loyaliteit uit de opleiding te vissen, tegen de achtergrond van ondermijnende criminaliteit in de Nederlandse havens?

Welcomes a level playing field for trainers but asks how concerns that uniformity harms training quality and shifts focus to examination are addressed, and whether external examination raises candidates' costs.
The BBB member asks the government how, in its view, it does justice to signals from the sector that uniformity is coming at the expense of trainer quality.

Het lid van de BBB-fractie vraagt de regering hoe volgens haar recht gedaan wordt aan signalen uit de branche dat zij zich zorgen maken dat de uniformiteit ten koste gaat van de kwaliteit van de opleider.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an advisory opinion on a bill amending the Havenbeveiligingswet (port security act) on training requirements, ship security checks and technical fixes, raising no substantive remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport forwards the opinion and confirms the bill is sent to parliament without changes.

36086.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement (departmental budget) of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport via a sixth supplementary budget, adjusting expenditure and receipts across policy articles. The explanatory memorandum covers funding for home-care combinations, patient position and transparency, training and labour market measures, and a temporary support scheme for long-term sick care workers.
q: The budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport for the year 2022 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36095.s: The bill temporarily allows higher education institutions to enrol students for the 2022–2023 academic year who could not meet prior-education or admission requirements because of COVID-19, provided they meet them later and otherwise are deregistered. Institutions adopt their own policy, subject to works council advice, and ministerial regulations may set detailed conditions; the provision expires on 1 September 2023.
36095.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary discretion by the study delays caused by COVID-19 and the measures taken against it, limited to the 2022–2023 year.
q: The institutional board may only use this power if COVID-19 and the related measures are the cause of the student's study delay.
Het instellingsbestuur kan slechts van deze bevoegdheid gebruikmaken als COVID-19 en de daarmee gepaard gaande maatregelen de oorzaak zijn van de studievertraging van de (aspirant-)student.
d: conditions for enrolment and topics of institutional policy
institutional board sets enrolment policy deviating from prior-education and admission requirements
p: Institutional boards gain discretion to enrol students who do not meet statutory prior-education or admission requirements, with works council advice and inspectorate oversight as safeguards.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division had no substantive remarks on a bill temporarily allowing deviating enrolment for the 2022–2023 academic year due to COVID-19, and advised submitting it to the House. The minister's reply merely updated the COVID-19 infection picture and made some editorial corrections to the explanatory memorandum.

36158.s: The bill implements several EU regulations on border controls and security, including the EES, Etias, SIS, interoperability and revised VIS regulations, by designating competent authorities and central access points. It also amends the Vreemdelingenwet 2000 and the Uitvoeringswet EU-verordeningen grenzen en veiligheid to create new travel authorisation powers, data retention and confidentiality rules, and fines.
36158.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as necessary to implement directly applicable EU regulations and to provide clarity on which Dutch authorities carry out the new tasks.
q: By general administrative order, authorities or bodies may be designated which, in connection with the tasks they perform, are regarded as the authorities or bodies referred to in the following regulations.

Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen autoriteiten of instanties worden aangewezen die in verband met de taken die zij uitvoeren worden aangemerkt als de autoriteiten of instanties, bedoeld in de volgende verordeningen
d: designation of competent authorities for EU border and security systems
designation of data controller under EES and VIS regulations
further rules on issuing limited-territory travel authorisations
p: The Minister may give general and specific instructions to the national Etias unit for performing its tasks under the Etias regulation.
The Minister may issue an entry-refusal alert in SIS for third-country nationals posing a public order or national security risk, where the regulation's conditions apply.
Persons receiving SIS personal data are bound to secrecy and the disclosure exception in Article 272(2) of the Penal Code is disapplied.

parties: Asks whether the regulations give Member States enough means of enforcement and whether individuals are adequately protected when data is shared, including with third countries.
Regarding data sharing between EU Member States, the government considers that the guidelines leave sufficient scope for this but also contain sufficient safeguards for individuals.
Wat betreft het delen van gegevens tussen EU-lidstaten onderling vindt de regering dat de richtlijnen hier voldoende ruimte voor biedt, maar ook voldoende waarborgen bevat voor individuele personen

Raises proportionality, function creep and the Toeslagenaffaire risk of linking large data sets, and asks why ETIAS decisions are not subject to a rechter-commissaris rather than an officier van justitie or the Marechaussee.
Is it correct that here, at least in the Netherlands, a public prosecutor always intervenes, or may the Royal Marechaussee, responsible for border control, take such a decision independently?

Klopt het dat hier altijd, in ieder geval in Nederland, een officier van justitie tussenstaat of mag de Koninklijke Marechaussee, die belast is met de grensbewaking, een dergelijk besluit zelfstandig nemen?
Asks why the government did not designate the rechter-commissaris as central access point and why no evaluation clause was included, as the AP recommended.
whether the government can further justify why the rechter-commissaris was not designated as the central access point giving access to the European information systems.
of de regering nader kan onderbouwen waarom niet is gekozen de rechter-commissaris aan te wijzen als centraal toegangspunt dat toegang geeft tot de Europese informatiesystemen

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a draft implementing act for EU regulations on border and security (EES, ETIAS, SIS, VIS, interoperability), raising concerns about the independence of the central access point prosecutor, sanctioning of unlawful data processing, the choice of a separate act, and the need for a PIA and clearer rights of data subjects. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, including making the central access point prosecutor's independence statutory and designating controllers by general administrative order, while deferring the sanctions regime to a later revision of the Wpg and Wjsg.
concerns: The Afdeling found that the central access point prosecutor must be independent of the prosecutor directing the designated authority, which the government now secures in statute.
Designation of processing controllers should be done by general administrative order rather than ministerial regulation, given the sensitivity of the data involved.
Sanctions for unlawful processing of personal data must be effective, proportionate and deterrent; the government postponed improving the sanctions regime to the wider Wpg/Wjsg revision.
A privacy impact assessment should be carried out and its results reported, and data subjects' rights and the authority to contact should be clarified.
Users of the self-service system must be assured of access to human assistance when needed.
The explanatory memorandum should be made more accessible, and the choice for a separate implementing act instead of amending existing laws should be motivated.

36167.s: The bill adds monkeypox (apenpokken) to the list of Group A infectious diseases in article 1(e) of the Public Health Act (Wpg), codifying a ministerial regulation that had been adopted under article 20(1) of that Act. It thereby keeps in force the reporting obligation that article 20(4) would otherwise let lapse, and enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
36167.j: The memorandum justifies incorporating the ministerial regulation into statute so that the reporting obligation can continue beyond the statutory deadline, in the interest of public health.
q: that it is in the interest of public health to perpetuate, on the basis of article 20(4) of the Public Health Act, that regulation by incorporating it into the law
dat het in het belang van de volksgezondheid is om dat grond van artikel 20, vierde lid, van de Wet publieke gezondheid te bestendigen door de betreffende regeling te incorporeren in de wet

parties: Asks how the Chamber is involved in any extension of the group A designation and what criteria govern ending it.
How is the Chamber involved in the decision to extend the designation of monkeypox as an A disease?
Hoe wordt de Kamer betrokken bij het besluit om een eventuele verlenging van apenpokken als A-ziekte aan te merken?
Agrees the designation is needed for surveillance but asks for concrete parameters determining whether the designation continues.
They ask whether the government can elaborate and specify the parameters on which it will decide whether the disease remains designated as group A.

Zij vragen naar aanleiding hiervan of de regering hier verder over kan uitweiden en concreter kan aangeven op basis van welke parameters wordt besloten of de ziekte al dan niet langer wordt aangemerkt als groep A-infectieziekte.
Asks under what conditions the designation would no longer be necessary and whether monkeypox will be placed in group A2 without collective measures.
These members ask whether the government can state under which conditions it is no longer necessary to designate monkeypox as an A disease.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de regering aan kan geven onder welke voorwaarden het niet meer noodzakelijk is om apenpokken als A-ziekte aan te merken.
Argues classifying a disease as A is a political as well as medical decision for the Chamber, not the RIVM, and asks why the government does not justify the political choice.
However, it is not for nothing that the RIVM does not decide whether something is an A disease; the Chamber decides this.
Echter is het niet voor niets dat niet het RIVM besluit of iets een A-ziekte is, maar dat dit door de Kamer wordt besloten.
Asks which powers the government deems necessary and how it relates to the permanent-coronawet type framework, probing the scope of state powers over citizens.
Finally, the aforementioned members ask which measures neighbouring countries are taking against the monkeypox virus.
Tot slot vragen de voornoemde leden welke maatregelen naburige landen nemen tegen het apenpokkenvirus.
Questions the proportionality of incorporation and A classification given more knowledge and available vaccines, and asks whether forced isolation or quarantine has occurred.
How does the government weigh the proportionality of incorporation into the Wpg and the A classification now that more is known about the virus and vaccines are available?
Hoe weegt de regering de proportionaliteit van de incorporatie in de Wpg en de classificatie als A-ziekte nu er meer bekend is over het virus en nu er vaccins beschikbaar zijn?
Objects that monkeypox should not be on the A list alongside SARS, MERS and polio, questioning the justification for the measure.
Like COVID-19, this disease does not belong there.
Net als COVID-19 hoort deze ziekte daar niet thuis.
Asks whether the epidemiological situation still justifies A listing, what criteria apply, and why group B or C was not chosen.
If the argument is that infections must be reported, why is it necessary to put monkeypox on the A list and why does the government not choose the B or C list?

Als het argument is dat er melding moet worden gedaan van een besmetting met apenpokken, waarom is het dan per se nodig om apenpokken in de A-lijst op te nemen en kiest de regering niet voor de B-lijst of C-lijst?
Argues the A status and possible isolation, quarantine and work restrictions are disproportionate given low hospitalisation and no deaths, and asks where the threshold lies.

Although these members understand that monkeypox is a relatively unknown infection in the Netherlands, the A status, the associated disease picture and the limited pressure on care appear disproportionate.

Hoewel deze leden begrijpen dat het apenpokkenvirus een voor Nederland relatief onbekende infectie is, lijkt de A-status voor dit virus, het bijbehorende ziektebeeld en de geringe druk op de zorg buitenproportioneel.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill amending the Wet publieke gezondheid to incorporate the Regeling apenpokken (monkeypox regulation), and raised no remarks and advised submitting the bill to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister forwarded the advice to the King and confirmed the bill would be submitted, so no separate nader rapport with substantive replies is included.

36176.s: The bill amends the Mediawet 2008 to require commercial on-demand media services to invest 4.5% of their Dutch-generated revenue in Dutch cultural audiovisual productions, with exemptions for small services and the Commissariaat able to grant exemptions. It also sets reporting duties, extends the obligation to foreign services targeting the Dutch public, and requires an evaluation within four years.
36176.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for practical detail on exemptions, percentages, contract consequences and indicators, and the exemption power by the need to avoid unworkable or unjustified application.
q: The Commissariaat may grant a media institution an exemption from the first paragraph if application, given the nature or subject of the media service or the use of innovative formats, would be practically impossible or unjustified.

Het Commissariaat kan een media-instelling als bedoeld in het eerste lid ontheffing verlenen van het eerste lid indien toepassing gelet op de aard of het onderwerp van de betreffende mediadienst, of het gebruik van innovatieve formats, praktisch onuitvoerbaar of ongerechtvaardigd zou zijn.
d: rules on exemptions from the investment obligation
percentage of investment for independent productions
consequences of terminated or unfulfilled contracts for investment
specification of information to be submitted to the Commissariaat
indicators for services targeting the Dutch public
p: The Commissariaat may grant exemptions from the investment obligation where application would be practically impossible or unjustified, a discretionary power to waive a statutory duty.
The Commissariaat may exempt foreign-established services from the investment obligation on the same discretionary grounds.

parties: Asks about the basis for the threshold, the exemption for startups, and how the Commissariaat will verify turnover information and enforce the obligation.

How will the Commissariaat check whether all relevant commercial media service providers inform the Commissariaat, now that smaller providers do not have to confirm with an auditor's statement that their turnover is below the turnover threshold?

Hoe gaat het Commissariaat controleren of alle relevante aanbieders van commerciële mediadiensten het Commissariaat informeren, nu kleinere aanbieders niet met een accountantsverklaring hoeven te bevestigen aan het Commissariaat dat hun omzet lager is dan de omzetdrempel, zo vragen zij.
Supports the bill and its aim of safeguarding audiovisual diversity, while asking about the choice of an investment obligation over a levy, the 30 million threshold, and monitoring.
These members endorse the aim of the proposal, which seeks to safeguard diversity in the Dutch audiovisual media offering.
Deze leden onderschrijven het doel van het voorstel, dat beoogt de diversiteit in het Nederlandse audiovisuele media-aanbod te borgen.
Supports the investment obligation but asks why certain genres are excluded, how the Commissariaat will judge language and culture criteria, and whether providers can seek ex-ante review.
These members further ask whether VOD providers can approach the Commissariaat for an ex-ante assessment, should providers wish it.
Voornoemde leden vragen voorts of aanbieders van VOD-diensten bij het Commissariaat terecht kunnen voor een toetsing aan de voorkant, mochten de aanbieders deze wens hebben.

Positive about the bill but asks whether foreign platforms such as Google, Facebook and YouTube should be covered, what counts as very large contributions, and whether talent development and dubbing fall within the obligation.
These members are positive about this, but still have some questions and comments.
Deze leden staan hier positief tegenover, maar hebben nog wel enkele vragen en opmerkingen.
Asks why the turnover threshold was raised thirtyfold from the consultation draft, why carry-over of investments is allowed, and whether a minimum annual amount can be set to ensure continuity.
Is the government willing to lower this turnover threshold, they ask.
Is de regering bereid om deze omzetdrempel te verlagen, zo vragen zij.

Considers the bill insufficient and objects to the reduction from 6% to 4.5%, the high threshold, the carry-over option and the exclusion of platforms, asking for the political and ministerial reasoning and annual monitoring.
Why do the interests of large, profitable, often listed on-demand media services weigh more heavily than those of small, national, cultural and creative producers, they ask.
Waarom wegen de belangen van grote, winstgevende, vaak beursgenoteerde, mediadiensten op aanvraag zwaarder dan die van kleine, nationale, culturele en creatieve makers, zo vragen zij.
Supports the aim but asks why the threshold was set at 30 million rather than lower levels used in other EU countries, and whether exemptions suffice for small and startup firms.
Can the government further explain why it arrived at a threshold of 30 million, which arguments were decisive, and why 5, 10, 15, 20 or 25 million was not chosen, they ask.

Kan de regering nader toelichten waarom zij op een drempel van 30 miljoen is gekomen, welke argumenten daarvoor leidend waren en waarom er niet gekozen is voor vijf, 10, 15, 20 of 25 miljoen euro, zo vragen zij.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the aim of protecting Dutch audiovisual content but advises reconsidering the investment obligation because its effectiveness is unclear, its scope and the meaning of 'Dutch cultural audiovisual product' are vague, and EU law, property rights and consultation are insufficiently addressed. The government's reply removed the obligation for public broadcaster NPO and cinemas, defined the criteria in the law itself, added justification on EU and property law, and held a four-week public internet consultation.
concerns: The investment obligation's effectiveness is insufficiently justified and expected yield is uncertain; the government added explanation of expected investments of about EUR 29.8 million per year and an evaluation after four years.
The obligation is not sufficiently justified for all groups, particularly cinemas and the public broadcaster NPO; the government exempted cinemas and removed the obligation for NPO.
The meaning of 'Dutch cultural audiovisual product' is unclear and was delegated to an AMvB; the government moved the criteria into the law itself.
Key elements such as the percentage and the criteria for Dutch products were left to lower regulation; the government incorporated the percentage and criteria into the bill.

The relationship with EU law, including the audiovisual media services directive, free movement and state aid rules, was only summarily addressed; the government added justification but the state aid question is answered by denial rather than exhaustively.

The investment obligation interferes with property rights of businesses and this relationship was not discussed; the government added a justification based on proportionality and a balance of interests.
Consultation was limited to a one-week targeted consultation without justification; the government held a four-week public internet consultation and reported 22 responses.
Criteria for determining whether foreign providers target the Dutch public are objective and suitable for elaboration in lower regulation; the government kept this approach without changing the bill.

36194.s: The bill amends the Public Health Act to create a permanent legal framework for mandatory collective measures against epidemics of group A1 infectious diseases (those with pandemic potential), including safe distancing, hygiene rules, venue and event restrictions, quarantine and travel entry requirements. It requires parliamentary involvement through pre-hang and post-hang procedures for ministerial regulations, a parliamentary approval procedure for designating or activating A1 status and powers, and a fallback emergency power that must be followed by a statute.
36194.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for swift and flexible action against epidemics, while adding parliamentary involvement to safeguard democratic legitimacy.
q: Because of the necessarily broad delegation of regulatory power, the government considers it necessary, from the standpoint of democratic legitimacy, to expressly provide for parliamentary involvement in the delegated regulations.

Vanwege de noodzakelijkerwijs ruime delegatie van regelgevende bevoegdheid, acht de regering het geboden om vanuit het oogpunt van democratische legitimatie uitdrukkelijk te voorzien in parlementaire betrokkenheid bij de gedelegeerde regelgeving
d: collective measures against group A1 infectious diseases
emergency collective measures where existing regulation insufficient
hygiene measures and personal protective equipment
designation of public places that may not open or open under conditions
designation of events that may be prohibited or restricted
restrictions on access to care locations
bans and rules on business passenger transport
test requirements for travellers entering the country
duration and exemptions of home quarantine obligation
designation of infectious diseases into groups A1 and A2
activation and deactivation of collective measure powers for A1 diseases
p: Gives the safety region chairman exclusive authority over epidemic control, including powers normally held by municipal authorities, with the mayor taking over in local situations.
Allows the minister to take additional collective measures by ministerial regulation in urgent situations not covered by specific powers, subject only to a post-hoc bill.
Lets mayors and safety region chairs issue binding orders to venue operators to implement distancing and other rules.
Gives mayors and safety region chairs power to order persons to leave private or public places where risk of transmission arises.
Imposes testing and home quarantine obligations on travellers, with a court request procedure available to challenge the quarantine obligation.

parties: Asks how the law addresses different pandemic types, why the sixth extension was used as basis, and how the activation/deactivation of the framework and the phases are defined.
What are the more concrete definitions of these phases?
Wat zijn de concretere definities van deze fases?

Questions the necessity and proven effectiveness of rights-restricting measures and the emergency power that could reintroduce school closures and curfews without parliamentary debate; requests postponement.
These members would appreciate a substantive response.
Graag ontvangen deze leden een inhoudelijke reactie.

Supports a structural legal basis but insists measures be strictly necessary, proportionate and subsidiary, with democratic legitimacy and parliamentary involvement; asks about co-signing ministers and timing of incorporation bills.
Finally, despite the need for the government to act quickly and decisively in emergencies, democratic legitimacy and thus parliamentary involvement and control over taking measures is essential.

ten slotte is – ondanks de noodzaak dat de regering in noodsituaties snel en daadkrachtig moet kunnen ingrijpen – democratische legitimatie en dus parlementaire betrokkenheid en zeggenschap bij het nemen van maatregelen essentieel.

Wants a balance between swift measures and democratic control over rights-restricting measures; questions the second tranche timing, the legality of emergency ordinances without a current crisis, and reliance on unwritten emergency law.
Does the government agree with these members that the use of emergency law is undesirable, partly because of the lack of democratic legitimacy for rights-restricting measures?
Is de regering het met genoemde leden eens dat het gebruik van noodrecht onder andere vanwege gebrek aan democratische legitimering van grondrecht beperkende maatregelen onwenselijk is?

Welcomes a legal basis but wants proper democratic control and parliamentary say over rights-limiting measures; asks for evaluations of effectiveness and proportionality, and for a roadmap of further tranches.
At the same time, these members ask whether the department and related bodies such as the RIVM first carried out an evaluation of the covid-19 pandemic before proceeding with this bill?

Tegelijkertijd vragen de genoemde leden of binnen het departement en aanpalende instanties zoals het RIVM eerst een evaluatie heeft plaatsgevonden over de covid-19-pandemie, alvorens over te gaan tot onderhavig wetsvoorstel?

Supports a statutory framework but requires a careful rights balance, parliamentary involvement, and an updated crisis law; asks how the bill balances foreseeing future situations with unforeseen ones.

They believe this framework must contain a solid justification for the necessity of restricting fundamental rights in exceptional moments in the interest of public health, safety or public order, and that parliamentary involvement must be secured.

Zij vinden dat dit kader een stevige onderbouwing moet bevatten van de noodzaak om op uitzonderlijke momenten grondrechten in te perken in het belang van de volksgezondheid, de veiligheid of de openbare orde en dat de parlementaire betrokkenheid hierin moet worden geborgd.

Argues the government has failed at prevention (livestock, pollution, diet) and that municipalities lack legal tools; wants preventive powers and a binding precautionary principle, and a coordinating role for the health minister.
Does the government share the view that too little is being done to provide everyone with the healthy living environment they are entitled to?
Deelt de regering de mening dat er door de regering te weinig gedaan wordt om iedereen de gezonde leefomgeving te bieden waar ze recht op hebben?
Views the proposal with alarm; demands scientific evidence of effectiveness per restrictive measure, and withdrawal of the bill if not provided, and questions why covid-19 should be category A1.
These members therefore urgently request the government to still provide scientific evidence showing that the proposed measures are effective.
Genoemde leden verzoeken de regering daarom met klem om alsnog wetenschappelijk bewijs te leveren waaruit blijkt dat de voorgestelde maatregelen effectief zijn.

Asks whether the instruments are general enough for other diseases, concerned the framework remains focused on infectious disease rather than economic and social effects, and that the Maatschappelijk Impact Team lacks a legal footing.
However, the OMT's advice still carries more legal weight, because it rests on a statutory power, whereas the MIT has no such basis.
Het advies van het OMT weegt echter juridisch gezien nu altijd nog zwaarder, omdat daar een wettelijke bevoegdheid aan ten grondslag ligt.

Values parliamentary involvement and attention to proportionality and fundamental rights, but says the details depend on how these are described and secured, and asks about communication and polarisation.
For this member, this parliamentary involvement is of great importance.
Voor genoemd lid is deze parlementaire betrokkenheid van groot belang.

Agrees swift action is needed but asks how the government reflects on the covid period when the legal powers were deliberately not used at critical moments, and on pandemic risks from large-scale livestock industry.
This member fully agrees, but again asks how the fact that this power was deliberately not used at crucial (peak) moments in the pandemic is reflected upon.
Genoemd lid is het hier volledig mee eens, maar stelt opnieuw de vraag hoe wordt gereflecteerd op het feit dat deze bevoegdheid op cruciale (piek)momenten in de pandemie bewust niet is ingezet.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports in principle the Eerste tranche wijziging Wpg, a structural emergency legal framework for A1 infectious disease epidemics, but asks for changes on ministerial co-signature by the Minister of JenV, the relation between A1 designation and activation of powers, the immediate submission of incorporation bills, exemptions for religious buildings, and differentiation between persons. The government's nader rapport accepts nearly all points, adopting the recommended changes to the bill and explanatory memorandum while retaining the religious-building exemption with justification.
concerns: Parliamentary involvement is needed in designation of A1 diseases and in activating or deactivating collective measures, and the role of parliament must be further considered for a definitive regime.

Measures may be taken by ministerial regulation; the emergency power in article 58d needs parliamentary control, and the government retained the delegation system while accepting the advice on the emergency power.
The relation between articles 20(3) and 58b is unclear and implies an all-or-nothing approach; differentiation in activating powers should be possible to meet necessity and proportionality.

The exemption from the hygiene and distance obligation for religious buildings is retained by the government despite the advice to delete it, justified by freedom of religion and church-state separation.
Differentiation between persons should be limited to age, given the risk of unequal treatment on other personal characteristics.
The explanatory memorandum should be made clearer and consistent, with the sections on consultation integrated into the relevant parts.
The Minister of Justice and Security should co-sign the bill and be involved in ministerial regulations given responsibility for emergency law.
The eight-week period for submitting an incorporation bill after designation of an A1 disease should be replaced by an immediate submission requirement to ensure timely parliamentary involvement.

36200-IV.s: The bill formally adopts the 2023 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds (H), setting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum covers allocations for rule of law, financial supervision of Caribbean Netherlands and the Caribbean countries, and planned evaluations.
36200-IV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget allocations by reference to the Comptabiliteitswet 2016 and existing bestuurlijke afspraken, not by any new delegation of power.
q: The budget statements forming part of the national budget are each adopted separately by law under Article 2.3(1) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016.
De begrotingsstaten die onderdeel zijn van de Rijksbegroting, worden op grond van artikel 2.3, eerste lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2016 elk afzonderlijk bij de wet vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued a blanket advisory opinion on the 2023 budget bills, raising no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport notes that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in annexes.

36200-VI.s: This bill sets the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security (VI) for 2023, including its policy articles, non-policy articles and budget totals in thousands of euros. It also sets the budget statements for the agencies DJI, CJIB, NFI, Justis, IND, Justid and JIO, and states that the Minister for Legal Protection is not responsible for the efficiency of the judiciary's operations.
36200-VI.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget-related provisions by referring to the division of competences under the Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie, under which the judiciary manages its own operations while the Minister retains supervisory responsibility.
q: Referring to article 4.1 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016 in conjunction with articles 23 and 91 of the Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie, the Minister for Legal Protection is not responsible for the efficiency of the judiciary's business operations.

Onder verwijzing naar artikel 4.1 van de Comptabiliteitswet 2016 jo. de artikelen 23 en 91 van de Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie is Onze Minister voor Rechtsbescherming niet verantwoordelijk voor de doelmatigheid van de bedrijfsvoering van de rechterlijke organisatie.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on 12 September 2022 that it had no remarks on the 2023 budget bill for the Ministry of Justice and Security and recommended submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport of 19 September 2022 only notes that some budgets need changes, referring to annexes.

36275.s: The bill temporarily authorises the Minister for Legal Protection to collect, link and share personal data of parents affected by childcare benefit errors and their children placed out of home, to map the group and offer support. The law lapses on 1 January 2025, extendable twice by one year by royal decree for urgent reasons, and the data must be destroyed before expiry.
36275.j: The memorandum justifies the data sharing as necessary to gain insight into the affected group and reflect on handling, and the lapse-extension power by the possibility that lists are not yet complete, with the Council of State's advice on tighter limits incorporated.
q: This means that during an extension the various organisations may only process personal data under the bill to the extent that this fits the urgent reason for the extension.

Dit brengt mee dat tijdens een verlenging de verschillende organisaties uitsluitend persoonsgegevens op grond van het wetsvoorstel mogen verwerken voor zover dat past bij de dringende reden waarvoor verlenging plaatsvindt.
d: extension of the law's lapse date by royal decree
p: The Minister may collect, link and share sensitive personal data of affected parents and children across the tax authority, child protection board and courts for defined purposes, limited in time.
Data subjects may request removal of their data from the lists, and the organisations must destroy data on request, providing a protection for citizens.

parties: Asks how reflection will concretely take place per organisation, whether it adds value given existing reflection, why the Minister's inspectorate is excluded, and why data-sharing routes were chosen.
What then is the added value of the purpose "reflection" of the bill?
Wat is dan de toegevoegde waarde van het doel «reflectie» van het wetsvoorstel?

Supports swift support for affected parents but questions how reflection purposes were weighed against parents' control over their data, and asks about consent, deletion and the scope of data shared with organisations.
These members still have questions about the bill, in particular about the provisions allowing data to be shared for reflection in the youth protection chain.
Deze leden hebben nog vragen over het wetsvoorstel, met name over de bepalingen waarmee gegevens gedeeld kunnen worden ten behoeve van reflectie in de jeugdbeschermingsketen.

Warns against raising false expectations, questions the proportionality of data linking for parents of children placed decades ago, and argues data protection for affected parents should be more robust.
The SP members are of the view that data protection for the affected parents may certainly be more robust in this case.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn de mening toegedaan dat de dataprotectie voor de gedupeerde ouders zeker in dit geval robuuster mag.

Asks whether existing law (AVG, Jeugdwet) already allows the data exchange, requests pseudonymisation as advised by the Raad van State, and asks how the sunset clause interacts with a slow restoration process.
These members ask the government to indicate how the swift pseudonymisation of data also finds its place.
Deze leden vragen de regering aan te geven hoe ook het zo snel mogelijk pseudonimiseren van gegevens zijn plek krijgt.
Asks how KOT-affected parents avoid receiving support through three channels and whether children are contacted when parents request deletion of their data.
The SGP members ask whether and in which situations UHP-KOT children are approached if their parents have indicated they have no need for support and want their data destroyed.

De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen of en in welke situaties UHP-KOT-kinderen worden benaderd indien hun ouders te kennen hebben gegeven geen behoefte te hebben aan ondersteuningsaanbod en hun gegevens vernietigd willen zien.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill for temporary exchange of personal data to identify parents harmed by the childcare benefits scandal whose children were placed out of home, raising concerns about the stated goal of gaining insight, the lack of detail on support and reflection, and the open-ended extension mechanism. The government's reply accepted most points by narrowing data lists, clarifying the support offered, limiting extensions to two one-year periods for urgent reasons, and making related drafting changes.
concerns: Insight into the group was questioned as an independent goal and the transfer of data to the Belastingdienst/Toeslagen and certified institutions lacked justification; the government dropped the transfer to the Belastingdienst and retained only limited data for certified institutions.

The data processing involves sensitive personal data and must be limited to what is necessary, so lists were narrowed to BSN and birth dates and the grounds for including birth dates of parents were removed.
Concerns about the information systems of the judiciary and the risk of incomplete data were acknowledged, with a staged linkage and an unchanged open technical design.
The open-ended extension possibility was capped at two extensions of one year each and limited to urgent reasons tied to the minister's task or the bill's goals.
Clarification was added on the forms of support offered to parents, the division of tasks, and complaint routes.
Text was adjusted to a related recent act, a coupling provision was removed, the entry-into-force provision was changed, and editorial changes were made.

36293.s: The bill corrects an omission in the transitional law of the Aanvullingswet bodem Omgevingswet by adding article 88 of the Wet bodembescherming to the list of Wbb articles whose competent authority and enforcement arrangements are preserved. It keeps provinces and designated municipalities as competent authority for soil-protection duty-of-care situations discovered after the Omgevingswet takes effect.
36293.j: The memorandum justifies the change by avoiding an unintended transfer of competences from municipalities to provinces and extra work for provinces after the Omgevingswet takes effect.
q: If this omission were not corrected, the provinces would unintentionally be burdened with extra work in duty-of-care situations after the Omgevingswet takes effect.
Wanneer deze omissie niet zou worden hersteld, zouden de provincies na inwerkingtreding van de Omgevingswet onbedoeld belast worden met extra werkzaamheden in zorgplichtsituaties.

parties: The VVD has no further questions on the bill.
These members have no further questions about it.
Deze leden hebben daar geen verdere vragen over.
The BBB asks whether the bill has negative side effects for the groups most affected by it.
Are any negative side effects of this bill apparent for the groups to whom it most relates?
Zijn er door dit wetsvoorstel negatieve bijeffecten inzichtelijk voor de groepen op wie dit wetsvoorstel het meest betrekking heeft?

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering gave advice on a government bill amending the Aanvullingswet bodem Omgevingswet to fix an omission in transitional law. The Afdeling raised no remarks and advised submitting the bill to the Tweede Kamer, so no government reply on substantive points was needed.

36360-X.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Defence (Hoofdstuk X) and the agency budget statement for Paresto, as a closing budget adjustment (Slotwet) in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has emerged for an amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2022.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2022.

36419.s: The bill amends the Dutch Caribbean tax laws (Belastingwet BES, Wet IB BES, Wet LB BES, DABES) for 2024, mainly to add a new minimum-tax chapter aligned with the Wet minimumbelasting 2024 and to adjust car-tax rules, filing and enforcement deadlines, penalties, and employer/chain liability. It also updates several technical references and makes the amendments effective from 2024 with some retroactive corrections.
36419.j: The memorandum justifies the new rules as necessary to implement the international minimum tax and to align Caribbean procedures with Dutch practice, and it describes the AMvB and ministerial delegations as enabling technical detail, with no sustained justification for the broader discretion.
q: For that reason, for the application of the Wet minimumbelasting 2024, all references to the AWR, the Awb, the Invorderingswet 1990 and the Penal Code are adjusted.

Om die reden worden, voor de toepassing van het wetsvoorstel Wet minimumbelasting 2024, alle verwijzingen naar de AWR, de Awb, de Invorderingswet 1990 (IW 1990) en het Wetboek van Strafrecht aangepast.
d: exclude vehicles from personal car or van classification
duty to proactively report errors and related fines
deadlines and manner of spontaneous reporting; making non-compliance an offence
property tax notification requirements (details left to inspector/notification rules)
further rules for preparing annual accounts
Art. IV.A (art. 6 Wet LB BES, lid 6)
additional benefits excluded from wage income
p: Extended filing and payment deadlines and longer limitation periods for the minimum tax, with the inspector given discretion to set filing deadlines within a floor.

Spontaneous filings submitted shortly before a limitation period expires are treated as invitation-based filings, extending the inspector's assessment and correction powers, and the inspector may refuse reductions where required returns or administrative obligations were not met.
Introduces a new administrative fine for intentionally or grossly negligently incorrect returns, with the fine basis and limitation period defined in statute and appealable.
New duty to notify the tax inspector of property rights, with an administrative fine up to 100 percent of the assessment for late notification.
Extends employer and contractor secondary liability to social insurance premiums and general consumption tax, widening the state's recovery options against third parties.
Adjusts thresholds and conditions for tax residence and treaty references.

parties: Asks which suggestions from the BES island governments and Centraal Dialoog Bonaire were made and considered, and asks about the revenue impact of income tax changes on a specific group.

The VVD members ask which suggestions the island executive boards of Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba and the Centraal Dialoog Bonaire have made, and which suggestions the government has or has not considered.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen welke suggesties de bestuurscolleges van de Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba (BES-)eilanden en de Centraal Dialoog Bonaire hebben gedaan en welke suggesties de regering wel of niet heeft overwogen.
Has no additional questions at this time.
The SP members have taken note of the present bill and have no additional questions about it at this time.](#)
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel en hebben hier op dit moment geen aanvullende vragen over.

Asks whether the government has analysed the effect of the higher gebruikelijk loon on purchasing power of small entrepreneurs and whether it will prevent them falling below subsistence level, and whether the change should be postponed until a social minimum is set.

Is the proposed change and increase of the gebruikelijk loon in the Caribbean Netherlands from 70% to 90% of the most comparable employment's wage, supplemented by evidence and efficiency margins, underpinned by an analysis showing its effect on purchasing power of subgroups of small and medium entrepreneurs?

Ligt aan de voorgestelde wijziging en verhoging van het gebruikelijk loon in Caribisch Nederland van 70% van het loon van een soortgelijke dienstbetrekking naar 90% van het loon van de meest vergelijkbare dienstbetrekking – aangevuld met enkele bewijslast- en doelmatigheidsmargegrenzen – een analyse ten grondslag, waaruit blijkt welke invloed deze wijziging verwacht wordt te hebben op de koopkracht van deelgroepen kleine en middelgrote ondernemers?
Asks about the budgetary effects of the tax treatment of cars and remaining differences with the European Netherlands in wage tax rules.
Member Omtzigt asks what the budgetary consequences are of the tax treatment of cars.
Het lid Omtzigt vraagt wat de budgettaire gevolgen zijn van fiscale behandeling van auto’s.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Belastingplan BES eilanden 2024, criticising the use of a separate tax bill outside the Belastingplan, the lack of internet consultation, and the reduced legal protection of a self-assessed minimum tax, as well as the weak enforceability of joint liability abroad. The government reply accepts that the explanatory memorandum is adjusted on the self-assessment and joint liability points, while explaining its choices on the separate bill and consultation.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum does not justify why this measure is included in the Belastingplan package rather than submitted earlier or separately; the government explains its reasoning in general terms.

Choosing self-assessment (aangifte) for the minimum tax gives taxpayers fewer safeguards than an assessment, since naheffing does not require a new fact, bad faith or a recognisable error; the memorandum was adjusted to explain this choice.

Joint liability of group entities abroad is of doubtful effectiveness given limited bilateral and multilateral assistance for collection; the government adds that the BES islands fall under the mutual assistance convention.

The internet consultation was not separately held for the BES islands and the explanatory memorandum does not show that the consultation was specifically brought to the attention of islanders; the government points to general outreach and consultations with island authorities.

36428.s: The bill temporarily codifies the Tax Authority's practice of treating a revised digital income tax return as a request for ex officio reduction of an income tax assessment, within the objection period. It exempts such reductions from Article 60 AWR and lets a tax assessment be reduced even when a later correction is submitted, so that the taxpayer keeps objection and appeal rights.
36428.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as a low-threshold way to correct omissions in tax assessments and to improve taxpayers' practical legal protection, without touching objection and appeal rights.
q: The proposal only provides that a revised digital income tax return generally qualifies as a request for ex officio reduction.
Het voorstel bepaalt slechts dat een herzien digitaal aangiftebiljet inkomstenbelasting in de regel als een verzoek om ambtshalve vermindering kwalificeert.
p: Artikel I A (artikel 9.6 lid 3-4 Wet IB 2001)

Requires the tax inspector to reduce an overstated assessment ex officio when a request is filed within the objection period, widening the grounds for reduction and protecting taxpayers' appeal rights.

parties: Asks how taxpayers will be informed in the online portal about their rights when submitting and amending returns, and about the number of objection procedures resulting from amendments.

The VVD members ask the government whether it will be made clear to citizens in the online return portal what their rights are when they submit their return and what happens to those rights if they submit a new return.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering of het voor burgers duidelijk wordt gemaakt in het online aangifte portal wat hun rechten zijn wanneer zij hun aangifte insturen en wat er met hun rechten gebeurt indien zij een nieuwe aangifte insturen.
Has no additional questions at this stage.
The SP members have taken note of the present bill and have no additional questions on it at this time.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel en hebben hierover op dit moment geen aanvullende vragen.
Welcomes a sound legal basis for current practice emphasising simplicity and a human scale, and has no questions.
The members see the value of a sound legal basis for the current way of working, in which simplicity, a human scale and feasibility are central to tax returns.
De leden zien het nut in van een goede juridische grondslag voor de huidige manier van werken waarbij eenvoud, menselijke maat en uitvoerbereid centraal staan bij de belastingaangifte.

Asks whether correcting omissions that increase tax is treated as voluntary improvement, and how the bill limits or widens remedies, comparing ex officio reduction with formal objection from a legal-protection standpoint.
Member Omtzigt also asks to what extent legal remedies for taxpayers are restricted (or expanded) by the present bill.
Het lid Omtzigt vraagt daarnaast ook in hoeverre rechtsmiddelen voor belastingplichtigen worden beperkt (of verruimd) door het onderhavige wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001 with temporary special rules for ex officio reductions (Wet tijdelijke regeling herzien aangifte inkomstenbelasting), and made no remarks, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Staatssecretaris's reply is a short covering note forwarding the advice and bill, so no substantive government response to concerns is given.

36446.s: The bill introduces a licensing regime (toelatingsplicht) for temporary-work agencies that lend out workers in the Netherlands, requiring them to obtain authorisation from the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment and to pass periodic compliance inspections by accredited private inspection bodies. It also imposes administrative duties on lenders and borrowers, financial security deposits, a fit-and-proper (VOG) requirement, and expanded Labour Inspectorate enforcement powers.
36446.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to AMvB and ministerial rules by the need for technical detail and rapid adjustment of the normenkader, and the Minister's discretion by the need to prevent malafide operators.
q: The compliance framework can be adjusted in response to new insights and ideas.
Het normenkader kan naar aanleiding van nieuwe inzichten en ideeën worden bijgesteld.
d: rules on exemption from the lending ban
licence application procedure, grounds for extension and fees
form and conditions of financial security
the normenkader (compliance framework) that agencies must meet
content and preparation of inspection reports
rules on designation, suspension and withdrawal of inspection bodies
cases and manner of providing data to the Minister
data exchange with inspection bodies and other authorities
exempting sectors or labour market segments from the Act
form and content of the public register
p: Allows executive decree by AMvB to exempt whole sectors from the licensing regime, possibly departing from the Act, without parliamentary approval.
The Minister has broad discretion to grant or refuse exemptions and may attach conditions, with refusal grounds including Bibob integrity screening.
The Minister may refuse, suspend or withdraw licences on broad grounds including Bibob integrity findings, with a four-week effectiveness period as a limited safeguard.
Broadens data sharing among the Minister, inspection bodies and other bodies, including use of the citizen service number, with rules left to AMvB.
Gives Labour Inspectorate officials power to impose penalty orders (last onder dwangsom) for non-compliance with the new duties.

parties: Asks for prior parliamentary review (voorhang) of the AMvB on exemptions and the norm framework, and worries that exemptions create loopholes for fraud.
These members ask the government for a heavy prior submission to parliament regarding the general administrative order (AMvB) for exceptions and exemptions.
Deze leden vragen aan de regering een zware voorhang als het gaat om de algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB) voor uitzonderingen en ontheffingen.
Supports tighter regulation but raises practical concerns about scope, timeline and burdens on firms, including whether the exemption thresholds are proportionate.
These members therefore see the need for good regulation of the staffing sector, especially where it concerns migrant workers.
Deze leden zien dan ook de noodzaak van goede regulering van uitzendsector, helemaal daar waar het arbeidsmigranten betreft.
