Doubts whether the bill will actually end abuses given past failed attempts; asks about exemption AMvBs and the Arbeidsinspectie's handhavingstoets.
The question therefore is to what extent this bill will actually achieve the intended effect and really end the abuses in the staffing sector.
De vraag is dan ook in hoeverre dit wetsvoorstel wel het beoogde effect zal bereiken en daadwerkelijk een eind kan maken aan de misstanden in de uitzendsector.
Welcomes the bill but asks why a g-rekening and an active registration duty were not made mandatory, and whether private inspection bodies are reliable given past experience.
Asks whether private inspectors will have enough capacity given staff shortages and why enforcement is outsourced to private bodies.
The follow-up question, however, is whether there are enough inspectors in the private market to take on this task, given the current staff shortage.
Alleen de vervolgvraag is wel, zijn er in de private markt genoeg inspecteurs aanwezig die deze taak op kunnen pakken, gekeken naar het huidige personeelstekort?
Asks how the government will involve the House in the many AMvBs and whether a voorhang procedure is considered.
how will the government involve the House in this? Is it considered to submit these AMvBs to the House via a voorhang procedure?
hoe gaat de regering de Kamer hierbij betrekken? Wordt overwogen deze AMvB’s via een voorhangprocedure aan de Kamer voor te leggen?
Questions the sector-exemption and ontheffing options, the very high 2.5 million euro threshold, and how physical checks of housing and worksites will be carried out.
Can the government indicate when the interest of the company outweighs the proposed legislation?
Kan de regering aangeven wanneer het belang van het bedrijf boven voorgestelde wetgeving gaat?
Asks for a baseline measurement and measurable goals, and how disproportionate effects on sectors will be limited, including how sector exemptions are requested and justified.
These members consider it sensible that a baseline measurement be carried out, so that after a number of years the effectiveness of the new system and the measures taken can be determined.
Deze leden achten het verstandig dat er een nulmeting komt, zodat na een aantal jaren kan worden vastgesteld wat de effectiviteit van het nieuwe stelsel en de genomen maatregelen is.

Stresses that the licensing regime must be robust enough to prevent a return to the 1990s situation, and asks about the independence of private inspection bodies financially dependent on the firms they check.

For the members of the ChristenUnie faction it is crucial that a repetition of the earlier licensing system, in which too many rogue staffing agencies remained active on the market without a licence, is prevented.

Voor de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie is het cruciaal dat een herhaling van het eerdere vergunningstelsel – waarbij te veel malafide uitleners zonder vergunning op de markt actief blijven – wordt voorkomen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill's aim of tackling abuses in temporary agency work but advises reconsidering the choice for mandatory certification, its governance (new private zbo), enforceability, the housing requirement and EU-law justification, and recommends adjusting the bill. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts most points: it replaces the private zbo with a ministerial licensing (toelating) system, moves the norm framework to an AMvB, adds an exemption for very small agencies, clarifies housing and free-movement justification, and adds more enforcement capacity, though it rejects the concern about overlapping inspections.
concerns: The Afdeling questions whether mandatory certification is justified over a licensing system, given past failures of SNA certification and the government's own policy on certification.

The Afdeling doubts the need to create a new private statutory zbo as certifying body and advises accreditation instead; the government drops the private body and makes the minister the licensing authority.
The Afdeling advises regulating the norm framework by AMvB rather than by the certifying body, which the government adopts.

The Afdeling advises a self-standing statutory housing quality norm rather than reference to CAO-based certification; the government does not introduce a separate norm but clarifies the existing framework.
The Afdeling asks for justification of restrictions on free movement from the housing requirement, financial security and exemptions; the government adds justification and exemption/transition rules.

The Afdeling questions enforceability given limited inspection capacity and the risk of private inspection shortages; the government adds Arbeidsinspectie capacity and monitoring but disputes the overlapping-inspection concern.
The Afdeling asks for explanation of the expected effectiveness of the fine policy; the government states higher fines and monitoring of effects.

36470-V.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for 2023 (second supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy articles and the Apparatus. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 December 2023.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has emerged for an amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the year 2023
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken voor het jaar 2023

36482.s: The bill amends the Wet op het financieel toezicht to implement EU Directive 2022/2556 on digital operational resilience for the financial sector, aligning ICT risk, testing and trading-system continuity rules with EU Regulation 2022/2554. It makes technical and cross-referencing changes to provisions on market operators, investment firms and risk management, with entry into force set by royal decree.
36482.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as necessary to implement the EU directive and create a uniform framework, without presenting new executive powers as such.
q: This bill makes the amendments to the Wet op het financieel toezicht necessary to implement Directive (EU) 2022/2556.
Dit wetsvoorstel voorziet in de aanpassingen van de Wet op het financieel toezicht (Wft) die noodzakelijk zijn ter implementatie van Richtlijn (EU) 2022/2556
d: entry into force date by royal decree, possibly varying per article

parties: Asks how coordination among European supervisors will work in practice and avoid bureaucratic complexity while ensuring effective supervision.
How is it prevented that the joint supervisory network becomes a bureaucratic tangle rather than promoting effective supervision?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat het gemeenschappelijke toezichtnetwerk een bureaucratische kluwen wordt maar effectief toezicht bevordert?
Asks which aspects of the directive remain to be implemented and when, and what happens if financial institutions do not comply in time.
What happens if financial institutions are not ready in time to implement the regulation or do not meet the risk requirements of the regulation?
Wat gebeurt er als financiële instellingen niet tijdig klaar zijn met het implementeren van de verordening of niet voldoen aan de risico-eisen uit de verordening?
Welcomes improved ICT risk management but asks how supervision of implementation is organised, how the rules relate to NIS2 and GDPR, and whether strategic autonomy is protected.
Can the government explain exactly how this works and what is done with this information?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe dit precies in z'n werk gaat en wat er met deze informatie wordt gedaan?
Supports resilience against cyber threats but stresses that regulatory burden must stay proportionate and harmonisation should not ignore differences between firms and member states.
They do wish to stress that there must be no disproportionate regulatory burden.
Wel willen zij benadrukken dat er geen sprake mag zijn van disproportionele regeldruk
Notes little policy room in implementation and asks whether the Adviescollege toetsing regeldruk should assess the burden and whether further regulatory-burden analysis is made.
These members ask whether, according to the government, the European Commission's impact analysis provides sufficiently specific information.
Deze leden vragen of volgens de regering de impactanalyse van de Europese Commissie voldoende specifieke informatie geeft.
Has no need for further explanation at this stage.
These members have no need for further explanation at this stage of the proceedings.
Deze leden hebben in deze fase van de behandeling geen behoefte aan een nadere toelichting.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Implementatiewet digitale operationele weerbaarheid, which implements EU Regulation DORA into the Wet op het financieel toezicht, and found no remarks, advising that the bill be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport is not included in the text, so no government reply is recorded.

36491.s: The bill amends the Dutch European Arrest Warrant Act (Overleveringswet) and the Penal Code to align them with EU framework decision 2002/584/JBZ, transferring several public prosecutor powers to the Amsterdam district court and adjusting grounds for refusal, surrender of Dutch nationals, and detention procedures. It also amends Penal Code provisions on hate speech and fiscal information obligations to implement EU framework decisions and directive 2017/1371.
36491.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the transfers by EU case law (HvJEU) requiring that the executive-influenced public prosecutor not act as the judicial authority for surrender.
q: The CJEU ruled in 2019 and 2020 that national public prosecutors who can be directed by the executive, such as a Minister of Justice, do not fall under the concept of judicial authority.

Het HvJEU heeft in 2019 ten aanzien van de «uitvaardigende rechterlijke autoriteit» en in 2020 ten aanzien van de «uitvoerende autoriteit» geoordeeld dat nationale openbare ministeries die kunnen worden aangestuurd door de uitvoerende macht, zoals een Minister van justitie, niet onder dit begrip vallen.
p: Artikel I, onderdelen K, M, N, S, BB, FF
Several powers of the public prosecutor (officier van justitie) to refuse, detain and decide on surrender are transferred to the courts, reducing executive-linked prosecutorial discretion.
A new right to be heard is introduced before consent to onward surrender, with the court consulting the issuing authority on how the hearing is conducted.

parties: Asks why separate bills were not used, whether the prosecution's role in surrender procedures is adequate, and how free speech under the constitution and treaties relates to the new offence.
Attach great importance to the right to freedom of expression.
Hechten sterk aan het recht op vrijheid van meningsuiting
Asks why a durable solution such as removing the prosecution's special instruction power was not chosen, given that EU case law on independent judicial authority keeps evolving.
Why, given possible future case law developments, was a truly future-proof solution not chosen?
Waarom is er nu dan met het oog op mogelijk toekomstige jurisprudentiële ontwikkelingen niet gekozen voor een echt toekomstbestendige oplossing
Asks whether the changes are needed in Dutch practice or only required by EU obligations, and where the cost estimates of the judiciary and prosecution diverge from the government's.
Are these changes that we as the Netherlands truly want ourselves, with conviction?
Zijn dit nu wijzigingen zijn die wij als Nederland zelf, met overtuiging, ook echt willen
Asks why it took years to legislate on Holocaust denial, whether enforcement will be prioritised, and whether a dedicated antisemitism offence would help.
These members ask the government why it took years to arrive at a bill criminalising Holocaust denial.
Deze leden vragen de regering waarom het nog jaren heeft geduurd om te komen tot een wetsvoorstel tot strafbaarstelling van holocaustontkenning.
Asks for clarity on which genocides and international crimes fall under the offence, whether a final court ruling is required, and whether the intent requirement sets the burden of proof too high.
They consider that, also from the legal certainty principle, it is important to be clear which conduct regarding which events is punishable.
Zij zijn van mening dat ook vanuit het rechtszekerheidsbeginsel het van belang is dat helder is welke gedragingen ten aanzien van welke gebeurtenissen strafbaar zijn.
Asks which specific events (Holodomor, Armenian genocide, Seyfo, Gaza) would qualify only after a final ruling by a recognised international court or the Dutch courts.
These members ask the government whether the following events will be classified as international crimes by a final decision of a recognised international court or the Dutch courts.
Deze leden vragen de regering of de volgende gebeurtenissen worden bestempeld als internationaal misdrijf die bij onherroepelijke beslissing

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Wet herimplementatie Europees strafrecht, raising points on shifting powers from the public prosecutor to the court in surrender procedures, the scope of the return guarantee, the surrender deadline, unspecified restrictive measures after release, and the criminalisation of denying or trivialising international crimes. The government's nader rapport reports that most advice was followed, including adding procedural safeguards and limiting denial/trivialisation to crimes established by a final court judgment, while not adopting that limitation for mere justification and explaining its reasons.
concerns: The Afdeling advised clarifying in the explanatory memorandum the grounds for shifting the public prosecutor's powers to the court, which the government did.
The Afdeling objected that restricting the court's assessment of the return guarantee to re-integration was too narrow, and the government changed the text to 'in het bijzonder'.
The Afdeling objected that the surrender deadline could be extended indefinitely without a new date, and the government removed that exception.
The Afdeling asked that restrictive measures after release be explicitly specified, tested against fundamental rights and accompanied by procedural safeguards, which the government added.
The Afdeling advised assessing the criminalisation of denial and trivialisation against Article 7 of the Constitution and Article 11 of the EU Charter, which the government added to the memorandum.

The Afdeling advised limiting criminalisation of denial and trivialisation to crimes finally established by a court; the government applied this only to denial and trivialisation and not to justification, and explained why.

36518.s: The bill amends the Omgevingswet and related laws to implement EU Regulation 2023/1115 on deforestation-free commodities, replacing the timber regulation references with the new EU regime. It adds ministerial powers to impose administrative measures, fines, and temporary exclusion from public tenders and subsidies on operators who breach the regulation.
36518.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as necessary for effective enforcement of the EU regulation, citing the Council of State advocate-general's conclusion that lack of administrative fining powers could breach the EU effectiveness principle.
q: That is better than imposing an order for the future. In the latter case, continuous checks would be required.
Dat is beter dan een last opleggen voor de toekomst. In het laatste geval moet immers blijvend gecontroleerd worden.
d: Artikel I, A (art. 4.3 lid 2 onder b Omgevingswet)
rules on trading and bringing deforestation-free commodities into the Netherlands
Artikel I, I (art. 18.16a lid 3 onder n en o)
exclusion from tender procedures and subsidies for up to 12 months, decided jointly with other ministers
rules implementing international law obligations not exhaustively regulated elsewhere
fee tariffs for controls and verifications, if later introduced
p: Artikel I, I (art. 18.16a lid 2 onder h-p en lid 4)

The Minister for Nature and Nitrogen may impose a wide range of administrative measures, including immediate suspension of trade and temporary trading bans, on operators without prior judicial involvement.
Extends the Minister's power to impose administrative fines to breaches involving deforestation-free products, with appeal to the administrative courts available.
Artikel I, I (art. 18.16a lid 2 onder n-o); Artikel II; Artikel III; Artikel IV
Allows the government to exclude operators from public tenders and subsidies, with the exclusion applied by contracting bodies and subsidy providers.

parties: Asks how risk categories are determined and updated, whether enforcement at NVWA has sufficient capacity, and how interim enforcement is ensured before the EU information systems exist.
Is sufficient capacity currently being made available at the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA)?
Wordt er op dit moment voldoende capaciteit bij de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) voor vrijgemaakt?
Asks about the administrative burden on SMEs, the basis for the claimed minimal regulatory burden and cost estimate, overlap with CSRD and CSDDD, and feasibility of the deadlines.
Why was it chosen to impose this obligation on every supply chain partner instead of only on the buyers who account for most imports and exports?
Waarom is ervoor gekozen om elke ketenpartner deze verplichting op te leggen in plaats van enkel voor de inkopers die het leeuwendeel van de import en export tot hun rekening nemen?
Has no further questions after reading the bill.
These members have no further questions.
Deze leden hebben geen verdere vragen.
Asks about the implementation timeline and about enforcement preparation at NVWA and Douane, including staffing and training.
How many FTEs will be appointed? Does the government foresee problems in recruiting and training people?
Hoeveel fte’s worden er aangesteld? Voorziet de regering problemen in het aannemen en opleiden van mensen?
Asks the government to report annually to the House on products excluded from the Dutch market and to share the EU's annual evaluation with the Chamber.
The ChristenUnie members ask the government to share the European Commission's annual evaluation of the Regulation with the House.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen de regering om de jaarlijkse evaluatie van de Verordening door de EC met de Kamer te delen.
Asks whether an advance-consultation procedure (voorhang) applies to AMvB rules, and asks about the basis for enforcement cost estimates and impact on NVWA and the level playing field.
These members ask the government whether in that case a prior-consultation procedure (voorhang) applies.
Deze leden vragen de regering of er in dat geval sprake is van een voorhangprocedure.
Asks about the meaning of a pure implementation, the EU benchmarking system, possible EU supplementary measures, and what minimum inspection levels mean for the Netherlands.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill amending the Omgevingswet to implement the EU deforestation regulation has no remarks and may be submitted to parliament. The government's reply notes only minor technical improvements, including a new administrative measure for temporary bans on trading and clarifications to delegation and subsidy law.

36527.s: The bill implements the EU crypto-asset regulation MiCA in Dutch law by adding to the Wft a new article 1:77n giving the supervisor (AFM/DNB) a broad set of enforcement powers, such as banning or suspending crypto services, advertising and trading, ordering content removal and domain blocking, and imposing temporary trading bans on management. It also amends the Wed to bring certain MiCA provisions under criminal law and adjusts the Wft's professional-ban provision.
36527.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as necessary to make the EU regulation effective and to protect consumers and financial stability, since MiCA requires enforcement tools not yet present in the Wft.
q: With this bill these powers are therefore added to the Wft, namely in article 1:77n Wft.
Met onderhavig wetsvoorstel worden daarom deze bevoegdheden aan de Wft toegevoegd, te weten in artikel 1:77n Wft.
d: supervisor's enforcement powers over crypto-asset providers
Artikel I, onderdeel C (art. 1:87, vierde lid Wft)
professional bans on other undertakings under EU regulation
p: Gives the supervisor wide discretion to ban, suspend or order removal of crypto services, advertising, content and domain names, often on mere reasonable suspicion of a breach, with limited specified procedural safeguards in the bill itself.

parties: Asks whether the six-month transition period could disadvantage Dutch providers and whether supervisory cost increases could drive firms abroad, and raises the feasibility assessment by AFM and DNB.
The PVV members note that supervisors expect a considerable increase in required supervisory capacity, with estimates of 36 FTE in 2025.
De leden van de PVV-fractie constateren dat toezichthouders een aanzienlijke toename van de benodigde toezichtcapaciteit verwachten, met schattingen van 36 fte in 2025.

Asks whether the government will evaluate the regime, whether ESMA should become a single supervisor, and how consumer risk disclosures and systemic risks will be policed, and questions the absence of an evaluation clause.
The GroenLinks-PvdA members note that the bill contains no evaluation clause.
De leden van de GroenLinks-PvdA-fractie merken op dat het wetsvoorstel geen evaluatiebepaling bevat.

Asks how supervision and enforcement will work, whether the Advisory Council on Regulatory Burden (ATR) should advise formally, and whether the Data Protection Authority should be consulted on personal data processing.

Asks how DNB and AFM supervisory capacity is affected, whether the Data Protection Authority should advise on personal data, and how personal data protection is secured, and asks for an evaluation clause.
The D66 members also ask the government whether it has considered requesting advice from the Data Protection Authority on the processing of personal data.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering eveneens of is overwogen om ten aanzien van de verwerking van persoonsgegevens een advies te vragen aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an opinion on the bill implementing the EU Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCAR) in the Wet op het financieel toezicht, raising no remarks and advising submission to parliament. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport reports that several provisions were added to the Wet op de economische delicten, a supervisory power was added, toezichtkosten were clarified, and the implementation table was made clearer.

36536.s: The bill strengthens authors' and performers' contract rights against exploiters of their works by allowing collective bargaining presumed fair, requiring written contracts for transfers and exclusive licences, converting rescission for non-exploitation into a termination right, and enabling mandatory membership of publicly funded exploiters in a dispute commission. It also creates a fair-remuneration right for film makers over video on demand and a power to impose mandatory collective management of that right by general administrative order.
36536.j: The memorandum justifies the general administrative order powers as a backstop if self-regulation for video on demand fails, with parliamentary control via the nahang procedure and a duty to evaluate.
q: This will only be used in case the self-regulation agreements are not, or insufficiently, complied with in practice.
Hiervan zal uitsluitend gebruik gemaakt worden in het geval de zelfreguleringsafspraken in de praktijk niet of onvoldoende worden nagekomen.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel G (artikel 25g lid 4 Auteurswet)
mandatory membership of publicly funded exploiters in dispute commission
mandatory collective management of video on demand exploitation
Artikel I, onderdeel J (artikel 45da lid 4 Auteurswet)
further rules on exercise of proportional fair remuneration right
Artikel I, onderdeel G (artikel 25g lid 1 Auteurswet)
composition, procedures, financing and supervision of dispute commission
p: The minister may by general administrative order compel publicly funded exploiters to join a dispute commission and set conditions, without parliamentary approval beyond the after-the-fact procedure.
A general administrative order may extend mandatory collective management to video on demand, subject to after-the-fact parliamentary control and a five-yearly evaluation report to parliament.

parties: Asks what measures will encourage voluntary use of the dispute committee and how to prevent blacklisting that deters creators from going to court.
Supports the bill but doubts that anonymous and collective complaint handling sufficiently protects creators against dominant market parties and asks about monitoring of collective bargaining.
Does the government see possibilities to better protect creators in this, especially against dominant market parties?
Ziet de regering mogelijkheden om makers hierin beter in bescherming te nemen, zeker tegen dominante marktpartijen?
Supports the bill and asks the government to show how regulatory burden effects identified by the Adviescollege toetsing regeldruk were investigated.
Can the government indicate for each of these elements what has been done to further map the regulatory burden effects?
Kan de regering aangeven bij elk van deze elementen wat is gedaan om de gevolgen van de regeldruk (nader) in beeld te krijgen?
Welcomes the bill but questions whether it is sufficient; asks for monitoring of collective negotiations and reconsideration of the unilateral request for fixing fair remuneration.
These members also note that it appears no monitoring will take place of collective negotiations once they occur.
De leden van de NSC-fractie merken ook op dat het erop lijkt dat er geen monitoring zal plaatsvinden van de collectieve onderhandelingen als deze plaatsvinden.

Asks whether the government will coerce publicly funded exploiters into collective agreements, requests explicit statutory fair-remuneration rights for all works, and asks why transparency duties carry no sanction.
Why is there no sanction for failing to comply with the transparency obligation?
Waarom staat er geen sanctie op het niet-naleven van de transparantieverplichting?

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division raised a point that the bill's option to oblige publicly funded exploiters to join a dispute committee for copyright contract disputes is unclear in relation to article 21 of the DSM Directive, which treats such procedures as voluntary, and asked for the explanatory memorandum to be supplemented and the bill adjusted if needed. The government's reply argues the mandatory joining under the existing committee rules does not lead to binding advice and therefore does not conflict with the Directive, and states that the memorandum and the bill were adjusted and the commitment of industry platforms noted.
concerns: The mandatory membership of publicly funded exploiters in the dispute committee may conflict with the voluntariness principle of article 21 of the DSM Directive, which the explanatory memorandum did not explain.

36545.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2022/2041 on adequate minimum wages by amending the Dutch Minimum Wage Act: it adds an anti-victimisation provision for workers who claim rights, and requires the four-yearly minimum wage evaluation to apply Directive criteria and indicative reference values set by ministerial regulation. It also creates a delegation allowing an AMvB to add further evaluation criteria.
36545.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB delegation by saying no more criteria are needed now but future relevant statistics or criteria might be, so a delegation is provided.
q: At present there is no reason to prescribe more criteria than those in paragraph 16(a), but it cannot be ruled out that this will differ in future.
Op dit moment is er geen reden om meer criteria voor te schrijven dan de criteria die zijn geregeld in het zestiende lid, onderdeel a, maar niet uit te sluiten valt dat dit in de toekomst anders is.
d: indicative reference values for assessing adequacy of minimum wage
additional criteria for minimum wage evaluation

parties: Questions whether the youth minimum wage and housing deductions are non-discriminatory, proportionate and adequate, and the omission of reference values from the law.
Asks why indicative reference values are set by ministerial regulation rather than AMvB and how the government justifies its non-discrimination and proportionality claims.
For these members, however, it is unclear why this is not done by general administrative order (AMvB).
Voor deze leden is het echter niet duidelijk waarom dit niet per algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB) gebeurt.
Asks how the new reference values relate to the existing criteria and when the draft ministerial regulation will be consulted.
Argues the minimum wage is too low for livelihood security and that the youth wage for adults should be abolished.
These members see good arguments for abolishing the youth wage for adults.
Deze leden zien goede argumenten om het jeugdloon voor volwassenen af te schaffen.
Questions the EU's competence and subsidiarity on wage setting and the loss of national policy freedom, including effects on benefits tied to the minimum wage.
These members have great difficulty with the fact that the EU increasingly interferes with the social security systems of member states.
Deze leden hebben grote moeite met het feit dat de EU zich steeds vaker bemoeit met het sociale zekerheidsstelsel van de lidstaten.
Worries that housing deductions make migrant workers fully dependent on employers and asks about safeguards and information for workers.
Does the government acknowledge that these migrant workers are fully dependent on the employer through this deduction?
Erkent de regering dat deze arbeidsmigranten door deze inhouding volledig afhankelijk zijn van de werkgever?
Asks why there was no internet consultation and why only social partners were consulted, and how the bill relates to the Commission on the social minimum.
The NSC members consider it a missed opportunity that no internet consultation was held.
De leden van de NSC-fractie vinden het een gemiste kans dat er geen internetconsultatie is gehouden.
Asks who decides whether variations and deductions are non-discriminatory and proportionate and whether organisations can go to court.
Is it possible for organisations to go to court because they believe a certain variation contains a form of discrimination?
Is het mogelijk voor organisaties om naar de rechter te stappen omdat zij van mening zijn dat een bepaalde variatie wel een vorm van discriminatie bevat?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the bill implementing the EU minimum wage directive, asking the explanatory memorandum to address trade union and employer organisation independence and the design of indicative reference values. The minister's reply accepts both points and states the memorandum was amended accordingly.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should address the independence of trade unions and employer organisations and the changing practice of collective agreements with staff associations and works councils.
Indicative reference values for the adequacy of the minimum wage should be designed with attention to the work-pays principle, sharing in general welfare development, and labour market effects.

36554.s: The bill adds an epidemic chapter to the Kieswet allowing election rules to be adjusted during an epidemic, such as flexible polling-station hours, digital attendance at central and main polling-station meetings, and altered identity documents. Most of these adjustments are activated by royal decree only when epidemic measures are in force and an election is imminent.
36554.j: The memorandum justifies delegation to general administrative orders by the need to change operational details quickly during an epidemic and to keep elections safe.
q: it is desirable to regulate the additional rules on identity documents in a general administrative order, so that a change in the list of accepted identity documents can be implemented more quickly

het is wenselijk om de aanvullende regels omtrent identiteitsdocumenten te regelen in een algemene maatregel van bestuur, zodat een wijziging in de lijst met geaccepteerde identiteitsdocumenten sneller kan worden doorgevoerd
d: further rules on counting and vote-count timing for polling stations
royal decree activating epidemic provisions, conditional on ministerial regulation under Wpg
rules on digital environment, live link and objections for polling-station meetings
rules on digital environment for main polling-station meetings
additional identity documents usable by voters abroad
p: Polling-station members may give binding instructions and the chair may bar persons from the premises for non-compliance with epidemic measures.
Public meetings may be held digitally, with attendance limited to conditions the chair can enforce.
Executive may by general administrative order change which identity documents voters abroad may use.

parties: Asks whether municipalities must keep signature-collection offices open by appointment only and whether they should be compensated for the extra cost burden.

These members can agree with the government's intention to replace temporary rules, as laid down in the Temporary Covid-19 Elections Act, with permanent legislation that can effectively be activated in case of an epidemic.

Deze leden kunnen zich vinden in het voornemen van de regering om in plaats van tijdelijke regels, zoals die vastgelegd waren in de Tijdelijke wet verkiezingen covid-19 (Twv), vaste wetgeving te maken die in het geval van een epidemie als het ware geactiveerd kan worden.

Welcomes that deployment requires a separate ministerial decision rather than automatic activation, given the fundamental nature of the right to vote, and asks about the minister's discretion and the powers of polling-station chairs to exclude voters.
They also consider it good that a separate decision must be taken to deploy the measures, so there is no automatism.
Ook achten zij het goed dat er voor het inzetten van de maatregelen een apart besluit moet worden genomen, dus dat er geen sprake is van een automatisme
Objects to deferring measures to emergency legislation without extra safeguards, since they could seriously restrict fundamental rights, and questions the narrow scope limited to A1 diseases.
Pre-emptively shifting measures to emergency legislation without an extra decision is undesirable for these members, because such measures could seriously restrict (fundamental) rights.
Maatregelen bij voorbaat, zonder extra besluit, doorschuiven naar noodwetgeving is voor deze leden onwenselijk, omdat deze maatregelen (grond)rechten ingrijpend kunnen inperken.
Supports the reforms but raises integrity risks (hacking, manipulation of digital streams, transport of ballots) and insists on strict necessity for epidemic status and its rights impact.
It must be said, however, that alongside this bill one must be critical about when there is an A1 epidemic and for how long that status should apply.
Wel moet daarbij genoemd worden dat men aanpalend aan dit wetsvoorstel kritisch moeten zijn over wanneer er sprake is van een A1-epidemie en voor hoelang die status van kracht moet zijn.
Criticises the omission of postal voting for vulnerable groups and of early voting, finds the government's justifications insufficient, and doubts the bill's future-proofness.
These members find the government's defence on this point insufficient and ask the government to further justify this choice.
Deze leden vinden het verweer van de regering op dit punt onvoldoende en vragen de regering deze gemaakte keuze nader te motiveren.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill adding an epidemic section to the Kieswet, criticising automatic activation, lack of differentiation, insufficient protection of elderly voters, the unexplained removal of early voting, same-day location changes, identity-document rules and ministerial instructions on support declarations. The minister's reply accepted several points, such as a separate activation decision and differentiation, but rejected others, such as reinstating postal voting and early voting and binding instructions to municipalities.
concerns: Automatic activation of the epidemic section whenever Wpg measures apply is considered disproportionate; the minister now allows activation only by separate decision.
The lack of differentiation between measures in the epidemic section is not necessary or proportionate; the minister accepts adding a differentiation option.
Protection of vulnerable elderly voters (postal voting and restricted access to care-home polling stations) should be included in the law; the minister declined, citing high vaccination rates.
Early voting should be included in the epidemic section; the minister excluded it given the pending initiative bill and its disproportionate burden on municipalities.
Allowing polling-station location changes on election day is not shown to be necessary; the minister removed this option.
Listing acceptable identity documents for Dutch voters abroad should be set in law rather than in the Kiesbesluit; the minister kept it in the Kiesbesluit for flexibility.
Ministerial instructions on support declarations need a statutory basis for binding force; the minister declined to make them binding, relying on non-binding guidance and municipal autonomy.

36560-V.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) as the final budget adjustment (Slotwet), recording the changes from the first and second supplementary budgets and the Prinsjesdag supplement and reporting realised figures. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Amendment of the 2023 budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) (final budget act)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2023 (Slotwet)

36581.s: The bill opens administrative appeal before the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State (ABRvS), in first and only instance, against airport decisions for Schiphol, Lelystad, Rotterdam and the military airport Eindhoven, which were previously excluded from appeal. It also harmonises the preparation procedures for airport designation, traffic and airport decisions, including longer public comment periods and submission of drafts to both chambers of parliament.
36581.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the change by uniform legal protection, the lower-threshold nature of administrative appeal, and the Luchtvaartnota 2020–2050 commitment, with the existing exclusions described as creating disadvantages and legal risks.
q: The Rutte III Cabinet included in the 2020 Aviation Policy Note 2020–2050 the intention to also open appeal in first and only instance to the ABRvS against these decisions.
Het Kabinet-Rutte III heeft in 2020 in de Luchtvaartnota 2020–2050 15 dan ook het voornemen opgenomen om ook tegen deze besluiten beroep in eerste en enige aanleg bij de ABRvS open te stellen.
d: Artikel 8.13 Wet luchtvaart (as amended by Artikel II B)
airport designation decisions (LIB/LVB) and their preparation procedure
Artikel 8.71 Wet luchtvaart (as amended by Artikel II C)
airport decisions and amendments, preparation procedure
p: Artikel I A and B (bijlage 2 Awb)
Removes the exclusion from administrative appeal for key airport decisions, giving citizens and local bodies access to the administrative judge in first and only instance.

parties: Has no follow-up questions after reviewing the bill, the public consultation and the Council of State's advice.
They have also taken note of the public consultation responses and the advice of the Council of State and, in view of the answers given, have no follow-up questions at this time.
Zij hebben tevens kennisgenomen van de inspraakreacties en het advies van de Raad van State en hebben, gezien de beantwoording, op dit moment geen vervolgvragen.
Supports a uniform legal route but asks why civil court access is seen as less accessible and worries the Administrative Jurisdiction Division will face a large increase in workload.
One disadvantage of this is that going to the civil court is perceived as less accessible.](The civil court route is perceived as less accessible.)
Dit heeft onder andere als nadeel dat de gang naar de civiele rechter als minder laagdrempelig wordt ervaren.

Asks why some decisions allow administrative review and others do not, whether first instance should lie with regional administrative judges, how the bill fits Article 21 of the Constitution, and how it affects court timelines under Article 17.
The NSC members ask for a reflection on how this bill fits with Article 21 of the Constitution.
De leden van de NSC-fractie vragen om een reflectie hoe dit wetsvoorstel zich rijmt met artikel 21 van de Grondwet.
Asks whether the bill can take effect in time before the draft airport decisions for Lelystad and Rotterdam, and how the Council of State will be resourced for increased appeals.
How will this be taken into account? Will budget accompany the new tasks for the Council of State's Administrative Jurisdiction Division?
Hoe zal hier rekening mee worden gehouden? Komt er, naast nieuwe taken, ook budget bij voor de ABRvS?
Asks who may appeal without personal nuisance, whether easier appeal creates staffing shortages, and what delays and economic and cost effects the increase in appeals will have for airports.
The BBB members ask to what extent persons who cannot personally experience nuisance may appeal against decisions.
De leden van de BBB-fractie vragen in hoeverre personen die persoonlijk zelf geen hinder kunnen ondervinden, in beroep mogen gaan tegen besluiten.

Asks whether substantive review differs between the two legal routes, whether civil law recourse disappears, whether the bill has disadvantages for citizens, and whether residents' legal protection was previously inadequate; demands a guarantee that no final decisions are taken before the bill takes effect.
These members believe this is of great importance for residents of those airports, who have suffered injustice for years.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat dit van groot belang is voor omwonenden van die luchthavens, die jarenlang onrecht is aangedaan.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no substantive remarks on the bill introducing appeal to the Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak against decisions on Schiphol, Lelystad, Rotterdam and Eindhoven airports, and advises submitting it to parliament. The government's reply notes only a technical correction to a cross-reference in the Wet luchtvaart and some textual additions to the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling proposed a technical correction of an outdated cross-reference to the Wet milieubeheer in article 5.10 of the Wet luchtvaart, which the government implemented.

36590.s: The bill amends the Wet strategische diensten to add a ministerial power to ban or require licences for transfers of software or technology dual-use items for public security or human rights reasons, and to clarify licence conditions. It also extends the Wet op de economische delicten so that breaches of these new ministerial rules and licence conditions are criminal offences.
36590.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial power by the speed of technological change, which requires flexibility and speed in responding to risks.
q: For that reason it is considered justified to arrange the power to impose a ban and create a licence requirement by ministerial regulation.
Om die reden wordt het gerechtvaardigd geacht om de bevoegdheid tot het instellen van een verbod en het in het leven roepen van een vergunningplicht bij ministeriële regeling te regelen.
d: ARTIKEL I A.2 (new art. 2, fifth paragraph)
ban or mandatory licence for software and technology transfers
ARTIKEL I B.1 (art. 14, first paragraph, amended)
attaching conditions and requirements to licences
p: ARTIKEL I A.2 (new art. 2, fifth paragraph)

The Minister may by ministerial regulation impose bans or mandatory licences on software and technology transfers for public security or human rights reasons, bypassing parliament for these measures; the memorandum says the minister will exercise restraint.

parties: Supports the bill and the need to act quickly to keep up with technological developments; has no further questions.
The VVD members share the government's view that it is important to act quickly and vigorously in order to keep pace with technological developments.
De leden van de VVD-fractie delen het standpunt van de regering dat het van belang is om snel en voortvarend te kunnen handelen om zo de technologische ontwikkelingen bij te kunnen houden.
Has read the bill and has no further questions.
The NSC members have taken note of the bill and have no further questions.
De leden van de NSC-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben geen verdere vragen.

Asks how the Raad van State's demanded concretisation, limitation and conditionality of ministerial powers differ from comparable laws, and about future need for controls on dual-use items and cooperation with other EU states.

The D66 members ask the government to explain how the concretisation, limitation and conditionality of ministerial powers that the Council of State wanted differ from the delimitation of such powers in comparable laws, such as the Strategic Goods Act.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering toe te lichten hoe de door de Raad van State gewenste concretisering, begrenzing en voorwaardelijkheid van ministeriële bevoegdheden met betrekking tot de voorgestelde wetswijziging verschillen van de afbakening van deze bevoegdheden in vergelijkbare wetten, zoals de Wet strategische goederen.

Positive about adapting export control but asks for specification of software covered, the EU hierarchy, the reasons for the technical changes, regulatory burden, and how restraint in applying the ministerial power squares with the urgency sought.
How does the government weigh the restraint in applying this article against the earlier-mentioned urgency of being able to respond, the SGP members ask.
Hoe weegt de regering de terughoudendheid bij het toepassen van dit artikel met de eerder genoemde voortvarendheid om te kunnen reageren, zo vragen de leden van de SGP-fractie.
Asks what the omission being repaired precisely is and what changed since the earlier implementation, given the Council of State saw no need for the ministerial power then.
What has changed precisely since then that makes that power now necessary?
Wat is er sindsdien precies veranderd waardoor die bevoegdheid nu wel nodig is?
Asks for examples of strategic services, prior authority, and the legal framing and grounds on which the minister may impose a ban or licence requirement.
The members ask whether it can be indicated how this is legally framed and how the law specifies in which situations and on what grounds the minister will impose a ban or licence requirement.

De fractieleden vragen of kan worden aangegeven hoe dit wettelijk ingekaderd is en hoe in de wet is vastgelegd in welke situaties en op wat voor gronden de Minister overgaat tot een verbod of vergunningplicht.
Asks which sectors would bear the added burden on Dutch business and whether EU firms would be affected too.
Which sectors would be mainly affected, how high is the added burden roughly, and is it a burden that only Dutch business will experience, or also business in EU countries?

Welke sectoren worden hier voornamelijk door geraakt, hoe hoog is de lastenverzwaring ongeveer en is dit een lastenverzwaring die alleen het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven gaat ervaren, of ook het bedrijfsleven in de EU-landen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the explanatory memorandum on a bill amending the Wet strategische diensten and Wet economische delicten should better justify the need for the changes and explain why ministerial regulations rather than the statute should set bans and licence requirements for software and technology transfers. The minister's reply states that the memorandum has been supplemented on both points, citing rapid technological change and the need for flexibility.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum lacked an adequate account of the need for and background to the proposed amendments, and the Afdeling asked for it to be supplemented.
The explanatory memorandum gave little reasoning for delegating to the minister by ministerial regulation the power to impose bans and licence requirements, which the Afdeling asked to be motivated.

36600-III.s: This bill fixes the 2025 budget statements for the Ministry of General Affairs (including agency Dienst Publiek en Communicatie), the Cabinet of the King, and the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services (CTIVD) in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date and does not itself create delegations or shift power.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2025 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2025 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2025 budget bills for the Ministry of General Affairs and related bodies, raising no remarks and recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport, submitted on behalf of the Prime Minister, notes that some budgets require changes and refers to attached annexes.

36608.s: The bill simplifies the Dutch rent allowance (huurtoeslag) rules, lowers the tenant's own contribution by €11.58 and moves to a linear income-dependent phase-out. It also lets ministerial regulations and general administrative orders (AMvB) raise or lower several amounts and percentages and sets a four-week pre-consultation period for such regulations.
36608.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial power to raise reference income points by the need to approximate the linear line in the income-dependent scheme, and the four-week pre-consultation period by reference to the Aanwijzingen voor de Regelgeving.
q: This article provides for the possibility of raising the reference income points by ministerial regulation from 1 January 2025 in order to approximate the linear line.
Dit artikel voorziet in de mogelijkheid om de referentie-inkomensijkpunten per 1 januari 2025 bij ministeriële regeling te verhogen om zo de lineaire lijn te benaderen
d: factors for income-linked standard rent formula
ARTIKEL II, onderdeel I (artikel 54, lid 2 en 4)
adjusting norm income and minimum-income reference points
raising or lowering rent reduction and elderly supplement amounts
ARTIKEL III, onderdeel E (artikel 27, lid 6 en 7)
raising or lowering service-cost and rent-reduction amounts; changing phase-out percentage
raising reference income points from 1 January 2025
p: Allows the minister to raise reference income points by regulation from 2025 without a statutory amount change, with the new amount indexed first under the existing rules.
ARTIKEL II, onderdeel I (artikel 54, lid 2) and ARTIKEL III, onderdeel E (artikel 27, lid 7)
Lets ministerial regulation change the norm income and the phase-out percentage to prevent unintended effects, outside the statutory amounts.

parties: Asks why the lower own contribution only takes effect in 2026 and whether the delegation basis was actually removed, pressing for clarity on the government's changes after Raad van State advice.

However, they also read in the supplementary report on the bill that, following remarks from the Council of State advisory division, the government decided to remove the proposed delegation basis from the bill.

Zij lezen echter ook in het Nader rapport inzake het wetsvoorstel dat de regering naar aanleiding van opmerkingen van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State heeft besloten de voorgenomen delegatiegrondslag uit het wetsvoorstel te schrappen.
Asks for certainty on the 2026 implementation date and for the Dienst Toeslagen implementation assessment, and notes the Raad van State warning about interaction with other housing laws.
The VVD members read in the Council of State advice that it is not unthinkable that there is an interaction with recent legislative changes in the rental domain.
De leden van de VVD-fractie lezen in het advies van de Raad van State dat niet ondenkbaar is dat er een wisselwerking bestaat met recente wetswijzigingen in het huurdomein.

Worries that the speed of legislating prevented proper examination of interactions between measures and other income schemes, and asks the government to show the net effects and how it responded to the Council of State.

Yet these members also worry that, because of the speed of action, the relationship between measures within the bill has not been sufficiently examined, as well as the relationship with other income schemes, as the Council of State also notes in its advice.

Toch hebben deze leden ook de zorg dat door de snelheid van handelen de relatie tussen maatregelen binnen de wet niet voldoende zijn onderzocht alsook de relatie met andere (inkomens)regelingen zoals de Raad van State ook opmerkt in zijn advies.
Asks technical questions on how household-type harmonisation affects passing thresholds, spending, and the financing of the two related bills.
These members ask what the harmonisation of the number of household types means for rent allowance expenditure?
Deze leden vragen wat de harmonisering van het aantal huishoudtypes betekent voor de uitgaves aan de huurtoeslag?
Welcomes simplification and higher purchasing power but worries about greater dependence on allowances and repayment risks, and asks about implementation costs and transition budgets.
With this increase they become more dependent on allowances again, and run the risk of higher reclaims if they make a mistake.
Zij worden met deze stijging weer afhankelijker van toeslagen, en lopen het risico op hogere terugvorderingen als zij een foutje maken.
Argues that combining many measures leaves both chambers too little time for proper scrutiny, and questions the removal of the delegation basis and the timing of the parameters.
By including all measures in this bill, the review period for both chambers is short, which may undermine proper scrutiny.
Door alle maatregelen in voorliggend wetsvoorstel op te nemen, is de behandeltermijn van beide Kamers kort, wat afbreuk kan doen aan een degelijke behandeling.
Asks for a split of financial effects per measure and for the reason the own contribution cut is delayed to 2026, and raises the widening income gap for students in non-independent housing.
Why is the own contribution not already lowered in 2025, as was also promised in the coalition agreement?
Waarom wordt de eigen bijdrage niet al in 2025 verlaagd, zoals ook was beloofd in het hoofdlijnenakkoord?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises reconsidering the bill to reduce the huurtoeslag own contribution, simplify household types and linearise the income-dependent phase-out, mainly on coherence with the Belastingplan 2025, implementability by the Dienst Toeslagen, and the delegation basis and parameter adjustment. The minister's reply largely accepts the points, decouples the delegation basis and the 2026 measures are kept in the bill, while defending the integral package and phasing.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the implementability and interaction of the measures and the Dienst Toeslagen's capacity, and advises decoupling 2026 measures from the Belastingplan; the government keeps them integrated but acknowledges the implementation risks.
The Afdeling questions the relation between the delegation basis for a lower basic rent from 2025 and the statutory reduction from 2026, and the government removed the delegation basis.

The Afdeling questions whether abolishing the four household types is a real simplification given other laws still use the typology; the government answers that the huurtoeslag stands apart and keeps the figures in the other laws for legislative economy.
The Afdeling notes unclear legal basis for the interim parameter adjustment mimicking linear phase-out; the government states the bill now provides a statutory basis for it.

36617.s: The bill creates a temporary income supplement (tegemoetkoming) for single-earner households who receive less allowance than comparable benefit-only households due to the tax-allowance design problem, to be granted by municipalities under a new chapter 7C of the Participatiewet. It sets the supplement's amount to be fixed annually by ministerial regulation and allows further detailed rules by ministerial regulation, and provides for ex officio granting based on Tax Administration data.
36617.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to ministerial regulation by the need to set the amount annually and to ensure uniform, workable implementation pending a fundamental fiscal solution.
q: The amount of the supplement is set annually by ministerial regulation.
De hoogte van de tegemoetkoming wordt jaarlijks vastgesteld bij ministeriële regeling.
p: A granted supplement cannot be revised to the recipient's disadvantage, limiting executive ability to reclaim amounts after a change in income.

parties: Asks why the allowance is not tax-free, how municipalities can verify eligibility from t-2 lists, and whether later-discovered incorrect payments will be reclaimed, raising transparency and accountability concerns.
These members read that improper allowances because the situation changed since t-2 will not be reclaimed.
Deze leden lezen dat onterechte tegemoetkomingen omdat de situatie is gewijzigd sinds t-2 niet worden teruggevorderd.
Asks for a substantiated count of affected households (6,000 vs 10,000), the amounts, payment timing, and the effects of higher income or inheritance on beneficiaries.
These members ask for further substantiation of this number, given that earlier reporting spoke of 10,000 households.
Deze leden vragen om een nadere onderbouwing van dit aantal, gelet op dat het in eerdere berichtgeving om 10.000 huishoudens ging.

Criticises the delegation of the allowance amount to a ministerial regulation outside Parliament, the vague on-request procedure, the absence of statutory eligibility rules and legal-protection problems for appeals, and questions constitutional duties under article 20 of the Constitution.

Asks whether the temporary regime is extended if the fiscal fix slips past 2028, the indicative basis for the amount, the risk of overcompensation, and how the invoeringstoets can inform the scheme if run only mid-2025.
Can the government explain whether the temporary scheme will also be extended should the fiscal solution unexpectedly take effect later than 2028?
Kan de regering toelichten of de tijdelijke regeling in deze ook wordt verlengd mocht de fiscale oplossing onverhoopt later dan 2028 in werking treden?

Supports the temporary route but worries about the adequacy of the fixed amount, reaching the target group, and the outdated list leading to wrongful payments, while asking for a fix for those not on the list.
The BBB members support ex officio granting but are concerned about its practical implementation.
De leden van de BBB-fractie ondersteunen een ambtshalve toekenning maar maken zich wel zorgen over de praktische uitvoering hiervan.

Worries about the many open ends and uncertainties, potential overcompensation, equal-treatment legal risks across different bases for granting, and how municipalities can assess income in individual cases with limited expertise.
Although the CDA members feel uneasy about the enormous overcompensation this proposal potentially entails, they do support the choice not to reclaim amounts once granted.
Hoewel de leden van de CDA-fractie ongemak voelen bij de enorme overcompensatie die dit voorstel in potentie inhoudt, staan zij wel achter de keuze eenmaal gegeven bedragen niet terug te vorderen.
Asks about legal risks flagged by the Raad van State, including unequal treatment of benefit recipients without compensation, and why proactive SZW services do not allow ex officio provision.
The SGP members ask the government to respond to the possible legal risks identified by the Council of State.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen de regering te reageren op de mogelijke juridische risico's, zoals geconstateerd door de Raad van State.
Regrets that the fiscal abolition of the double AHK only starts in 2028 and prefers swift abolition with compensating measures; asks how municipalities will reach non-listed households.
These members express a preference for swift abolition of the double AHK and compensating purchasing-power measures for the target group.
Deze leden spreken de voorkeur uit voor een vlotte afschaffing van de dubbele AHK en compenserende koopkrachtmaatregelen voor de doelgroep.

NSC argues the government's narrowed scope may not comply with the Central Appeals Tribunal ruling that households falling below the social minimum through combined schemes must be covered, and asks whether the government will extend the group.

Does the government agree that this ruling is not only about people who fall below the social minimum because of the tax scheme, but about everyone who falls below that minimum through a combination of schemes?

Deelt de regering dat deze uitspraak dus niet enkel gaat over mensen die door de fiscale regeling onder het bestaansminimum belanden, maar dat het om allen gaat die onder dat bestaansminimum belanden door een samenloop van regelingen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the temporary allowance bill for single-earner households (alleenverdienersproblematiek) raises many new legal questions and does not fully solve the problem, since it is a foreseeable consequence of national policy rather than an external emergency, and it burdens municipalities; it advised improving the regulation and ensuring its duration is as short as possible. The government's reply accepts many points: it acknowledges imperfections such as overcompensation and non-ambtshalve reach, changes the discretionary power to a binding entitlement, clarifies the income-from-work exclusion, but rejects the option of reclaiming erroneous payments.
concerns: The regulation does not fully remove the underlying problem and only partly alleviates its consequences, raising new questions, while the government acknowledges it is not perfect but no better short-term option exists.
The flat-rate allowance overcompensates most single-earner households and does not compensate the comparable benefit households, which conflicts with the income-policy rationale.
The discretionary power ('kan-bepaling') conflicts with the uniform entitlement intended; the government changed it to a binding entitlement (gebonden bevoegdheid).
Unclear whether the defined target group excludes households with income from work; the explanatory memorandum was clarified accordingly.
The prohibition on reclaiming erroneously granted allowances means errors cannot be corrected; the government keeps this design choice despite the concern.
The problem stems from a foreseeable combination of national policy measures rather than an external emergency, and burdening municipalities with it fits poorly with intergovernmental relations.
Risk that the temporary regulation will apply longer than intended due to delays in the structural fiscal solution; the government acknowledges this and aims for 2028 entry into force.

36625-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statement for the other Hoge Colleges van Staat, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, the second supplementary budget. It increases the Ombudsman's commitments and expenditure by 966 thousand euros and the Algemene Rekenkamer's by 70 thousand euros, with the rest unchanged.
q: The budget statement for the other Hoge Colleges van Staat, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council for 2024 is amended.
De begrotingsstaat van de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat, de Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs en de Kiesraad voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd.

36626.s: The bill amends the Dutch heavy goods vehicle levy (Wet vrachtwagenheffing) to align it with the revised EU Eurovignette Directive 1999/62/EC, making tariffs depend on CO2 emission classes and extending the levy to certain light trucks. It also adjusts tariff indexation, the rules on how service providers determine tariffs, data retention, enforcement-related powers of the supervisor versus the toll collector, and the reporting obligation to Parliament.
36626.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by pointing to the revised EU directive's requirements and to practical enforceability, such as the need to allow appeals after deadlines have passed.
q: The current article 21, second paragraph, under b, sub-point 2°, provides that personal data may be retained until the administrative fine has been paid.
Het huidige artikel 21, tweede lid, onderdeel b, subonderdeel 2°, bepaalt dat persoonsgegevens kunnen worden bewaard totdat de bestuurlijke boete is betaald.
d: allowing service providers to consult further vehicle documents designated by general administrative order
p: Personal data may be retained for five years after a fine is paid, annulled or waived, extending data retention beyond the earlier payment-based period, partly to allow assessment of late objections or appeals.
Removes the supervisor's power to send reminder or warning letters to holders without a service agreement and shifts that power to the toll collector.

parties: Asks about flexibility in the EU directive, how other member states implement it, and warns of diversion onto local roads not designed for heavy freight traffic.
These members ask how the other member states implement this directive and to what extent those versions align with the Dutch version.
Deze leden vragen op welke wijze de overige lidstaten deze richtlijn implementeren en in hoeverre deze versies aansluiten op de versie van Nederland.
Supports the user-pays and polluter-pays principles and asks for illustrative calculations of full external costs compared with the proposed tariffs.
The GroenLinks-PvdA members support the starting point and design of the truck toll and the basis on which it is levied.
De leden van de GroenLinks-PvdA-fractie steunen het uitgangspunt en de uitwerking van de vrachtwagenheffing en de grondslag waarop deze wordt geheven.

Supports the no-higher-average-tariff principle but asks how monitoring and evaluation of diversion will be done, how an emergency regulation would work, and questions the decision not to carry out an SME test despite ATR advice.
Moreover, these members ask how an emergency regulation would work in practice and within what time period it would take effect if it turns out that rat-running routes are indeed being used.
Bovendien vragen deze leden hoe een eventuele spoedregeling in de praktijk werkt en binnen welke tijdsperiode deze in werking treedt, als blijkt dat inderdaad van sluiproutes gebruik wordt gemaakt.
Asks for an overview of all actors in implementation and supervision, who will act as supervisor, and how revenues will be spent.
The NSC members ask who will fulfil the role of supervisor.
De leden van de NSC-fractie vragen wie de rol van toezichthouder gaat vervullen.
Asks why no formal SME test was carried out despite ATR advice, and asks how effects on emissions and diversion will be monitored and evaluated.
Can it be explained in more detail and at length why a formal SME test was not chosen?
Kan er nader en uitgebreid worden toegelicht waarom er niet is gekozen voor een formele mkb-toets?
Highlights the sharp rise in costs for diesel trucks and asks about business impacts, competitiveness and reactions from sector organisations and non-member businesses.
The BBB members ask the government to reflect on the fact that the costs for ordinary diesel trucks will become almost eight to nine times higher.
De leden van de BBB-fractie vragen de regering om te reflecteren op het feit dat de kosten voor normale dieselvrachtwagens bijna acht à negen keer hoger worden.

Asks why CO2 class discounts cannot yet be set, why revenues are not increased, how 'reëel' external-cost percentages are determined, and what alternatives were considered for the phase-down of revenue return.
The ChristenUnie members ask the government how it determines which percentage of the external costs of air pollution is 'realistic'.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen de regering op welke wijze zij bepaalt welk percentage van de externe kosten van luchtverontreiniging «reëel» is.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division had no remarks on the bill amending the Wet vrachtwagenheffing to implement revised EU tolling rules and advised submitting it to the House of Representatives. The minister's reply reports only drafting changes and technical corrections, including exempting one-day plates and a five-year retention period for certain personal data.
concerns: Redactional changes were made to the explanatory memorandum and the definition of truck was aligned with the explanatory memorandum.

36644.s: The bill creates a standalone Dutch national identity card law (Wet op de Nederlandse identiteitskaart), moving the identity card provisions out of the Passport Act and implementing EU Regulation 2019/1157 on secure identity cards. It sets out eligibility, grounds for refusal (only a travel ban under the temporary counter-terrorism measures act), loss by operation of law, seizure, and oversight by the Minister of the Interior, largely delegating technical detail to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations.
36644.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations mainly as suited to administrative and technical detail that changes often, and links the lapse and refusal rules to the EU regulation and the counter-terrorism measures act.
d: validity period and model of the identity card
card contents, biometrics, and administrative data processing
public identification means: data, technical arrangements, and costs
further rules on data processing in the basic register of travel documents
fees, cost recovery and exemptions for identity card applications
mandate to friendly foreign authorities in exceptional circumstances
identity verification, required documents and security of application process
processing time limits and procedures for issuing identity cards
time limits and procedures for refusal of identity cards
procedures for entry and removal of refusal records in the register
procedures for seizure of identity cards
grounds and manner for permanent withdrawal of identity cards from circulation
detailed procedures and technical security of application and issuance process
p: Refusal of an identity card is possible at the request of the Minister, limited to persons subject to a travel ban under the counter-terrorism measures act, with refusal triggered by an executive request rather than a court decision.

Identity cards lapse by operation of law on several grounds, including a travel ban and reported loss or fraud, and the Minister may record holders in the travel document register without a court decision.
Authorities including police and border guards may seize identity cards, with notification to the holder but no prior judicial authorisation.
Any person holding another's identity card must surrender it to a competent authority.

parties: Asks for clarification of the relationship between central registrations and local travel document administrations, and about the impact analysis and municipal costs.
What additional costs compared to the current situation are there for municipalities in the new situation?
Welke meerkosten ten opzichte van de huidige situatie zijn er in de nieuwe situatie voor gemeenten?
Questions whether the broad delegation and subdelegation powers to AMvB and ministerial regulations undermine parliamentary involvement and the legality principle in Article 10 of the Constitution.
How will the government guarantee that essential safeguards for privacy and data protection are not left to lower legislation?
Hoe gaat de regering garanderen dat essentiële waarborgen voor privacy en gegevensbescherming niet worden overgelaten aan lagere wetgeving?

Raises the unfulfilled Frisian-language motion, asking why the bill does not secure issuing identity cards in Frisian as the Chamber requested, and questions the proposed research on removing height from the card.
These members express their disappointment that this bill does not already provide for the wish of the Chamber.
Deze leden spreken hun teleurstelling uit over het feit dat dit wetsvoorstel niet al voorziet in de wens van de Kamer.
Asks about the consequences of implementation for municipalities and whether the government will compensate additional costs.
Can the government also indicate whether it intends to compensate the additional costs municipalities must incur to implement this new law?
Kan de regering tevens aangeven of zij voornemens is om de extra kosten die gemeenten moeten maken ter uitvoering van deze nieuwe wet te compenseren?
Supports the bill's goals and has no questions.
These members support the goals the bill intends to achieve.
Deze leden steunen de doelen die het wetsvoorstel beoogt.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill on the Dutch identity card must address how its delegation provisions relate to article 10 of the Constitution, given that data protection main rules should be set in statute. The government's reply accepts that main rules belong in the law, moves one delegation into the statute itself, removes one subdelegation, and supplements explanations for the others while retaining ministerial-regulation subdelegation for administrative details.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the bill and explanation address how the many delegation provisions relate to article 10 of the Constitution, which requires main data-protection rules in statute.
The Afdeling questioned the necessity of several delegation grounds, including subdelegation to ministerial regulation, which it said is not self-evident under article 10.

36671.s: The bill implements the EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation by designating Autoriteit Consument en Markt officials to assist the European Commission in inspections, including with police support against resistance, and to carry out inspections on Commission request under national law. It also amends the Aanbestedingswet 2012 to extend procurement rules to postal services and to tighten the definition of special-sector undertakings.
36671.j: The memorandum justifies the powers as required by Article 14 of the EU regulation, which obliges the member state to authorise officials to assist Commission inspections, and limits them to what is necessary.
q: Article 14(5) of the regulation requires the member state to authorise officials to assist Commission inspections.
Artikel 14, vijfde lid, van de verordening eist dat de lidstaat functionarissen machtigt om bijstand te verlenen bij inspecties door de Commissie
p: Designated ACM officials may assist Commission inspections, using police force if needed to overcome resistance, with the powers and necessity and proportionality limits set by EU law.
ACM officials may carry out independent inspections or fact-finding on Commission request with the powers of Article 14(2) of the regulation, using police assistance where necessary.

parties: Asks whether the Commission and ACM have sufficient tools and a low enough threshold to detect market distortion by foreign state-backed companies.
Is the government of the opinion that the current regulation and implementing act give the EC and the ACM sufficient means to uncover this?
Is de regering van mening dat de huidige verordening en uitvoeringswet de EC en de ACM wel voldoende middelen geeft om dit te achterhalen?
Asks whether interim measures target the subsidised firm or the third country itself, and why third countries are not sanctioned directly.
If the measure is only aimed at the undertaking receiving the third-country subsidy, why are no measures imposed on the third country?
Indien de maatregel alleen gericht is op de onderneming die de subsidie van een derde land ontvangt, waarom worden er dan geen maatregelen aan het derde land opgelegd?
Supports tackling unfair competition but asks about overlap with other instruments, the notification duty, administrative burden on SMEs, and oversight of implementation.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Implementation Act for EU Regulation 2022/2560 on foreign subsidies distorting the internal market, and found no remarks to make. The minister's accompanying letter forwards the advice to the Crown and requests that the bill and explanatory memorandum be sent to the Tweede Kamer, with no substantive changes.

36680.s: The bill suspends, for 2026 only, the annual indexation of the maximum hourly rate used to calculate the childcare allowance under the Childcare Act. It takes effect on 1 January 2026 and leaves the executive's existing power to set the hourly rate by general administrative order unchanged.
36680.j: The memorandum justifies the one-off suspension of indexation by the need for sound and sustainable public finances given past and expected expansions of the childcare subsidy.
q: in view of the need for sustainable and durable public finances in light of the substantial expansions of the public subsidy for the use of childcare in the recent past and near future
gelet op de noodzaak tot houdbare en bestendige overheidsfinanciën in het licht van de omvangrijke verruimingen van de publieke vergoeding voor het gebruik van kinderopvang
d: Artikel 1.7, tweede lid, Wet kinderopvang (as referred to in memorandum)
setting the hourly rate used for childcare allowance

parties: Questions whether the government has adequately analysed income effects and whether the decision was made with all relevant information, citing Raad van State doubts.
These members note that the Raad van State is not convinced of the chosen measure.
Deze leden constateren dat de Raad van State zich niet overtuigd toont van de gekozen maatregel.
Accepts the one-year freeze as part of coalition agreement but asks how the government will prevent negative effects on low-income parents.
In the eyes of these members this measure must not result in harm to parents with low incomes.
Deze maatregel mag er in de ogen van deze leden niet toe leiden dat dit ten koste gaat van ouders met een laag inkomen.
