Opposes the freeze as harming working parents and asks detailed questions on effects, which the government has not quantified, and on whether the government will gather more information before proceeding.
Reviews the alternatives in the explanatory memorandum and asks about their structural versus one-off nature.
Criticises the freeze's burden on low incomes, questions the feasibility of the planned free childcare, and asks why the government sets aside concerns from consultation and the Raad van State.
Asks for explanation of past investments, alternatives considered, and why the legislature did not include an option to waive indexation in the law.
The SGP members ask the government what the reason is that the legislature did not choose to include a possibility in the law to waive annual indexation.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen de regering wat de reden is dat de wetgever er niet voor heeft gekozen een mogelijkheid in de wet op te nemen om af te zien van jaarlijkse indexatie.

Calls the saving a lazy choice, criticises the absence of quantified effects, asks for price regulation, and asks the government to explain the Raad van State's objection that no less burdensome alternatives were considered.
The ChristenUnie members agree with the Raad van State's criticism that the explanation does not convincingly show why this measure was chosen.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie sluiten zich aan bij de kritiek van de Raad van State dat uit de toelichting niet overtuigend blijkt waarom is gekozen voor deze maatregel.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised the government to further justify its decision not to index the childcare maximum hourly rates in 2026, arguing it could reduce affordability and access for low-income parents and lacks convincing reasoning against less burdensome alternatives. In its reply, the State Secretary partly accepted the advice by sharpening the explanatory memorandum on the relationship to childcare goals, alternatives considered, and the one-off nature of the measure, but maintained the non-indexation as the chosen savings instrument.
concerns: The Council questions how non-indexation fits the childcare system's goals of labour participation and child development, and asks for further justification of the savings measure; the government clarified the relationship in the memorandum but kept the measure, citing the low-income parents already at the maximum reimbursement rate.

The Council warns non-indexation may raise costs for low-income parents, risking displacement, and the explanatory memorandum does not convincingly show why less burdensome alternatives were rejected; the government expanded its discussion of alternatives but still prefers non-indexation.

The Council notes non-indexation could strain consistency and predictability of government policy; the government stressed the measure is explicitly one-off in the bill and committed to informing affected parties, and added this to the memorandum.

36707.s: The bill makes a bundle of technical and editorial corrections across education laws under the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, mainly harmonising terms (leerling to onderwijsdeelnemer, ouders, instelling) and fixing cross-references. It also removes obsolete provisions, such as the lichamelijke opvoeding hours clause, a stage funds rule, and transitional arrangements.
q: The term «leerling» has been replaced by the term «onderwijsdeelnemer».
Het begrip «leerling» is vervangen door het begrip «onderwijsdeelnemer».

parties: Asks why the government has not yet sent a proposal to reverse the VAT increase on books, newspapers, culture, media and sport, and whether the 1.3 billion euro increase is structurally off the table.
Can the government reassure these people and state that the entire 1.3 billion euro VAT increase is actually structurally off the table?
Kan de regering deze mensen geruststellen en aangeven dat de hele € 1,3 miljard aan btw-verhoging daadwerkelijk structureel van tafel is?
Welcomes the technical and drafting corrections in the OCW repair bill and has no questions.
welcome these repairs and have no questions about them
juichen deze reparaties toe en hebben daarover geen vragen

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State gave a favourable opinion on a technical repair bill for education, culture and science, raising no substantive remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's reply notes only some editorial improvements and an added transitional/samenloop provision, with no substantive changes.
concerns: The Afdeling made no substantive remarks on the bill, and the government made some editorial improvements and added a samenloop provision.

36716.s: The bill amends the Medicines Act (Geneesmiddelenwet) to expressly allow advice from pharmacists or drugstore assistants to customers at a distance (by digital communication) when selling non-prescription UAD medicines, including via online shops. It requires that the quality-of-care conditions of article 62(2) also apply to remote sales and that sufficient (assistant-)drugstore staff be available to give such advice.
36716.j: The memorandum justifies the change by pointing to the Council of State ruling of 4 November 2020 and to the value of online communication in healthcare, and it states that supervision remains with the IGJ and the Medicines Evaluation Board.
q: Supervision of the sale of UAD medicines is guaranteed by the basic requirement of providing responsible care.
Het toezicht op de verkoop van UAD-geneesmiddelen wordt gegarandeerd met de basiseis: het bieden van verantwoorde zorg.

parties: Asks what problem the bill solves and for practical examples justifying the change from current law.
What shows that this is necessary and that current legislation would no longer be sufficient?
Waaruit blijkt dat dit nodig is en de huidige wetgeving niet meer afdoende zou zijn?
Balance between access and safety; worries about interpretive room in article 62, vulnerable patients and the need for uniform norms and enforcement.
On this delicate balance between availability and safety, and how the government fills it in, these members have several questions.
Over deze delicate balans tussen beschikbaarheid en veiligheid, en hoe die door de regering wordt ingevuld hebben deze leden meerdere vragen.
Supports digitalisation but asks about risks of NSAIDs, the European pharmaceutical legislation review and the enforcement role of supervisors.
These members are positive about the proposal, since care now and health tomorrow require legal room for digitalisation.
Genoemde leden staan positief tegenover het voorstel, immers voor de zorg van nu en de gezondheid van morgen, is wettelijke ruimte nodig voor digitalisering.
Fears lower threshold for retailers without pharmaceutical expertise to sell medicines and questions why the broader amendment rather than targeted change to article 67a.
These members are concerned that this lowers the threshold for various shops to offer medicines, as long as a digital advice service is available.
Deze leden maken zich zorgen dat dit de drempel verlaagt voor uiteenlopende winkels om geneesmiddelen aan te bieden, zolang er maar een digitale adviesvoorziening beschikbaar is.
Supports online advice but asks how quality equivalence, accessibility for vulnerable groups and structural monitoring will be ensured.
To that end these members ask how it will be established whether the digital communication facilities are actually sufficiently understandable and accessible for vulnerable groups.
Daartoe vragen deze leden hoe vastgesteld zal worden of de digitale communicatievoorzieningen daadwerkelijk voldoende begrijpelijk en toegankelijk zullen zijn voor kwetsbare groepen.
Asks how people less digitally skilled and rural areas keep access to clear, personal advice.
How does this bill ensure that people who are not digitally skilled can still always get clear and personal explanation in the shop?
Hoe zorgt dit wetsvoorstel ervoor dat mensen die niet digitaal vaardig zijn, toch altijd duidelijke en persoonlijke uitleg kunnen krijgen in de winkel?
Wants better practical data, asks whether some physical presence should remain, and sees a grey zone for pharmacists hired by multiple shops.
These members ask whether the government has considered still requiring partial physical presence as a condition.
Deze leden vragen of de regering heeft overwogen om nog wel als eis te stellen dat er deels fysieke aanwezigheid is.
Asks what 'sufficient' availability means, the absence of an explicit physical-presence norm, and how the IGJ uses the field norm in enforcement.
Can the government clarify what is meant by 'sufficient'?
Kan de regering verduidelijken wat wordt verstaan onder «voldoende»?
Worries that loosening supervision erodes quality assurance and asks whether physical presence should remain mandatory in shops, plus risks of bulk purchases.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering reviewed a bill amending the Geneesmiddelenwet to allow digital communication means for pharmacy advice on sales of UAD medicines and raised no remarks, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport merely transmits the advice and notes that the memorie van toelichting was supplemented on some points.

36725-IIA.s: The bill amends the 2025 budget of the States General (Staten-Generaal) through the first supplementary budget, adding about EUR 3.9 million in commitments and expenditure across the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer and joint interparliamentary articles, with retroactive effect to 1 June 2025. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and provides the formal enactment and entry-into-force clauses.
36725-IIA.j: The memorandum justifies the budget increases by pointing to project costs, such as the new parliamentary information system and the modern workplace, and the OSCE Parliamentary Assembly session, without any delegation of power.
q: The need has emerged for an amendment to the budget of the States General for the year 2025.
De noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal voor het jaar 2025.

36734.s: The bill amends the 2025 budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs by adding an incidental supplementary budget of EUR 1 million per year (2026-2029) for a new maatwerkgarantie (tailored guarantee) instrument under policy article 2 on innovation and entrepreneurship. The explanatory memorandum sets out the budgetary effects and states that budget flexibility of the article is unchanged.
q: Maatwerkgaranties 0 1,000 1,000 1,000 1,000 1,000 1,000 (budgetary increase for tailored guarantees)

36740-V.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Slotwet), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across its policy and non-policy articles following the supplementary budgets. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, applying retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: We ... have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2024
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2024

36743.s: The bill amends the Dutch Civil Code (Book 8 and Book 10) to recognise electronic bills of lading as legally equivalent to paper ones, including rules on control, transfer and replacement. It sets out reliability requirements for electronic methods but leaves the detailed methods to practice and requires a review report within three years.
36743.j: The memorandum justifies leaving reliable methods to practice because the technology is developing and parties can agree on electronic issuance, with no obligation to use it.
q: It is left to practice to develop reliable methods on the basis of which the authenticity can be guaranteed, control can be established and the electronic file can maintain its integrity.

Het wordt aan de praktijk overgelaten om betrouwbare methodes te ontwikkelen op basis waarvan de authenticiteit kan worden gewaarborgd, de zeggenschap kan worden vastgesteld en hoe ervoor kan worden gezorgd dat het elektronisch bestand zijn integriteit behoudt
d: Artikel I C, artikel 400 lid 1 (betrouwbare methode)
reliable methods for electronic bill of lading; left to practice

parties: Asks about technology neutrality, authenticity verification, who supervises the methods, and the delayed entry into force of the Rotterdam Rules, without arguing for more or less executive discretion.
Who supervises the reliability of the chosen methods?
Wie houdt er toezicht op de betrouwbaarheid van de gekozen methodes?
Asks for an implementation test one year after entry into force and a shorter, explicit evaluation deadline so the law can be adjusted in practice.
These members ask the government whether this period can be shortened and additionally request a more explicit inclusion in the bill rather than 'within X years'.
Deze leden vragen de regering of deze termijn kan worden verkort en vragen bovendien om een expliciete(re) opname in het wetsvoorstel daarvan (in plaats van « binnen X jaar»).
Supports further digitalisation and efficiency in goods transport and sees no reason for detailed substantive comment at this stage.
These members support further digitalisation regarding the electronic bill of lading and improving efficiency in goods transport.
De leden van de D66-fractie onderschrijven de verdere digitalisering met betrekking tot het elektronisch cognossement en het verbeteren van de efficiëntie in het goederenverkeer.
Asks whether reliable authentication methods exist and whether problems are foreseen when electronic bills of lading are presented to a court in legal disputes, leaving these to practice.
These members ask the government whether possible practical problems are foreseen when presenting electronic bills of lading to the court.
Deze leden vragen aan de regering of in dezen mogelijke problemen in de praktijk worden voorzien bij het voorleggen van elektronische cognossementen aan de rechter.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering gave advice on a bill amending Book 8 of the Civil Code to introduce the electronic bill of lading, raising no substantive objections and recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport notes only drafting updates and clarifications to the explanatory memorandum, such as a clearer passage on acquiring ownership or a pledge and an added practical example.

36815.s: The bill differentiates the Dutch aviation tax per passenger by final destination, setting three rates: a lower rate for states in Annex A, a higher rate for states in Annex B, and the highest rate for all others or where destination is unknown. It adds a definition of final destination, requires airport operators to prescribe how passenger data is provided, and takes effect on 1 January 2027.
36815.j: The memorandum justifies the rate categories by legal certainty and feasibility for airports and airlines, and explains that a central registration of frequent flyers was rejected due to privacy intrusion and implementation problems.
q: By categorising states by means of annexes, it is clear in advance to airports and airlines, and verifiable, which rate applies to a given final destination.

Door staten aan de hand van bijlagen te categoriseren, is het voor luchthavens en luchtvaartmaatschappijen op voorhand helder en controleerbaar welk tarief van toepassing is bij een bepaalde eindbestemming.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 79, eerste lid)
manner of providing passenger destination data prescribed by airport operator
p: Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 79, eerste lid)
Airport operators, rather than statute, may prescribe the manner in which passenger destination information is supplied for the tax return.

parties: Asks how high external costs are, whether they are internalised, and who bears remaining costs, and questions whether revenue is used to cover them.
Can the government indicate how high these costs are for both short and long flights and to what extent these costs are internalised by the new proposal?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe hoog deze kosten zijn voor zowel korte als lange vluchten en in welke mate deze kosten met het nieuwe voorstel wel zijn geïnternaliseerd?
Asks the government to justify unilateral national differentiation, to provide evaluation and to reconsider the tariff structure if the measure only shifts traffic.
If the evaluation shows that the measure mainly leads to a shift of air traffic without environmental gain, these members ask whether the government is willing to reconsider the tariff structure.

Indien uit de evaluatie blijkt dat de maatregel hoofdzakelijk leidt tot verplaatsing van vliegverkeer zonder milieuwinst, vragen deze leden of de regering bereid is de tariefstructuur te heroverwegen.
Supports the aim but asks about EU level playing field, border avoidance, the Suriname exception and a possible private jet supertariff.
These members ask the government how this differentiation relates to the aim of a level playing field within Europe and how it is prevented that travellers divert to airports just across the border.

Deze leden vragen de regering hoe deze differentiatie zich verhoudt tot het streven naar een gelijk speelveld binnen Europa en hoe wordt voorkomen dat reizigers uitwijken naar luchthavens net over de grens.

Questions the arbitrary destination classifications and exceptions for North Africa and outermost regions, and asks why alternatives such as frequent-flyer levies were not explored, noting an advisory body's criticism.
Can the government further explain this choice, also in view of the fact that in a neighbouring country such as Germany these countries are placed in the lower category?
Kan de regering deze keuze nader toelichten, ook met het oog op het feit dat in een omliggend land als Duitsland deze landen in de lagere categorie zijn geplaatst?
Has a critical basic stance, asks for structural monitoring of effects and for an earlier evaluation after three years.
Is it possible to bring the evaluation forward and have it take place already after three years?
Is het mogelijk de evaluatie naar voren te halen en deze reeds na drie jaar te laten plaatsvinden?
Questions whether border countries' rates were sufficiently considered and whether the budget target should outweigh real effects on citizens and business.
These members ask the government whether a budgetary target should weigh more heavily than the real consequences for citizens and businesses of a particular design.
Deze leden vragen de regering of een budgettaire taakstelling zwaarder moet wegen dan de reële gevolgen voor burgers en bedrijfsleven van een bepaalde vormgeving.
Asks how the Surinamese diaspora's interests were weighed in the destination lists and about the consequences for families and low-income travellers.
When drawing up these lists, has the government taken into account the strong historical ties between Suriname and the Netherlands?
Heeft de regering bij het opstellen van deze lijsten rekening gehouden met de sterke historische verbondenheid tussen Suriname en Nederland?
Questions arbitrary exceptions and double taxation risk on connecting flights, and asks for a transparent decision scheme and whether the rules lead to fairness and clarity.
Why was no clear system without such exceptions chosen?
Waarom is niet gekozen voor een heldere systematiek zonder dergelijke uitzonderingen?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the bill differentiating the aviation tax by distance be supplemented with a European law section, since the exceptions to the distance criterion (EU member states, outermost regions, Dutch Caribbean, Tunisia and Algeria) raise questions of non-discrimination and state aid that the explanatory memorandum did not address. The government's reply states that a European law section and a state aid analysis have been added to the explanatory memorandum, justifying the differentiated tariffs on objective criteria.
concerns: The Council asked for a European law section on non-discrimination and the objective justification of the tariff exceptions, which the government added to the explanatory memorandum.

The Council asked for analysis of possible EU state aid implications of the exceptions, and the government added an analysis concluding there is no state aid, though it did not contact the Commission.

The Council questioned why the equal-treatment rationale was not applied more broadly to other territories, such as Sint Maarten versus Martinique, and the government defended the differences as justified by legal status and effects.

36824.s: This omnibus repair bill corrects minor technical defects across many Dutch laws, updates ministerial designations after the cabinet reshuffle, and moves provisions from the Omgevingswet safety-net regulation into formal statute. It also makes amendments touching the Omgevingswet, the Huisvestingswet, the Ombudsman's publicity rules, and housing and pension laws.
36824.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as technical reparation of defects, updating ministerial designations, and moving safety-net rules into formal law so they are more transparent and legally certain.
q: Strictly speaking the designation does not need to be changed.
Strikt genomen hoeft de aanduiding niet te worden aangepast.
d: Artikel III (Algemene pensioen- en uitkeringswet politieke ambtsdragers, art. 52b, 1st and 4th paragraphs)
rules on job-search support cost reimbursement and provider requirements
Artikel III (Wet Appa, art. 52b, 3rd paragraph; art. 132b)
rules on reintegration plan components, allowances and cost reimbursement
Artikel XXXIX / Artikel XVII (Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte, maximum rent definitions)
maximum rent limits for rental housing (via statute cross-references)
p: Clarifies and reorganises the expiry rules for pre-emptive rights (voorkeursrechten) on land, with time limits tied to adopted plans and a possible extension by the authority.
Artikel XII, onder D (Omgevingswet art. 9.1, 5th paragraph)
Lets the authority determine in a pre-emptive right decision which planning document will create a follow-on basis for the right, affecting landowners' expiry timing.
Artikel XII, onder B (Omgevingswet art. 16.122 etc.)
Routine renaming of ministerial designations and technical cross-reference corrections in many articles.
Artikel IV, onder A and B (Algemene wet bestuursrecht art. 9:36, 9:36a)

Makes information held by the Ombudsman about investigations non-public unless it is in the report, and routes Wet open overheid requests about such information to the administrative body concerned, narrowing transparency of ombudsman investigations.
Removes the words 'geheel of gedeeltelijk' from the withdrawal power, a clarification that does not expand the power in substance.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division had no remarks on a technical bill transferring provisions from the Vangnetregeling Omgevingswet into formal law and fixing legislative gaps, and advised submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport adds several technical amendments (pension law, Awb ombudsman provisions, Huisvestingswet, Omgevingswet, rent regulation and cross-reference corrections) without substantive objections being addressed.
concerns: The Afdeling had no remarks on the proposal and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer.

36833.s: The bill amends the Wft to implement Directive (EU) 2024/927, updating rules on delegation, liquidity risk management, supervisory reporting, depositary services and loan origination by alternative investment funds and UCITS. It replaces references to FATF non-cooperative jurisdiction lists with EU high-risk third country criteria and grants AFM powers to suspend redemptions in exceptional circumstances after consulting the manager.
36833.j: The memorandum justifies the new and expanded powers as needed to harmonise EU rules, protect investors and safeguard financial stability, as required by the directive.
d: AFM may order suspension or lifting of redemptions of fund units
p: The AFM may order a manager to suspend redemptions of fund units in exceptional circumstances after consulting the manager, on grounds of investor protection or financial stability, with DNB advice in the stability case.
DNB may demand additional data from fund managers, periodically or not, when it considers this necessary to safeguard financial system stability.
The AFM may require additional data from Dutch fund managers on its own judgement where it deems this necessary for financial stability, and on request from ESMA.
UCITS managers may suspend subscriptions and redemptions in exceptional cases in the interest of participants, with notification to the AFM.

parties: The D66 fractie has no questions at this stage.
The members of the D66 fractie have taken note of the bill but currently have no questions about it.
De leden van de D66-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel, maar hebben op dit moment hierover geen vragen.

The VVD asks whether requiring AFM approval for sharing internal business activities goes beyond EU directives and adds burdens, and whether a new AFM check is needed where requirements are already met.
Does the government agree with these members that this does not follow from the EU directives and leads to additional burdens?
Is de regering het met deze leden eens dat dit niet volgt uit de EU-richtlijnen en leidt tot extra lasten?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Implementation Act for the amended AIFM and UCITS directives, raising no remarks and recommending submission to the House of Representatives. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport notes that some technical and editorial changes were made (article 4:1, articles 4:37ic and 4:37p, the explanatory note on article 2:67a and the transposition table) but does not respond to substantive points because none were raised.

36850-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget statement of the other High Councils of State, the Governors' offices of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, and the Electoral Council, via a second supplementary budget. It changes budgeted commitments, expenditure and receipts for those bodies, most notably reducing Raad van State appellate immigration case spending and increasing the Electoral Council's budget, and it takes effect retroactively from 1 December 2025.
36850-IIB.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to lower-than-forecast immigration appeal caseloads at the Raad van State, with no delegation or new power claimed.
q: The number of cases before the Raad van State on appeal in immigration matters (HBV) is lagging behind the forecasts.
Het aantal zaken bij de Raad van State in hoger beroep vreemdelingenzaken (HBV) blijft achter ten opzichte van de prognoses.

36860.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2023/2673 on distance-concluded financial services contracts by amending the Wft, Dutch Civil Code Book 6 and the Consumer Protection Enforcement Act, including a consumer withdrawal button and extended precontractual information duties. It also lets an AMvB extend the Wft distance-contract rules to newly defined products and services and sets rules on AFM and ACM enforcement.
36860.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB power by the need to quickly cover new financial products that fall outside sector-specific EU law.
q: To ensure that new (financial) products and services not covered by sector-specific EU legislation also comply with the directive's rules, products or services may be designated by general administrative order.

Om ervoor te zorgen dat nieuwe (financiële) producten en diensten die niet onder sectorspecifieke Uniewetgeving vallen, ook aan de regels van de richtlijn dienen te voldoen, kunnen bij algemene maatregel van bestuur producten of diensten worden aangewezen
d: designating products or services subject to distance-contract rules
p: Allows an AMvB to extend Wft distance-contract information and conduct rules to newly designated products or services without a statutory amendment, though the scope is limited to the listed provisions.

parties: Asks how compliance with the withdrawal function and website accessibility will be checked, how AFM will be resourced, and how administrative burden on SMEs is proportionate.
How is it checked whether the withdrawal function on websites is actually clearly visible and accessible?
Hoe wordt gecontroleerd of de ontbindingsfunctie op websites daadwerkelijk goed zichtbaar en toegankelijk is?
Sees value in the consumer protections but asks why telephone contracts are excluded from the click-to-cancel obligation and whether consumers and bodies like Kifid can report misleading websites.
These members ask whether, given those two aims, it would not be wise to introduce a click-to-cancel option for telephone-concluded contracts too.
Deze leden vragen of het vanuit die twee doelen dan ook niet verstandig is om wel een click-to-cancel optie voor telefonisch gesloten contracten in te voeren.
Has no questions on the bill.
The JA21 members have taken note of the bill and refrain from asking questions.
De leden van de JA21-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en zien af van het stellen van vragen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill implementing the EU directive on distance-concluded financial services contracts and raised no remarks, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply notes that an article implementing the Accessibility Directive was added to correct an omission, along with some editorial improvements.

36905.s: The bill implements the EU e-evidence package by letting service providers offering services in the Netherlands designate establishments or legal representatives to receive and enforce European production and preservation orders, with the Authority for Consumers and Markets as central authority and supervisor. It also amends the Code of Criminal Procedure to designate the public prosecutor and investigating judge as issuing authorities, sets fines up to 2% of global turnover for non-compliance, and provides for judicial review by the district court.
36905.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers as necessary to implement the mandatory EU regulation and directive on electronic evidence.
q: The European production order and European preservation order cannot be issued by competent Dutch authorities where the designated establishment is established in the Netherlands or the legal representative resides in the Netherlands.

Het Europees verstrekkingsbevel en het Europees bewaringsbevel kunnen door bevoegde Nederlandse autoriteiten niet worden uitgevaardigd indien de aangewezen vestiging in Nederland is gevestigd of de wettelijke vertegenwoordiger in Nederland verblijft.
d: place of designation or appointment of addressees
p: The supervisory authority is denied certain investigative powers under the General Administrative Law Act when supervising compliance with the bill's obligations.
Public prosecutors may issue European production and preservation orders, with investigating judge authorization required only for traffic and content data.

parties: Asks how direct orders without judicial involvement can respect proportionality, effective legal protection, fair trial rights and ne bis in idem.
Supports the aims but questions whether the ACM is a suitable supervisor and how ministerial responsibility and oversight of the legal representative are organised.
These members note that the task the bill assigns to the ACM does not in principle fit the ACM well, because it is not market supervision.
Deze leden constateren dat de taak die het wetsvoorstel toebedeelt aan de ACM in beginsel niet goed past bij de ACM, omdat het geen markttoezicht betreft.
Worried about legal protection since the instruments operate without prior judicial authorisation and about use for politically motivated prosecutions; asks what remedies providers have.
they believe there is reason for concern regarding, among other things, legal protection now that these instruments will be used without the intervention of a judge beforehand.
menen zij dat er reden tot zorg is ten aanzien van onder andere de rechtsbescherming nu het gebruik van deze instrumenten zonder tussenkomst van een rechter vooraf gaat gebeuren.
Asks technical and procedural questions on notification duties, refusal grounds and implementation capacity without raising a check concern.
These members have some further questions for the government about this bill.
Deze leden hebben nog enkele vragen aan de regering over dit wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Uitvoeringswet elektronisch bewijsmateriaal implementing EU regulation 2023/1543 and directive 2023/1544 on cross-border electronic evidence. It raised two points: whether omitting 'met rechtspersoonlijkheid' widens the addressee obligation beyond the directive, and whether the ACM needs the investigation, sampling and seizure power in article 5:18 Awb. The government's reply accepted both points, clarified the position of natural persons, and removed article 5:18 powers from ACM supervision.
concerns: The Afdeling asked to explain or align the omission of 'met rechtspersoonlijkheid' so the scope does not exceed the directive; the government clarified natural persons must themselves be addressee and amended the bill and explanation.
The Afdeling questioned whether the ACM needs the investigation, sampling and seizure power of article 5:18 Awb for supervision; the government excluded this power from ACM supervision.

36923.s: The bill raises the income-related child budget (kindgebonden budget) amount to EUR 2,511 per child on the 2025 basis and adds a separate extra phase-out rate of 4.30% on income above EUR 60,000. It also amends the Civil Procedure Code's calculation of attachable amounts so the new phase-out is accounted for, with the amounts indexed under the existing Act.
36923.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as directing the budget to parents most in need and using general funds efficiently, but it does not justify any delegation of power.
q: to allocate the child-related budget to parents who most need financial support
het kindgebonden budget toe te kennen aan ouders die de financiële ondersteuning het meest nodig hebben
d: Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 3, zevende lid)
indexation of child budget amounts by Minister

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, without any substantive remarks, that the bill raising the kindgebonden budget phase-out percentage for parents with a test income from €60,000 be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister's nader rapport reports that the ATR's comments were incorporated, that the ATR has no further comments, and that a Civil Code change to the beslagvrije voet formula was added to protect indebted households.

36932.s: The bill simplifies the partner concept for benefits by removing the cohabitation-address criterion and the partner rules tied to the same address in the prior year and the rest of the year, while adding a notarial cohabitation contract ground and excluding minors. It also moves existing exceptions into a delegated general administrative order and lowers wealth limits for the healthcare allowance and child-related budget.
36932.j: The memorandum justifies moving exceptions to the administrative order because detailed statutory rules for small groups are undesirable and the order allows faster additions, while the Council of State's advice against detailed legislation is cited.
q: By including the exceptions in the UB Awir, it is first of all prevented that for relatively small groups of households in proportion to the total population of benefit recipients, provisions at statutory level must be made.

Door de uitzonderingen op te nemen in het UB Awir wordt allereerst naar de toekomst toe voorkomen dat voor relatief kleine groepen huishoudens in verhouding tot de totale populatie toeslaggerechtigden voorzieningen op wetsniveau hoeven te worden getroffen.
d: partner status for cohabitation in notarial contract
rules on which person counts as partner when several qualify under same category
designation of persons excluded from partner status and exceptions to partner concept
treatment of legally separated persons as unmarried
p: Exceptions to the statutory partner concept are moved to a general administrative order, letting the executive designate excluded persons without parliamentary approval.
I.A.1 en I.A.4 (art. 3 lid 1 en lid 3 nieuw)
Partner determination for multiple candidates is partly left to a general administrative order.
IV, VI (zorgtoeslag en kindgebonden budget vermogensgrens)
Lower wealth thresholds terminate benefit entitlement for households above new limits, affecting property interests without individualized review.

parties: Asks whether the new partner definition could still lead to incorrect partnership determinations in implementation.
Can the government indicate how the new partner definition will not still lead to incorrect partnership determinations in implementation?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe de nieuwe partnerdefinitie in de uitvoering niet alsnog leidt tot onjuiste partnerschapsvaststellingen?
Questions whether the asset-limit reduction is double-counted against the planned 2028 harmonisation and whether it is a sound way to fund the bill.
Supports simplification but questions whether the bill achieves the stated goals and raises concern about broader inconsistency in asset limits across regimes.
At the same time these members ask whether the bill sufficiently achieves the stated objectives.
Tegelijkertijd vragen deze leden of het voorliggende wetsvoorstel de genoemde doelstellingen wel voldoende bereikt.
Asks whether formal partnership could be deliberately avoided and whether unreported partnerships could go undetected, and what enforcement remains.
These members ask whether there is any enforcement or control of an actual situation at all.
Deze leden vragen Of enige sprake is van handhaving of controle op een feitelijke situatie.
Objects to coupling a simplification with a budget-driven cut to asset limits, questions the draagkracht principle, enforceability and perverse incentives, and asks for a restructuring roadmap.
In the view of these members two decisions of different nature are being coupled here.
Naar het oordeel van deze leden worden hier twee beslissingen van verschillende aard aan elkaar gekoppeld.
Worries about unequal treatment between composite and non-composite families and about frequent changes creating uncertainty.
Does this not lead to undesirable unequal treatment?
Leidt dit niet tot ongewenste ongelijke behandeling?
Asks whether people who should count as partners may fail to apply and therefore receive too much allowance, and requests quantification.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports simplifying the toeslag partner concept but advises a fundamental review of the asset limits for zorgtoeslag and kindgebonden budget, clarification of whether an EP art. 1 property right is affected, consistency in what is set by law versus AMvB, and alignment with the AWR nursing-home rule. The government reply largely accepts the advice: it commits to reviewing the asset test, clarifies the property-right justification, explains the statutory placement of partner rules, and points to a separate fiscal study on the AWR rule.
concerns: The Afdeling advises clarifying whether the zorgtoeslag and kindgebonden budget fall under the property right of EP art. 1 and motivating any expectation; the government accepts an interference may exist and adds justification in the memorie van toelichting.

The Afdeling advises a more fundamental review of the asset limits for zorgtoeslag and kindgebonden budget, since the proposed cut is driven by budget coverage; the government agrees to examine it and plans to align with box 3 exempt assets, but defers a fundamental revision to a separate bill.

The Afdeling advises consistency in which partner-concept elements are set in statute versus AMvB; the government explains that elements creating partnership are set in law and exceptions that end partnership go to an AMvB, and clarifies this in the memorie van toelichting.

The Afdeling advises addressing the mismatch between the AWR nursing-home partner rule and practice; the government explains the Belastingdienst practice fits the AWR and defers any change to a broader fiscal study, with the explanation added to the memorie van toelichting.

36950.s: The bill amends the Criminal Code and Code of Criminal Procedure to create a bridging procedure for prosecuting and trying indictable offences (ambtsmisdrijven) committed by MPs, Ministers and State Secretaries while the constitutional amendment is pending. It transfers investigation to the Procureur-Generaal at the Supreme Court, lets Parliament and government jointly end an investigation, repeals the ministerial criminal liability articles 355-356 Sr and the Wmv, and sets seven judges for Supreme Court trials.
36950.j: The memorandum justifies the new procedure as necessary to remove practical obstacles under the current Article 119 Constitution pending a constitutional amendment, citing the Fokkens commission and GRECO criticism.
q: Within the current Constitution the bill can establish a workable procedure that removes practical obstacles to prosecution and trial.
Het wetsvoorstel kan wel binnen de kaders van de huidige Grondwet een werkbare procedure in het leven roepen, waarmee praktische belemmeringen voor vervolging en berechting worden weggenomen.
d: Artikel II, D (art. 162 Sv) and Titel I Vierde Boek Sv (art. 485a-485f)
investigation and prosecution of ambtsmisdrijven by Procureur-Generaal at the Supreme Court
p: Artikel II, Titel I Vierde Boek Sv (art. 485c)
Parliament and government may jointly order the Procureur-Generaal to end an ongoing investigation, with notification to both bodies and publication in the Staatscourant.
Artikel II, Titel I Vierde Boek Sv (art. 484-485)
Supreme Court acts as sole trial court in first and only instance for ambtsmisdrijven, excluding appeal and cassation for these cases, while medeverdachten are moved to regular courts.
Artikel I, A and B (art. 355-356 Sr)
Repeals vague criminal offences for ministers acting unlawfully, citing legality and legal certainty concerns, which reduces criminal accountability of executive officials.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Herzieningswet ambtsmisdrijven, a bill revising the procedure for prosecuting ministers and MPs for official crimes, mainly criticising the two-track approach, the retained political role in prosecution decisions, and the three-instance trial; the Dutch government's nader rapport responds, accepting several points such as the 6-month investigation term and the explanation of the Hoge Raad's role in procedural matters. The government's reply largely follows the advice on the investigation term and procedural motivation but does not change the basic two-track structure or the three-instance trial model.
concerns: The Afdeling objects that the bill retains government and parliamentary power to order stopping investigations, creating a statutory basis for political influence on prosecution of official crimes.
The Afdeling questions whether the interim two-track approach via the Herzieningswet is justified given the drawbacks and the lengthy constitutional amendment process.
The Afdeling is not convinced that trial in three instances is justified for this small group, given the harmful effect of prolonged suspicion on parliamentary trust.
The Afdeling advises lengthening the initial investigation term to six months with extensions in six-month steps, which the government adopted.

The Afdeling asks for justification of why the Hoge Raad and procureur-generaal act as judge and prosecutor in other criminal procedures, which the government explained in the memorie van toelichting.
